## Cross correlation of gene abundance per annotation for UMAP
https://embed.tidymodels.org/reference/step_umap.html

- do not have organelle IP data, but have very rich proteinIDs from the nDIA
- idea now is, for each organelle annotation list, to calculate the correlation of the proteins against each other, based on the log2FC from KO/Ctrl.
- have to embed the effect of the KO/Ctrl into the correlation
- then use these correlations and embed them in an UMAP.
- So in simple terms we embed the correlations of protein abundance influences both by the knockout (KO) and the local, synthetic protein environment (annotations)
```{r}
#install.packages("umap")
#library(umap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
#install.packages("uwot")
library(uwot)

# create new df variable, so it will not get corrupted 
UMAP_d50_df <- complete_data_annotated_day50

# Define your annotations
annotation_columns <- names(log2FC_d50_annotated)[(ncol(log2FC_d50_annotated)-19):ncol(log2FC_d50_annotated)]

# Step: Define usable annotations
usable_annotations <- colnames(complete_data_annotated_day50)[
  (ncol(complete_data_annotated_day50) - 17):ncol(complete_data_annotated_day50)
]

# Drop problematic or overly specific annotations
usable_annotations <- setdiff(usable_annotations, c("Autophagy..Detailed.", "EndoDetailed"))

# Function to process one annotation
process_annotation_umap <- function(usable_annotations) {
  # Step 1: Filter by annotation
  filtered <- log2FC_d50_annotated %>% filter(.data[[usable_annotations]] == TRUE)
  
  # Step 2: Extract log2FC matrix
  log2fc_mat <- filtered[, 2:47]
  log2fc_mat[is.na(log2fc_mat)] <- 0
  rownames(log2fc_mat) <- filtered$Genes
  
  # Step 3: Gene correlation
  gene_corr <- cor(t(log2fc_mat), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  gene_corr[is.na(gene_corr)] <- 0
  
  # Step 4: UMAP
  if (nrow(gene_corr) < 3) return(NULL)  # Skip tiny sets
  umap_res <- umap(gene_corr, n_neighbors = 10, min_dist = 0.1, metric = "correlation")
  
  # Step 5: Format output
  umap_df <- as.data.frame(umap_res)
  umap_df$Gene <- rownames(gene_corr)
  umap_df$Annotation <- usable_annotations
  return(umap_df)
}

# Run across all annotations
umap_all <- usable_annotations %>%
  map_dfr(~process_annotation_umap(.x))

# Plot UMAP embeddings
ggplot(umap_all, aes(x = V1, y = V2)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Annotation, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "UMAP Embedding of Gene Correlation per Organelle Annotation",
       x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2")




# ----- annotation based UMAP ------ # 
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(uwot)
library(ggplot2)


# --- Step 0: Copy input to avoid corrupting original ---
UMAP_d50_df <- complete_data_annotated_day50

# --- Step 1: Prepare log2FC and annotation matrices ---
log2fc_matrix_d50 <- UMAP_d50_df[, 2:47]
log2fc_matrix_d50[is.na(log2fc_matrix_d50)] <- 0
rownames(log2fc_matrix_d50) <- UMAP_d50_df$Genes

annotation_matrix_d50 <- UMAP_d50_df[, 48:ncol(UMAP_d50_df)]
rownames(annotation_matrix_d50) <- UMAP_d50_df$Genes

# Drop problematic annotations
annotation_matrix_d50 <- annotation_matrix_d50 %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("Autophagy..Detailed.", "EndoDetailed"))

# --- Step 2: Identify valid annotations with ≥ 3 genes ---
valid_annotations <- annotation_matrix_d50 %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(.x == TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Annotation", values_to = "Count") %>%
  filter(Count >= 3) %>%
  pull(Annotation)

# --- Step 3: Compute flattened correlation matrices ---
organelle_cor_vectors <- list()
max_length <- 0

for (ann in valid_annotations) {
  genes <- rownames(annotation_matrix_d50)[annotation_matrix_d50[[ann]] == TRUE]
  sub_mat <- log2fc_matrix_d50[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sub_mat) < 3) next

  corr_mat <- cor(t(sub_mat), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  corr_mat[is.na(corr_mat)] <- 0

  corr_vec <- as.vector(corr_mat)
  organelle_cor_vectors[[ann]] <- corr_vec

  max_length <- max(max_length, length(corr_vec))
}

# --- Step 4: Pad correlation vectors to uniform length ---
organelle_correlation_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(organelle_cor_vectors, function(v) {
  length(v) <- max_length
  v[is.na(v)] <- 0
  v
}))

# --- Step 5: UMAP embedding with disk-backed temp dir ---
cor_mat_file <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/organelle_correlation_matrix.rds"
umap_out_file <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/organelle_umap_result.rds"
local_tmp <- "~/umap_tmp"
dir.create(local_tmp, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!exists("organelle_correlation_matrix")) {
  organelle_correlation_matrix <- readRDS(cor_mat_file)
}

if (!file.exists(umap_out_file)) {
  organelle_umap_result <- umap(
    organelle_correlation_matrix,
    n_neighbors = 5,
    min_dist = 0.1,
    metric = "euclidean",
    n_threads = 1,
    tmpdir = normalizePath(local_tmp),
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  saveRDS(organelle_umap_result, umap_out_file)
} else {
  organelle_umap_result <- readRDS(umap_out_file)
}

rownames(organelle_umap_result) <- rownames(organelle_correlation_matrix)

# --- Step 6: Plot UMAP ---
umap_df <- as.data.frame(organelle_umap_result)
umap_df$Annotation <- rownames(umap_df)

ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = V1, y = V2, label = Annotation)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(size = 3, vjust = 1.2, hjust = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP of Organelle Log2FC Correlation Patterns",
    x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()








# ----------- Gene-based UMAP -----------
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(uwot)
library(irlba)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(RColorBrewer)
#install.packages("NatParksPalettes")
library(NatParksPalettes)

# Step 1: Gene correlation and PCA
gene_cor <- cor(t(log2fc_matrix_d50), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
gene_cor[is.na(gene_cor)] <- 0

gene_pca <- prcomp_irlba(gene_cor, n = 100)

# Step 2: UMAP
gene_umap <- umap(
  gene_pca$x,
  n_neighbors = 25,
  min_dist = 0.2,
  metric = "cosine",
  n_threads = 1
)

# Step 3: Format UMAP output
gene_umap_df <- as.data.frame(gene_umap)
gene_umap_df$Gene <- rownames(log2fc_matrix_d50)

# ----------- Use subcell_df for annotation -----------
# subcell_df: each column = localization, values = gene symbols
# Step 4: Convert to long format
subcell_long <- subcell_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Localization", values_to = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene))

# Step 5: Join with UMAP data (multi-row per gene possible)
gene_umap_annotated <- gene_umap_df %>%
  inner_join(subcell_long, by = "Gene")

# ----------- Plotting -----------
# Set a fixed palette length (e.g., 10 categories)
n_annots <- length(unique(gene_umap_annotated$Localization))
custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Paired")))(n_annots)

# UMAP with custom discrete colors
UMAP_gene <- ggplot(gene_umap_annotated, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = Localization)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "ProteinID-level UMAP colored by subcellular localization",
    x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", color = "Localization"
  )
UMAP_gene




# Faceted UMAP
# Assume 'gene_umap_annotated' has columns: V1, V2, Gene, Localization
# Step 1: Create a data frame with all combinations of genes and localizations
all_localizations <- unique(gene_umap_annotated$Localization)
all_genes <- gene_umap_annotated %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, V1, V2, Localization)

# Create all combinations
plot_data <- expand.grid(FacetLocalization = all_localizations, Gene = all_genes$Gene) %>%
  left_join(all_genes, by = "Gene")

# Step 2: Assign colors
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(point_color = ifelse(Localization == FacetLocalization, "dodgerblue", "grey80"))

# Step 3: Separate the data into background and highlight points
background_points <- plot_data %>% filter(point_color == "grey80")
highlight_points <- plot_data %>% filter(point_color == "dodgerblue")

# Step 4: Plot
UMAP_gene_facet <- ggplot() +
  # Background layer: all points in grey
  geom_point(data = background_points, aes(x = V1, y = V2), color = "grey80", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  # Highlight layer: points matching the facet's localization in blue
  geom_point(data = highlight_points, aes(x = V1, y = V2), color = "dodgerblue", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ FacetLocalization) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "ProteinID-level UMAP faceted by subcellular localization",
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2"
  )
UMAP_gene_facet




# Optional: save annotated file
write_csv(
  gene_umap_annotated,
  "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/gene_umap_annotated.csv"
)


# ------------ Combine Plots ----------- #
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

# combine plots for 
p10 <- UMAP_gene + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p11 <- UMAP_gene_facet + theme(legend.position = "none")


# Combine layout: 
combined_plot_UMAP <- p10 / p11 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.5,1)) & 
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0.01, 10, 0.01, 10)) # Top, Right, Bottom, Left padding


# View or save
combined_plot_UMAP

# Save as PDF
ggsave("/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/diff132_d50_UMAP_gene_plot.pdf", combined_plot_UMAP, width = 12, height = 12, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
  SCARB2="grey76", SGSH="grey76", SLC17A5="grey76", SMPD1="#D53E4F", SUMF1="grey76"
)

# --- Step 2. Load and reshape the correlation data
HeLaCrossOmeCorrProt_df <- read.csv(
  '/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/20240801_dif118_iN-iDA_Ctrl-SMPD1-ASAH1_Proteomics/MSstats/HeLaCrossOmeCorr/LSD-nMOST_Protein-LipidCorr_tidyplots.csv', header = TRUE, sep = ',', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# --- Step 3. Convert wide to long format and clean cluster names
HeLaCrossOmeCorrProt_df_long <- HeLaCrossOmeCorrProt_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Protein.Cluster"), names_to = "Cluster", values_to = "Score") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cluster = Cluster %>%
           str_replace("Protein\\.Cluster\\.", "Cluster ") %>%
           str_replace("\\.Signature", ""))


# --- Step 4.  Order clusters by median for optional use
cluster_order <- HeLaCrossOmeCorrProt_df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(Score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(med) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Cluster)

HeLaCrossOmeCorrProt_df_long <- HeLaCrossOmeCorrProt_df_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = cluster_order))


# --- Step 5. Main plotting function
HeLaClusterCorr <- function(df_long, cluster_name = "Cluster 7", plot_type = "mean") {
  df_filtered <- df_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(Cluster == cluster_name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Group = as.character(Group))

  # Sort groups by mean score for consistent display
  group_order <- df_filtered %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(mean_score) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Group)

  df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_order))

  if (plot_type == "mean") {
    # Barplot of group means
    df_filtered %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Group) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = mean_score)) +
      geom_col(fill = "grey40") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      labs(title = paste0("Mean score per group – ", cluster_name),
           x = NULL, y = "Mean Score") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  } else if (plot_type == "box") {
    # Color map for visible groups only
    used_groups <- levels(df_filtered$Group)
    col_used <- col[names(col) %in% used_groups]
    missing_groups <- setdiff(used_groups, names(col_used))
    col_used[missing_groups] <- "grey76"

    # Colored boxplot with quartile lines and y=0 reference
    ggplot(df_filtered, aes(x = Group, y = Score, fill = Group)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = col_used) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      labs(title = paste0("nMOST Proteome Correlation GO - ", cluster_name),
           x = NULL, y = "Score") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "none")
  } else {
    stop("plot_type must be 'mean' or 'box'")
  }
}
```

# Neuron - HeLa Proteome Correlations
use complete_data_annotated_day50 and group into iN and iDA
read in HeLa nMOST file
- match KOs and only use the ones found in all df
- calculate pairwise correlation based on genes / protein IDs per genotype
- plot corr across genotypes in crircos plot (color based on R corr)
- also plot heatmaps of pairwise comparisons 

## Neuron-HeLa Proteome Correlation Analysis
```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------- #
# iNeuron - Hela Proteome Correlations 
# Neuron–HeLa Proteome Correlation Analysis
# --------------------------------------------------- #
library(ComplexHeatmap)
detach("package:ComplexHeatmap", unload = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
# -----------------------------
# I. Disease Class Definitions
# -----------------------------
disease_classes <- list(
  Sphingolipidoses = c("ARSA", "ASAH1", "GALC", "GBA1", "GLA", "GLB1", "GM2A", "HEXA", "HEXB", "PSAP", "SMPD1"),
  Mucopolysaccharidoses = c("GLB1", "ARSB", "GALNS", "GNS", "GUSB", "HGSNAT", "HYAL1", "IDS", "IDUA", "NAGLU", "SGSH"),
  Glycoproteinoses = c("AGA", "CTSA", "FUCA", "MAN2B1", "MANBA", "NAGA", "NEU1"),
  Neuronal.ceroid.lipofuscinoses = c("PPT1", "CTSD", "GRN", "ATP13A2", "CTSF", "KCTD7", "TPP1", "CLN3", "DNAJC5", "CLN5", "CLN6", "MFSD8", "CLN8"),
  Integral.membrane.protein.disorders = c("ATP13A2", "CLN3", "CTNS", "LAMP2", "MCOLN1", "NPC1", "NPC2", "SCARB2", "SLC17A5"),
  PTM.defects = c("GNPTAB", "GNPTG", "SUMF1"),
  Lipid.storage.diseases = c("GAA", "LIPA")
)
disease_colors <- c(
  Sphingolipidoses = "#D53E4F", Mucopolysaccharidoses = "#F46D43",
  Glycoproteinoses = "#FDAE61", Neuronal.ceroid.lipofuscinoses = "#FEE08B",
  Integral.membrane.protein.disorders = "#E6F598", PTM.defects = "#ABDDA4",
  Lipid.storage.diseases = "#66C2A5"
)
ko_to_class <- map_dfr(disease_classes, ~data.frame(KO = .x), .id = "class")

# -----------------------------
# II. Data Preparation
# -----------------------------
neuron_proteome_wide <- complete_data_annotated_day50
HeLaWCnMOST_df <- read.csv("/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/HeLa_nMOSTWCprot.csv")

neuron_long <- neuron_proteome_wide %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_abundance") %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(sample_id, "log2_fold_change")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    genotype = str_extract(sample_id, "^[^_]+"),
    neuron = str_extract(sample_id, "_(iN|iDA)_") %>% str_remove_all("_")
  )

neuron_df <- neuron_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(log2_abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes, genotype, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_log2_abundance = mean(log2_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = neuron, values_from = mean_log2_abundance)

HeLa_long <- dplyr::rename(HeLaWCnMOST_df, Genes = Gene.names) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = ends_with(".KO"),
                      names_to = "genotype",
                      values_to = "hela_abundance") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(genotype = stringr::str_remove(genotype, "\\.KO"))

merged_df <- dplyr::inner_join(neuron_df, HeLa_long, by = c("Genes", "genotype"))

merged_wide <- merged_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(iN, iDA), names_to = "neuron_type", values_to = "neuron_abundance") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = paste(genotype, neuron_type, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, sample, abundance = neuron_abundance) %>%
  bind_rows(
    merged_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(sample = paste0(genotype, "_HeLa")) %>%
      dplyr::select(Genes, sample, abundance = hela_abundance)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes, sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = abundance)

abundance_matrix <- merged_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genes") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  as.matrix()

correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA <- cor(abundance_matrix, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")


# -----------------------------
# III. Circos Plot Setup
# -----------------------------

library(ComplexHeatmap)

sample_groups <- tibble(
  sample = colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA),
  group = case_when(
    str_detect(colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA), "_iN$") ~ "iN",
    str_detect(colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA), "_iDA$") ~ "iDA",
    str_detect(colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA), "_HeLa$") ~ "HeLa",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
)

ordered_samples <- sample_groups %>% arrange(group, sample) %>% pull(sample)

# -----------------------------
# IV. Define Circos Plot Function
# -----------------------------
# Define global group color mapping
group_colors <- c("iN" = "dodgerblue", "iDA" = "#D53E4F", "HeLa" = "grey76")

# Define global sample color mapping for default fallback
sample_colors <- setNames(group_colors, names(group_colors))

# Define the plotting function
plot_dual_layer_circos <- function(link_df, title_text, output_path) {
  involved_samples <- unique(c(link_df$from, link_df$to))
  ordered_samples_local <- ordered_samples[ordered_samples %in% involved_samples]
  
  # Build disease class mapping aligned to ordered_samples_local
  ko_labels <- str_extract(ordered_samples_local, "^[^_]+")
  sector_classes_local <- tibble(sample = ordered_samples_local, KO = ko_labels) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(ko_to_class, by = "KO") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(disease_color = disease_colors[class]) %>%
    replace_na(list(disease_color = "grey90"))
  
  # ensure correct alignment
  disease_track_colors <- setNames(sector_classes_local$disease_color,
                                   sector_classes_local$sample)
  
  # Sample group mapping
  sample_colors_local <- setNames(group_colors[sample_groups$group[match(ordered_samples_local, sample_groups$sample)]],
                                  ordered_samples_local)
  
  pdf(output_path, width = 10, height = 12)
  circos.clear()
  circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.degree = 4)
  
  chordDiagram(
    x = link_df,
    grid.col = sample_colors_local,
    col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red"))(link_df$correlation),
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    transparency = 0,
    preAllocateTracks = list(
      #list(track.height = 0.05), # labels
      list(track.height = 0.03), # group colors
      list(track.height = 0.03)  # disease class colors
    ),
    order = ordered_samples_local
  )
  
  # Track 1: labels
  circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    circos.text(CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1] + mm_y(1),
                CELL_META$sector.index,
                facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE, adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.6)
  }, bg.border = NA)
  
  # Track 2: group colors
  circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 2, bg.col = sample_colors_local,panel.fun = function(x, y) {}, bg.border = NA)
  
  # Track 3: disease class colors
  circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 3, bg.col = disease_track_colors, panel.fun = function(x, y) {}, bg.border = NA)
  
  # Title
  grid.text(title_text, x = 0.5, y = 0.98, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))
  
  # Add correlation legend
  cor_legend <- Legend(
    at = c(-0.5, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5),
    col_fun = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),
    title = "Pearson r",
    direction = "horizontal",
    legend_width = unit(3, "cm")
  )
  draw(cor_legend, x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = c("center", "bottom"))
  
  # Add disease class legend
  disease_legend <- Legend(
    labels = names(disease_colors),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = disease_colors),
    title = "Disease Class",
    ncol = 2
  )
  draw(disease_legend, x = unit(1, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = c("right", "bottom"))
  
  dev.off()
}
# -----------------------------
# V. Call Circos 
# -----------------------------
# Pairwise combinations (example)
pairwise_links <- expand.grid(from = colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA),
                              to = colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA),
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(from != to) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pair_id = pmap_chr(list(from, to), ~ paste(sort(c(..1, ..2)), collapse = "_"))) %>%
  distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(correlation = mapply(function(x, y) correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA[x, y], from, to))


# Identify inter-group correlations only
sample_groups <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA),
  group = case_when(
    str_detect(colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA), "_iN$")   ~ "iN",
    str_detect(colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA), "_iDA$")  ~ "iDA",
    str_detect(colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA), "_HeLa$") ~ "HeLa",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
)

pairwise_links_inter <- pairwise_links %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_groups, by = c("from" = "sample")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(group_from = group) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_groups, by = c("to" = "sample")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(group_to = group) %>%
  dplyr::filter(group_from != group_to)  # Only inter-group comparisons


## plot function for both inter and intra correlations 
plot_dual_layer_circos(
  link_df = pairwise_links %>% filter(abs(correlation) > 0.05),
  title_text = "Neuron–HeLa Proteome Cross-Correlation",
  output_path = file.path(out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelation,"neuron_hela_circos_plot.pdf")
)



## plot only intra-celltype correlations:
plot_dual_layer_circos(
  link_df = pairwise_links_inter %>% filter(abs(correlation) > 0.05),
  title_text = "Inter-Group Neuron–HeLa Proteome Correlation",
  output_path = "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/nMOST-nDIAcorrelation/neuron_hela_circos_interonly.pdf"
)
#dev.off()

detach("package:ComplexHeatmap", unload = TRUE)
```

## nMOST-nDIA correlation of select genotype
```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------- #
# iNeuron - Hela Proteome Correlations 
# nMOST-nDIA correlation of select genotype
# --------------------------------------------------- #

# load complexheatmap for circos plots
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# Functions to plot circos plot of select genotype. Splits by pos / neg correlation 
## change inter_only from FALSE to TRUE to only plot inter-group links
## inter_only = TRUE: Filters only inter-group links (e.g. iN–HeLa, iDA–HeLa, iN–iDA)

# --- 0. create output directory 
out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_single <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/nMOST-nDIAcorrelation/SingleGeno"
dir.create(out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_single, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Step 1. Plotting function for user-def input 
circos_by_genotype <- function(ko,
                               pos_cut = 0.25,
                               neg_cut = -0.25,
                               out_dir = base_dir,
                               inter_only = TRUE) {
  # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # 1. Find sample names matching the given KO
  ko_pat     <- paste0("^", ko, "_")
  ko_samples <- grep(ko_pat, colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA), value = TRUE)

  if (length(ko_samples) == 0) {
    stop("No samples matched the KO name ‘", ko, "’. Check spelling.")
  }

  # 2. Helper: Build link data frame based on correlation cutoff
  make_link_df <- function(cut_fun) {
    expand.grid(from = ko_samples,
                to   = colnames(correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA),
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
      dplyr::filter(from != to) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        pair_id     = purrr::map2_chr(from, to, ~ paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "_")),
        correlation = purrr::map2_dbl(from, to, ~ correlation_matrix_nMOSTnDIA[.x, .y])
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(cut_fun(correlation)) |>
      dplyr::distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
      dplyr::select(-pair_id)
  }

  pos_links <- make_link_df(\(r) r >= pos_cut)
  neg_links <- make_link_df(\(r) r <= neg_cut)

  # 3. Optionally filter for inter-group links only
  if (inter_only) {
    pos_links <- pos_links |>
      dplyr::left_join(sample_groups, by = c("from" = "sample")) |>
      dplyr::rename(group_from = group) |>
      dplyr::left_join(sample_groups, by = c("to" = "sample")) |>
      dplyr::rename(group_to = group) |>
      dplyr::filter(group_from != group_to)

    neg_links <- neg_links |>
      dplyr::left_join(sample_groups, by = c("from" = "sample")) |>
      dplyr::rename(group_from = group) |>
      dplyr::left_join(sample_groups, by = c("to" = "sample")) |>
      dplyr::rename(group_to = group) |>
      dplyr::filter(group_from != group_to)
  }

  message(ko, ": ", nrow(pos_links), " positive; ",
              nrow(neg_links), " negative links kept")

  # 4. Define output file paths
  pos_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("circos_", ko, "_positive.pdf"))
  neg_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("circos_", ko, "_negative.pdf"))

  # 5. Plot
  if (nrow(pos_links) > 0) {
    plot_dual_layer_circos(
      link_df = pos_links,
      title_text = paste0(ko, " – positive r ≥ ", pos_cut),
      output_path = pos_file
    )
  }

  if (nrow(neg_links) > 0) {
    plot_dual_layer_circos(
      link_df = neg_links,
      title_text = paste0(ko, " – negative r ≤ ", neg_cut),
      output_path = neg_file
    )
  }
}

circos_by_genotype("ASAH1")

# Relaxed threshold
circos_by_genotype("ASAH1", pos_cut = 0.05, neg_cut = -0.05)


detach("package:ComplexHeatmap", unload = TRUE)
```

```{r}

## 2.   Define annotations to be calculated in the function below
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

selected_annotations <- c(
  "EndoLyso", "SynGO", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley",
  "Lysosome", "Presynaptic", "Postsynaptic",
  "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome"

selected_annotations = c("Mito","OXPHOS",
                  "mtComplexI","Golgi", "Lysosome","ER","Cytoplasm","Nucleus",
                  "Autophagy","SynGO","Endo_iN_curated_Hundley","SynapseSVs",
                  "Presynaptic","Postsynaptic","NeuroDev","EndoLyso","EarlyEndosome",
                  "RecyclingEndosome","SVfusion","Svendocytosis","Svexocytosis", "vATPase")

# selected_annotations = c("Mito","MitoIMS","MitoMatrix","MitoMIM","MitoMOM","OXPHOS",
#                   "mtComplexI","Golgi", "Lysosome","ER","Cytoplasm","Nucleus",
#                   "Autophagy","SynGO","Endo_iN_curated_Hundley","SynapseSVs",
#                   "Presynaptic","Postsynaptic","NeuroDev","EndoLyso","EarlyEndosome",
#                   "RecyclingEndosome","SVfusion","Svendocytosis","Svexocytosis","vATPase")


## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 3.   Function to calculate correlation for select annotation 
##      plots in circos plot
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_annotation_circos <- function(cor_mat, annot_name, output_path) {

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 1. Prepare sample metadata
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  # Extract all sample names from the correlation matrix
  sector_names <- union(rownames(cor_mat), colnames(cor_mat))

  # Assign each sample to a cell type or origin
  sample_meta <- tibble(sample = sector_names) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(geno_membership = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "_iN") ~ "iN",
      str_detect(sample, "_iDA") ~ "iDA",
      str_detect(sample, "\\.KO$") ~ "HeLa",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ))

  # Define color scheme for sample types
  celltype_colors <- c("iN" = "dodgerblue", "iDA" = "#D53E4F", "HeLa" = "grey76")

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 2. Create edge list from correlation matrix
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  link_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(from = Var1, to = Var2, correlation = Freq) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(from = as.character(from), to = as.character(to)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(from != to) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pair_id = map2_chr(from, to, ~ paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "_"))) %>%
    distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(-pair_id)

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 3. Define color gradient for correlation strength
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  corr_palette <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))
  corr_values  <- seq(-0.6, 0.6, length.out = 11)
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(corr_values, corr_palette)

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 4. Filter edges by threshold and prepare sample order
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  # Keep only strong correlations
  plot_links <- link_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(correlation < -0.3 | correlation > 0.3)

  if (nrow(plot_links) == 0) {
  message("No correlations pass threshold for annotation: ", annot_name)
  return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Collect samples participating in selected edges
  samples_in_plot <- union(plot_links$from, plot_links$to)

  # Filter and order metadata for plotting
  ordered_sample_meta <- sample_meta %>%
    dplyr::filter(sample %in% samples_in_plot) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(geno_membership, sample)

  ordered_samples <- ordered_sample_meta$sample
  ordered_membership <- ordered_sample_meta$geno_membership
  sector_colors <- setNames(celltype_colors[ordered_membership], ordered_samples)
  celltype_ring_colors <- sector_colors
  
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 5. Compute spacing between sectors
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  gap_between_sectors <- 1
  gap_between_groups  <- 10

  group_counts <- ordered_sample_meta %>%
    dplyr::count(geno_membership, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::pull(n)

  gap_after <- unlist(lapply(group_counts, function(n) {
    c(rep(gap_between_sectors, n - 1), gap_between_groups)
  }))
  gap_after[length(gap_after)] <- 0  # no trailing gap

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 6. Draw circos plot
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  pdf(output_path, width = 10, height = 12)
  circos.clear()
  circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.after = gap_after)

  chordDiagram(
    x = plot_links,
    grid.col = sector_colors,
    col = col_fun(plot_links$correlation),
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    transparency = 0.1,
    preAllocateTracks = list(
      list(track.height = 0.05),  # sector label track
      list(track.height = 0.03)   # outer ring track
    ),
    order = ordered_samples
  )

  # Track 1: Sample labels
  circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    tryCatch({
      circos.text(
        CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1] + mm_y(1),
        CELL_META$sector.index,
        facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.6
      )
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }, bg.border = NA)

  # Track 2: Cell type color ring
  circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 2, bg.col = celltype_ring_colors,
                         panel.fun = function(x, y) {}, bg.border = NA)

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 7. Add legends
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  draw(Legend(
    at = c(-0.6, 0, 0.6),
    col_fun = col_fun,
    title = "Pearson r",
    direction = "horizontal",
    legend_width = unit(3, "cm")
  ), x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = c("center", "bottom"))

  draw(Legend(
    labels = names(celltype_colors),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = celltype_colors),
    title = "Cell Type",
    ncol = 1
  ), x = unit(1, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = c("right", "bottom"))

  dev.off()
}

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 4.   Call circos function 
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
in_dir <- out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_OrganelleComp

    output_path = circos_out
  )
}


## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 5.   Function to calculate correlation for select annotation 
##      plots in pheatmap and saves as csv
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
calculate_annotation_correlation_matrix <- function(annot_name, neuron_df, hela_df) {
  # Filter for genes in annotation
  genes <- neuron_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!!sym(annot_name) == TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Genes) %>%
    intersect(hela_df$Genes)

  # Prepare matrices
  neuron_mat <- neuron_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Genes %in% genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, matches("^.*log2_fold_change.*")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Genes")

  hela_mat <- hela_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Genes %in% genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, matches("\\.KO$")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Genes")

  # Keep only common genes
  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(neuron_mat), rownames(hela_mat))
  if (length(common_genes) < 5) {
    warning(paste("Too few genes for", annot_name))
    return(NULL)
  }

  neuron_mat <- neuron_mat[common_genes, ]
  hela_mat <- hela_mat[common_genes, ]

  # Pearson correlation
  cor_mat <- cor(neuron_mat, hela_mat, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  # Save CSV
  write.csv(
    cor_mat,
    file = file.path(out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_OrganelleComp, paste0("cor_", annot_name, ".csv")),
    quote = FALSE
  )

  # Prepare annotation for heatmap rows
  celltype_vec <- ifelse(grepl("iN", rownames(cor_mat)), "iN",
                         ifelse(grepl("iDA", rownames(cor_mat)), "iDA", NA))
  annotation_row <- data.frame(CellType = factor(celltype_vec, levels = c("iN", "iDA")))
  rownames(annotation_row) <- rownames(cor_mat)
  annotation_colors <- list(CellType = c(iN = "grey40", iDA = "grey80"))

  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    cor_mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    main = paste("Correlation:", annot_name),
    annotation_row = annotation_row,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    color = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")),
    fontsize = 6,
    border_color = NA,
    cellheight = 8,
    cellwidth = 8,
    filename = file.path(out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_OrganelleComp, paste0("cor_", annot_name, ".pdf")),
    width = 8,
    height = 8
  )

  return(cor_mat)
}


## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 6.   Call function and plot heatmaps + csv files   
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  message("Processing: ", ann)
  calculate_annotation_correlation_matrix(ann, complete_data_annotated_day50, HeLaWCnMOST_df_annotated)
})
```

# =================================================
# Module 11: Master PPI Evidence & Analysis 
# =================================================

# PPI vulnerability pipeline in iN and iDA LSD mutants from two PPI datasets

Goal: Build a Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) vulnerability and rewiring landscape for neuronal proteomes (iN and iDA) across 23 lysosomal KOs. Integrate experimental proteome shifts with predicted and experimentally validated interaction data to quantify network destabilization, organelle-specific vulnerabilities, and neuron-type-specific effects.

> Data Sources
>> 1. Baker Lab Human Interactome (Predictome80)**
- Source: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.01.615885v1
- ~29k edges, 80% confidence threshold
- Scores: RFprob (RoseTTAFold coevolution), AFMprob (AlphaFold-Multimer)

>> 2. Predictomes.org 16k set**
- Source: https://predictomes.org/downloads
- Paper: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.11.10.687652v1
- ~16.5k edges, top predictions by SPOC score (~90% precision)
- Scores: SPOC (omics integration), ipTM_max (interface quality), KIRC

>> 3. IntAct Database**
- Source: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/intact/
- Experimentally validated interactions (MI-score >= 0.5)
- Used as orthogonal validation, not primary source

>> Overlap Statistics
- Predictome80 only: ~22k edges
- Predictomes16k only: ~9.5k edges  
- In both (convergent): ~7k edges
- With IntAct validation: ~1.7k edges

> Confidence Tier Logic
>> Tier 1:
- In both prediction sources (convergent evidence), OR
- AFMprob >= 0.9 AND RFprob >= 0.9 (high structural + coevolution), OR
- SPOC >= 0.95 (high omics integration)

>> Tier 2:
- AFMprob >= 0.8 (good structural), OR
- RFprob >= 0.8 (good coevolution), OR
- SPOC >= 0.9 (good omics)

>> Tie 3:
- Remaining edges with lower confidence

> Additional Flags
- high_interface_quality: ipTM_max >= 0.7 (retained for complex analysis)
- has_experimental_validation: present in IntAct (orthogonal QC)

> Key Insight
AFMprob and RFprob correlate; ipTM_max does not correlate with other metrics. ipTM likely measures interface quality specifically, valuable for complex analysis but not for general PPI confidence tiering.



# Module 1: PPI Database Construction
Creates master_ppi_v3 with all filter columns and support scores

## Chunk 1: Input Paths and Database Loading
```{r ppi_db_paths_loading}
# =============================================================================
# PPI Database: Input Paths and Database Loading
# =============================================================================

# --- Setup output directory ---

out_dir_ppi_dual <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "ppi_dual_evidence")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_dir_baseline <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "baseline")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Input paths ---
path_predictome80 <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/tmpneurogit/proteome/final_predictions_80.tsv"
path_predictomes16k <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/tmpneurogit/proteome/Predictomes_16kset.csv"
path_corum <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/tmpneurogit/proteome/corum_humanComplexes.txt"
path_complexportal <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/tmpneurogit/proteome/9606.tsv"

# --- Helper functions ---
.make_undirected_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

# Strip isoform suffix (e.g., "P12345-1" -> "P12345")
.strip_isoform <- function(x) sub("-\\d+$", "", x)

# --- Load CORUM database ---
corum_available <- file.exists(path_corum)

if (corum_available) {
  message("Loading CORUM database...")
  corum_raw <- data.table::fread(path_corum, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = FALSE)

  # Parse using correct column names from corum_humanComplexes.txt
  corum_human <- corum_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(organism == "Human") %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, subunits_uniprot_id, subunits_gene_name,
                  subunits_stoechiometrie, functions_go_name, pmid) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(subunits_gene_name) & subunits_gene_name != "")

  # Create edge lookup from gene names

  corum_edges <- corum_human %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genes = list(trimws(unlist(strsplit(subunits_gene_name, ";"))))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genes = purrr::map(genes, ~ unique(.x[.x != "" & !is.na(.x)]))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(purrr::map_int(genes, length) >= 2) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      edge_pairs = purrr::map(genes, function(g) {
        g <- unique(g)  # Ensure unique
        if (length(g) < 2) return(data.frame(Gene1 = character(), Gene2 = character()))
        pairs <- t(combn(sort(g), 2))
        data.frame(Gene1 = pairs[, 1], Gene2 = pairs[, 2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      })
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(edge_pairs) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(key = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
    dplyr::select(key, complex_id, complex_name) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  corum_edge_lookup <- corum_edges %>%
    dplyr::group_by(key) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      corum_complex_ids = paste(unique(complex_id), collapse = ";"),
      corum_complex_names = paste(unique(complex_name), collapse = ";"),
      n_corum_complexes = dplyr::n_distinct(complex_id),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Create complex membership lookup (for top-down analysis)
  corum_complex_members <- corum_human %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, subunits_gene_name, subunits_uniprot_id, subunits_stoechiometrie) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      genes = list(trimws(unlist(strsplit(subunits_gene_name, ";")))),
      proteins = list(trimws(unlist(strsplit(subunits_uniprot_id, ";")))),
      stoich = list(trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(subunits_stoechiometrie), ";"))))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_subunits = purrr::map_int(genes, length)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, genes, proteins, stoich, n_subunits)

  message("  CORUM complexes (human): ", nrow(corum_human))
  message("  CORUM unique edges (gene-based): ", nrow(corum_edge_lookup))

  # Check UniProt coverage in CORUM
  corum_with_uniprot <- sum(!is.na(corum_human$subunits_uniprot_id) & corum_human$subunits_uniprot_id != "")
  message("  CORUM complexes with UniProt IDs: ", corum_with_uniprot, " / ", nrow(corum_human))
} else {
  message("CORUM file not found, skipping...")
  corum_edge_lookup <- NULL
  corum_complex_members <- NULL
}

# --- Load ComplexPortal ---
message("Loading ComplexPortal...")
complexportal_raw <- data.table::fread(path_complexportal, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, quote = "", data.table = FALSE)

complexportal <- complexportal_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    complex_id = `#Complex ac`,
    complex_name = `Recommended name`,
    proteins_raw = `Identifiers (and stoichiometry) of molecules in complex`,
    go_annotations = `Go Annotations`,
    description = Description
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    proteins_list = stringr::str_extract_all(proteins_raw, "[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5}(?=\\()"),
    n_proteins = purrr::map_int(proteins_list, length)
  )

message("  ComplexPortal complexes: ", nrow(complexportal))

# Metadata lookup for joining onto matched complexes
cp_metadata <- complexportal %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, cp_name = complex_name, cp_description = description)

# Create lookup: complex_id -> all proteins
complex_to_proteins <- complexportal %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, proteins_list) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(proteins_list) %>%
  dplyr::rename(protein = proteins_list) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(proteins = list(unique(protein)), .groups = "drop")

# Create edge lookup with strict/relaxed distinction
complexportal_edges <- complexportal %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_proteins >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge_pairs = list({
      prots <- proteins_list
      if (length(prots) < 2) return(data.frame(Protein1 = character(), Protein2 = character()))
      pairs <- t(combn(sort(unique(prots)), 2))
      data.frame(Protein1 = pairs[, 1], Protein2 = pairs[, 2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    })
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::unnest(edge_pairs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2),
    cp_type = ifelse(n_proteins == 2, "strict", "relaxed")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, complex_id, cp_type) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

complexportal_edge_lookup <- complexportal_edges %>%
  dplyr::group_by(key) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cp_complex_ids = paste(unique(complex_id), collapse = ";"),
    n_cp_complexes = dplyr::n_distinct(complex_id),
    has_strict = any(cp_type == "strict"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(filter_ComplexPortal = ifelse(has_strict, "strict", "relaxed"))

message("  ComplexPortal unique edges: ", nrow(complexportal_edge_lookup))
message("  Strict (dimers): ", sum(complexportal_edge_lookup$filter_ComplexPortal == "strict"))
message("  Relaxed (larger complexes): ", sum(complexportal_edge_lookup$filter_ComplexPortal == "relaxed"))
```


## Chunk 2: Master PPI Creation
```{r ppi_db_master_creation}
# =============================================================================
# PPI Database: Master PPI Table Creation
# =============================================================================

# --- Load Predictome80 ---
message("Loading Predictome80...")
predictome80_raw <- data.table::fread(path_predictome80, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, skip = 28, fill = TRUE, quote = "", data.table = FALSE)
predictome80_raw <- predictome80_raw[!grepl("^#", predictome80_raw$Protein1), ]

predictome80 <- predictome80_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Protein1 = Protein1, Protein2 = Protein2,
    Gene1 = Name1, Gene2 = Name2,
    RFprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(RFprob)),
    AFprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(AFprob)),
    AFMprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(AFMprob)),
    CFprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CFprob)),
    STRING = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STRING)),
    confDBs = confDBs, allDBs = allDBs, Source = Source, PDBtemp = PDBtemp,
    Locality1 = Locality1, Locality2 = Locality2,
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(in_Predictome80 = TRUE)

message("  Predictome80: ", nrow(predictome80), " unique edges")

# --- Parse filter columns from P80 ---
predictome80 <- predictome80 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    filter_BIOGRID = ifelse(grepl("BIOGRID", allDBs, ignore.case = TRUE), "present", "none"),
    filter_STRING = ifelse(grepl("STRING", allDBs, ignore.case = TRUE), "present", "none"),
    filter_PDB = dplyr::case_when(
      PDBtemp == "exact" ~ "exact",
      PDBtemp == "homolog" ~ "homolog",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    )
  )

# --- Load Predictomes.org 16k ---
message("Loading Predictomes.org 16k...")
predictomes16k_raw <- readr::read_csv(path_predictomes16k, show_col_types = FALSE)

predictomes16k <- predictomes16k_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Protein1 = sub(" / .*", "", UniProt_ID),
    Protein2 = sub(".* / ", "", UniProt_ID),
    Gene1_16k = sub(" / .*", "", Gene_Symbol),
    Gene2_16k = sub(".* / ", "", Gene_Symbol)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Protein1 = Protein1, Protein2 = Protein2,
    Gene1_16k = Gene1_16k, Gene2_16k = Gene2_16k,
    SPOC_score = as.numeric(SPOC_score),
    FDR_pct = as.numeric(`FDR_(%)`),
    ipTM_max = as.numeric(ipTM_max),
    KIRC_score = as.numeric(KIRC_score),
    BioGRID_count = as.numeric(BioGRID),
    STRING_16k = as.numeric(STRING_score),
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(in_Predictomes16k = TRUE)

message("  Predictomes16k: ", nrow(predictomes16k), " unique edges")

# --- Merge sources ---
message("Merging prediction sources...")
master_ppi_v3 <- predictome80 %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, CFprob, STRING,
                confDBs, allDBs, Source, Locality1, Locality2, in_Predictome80,
                filter_BIOGRID, filter_STRING, filter_PDB) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    predictomes16k %>% dplyr::select(key, Gene1_16k, Gene2_16k, SPOC_score, FDR_pct, ipTM_max,
                                      KIRC_score, BioGRID_count, STRING_16k, in_Predictomes16k),
    by = "key"
  )

# Fill missing values
master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_Predictome80 = tidyr::replace_na(in_Predictome80, FALSE),
    in_Predictomes16k = tidyr::replace_na(in_Predictomes16k, FALSE),
    in_both_predictions = in_Predictome80 & in_Predictomes16k,
    filter_BIOGRID = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(filter_BIOGRID) ~ filter_BIOGRID,
      BioGRID_count > 0 ~ "present",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    ),
    filter_STRING = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(filter_STRING) ~ filter_STRING,
      STRING_16k > 0 ~ "present",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    ),
    filter_PDB = tidyr::replace_na(filter_PDB, "none"),
    Gene1 = dplyr::coalesce(Gene1, Gene1_16k),
    Gene2 = dplyr::coalesce(Gene2, Gene2_16k)
  )

message("  Merged master table: ", nrow(master_ppi_v3), " unique edges")
```


## Chunk 3: Add Database Filter Columns
```{r ppi_db_filter_columns}
# =============================================================================
# PPI Database: Add CORUM and ComplexPortal Annotations
# =============================================================================

# --- Add ComplexPortal annotations ---
message("Adding ComplexPortal annotations...")
master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complexportal_edge_lookup %>% dplyr::select(key, filter_ComplexPortal, cp_complex_ids), by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(filter_ComplexPortal = tidyr::replace_na(filter_ComplexPortal, "none"))

message("  Edges in ComplexPortal strict: ", sum(master_ppi_v3$filter_ComplexPortal == "strict"))
message("  Edges in ComplexPortal relaxed: ", sum(master_ppi_v3$filter_ComplexPortal == "relaxed"))

# --- Add CORUM annotations (gene-based + UniProt fallback) ---
message("Adding CORUM annotations...")
if (!is.null(corum_edge_lookup) && nrow(corum_edge_lookup) > 0) {
  # CORUM uses gene-based keys - normalize to uppercase for matching
  master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Gene1_upper = toupper(Gene1),
      Gene2_upper = toupper(Gene2),
      gene_key = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2),
      gene_key_upper = .make_undirected_key(Gene1_upper, Gene2_upper)
    )

  # Also create uppercase CORUM lookup
  corum_edge_lookup_upper <- corum_edge_lookup %>%
    dplyr::mutate(key_upper = toupper(key))

  # Diagnostics: check gene name overlap (case-insensitive)
  ppi_genes <- unique(c(master_ppi_v3$Gene1, master_ppi_v3$Gene2))
  ppi_genes_upper <- unique(toupper(ppi_genes))
  corum_genes <- unique(unlist(corum_complex_members$genes))
  corum_genes_upper <- unique(toupper(corum_genes))
  gene_overlap <- length(intersect(ppi_genes, corum_genes))
  gene_overlap_upper <- length(intersect(ppi_genes_upper, corum_genes_upper))
  message("  PPI unique genes: ", length(ppi_genes))
  message("  CORUM unique genes: ", length(corum_genes))
  message("  Gene overlap (exact case): ", gene_overlap, " (", round(100 * gene_overlap / length(ppi_genes), 1), "% of PPI genes)")
  message("  Gene overlap (case-insensitive): ", gene_overlap_upper, " (", round(100 * gene_overlap_upper / length(ppi_genes), 1), "% of PPI genes)")

  # Gene-based matching (try exact case first, then case-insensitive)
  master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::left_join(corum_edge_lookup, by = c("gene_key" = "key"))

  # Also try case-insensitive matching for unmatched
  master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      corum_edge_lookup_upper %>%
        dplyr::select(key_upper, corum_complex_ids_upper = corum_complex_ids,
                      corum_complex_names_upper = corum_complex_names),
      by = c("gene_key_upper" = "key_upper")
    )

  # Combine: use exact match if available, otherwise use case-insensitive
  master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      corum_complex_ids = dplyr::coalesce(corum_complex_ids, corum_complex_ids_upper),
      corum_complex_names = dplyr::coalesce(corum_complex_names, corum_complex_names_upper),
      filter_CORUM_gene = ifelse(!is.na(corum_complex_ids), "present", "none")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-corum_complex_ids_upper, -corum_complex_names_upper)

  gene_matches <- sum(master_ppi_v3$filter_CORUM_gene == "present")
  message("  CORUM matches (gene-based, case-insensitive): ", gene_matches)

  # UniProt-based matching as alternative
  message("  Creating UniProt-based CORUM edge lookup...")

  corum_edges_uniprot <- corum_human %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      proteins_raw = list(trimws(unlist(strsplit(subunits_uniprot_id, ";")))),
      proteins_raw = list(proteins_raw[proteins_raw != "" & !is.na(proteins_raw)]),
      # Create version without isoform suffixes AND make unique
      proteins_base = list(unique(.strip_isoform(proteins_raw)))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(purrr::map_int(proteins_base, length) >= 2)  # Filter on unique base proteins

  # Create edges using base UniProt IDs (without isoforms)
  corum_edges_uniprot <- corum_edges_uniprot %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      edge_pairs = purrr::map(proteins_base, function(p) {
        if (length(p) < 2) return(data.frame(P1 = character(), P2 = character()))
        pairs <- t(combn(sort(p), 2))
        data.frame(P1 = pairs[, 1], P2 = pairs[, 2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      })
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(edge_pairs) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(uniprot_key = .make_undirected_key(P1, P2)) %>%
    dplyr::select(uniprot_key, complex_id, complex_name) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  corum_edge_uniprot_lookup <- corum_edges_uniprot %>%
    dplyr::group_by(uniprot_key) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      corum_uniprot_ids = paste(unique(complex_id), collapse = ";"),
      corum_uniprot_names = paste(unique(complex_name), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  message("  CORUM UniProt edges: ", nrow(corum_edge_uniprot_lookup))

  # Diagnostics: Compare CORUM vs ComplexPortal edge counts
  message("\n=== CORUM vs ComplexPortal Edge Comparison ===")
  message("ComplexPortal unique edges: ", nrow(complexportal_edge_lookup))
  message("CORUM gene-based edges: ", nrow(corum_edge_lookup))
  message("CORUM UniProt edges (isoform-stripped): ", nrow(corum_edge_uniprot_lookup))

  # Check UniProt overlap (using base IDs without isoforms)
  ppi_uniprots <- unique(c(master_ppi_v3$Protein1, master_ppi_v3$Protein2))
  ppi_uniprots <- ppi_uniprots[!is.na(ppi_uniprots) & ppi_uniprots != ""]
  ppi_uniprots_base <- unique(.strip_isoform(ppi_uniprots))

  # Get all UniProts from CORUM (already stripped in edge creation)
  corum_uniprots_raw <- unique(unlist(corum_complex_members$proteins))
  corum_uniprots_raw <- corum_uniprots_raw[!is.na(corum_uniprots_raw) & corum_uniprots_raw != ""]
  corum_uniprots_base <- unique(.strip_isoform(corum_uniprots_raw))

  # Get all UniProts from ComplexPortal
  cp_uniprots <- unique(unlist(complexportal$proteins_list))

  message("\nUniProt coverage:")
  message("  PPI unique UniProts (raw): ", length(ppi_uniprots))
  message("  PPI unique UniProts (base): ", length(ppi_uniprots_base))
  message("  CORUM unique UniProts (raw): ", length(corum_uniprots_raw))
  message("  CORUM unique UniProts (base): ", length(corum_uniprots_base))
  message("  ComplexPortal unique UniProts: ", length(cp_uniprots))
  message("  PPI-CORUM UniProt overlap (base): ", length(intersect(ppi_uniprots_base, corum_uniprots_base)))
  message("  PPI-CP UniProt overlap: ", length(intersect(ppi_uniprots_base, cp_uniprots)))

  # Check edge key overlap directly
  ppi_keys_base <- unique(.make_undirected_key(.strip_isoform(master_ppi_v3$Protein1),
                                                .strip_isoform(master_ppi_v3$Protein2)))
  cp_edge_keys <- unique(complexportal_edge_lookup$key)
  corum_uniprot_keys <- unique(corum_edge_uniprot_lookup$uniprot_key)

  message("\nEdge key overlap (using base UniProt IDs):")
  message("  PPI edge keys: ", length(ppi_keys_base))
  message("  CP edge keys: ", length(cp_edge_keys))
  message("  CORUM UniProt edge keys: ", length(corum_uniprot_keys))
  message("  PPI-CP edge overlap: ", length(intersect(ppi_keys_base, cp_edge_keys)))
  message("  PPI-CORUM UniProt edge overlap: ", length(intersect(ppi_keys_base, corum_uniprot_keys)))

  # Sample of CORUM UniProt IDs to check format
  message("\nSample CORUM UniProt IDs (raw, first 5):")
  print(head(corum_uniprots_raw, 5))
  message("Sample PPI UniProt IDs (first 5):")
  print(head(ppi_uniprots, 5))

  # Check if CORUM UniProts contain isoform suffixes like "-1"
  corum_has_isoform <- sum(grepl("-\\d+$", corum_uniprots_raw))
  ppi_has_isoform <- sum(grepl("-\\d+$", ppi_uniprots))
  message("\nIsoform suffix check:")
  message("  CORUM UniProts with isoform: ", corum_has_isoform, " / ", length(corum_uniprots_raw))
  message("  PPI UniProts with isoform: ", ppi_has_isoform, " / ", length(ppi_uniprots))

  # Match using UniProt keys (Protein1::Protein2) - strip isoforms for matching
  master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Protein1_base = .strip_isoform(Protein1),
      Protein2_base = .strip_isoform(Protein2),
      uniprot_key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2),
      uniprot_key_base = .make_undirected_key(Protein1_base, Protein2_base)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(corum_edge_uniprot_lookup, by = c("uniprot_key_base" = "uniprot_key")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(filter_CORUM_uniprot = ifelse(!is.na(corum_uniprot_ids), "present", "none"))

  uniprot_matches <- sum(master_ppi_v3$filter_CORUM_uniprot == "present")
  message("  CORUM matches (UniProt-based, isoform-stripped): ", uniprot_matches)

  # Combine: use either gene OR UniProt match
  master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      filter_CORUM = ifelse(filter_CORUM_gene == "present" | filter_CORUM_uniprot == "present", "present", "none"),
      # Merge complex IDs from both sources
      corum_complex_ids = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(corum_complex_ids) & !is.na(corum_uniprot_ids) ~ paste(corum_complex_ids, corum_uniprot_ids, sep = ";"),
        !is.na(corum_complex_ids) ~ corum_complex_ids,
        !is.na(corum_uniprot_ids) ~ corum_uniprot_ids,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      corum_complex_names = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(corum_complex_names) & !is.na(corum_uniprot_names) ~ paste(corum_complex_names, corum_uniprot_names, sep = ";"),
        !is.na(corum_complex_names) ~ corum_complex_names,
        !is.na(corum_uniprot_names) ~ corum_uniprot_names,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
} else {
  message("CORUM not available, skipping...")
  master_ppi_v3$filter_CORUM <- "none"
  master_ppi_v3$filter_CORUM_gene <- "none"
  master_ppi_v3$filter_CORUM_uniprot <- "none"
  master_ppi_v3$corum_complex_ids <- NA_character_
  master_ppi_v3$corum_complex_names <- NA_character_
  master_ppi_v3$gene_key <- .make_undirected_key(master_ppi_v3$Gene1, master_ppi_v3$Gene2)
}

message("  Edges in CORUM (combined): ", sum(master_ppi_v3$filter_CORUM == "present"))

  # Additional diagnostics for CORUM matching
  message("\n=== CORUM Matching Diagnostics ===")
  message("Total CORUM edges available: ", nrow(corum_edge_lookup))
  message("Total CORUM UniProt edges: ", nrow(corum_edge_uniprot_lookup))
  message("Total CORUM complexes: ", nrow(corum_complex_members))

  # Check how many PPI genes are in any CORUM complex
  ppi_gene1_in_corum <- master_ppi_v3$Gene1 %in% corum_genes
  ppi_gene2_in_corum <- master_ppi_v3$Gene2 %in% corum_genes
  ppi_both_in_corum <- ppi_gene1_in_corum & ppi_gene2_in_corum
  ppi_either_in_corum <- ppi_gene1_in_corum | ppi_gene2_in_corum

  message("\nPPI edges where Gene1 is in CORUM: ", sum(ppi_gene1_in_corum))
  message("PPI edges where Gene2 is in CORUM: ", sum(ppi_gene2_in_corum))
  message("PPI edges where BOTH genes are in CORUM (any complex): ", sum(ppi_both_in_corum))
  message("PPI edges where EITHER gene is in CORUM: ", sum(ppi_either_in_corum))
  message("PPI edges where both genes are in SAME CORUM complex (edge match): ", gene_matches)

  # Sample of unmatched edges where both genes are in CORUM
  both_in_corum_but_no_match <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::filter(ppi_both_in_corum & filter_CORUM_gene == "none") %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)

  if (nrow(both_in_corum_but_no_match) > 0) {
    message("\nSample of edges where both genes are in CORUM but NOT in same complex:")
    for (i in seq_len(min(5, nrow(both_in_corum_but_no_match)))) {
      message("  ", both_in_corum_but_no_match$Gene1[i], " - ", both_in_corum_but_no_match$Gene2[i])
    }
  }

  # CORUM complex size distribution
  corum_size_dist <- corum_complex_members %>%
    dplyr::count(n_subunits, name = "n_complexes") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(n_subunits)

  message("\nCORUM complex size distribution (top 10):")
  print(head(corum_size_dist, 10))

  message("  Median CORUM complex size: ", median(corum_complex_members$n_subunits))
  message("  Mean CORUM complex size: ", round(mean(corum_complex_members$n_subunits), 1))
```


## Chunk 4: Support Score Computation
```{r ppi_db_support_score}
# =============================================================================
# PPI Database: Compute Weighted Support Score
# =============================================================================
# Scoring:
#   PDB: exact=3, homolog=1, none=0
#   ComplexPortal: strict=3, relaxed=1, none=0
#   STRING: present=1, none=0
#   BIOGRID: present=1, none=0
#   CORUM: present=1, none=0
# Max possible = 3 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 9

message("Computing support scores...")

master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    score_PDB = dplyr::case_when(filter_PDB == "exact" ~ 3L, filter_PDB == "homolog" ~ 1L, TRUE ~ 0L),
    score_ComplexPortal = dplyr::case_when(filter_ComplexPortal == "strict" ~ 3L, filter_ComplexPortal == "relaxed" ~ 1L, TRUE ~ 0L),
    score_STRING = ifelse(filter_STRING == "present", 1L, 0L),
    score_BIOGRID = ifelse(filter_BIOGRID == "present", 1L, 0L),
    score_CORUM = ifelse(filter_CORUM == "present", 1L, 0L),
    support_score = score_PDB + score_ComplexPortal + score_STRING + score_BIOGRID + score_CORUM,
    n_databases_supporting = (filter_PDB != "none") + (filter_ComplexPortal != "none") +
                              (filter_STRING != "none") + (filter_BIOGRID != "none") +
                              (filter_CORUM != "none")
  )

# Summary
support_summary <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges = dplyr::n(),
    edges_PDB_exact = sum(filter_PDB == "exact"),
    edges_PDB_homolog = sum(filter_PDB == "homolog"),
    edges_ComplexPortal_strict = sum(filter_ComplexPortal == "strict"),
    edges_ComplexPortal_relaxed = sum(filter_ComplexPortal == "relaxed"),
    edges_STRING = sum(filter_STRING == "present"),
    edges_BIOGRID = sum(filter_BIOGRID == "present"),
    edges_CORUM = sum(filter_CORUM == "present"),
    mean_support_score = round(mean(support_score), 2),
    median_support_score = median(support_score),
    max_support_score = max(support_score)
  )

message("\nSupport score summary:")
print(as.data.frame(t(support_summary)))

score_dist <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::count(support_score, name = "n_edges") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_edges / sum(n_edges), 1))

message("\nSupport score distribution:")
print(score_dist)
```


## Chunk 5: Confidence Tier Assignment
```{r ppi_db_confidence_tiers}
# =============================================================================
# PPI Database: Confidence Tier Assignment (Tier1-Only for downstream)
# =============================================================================
# Gold criteria:
#   - in both prediction sources (convergent evidence)
#   - OR high structural + coevolution (AFMprob >= 0.9 AND RFprob >= 0.9)
#   - OR high omics integration (SPOC >= 0.95)

message("Assigning confidence tiers...")

master_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    confidence_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      in_both_predictions ~ "Tier1",
      AFMprob >= 0.9 & RFprob >= 0.9 ~ "Tier1",
      SPOC_score >= 0.95 ~ "Tier1",
      AFMprob >= 0.8 ~ "Tier2",
      RFprob >= 0.8 ~ "Tier2",
      SPOC_score >= 0.9 ~ "Tier2",
      TRUE ~ "Tie3"
    ),
    confidence_tier_rationale = dplyr::case_when(
      in_both_predictions ~ "both_prediction_sources",
      AFMprob >= 0.9 & RFprob >= 0.9 ~ "P80_high_structural_and_coevol",
      SPOC_score >= 0.95 ~ "16k_high_omics",
      AFMprob >= 0.8 ~ "P80_good_structural",
      RFprob >= 0.8 ~ "P80_good_coevol",
      SPOC_score >= 0.9 ~ "16k_good_omics",
      TRUE ~ "low_conf"
    )
  )

tier_summary <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::count(confidence_tier, confidence_tier_rationale) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(confidence_tier, dplyr::desc(n))

message("\nConfidence tier summary:")
print(tier_summary)

support_by_tier <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(confidence_tier) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_support = round(mean(support_score), 2),
    median_support = median(support_score),
    pct_in_CORUM = round(100 * mean(filter_CORUM == "present"), 1),
    pct_PDB_struct = round(100 * mean(filter_PDB != "none"), 1),
    pct_ComplexPortal = round(100 * mean(filter_ComplexPortal != "none"), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

message("\nSupport by tier:")
print(support_by_tier)
```


## Chunk 6: QC Plots
```{r ppi_db_qc_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# PPI Database: QC Plots
# =============================================================================

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Plot 1: Database support barplot ---
message("Generating database support barplot...")

filter_counts <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    PDB_exact = sum(filter_PDB == "exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    PDB_homolog = sum(filter_PDB == "homolog", na.rm = TRUE),
    ComplexPortal_strict = sum(filter_ComplexPortal == "strict", na.rm = TRUE),
    ComplexPortal_relaxed = sum(filter_ComplexPortal == "relaxed", na.rm = TRUE),
    STRING = sum(filter_STRING == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    BIOGRID = sum(filter_BIOGRID == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    CORUM = sum(filter_CORUM == "present", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "database", values_to = "n_edges") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    db_group = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("PDB", database) ~ "Structural",
      grepl("ComplexPortal|CORUM", database) ~ "Complex",
      TRUE ~ "Interaction"
    )
  )

p_db_support <- ggplot(filter_counts, aes(x = reorder(database, -n_edges), y = n_edges, fill = db_group)) +

  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n_edges)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Structural" = "grey75", "Complex" = "grey55", "Interaction" = "grey40"), name = "Type") +
  labs(title = "PPI edges by database/structure support", x = NULL, y = "Number of edges") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "barplot_database_support.pdf"), p_db_support, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# --- Plot 2: Support score distribution ---
p_support_dist <- ggplot(master_ppi_v3, aes(x = factor(support_score))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Support score distribution (all edges)", subtitle = "Max = 9: PDB exact +3 homolog +1 CP strict +3 CP relaxed +1 STING, BIOGRID, CORUM +1", x = "Support Score", y = "Number of edges") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "barplot_support_score_distribution.pdf"), p_support_dist, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# --- Plot 3: UpSet plot for database overlap ---
upset_data <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    PDB = as.integer(filter_PDB != "none"),
    ComplexPortal = as.integer(filter_ComplexPortal != "none"),
    CORUM = as.integer(filter_CORUM == "present"),
    STRING = as.integer(filter_STRING == "present"),
    BIOGRID = as.integer(filter_BIOGRID == "present")
  )

if (requireNamespace("UpSetR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pdf(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "upset_database_overlap.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5)
  print(UpSetR::upset(as.data.frame(upset_data), sets = c("PDB", "ComplexPortal", "CORUM", "STRING", "BIOGRID"),
                      order.by = "freq", decreasing = TRUE, mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4), text.scale = 1.2,
                      main.bar.color = "steelblue", sets.bar.color = "darkgray"))

}

# --- Plot 4: Support by tier ---
support_by_tier_long <- support_by_tier %>%

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "barplot_support_by_tier.pdf"), p_support_tier, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# --- Save outputs ---
readr::write_csv(master_ppi_v3, file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tables", "master_ppi_v3.csv"))

readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(support_by_tier), file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc", "support_by_tier.csv"))
```

# Module 2: Baseline PPI Network
Filters to gold tier + neuronal proteome, adds organelle annotations
Requires: master_ppi_v3 from Module 1, complete_data_annotated_day50, binary_matrix

## Chunk 1: Tier1-Only Baseline Filtering
```{r baseline_gold_filtering}
# =============================================================================
# Baseline PPI: Tier1-Only Filtering to Neuronal Proteome
# =============================================================================

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_baseline <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "baseline")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Define neuronal proteome ---
neuronal_genes <- unique(complete_data_annotated_day50$Genes)
message("Neuronal proteome: ", length(neuronal_genes), " proteins")

# --- Filter to gold tier ---
# message("Filtering to Tier 1 only...")
master_ppi_gold <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::filter(confidence_tier == "Tier1")
message(" Tier 1 edges: ", nrow(master_ppi_gold))

# for both tie 1 and 2
# master_ppi_gold <- master_ppi_v3 %>%
#   dplyr::filter(confidence_tier %in% c("Tier1", "Tier2"))
# message(" Tier 1 + 2 edges: ", nrow(master_ppi_gold))


# --- Pre-filter stats ---
n_pre <- nrow(master_ppi_gold)
n_gene1_in <- sum(master_ppi_gold$Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes)
n_gene2_in <- sum(master_ppi_gold$Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)
n_both_in <- sum(master_ppi_gold$Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes & master_ppi_gold$Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)

message("\nProteome overlap (gold tier):")
message("  Gene1 in proteome: ", n_gene1_in, " (", round(100 * n_gene1_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")
message("  Gene2 in proteome: ", n_gene2_in, " (", round(100 * n_gene2_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")
message("  Both in proteome: ", n_both_in, " (", round(100 * n_both_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")

# --- Filter to neuronal proteome ---
baseline_ppi_v3 <- master_ppi_gold %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes & Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)

message("\nBaseline PPI (gold, neuronal): ", nrow(baseline_ppi_v3), " edges")

# Unique proteins
baseline_proteins <- unique(c(baseline_ppi_v3$Gene1, baseline_ppi_v3$Gene2))
message("Unique proteins in baseline: ", length(baseline_proteins))
message("Proteome coverage: ", round(100 * length(baseline_proteins) / length(neuronal_genes), 1), "%")

# --- Support score distribution ---
baseline_support_dist <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::count(support_score, name = "n_edges") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_edges / sum(n_edges), 1))

message("\nBaseline support score distribution:")
print(baseline_support_dist)

# --- Database support in baseline ---
baseline_db_support <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges = dplyr::n(),
    PDB_exact = sum(filter_PDB == "exact"),
    PDB_homolog = sum(filter_PDB == "homolog"),
    ComplexPortal_strict = sum(filter_ComplexPortal == "strict"),
    ComplexPortal_relaxed = sum(filter_ComplexPortal == "relaxed"),
    STRING = sum(filter_STRING == "present"),
    BIOGRID = sum(filter_BIOGRID == "present"),
    CORUM = sum(filter_CORUM == "present")
  )

message("\nDatabase support in baseline:")
print(as.data.frame(t(baseline_db_support)))

# Assign to baseline_filtered for downstream compatibility
baseline_filtered <- baseline_ppi_v3
```


## Chunk 2: Organelle Annotations
```{r baseline_organelle_annotations}
# =============================================================================
# Baseline PPI: Add Subcellular Annotations
# =============================================================================

message("Adding subcellular annotations...")

# Get organelle tags from binary_matrix
organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
gene_to_org <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags))

# Add annotations for Gene1
baseline_ppi_v3 <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot1"), dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags))

# Add annotations for Gene2
baseline_ppi_v3 <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot2"), dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags))

# Count annotations
n_gene1_annotated <- sum(!is.na(baseline_ppi_v3[[paste0(organelle_tags[1], "_prot1")]]))
n_gene2_annotated <- sum(!is.na(baseline_ppi_v3[[paste0(organelle_tags[1], "_prot2")]]))
message("  Gene1 with annotations: ", n_gene1_annotated, " / ", nrow(baseline_ppi_v3))
message("  Gene2 with annotations: ", n_gene2_annotated, " / ", nrow(baseline_ppi_v3))

# --- Create shared organelle edge table ---
message("Creating shared organelle edge table...")

org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")
existing_org1_cols <- intersect(org1_cols, colnames(baseline_ppi_v3))
existing_org2_cols <- intersect(org2_cols, colnames(baseline_ppi_v3))

shared_long_baseline <- {
  if (length(existing_org1_cols) == 0 || length(existing_org2_cols) == 0) {
    message("No organelle columns found")
    data.frame(key = character(0), tag = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    m1 <- baseline_ppi_v3[, existing_org1_cols, drop = FALSE] %>%
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% as.data.frame()
    m2 <- baseline_ppi_v3[, existing_org2_cols, drop = FALSE] %>%
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% as.data.frame()
    shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)
    existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1_cols)

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
      idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
      if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(key = baseline_ppi_v3$key[i], tag = existing_tags[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }
}

message("  Shared organelle edges: ", nrow(shared_long_baseline))

# Organelle edge counts
organelle_edge_counts <- shared_long_baseline %>%
  dplyr::count(tag, name = "n_edges") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_edges))

message("\nOrganelle edge counts:")
print(head(organelle_edge_counts, 15))

# Update baseline_filtered
baseline_filtered <- baseline_ppi_v3
```
