## Chunk 4: Score Analysis by Organelle
```{r baseline_score_analysis, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# Baseline PPI: Score Analysis by Organelle
# Prediction scores: RFprob, AFMprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max
# =============================================================================

message("\n=== Score Analysis by Organelle ===")

# Score columns to analyze
score_cols <- c("RFprob", "AFMprob", "SPOC_score", "ipTM_max")

# Check which score columns exist
existing_score_cols <- intersect(score_cols, colnames(baseline_ppi_v3))
message("Score columns available: ", paste(existing_score_cols, collapse = ", "))

if (length(existing_score_cols) > 0 && nrow(shared_long_baseline) > 0) {

  # --- Filter to organelles with sufficient edges ---
  min_edges_for_density <- 50
  tags_to_keep <- shared_long_baseline %>%
    dplyr::count(tag) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n >= min_edges_for_density) %>%
    dplyr::pull(tag)

  message("Organelles with >= ", min_edges_for_density, " edges: ", length(tags_to_keep))

  # Prepare scores with organelle annotations
  scores_org_baseline <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::select(key, dplyr::all_of(existing_score_cols)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_long_baseline, by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), tag %in% tags_to_keep)

  message("Edges with organelle annotations (n >= 50): ", nrow(scores_org_baseline))

  # Update colors for filtered set
  organelle_colors_filtered <- organelle_colors[names(organelle_colors) %in% tags_to_keep]

  # --- Organelle score summary for bubble plots ---
  organelle_score_summary <- scores_org_baseline %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_edges = dplyr::n(),
      mean_RFprob = if ("RFprob" %in% existing_score_cols) mean(RFprob, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      mean_AFMprob = if ("AFMprob" %in% existing_score_cols) mean(AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      mean_SPOC = if ("SPOC_score" %in% existing_score_cols) mean(SPOC_score, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      mean_ipTM = if ("ipTM_max" %in% existing_score_cols) mean(ipTM_max, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Export source data
  readr::write_csv(organelle_score_summary, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "organelle_score_summary.csv"))

  # --- Bubble Plot 1: RFprob vs AFMprob ---
  if (all(c("RFprob", "AFMprob") %in% existing_score_cols)) {
    p_bubble_rf_afm <- ggplot(organelle_score_summary, aes(x = mean_AFMprob, y = mean_RFprob, size = n_edges, fill = tag)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.3) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors_filtered, guide = "none") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 12), name = "Edges") +
      labs(title = "Mean RFprob vs AFMprob by organelle", x = "Mean AFMprob", y = "Mean RFprob") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            legend.position = "right", legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc", "bubble_RFprob_vs_AFMprob_by_organelle.pdf"), p_bubble_rf_afm, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  # --- Bubble Plot 2: SPOC vs ipTM ---
  if (all(c("SPOC_score", "ipTM_max") %in% existing_score_cols)) {
    p_bubble_spoc_iptm <- ggplot(organelle_score_summary, aes(x = mean_ipTM, y = mean_SPOC, size = n_edges, fill = tag)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.3) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors_filtered, guide = "none") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 12), name = "Edges") +
      labs(title = "Mean SPOC vs ipTM by organelle", x = "Mean ipTM_max", y = "Mean SPOC_score") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            legend.position = "right", legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc", "bubble_SPOC_vs_ipTM_by_organelle.pdf"), p_bubble_spoc_iptm, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  # --- Density plots by organelle ---
  plot_score_density_by_organelle <- function(df, score_col, org_colors, out_dir) {
    df_plot <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!rlang::sym(score_col)))
    if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

    # Export source data
    readr::write_csv(df_plot %>% dplyr::select(key, tag, !!rlang::sym(score_col)),
                     file.path(out_dir, paste0("sourcedata_density_", score_col, ".csv")))

    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = !!rlang::sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
      labs(title = paste(score_col, "density by organelle (n >= 50)"), x = score_col, y = "Density") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.position = "right")

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("density_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")), p, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  for (sc in existing_score_cols) {
    plot_score_density_by_organelle(scores_org_baseline, sc, organelle_colors_filtered, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc"))
  }
  message("Density plots saved for: ", paste(existing_score_cols, collapse = ", "))

  # --- Boxplots by organelle ---
  plot_score_boxplot_by_organelle <- function(df, score_col, org_colors, out_dir) {
    df_plot <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!rlang::sym(score_col)))
    if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

    # Compute summary for export
    boxplot_summary <- df_plot %>%
      dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n = dplyr::n(),
        min = min(!!rlang::sym(score_col), na.rm = TRUE),
        q1 = quantile(!!rlang::sym(score_col), 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(!!rlang::sym(score_col), na.rm = TRUE),
        q3 = quantile(!!rlang::sym(score_col), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(!!rlang::sym(score_col), na.rm = TRUE),
        mean = mean(!!rlang::sym(score_col), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    readr::write_csv(boxplot_summary, file.path(out_dir, paste0("sourcedata_boxplot_", score_col, ".csv")))

    # Order by median
    tag_order <- boxplot_summary %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(median)) %>% dplyr::pull(tag)
    df_plot$tag <- factor(df_plot$tag, levels = tag_order)

    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = tag, y = !!rlang::sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
      labs(title = paste(score_col, "by organelle (n >= 50)"), x = NULL, y = score_col) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("boxplot_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")), p, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  for (sc in existing_score_cols) {
    plot_score_boxplot_by_organelle(scores_org_baseline, sc, organelle_colors_filtered, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc"))
  }
  message("Boxplots saved for: ", paste(existing_score_cols, collapse = ", "))

} else {
  message("Skipping score analysis: no score columns or organelle annotations available")
}
```


## Chunk 5: Heatmap Organelle x Database Validation
```{r baseline_heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# Baseline PPI: Heatmap of Organelle x Database Validation
# Rows: organelles, Columns: validation sources (PDB, CORUM, ComplexPortal, STRING, BIOGRID)
# =============================================================================

message("\n=== Heatmap: Organelle x Database Validation ===")

if (nrow(shared_long_baseline) > 0) {

  # Prepare edge-level database flags
  edge_db_flags <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::select(key, filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      has_PDB = filter_PDB != "none",
      has_CORUM = filter_CORUM == "present",
      has_ComplexPortal = filter_ComplexPortal != "none",
      has_STRING = filter_STRING == "present",
      has_BIOGRID = filter_BIOGRID == "present"
    )

  # Join with organelle annotations
  org_db_combined <- shared_long_baseline %>%
    dplyr::left_join(edge_db_flags, by = "key")

  # Compute counts per organelle per database
  org_db_matrix <- org_db_combined %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total = dplyr::n(),
      PDB = sum(has_PDB),
      CORUM = sum(has_CORUM),
      ComplexPortal = sum(has_ComplexPortal),
      STRING = sum(has_STRING),
      BIOGRID = sum(has_BIOGRID),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_total >= 30)  # minimum edges for heatmap

  # Export source data
  readr::write_csv(org_db_matrix, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "sourcedata_heatmap_organelle_database.csv"))

  if (nrow(org_db_matrix) > 1) {
    # Convert to matrix for pheatmap
    mat <- org_db_matrix %>%
      dplyr::select(tag, PDB, CORUM, ComplexPortal, STRING, BIOGRID) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("tag") %>%
      as.matrix()

    # Heatmap of counts
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat,
      display_numbers = TRUE,
      number_format = "%d",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "steelblue"))(50),
      main = "Baseline PPIs: organelle x database validation (counts)",
      fontsize = 6,
      fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA,
      cellheight = 12,
      cellwidth = 12,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_database_counts.pdf"),
      width = 5,
      height = max(4, nrow(mat) * 0.25)
    )

    # Heatmap of percentages
    mat_pct <- sweep(mat, 1, org_db_matrix$n_total, "/") * 100

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat_pct,
      display_numbers = TRUE,
      number_format = "%.0f",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(50),
      main = "Baseline PPIs: organelle x database validation (% of edges)",
      fontsize = 6,
      fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA,
      cellheight = 12,
      cellwidth = 12,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_database_pct.pdf"),
      width = 5,
      height = max(4, nrow(mat) * 0.25)
    )

    message("Heatmaps saved: organelle x database validation")
  } else {
    message("Not enough organelles for heatmap (< 2 with n >= 30)")
  }
}

# Heatmap: support score distribution per organelle (row-normalized fractions)
support_org_mat <- shared_long_baseline %>%
  dplyr::left_join(baseline_ppi_v3 %>% dplyr::select(key, support_score), by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(support_score)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(tag, support_score) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(tag, support_score, frac) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = support_score, values_from = frac, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as.data.frame()

hm_mat_support <- as.matrix(support_org_mat[, -1])
rownames(hm_mat_support) <- support_org_mat$tag
hm_mat_support <- hm_mat_support[, order(as.integer(colnames(hm_mat_support))), drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(hm_mat_support) >= 2) {
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    hm_mat_support,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2166AC"))(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    display_numbers = FALSE,
    fontsize = 8,
    border_color = NA,
    cellwidth = 12,
    cellheight = 12,
    main = "Support score distribution by organelle (fraction of edges, baseline PPIs)",
    filename = file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc", "heatmap_support_score_by_organelle.pdf"),
    width = 5,
    height = max(4, nrow(hm_mat_support) * 0.3)
  )
  message("Heatmap saved: support score distribution by organelle")
}

message("\nModule 2 complete. Baseline PPI saved with ", nrow(baseline_ppi_v3), " edges")
message("QC plots saved to: ", file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc"))
```




# Module 3: Trimer Detection and Validation
Detects triangles from gold-tier baseline, validates against PDB/CORUM/ComplexPortal
Requires: baseline_ppi_v3 from Module 2, corum_complex_members, complexportal

## Chunk 1: Trimer Detection (Tier1-Only)
```{r trimer_detection}
# =============================================================================
# Trimers: Detection from Tier1 Baseline
# =============================================================================
install.packages("igraph")
library(igraph)

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_trimer <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "trimers")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_trimer, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Build graph from gold-only edges ---
message("=== Building graph from gold-tier edges ===")

g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  baseline_ppi_v3 %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
  directed = FALSE
)
g <- igraph::simplify(g)

message("Graph: ", igraph::vcount(g), " nodes, ", igraph::ecount(g), " edges")

# --- Find all triangles ---
message("Finding triangles...")

triangles_raw <- igraph::triangles(g)
n_triangles <- length(triangles_raw) / 3

message("Triangles found: ", n_triangles)

if (n_triangles > 0) {
  triangle_matrix <- matrix(igraph::V(g)$name[triangles_raw], ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  triangle_matrix_sorted <- t(apply(triangle_matrix, 1, sort))

  trimers_df <- data.frame(
    Gene1 = triangle_matrix_sorted[, 1],
    Gene2 = triangle_matrix_sorted[, 2],
    Gene3 = triangle_matrix_sorted[, 3],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(trimer_id = paste(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, sep = "::")) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(trimer_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  message("Unique trimers: ", nrow(trimers_df))
} else {
  stop("No triangles found. Check graph connectivity.")
}

# --- Get edge keys for each trimer ---
message("Retrieving edge data for trimers...")

.get_edge_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge1_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2),
    edge2_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene3),
    edge3_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene3)
  )

# Create edge lookup
edge_lookup <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(edge_key = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(edge_key, Protein1, Protein2, RFprob, AFMprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max,
                support_score, filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID,
                corum_complex_ids, corum_complex_names, cp_complex_ids)

# Join for each edge
trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e1"), -edge_key), by = c("edge1_key" = "edge_key")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e2"), -edge_key), by = c("edge2_key" = "edge_key")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e3"), -edge_key), by = c("edge3_key" = "edge_key"))
```


## Chunk 2: Trimer Scoring and Validation
```{r trimer_scoring_validation}
# =============================================================================
# Trimers: Scoring and Multi-Database Validation
# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION TIERS (ordered from strongest to weakest evidence):
#   PDB_exact_3:     All 3 edges have exact PDB structure evidence
#   known_complex_3: All 3 edges found in CORUM OR ComplexPortal (reported separately below)
#   PDB_exact_2:     2/3 edges have exact PDB structure evidence
#   known_complex_2: 2/3 edges in CORUM OR ComplexPortal
#   PDB_any_2:       2/3 edges have any PDB evidence (exact or homolog)
#   partial_support: At least 1 edge has PDB/CORUM/ComplexPortal support
#   novel:           No database evidence for any edge
#
# KNOWN COMPLEX MATCHING:
#   - CORUM: gene-based matching (subunits_gene_name column)
#   - ComplexPortal: UniProt ID-based matching
#   - strict match: all 3 proteins found in same reference complex
#   - relaxed match: at least 2/3 proteins found in same reference complex
# =============================================================================

message("Computing trimer scores...")

# Safe functions
safe_mean <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x) & !is.infinite(x)]; if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(x) }
safe_min <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x) & !is.infinite(x)]; if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else min(x) }

trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_AFMprob = safe_mean(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3)),
    min_AFMprob = safe_min(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3)),
    mean_RFprob = safe_mean(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3)),
    min_RFprob = safe_min(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3)),
    mean_ipTM = safe_mean(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3)),
    min_ipTM = safe_min(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3)),
    mean_SPOC = safe_mean(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3)),
    min_SPOC = safe_min(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3)),
    # Support scores
    support_total = sum(c(support_score_e1, support_score_e2, support_score_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    support_mean = support_total / 3,
    # Database flags per edge
    n_edges_PDB = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_PDB_exact = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3) == "exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_CORUM = sum(c(filter_CORUM_e1, filter_CORUM_e2, filter_CORUM_e3) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_ComplexPortal = sum(c(filter_ComplexPortal_e1, filter_ComplexPortal_e2, filter_ComplexPortal_e3) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_STRING = sum(c(filter_STRING_e1, filter_STRING_e2, filter_STRING_e3) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_BIOGRID = sum(c(filter_BIOGRID_e1, filter_BIOGRID_e2, filter_BIOGRID_e3) == "present", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# --- Validation flags ---
trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # All 3 edges in same database
    all_edges_PDB = n_edges_PDB == 3,
    all_edges_PDB_exact = n_edges_PDB_exact == 3,
    all_edges_CORUM = n_edges_CORUM == 3,
    all_edges_ComplexPortal = n_edges_ComplexPortal == 3,
    all_edges_STRING = n_edges_STRING == 3,
    all_edges_BIOGRID = n_edges_BIOGRID == 3,
    # At least 2 edges
    partial_PDB = n_edges_PDB >= 2,
    partial_CORUM = n_edges_CORUM >= 2,
    partial_ComplexPortal = n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 2,
    # Validation tier
    validation_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      all_edges_PDB_exact ~ "PDB_exact_3",
      all_edges_CORUM | all_edges_ComplexPortal ~ "known_complex_3",
      n_edges_PDB_exact >= 2 ~ "PDB_exact_2",
      partial_CORUM | partial_ComplexPortal ~ "known_complex_2",
      n_edges_PDB >= 2 ~ "PDB_any_2",
      n_edges_PDB >= 1 | n_edges_CORUM >= 1 | n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 1 ~ "partial_support",
      TRUE ~ "novel"
    )
  )

# --- Get UniProt IDs for proteins ---
uniprot_lookup <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = Gene1, uniprot = Protein1) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(baseline_ppi_v3 %>% dplyr::select(Gene2, Protein2) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = Gene2, uniprot = Protein2)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(Protein1 = uniprot), by = c("Gene1" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(Protein2 = uniprot), by = c("Gene2" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(Protein3 = uniprot), by = c("Gene3" = "gene"))

# --- ComplexPortal exact match check ---
message("Checking ComplexPortal exact matches...")

.check_cp_match <- function(p1, p2, p3, complex_to_proteins) {
  if (is.na(p1) || is.na(p2) || is.na(p3)) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
  proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
    complex_proteins <- complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]]
    n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_proteins)
    if (n_match == 3) return(list(strict = TRUE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
    if (n_match >= 2) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
  }
  return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
}

cp_matches <- purrr::pmap(list(trimers_df$Protein1, trimers_df$Protein2, trimers_df$Protein3),
                          ~ .check_cp_match(..1, ..2, ..3, complex_to_proteins))

trimers_df$cp_strict_match <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches, "strict")
trimers_df$cp_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches, "relaxed")
trimers_df$cp_matched_id <- purrr::map_chr(cp_matches, "complex_id")

message("  ComplexPortal strict (3/3): ", sum(trimers_df$cp_strict_match))
message("  ComplexPortal relaxed (2/3): ", sum(trimers_df$cp_relaxed_match))

# --- CORUM exact match check (UniProt-based) ---
message("Checking CORUM exact matches (UniProt-based)...")

if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0) {
  # UniProt-based matching (preferred)
  .check_corum_match_uniprot <- function(p1, p2, p3, corum_members) {
    proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3)
    proteins <- proteins[!is.na(proteins)]
    if (length(proteins) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_))

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_members))) {
      complex_proteins <- corum_members$proteins[[i]]
      n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_proteins)
      if (n_match == 3) return(list(strict = TRUE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
      if (n_match >= 2) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
    }
    return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_))
  }

  corum_matches <- purrr::pmap(list(trimers_df$Protein1, trimers_df$Protein2, trimers_df$Protein3),
                               ~ .check_corum_match_uniprot(..1, ..2, ..3, corum_complex_members))

  trimers_df$corum_strict_match <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches, "strict")
  trimers_df$corum_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches, "relaxed")
  trimers_df$corum_matched_id <- purrr::map_int(corum_matches, "complex_id")
  trimers_df$corum_matched_name <- purrr::map_chr(corum_matches, "complex_name")

  message("  CORUM strict (3/3): ", sum(trimers_df$corum_strict_match))
  message("  CORUM relaxed (2/3): ", sum(trimers_df$corum_relaxed_match))
} else {
  trimers_df$corum_strict_match <- FALSE
  trimers_df$corum_relaxed_match <- FALSE
  trimers_df$corum_matched_id <- NA_integer_
  trimers_df$corum_matched_name <- NA_character_
}

# --- Flag: in known complex (any source) ---
trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_known_complex = cp_strict_match | corum_strict_match | all_edges_PDB_exact,
    in_known_complex_relaxed = cp_relaxed_match | corum_relaxed_match | all_edges_PDB
  )

message("\nTrimers in known complex (strict): ", sum(trimers_df$in_known_complex))
message("Trimers in known complex (relaxed): ", sum(trimers_df$in_known_complex_relaxed))
```


## Chunk 3: Trimer QC Plots
```{r trimer_qc_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# Trimers: QC Plots
# All plots export source data CSV for journal compliance
# =============================================================================

# --- Plot 1: Database support barplot ---
db_support_trimers <- data.frame(
  database = c("PDB_any", "PDB_exact", "CORUM", "ComplexPortal", "STRING", "BIOGRID"),
  all_3_edges = c(sum(trimers_df$all_edges_PDB), sum(trimers_df$all_edges_PDB_exact),
                  sum(trimers_df$all_edges_CORUM), sum(trimers_df$all_edges_ComplexPortal),
                  sum(trimers_df$all_edges_STRING), sum(trimers_df$all_edges_BIOGRID)),
  at_least_2 = c(sum(trimers_df$partial_PDB), sum(trimers_df$n_edges_PDB_exact >= 2),
                 sum(trimers_df$partial_CORUM), sum(trimers_df$partial_ComplexPortal),
                 sum(trimers_df$n_edges_STRING >= 2), sum(trimers_df$n_edges_BIOGRID >= 2))
)

# Export source data
readr::write_csv(db_support_trimers, file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc", "sourcedata_database_support_trimers.csv"))

db_support_trimers_long <- db_support_trimers %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-database, names_to = "coverage", values_to = "n_trimers")

p_db_trimers <- ggplot(db_support_trimers_long, aes(x = database, y = n_trimers, fill = coverage)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_trimers), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("all_3_edges" = "grey55", "at_least_2" = "#377EB8"), name = "Coverage") +
  labs(title = "Trimer database support", x = NULL, y = "Number of trimers") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +

# --- Plot 7: Heatmap organelle x validation ---
message("Creating organelle x validation heatmap...")

# Use node-level (protein) annotations with MAJORITY VOTING
# If 2/3 proteins are mito and 1 is lyso, assign trimer as "mito"
if (exists("binary_matrix") && nrow(binary_matrix) > 0) {
  organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
  gene_to_org <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags))

  # Function to get majority organelle for a set of genes
  .get_majority_organelle <- function(genes, gene_to_org, org_tags) {
    org_votes <- lapply(genes, function(g) {
      row <- gene_to_org %>% dplyr::filter(Genes == g)
      if (nrow(row) == 0) return(character(0))
      orgs <- org_tags[as.logical(row[1, org_tags])]
      return(orgs)
    })
    all_orgs <- unlist(org_votes)
    if (length(all_orgs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    # Get majority (most frequent)
    org_counts <- table(all_orgs)
    majority_org <- names(org_counts)[which.max(org_counts)]
    return(majority_org)
  }

  # Apply to each trimer
  trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      majority_organelle = .get_majority_organelle(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3), gene_to_org, organelle_tags)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # Also keep shared_organelle for compatibility (but use majority for heatmap)
  trimers_df$shared_organelle <- trimers_df$majority_organelle

  n_with_org <- sum(!is.na(trimers_df$majority_organelle))
  message("  Trimers with organelle annotation: ", n_with_org, " / ", nrow(trimers_df))

  # Build matrix: organelle x validation source (using majority annotation)
  org_validation_matrix <- trimers_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(majority_organelle)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(majority_organelle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total = dplyr::n(),
      PDB_exact = sum(all_edges_PDB_exact),
      PDB_any = sum(all_edges_PDB),
      CORUM = sum(all_edges_CORUM),
      ComplexPortal = sum(all_edges_ComplexPortal),
      STRING = sum(all_edges_STRING),
      BIOGRID = sum(all_edges_BIOGRID),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_total >= 5)  # Lowered threshold for heatmap

  readr::write_csv(org_validation_matrix, file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc", "sourcedata_heatmap_organelle_validation.csv"))

  if (nrow(org_validation_matrix) > 1) {
    mat <- org_validation_matrix %>%
      dplyr::select(majority_organelle, PDB_exact, CORUM, ComplexPortal, STRING, BIOGRID) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("majority_organelle") %>%
      as.matrix()

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat,
      display_numbers = FALSE,
      number_format = "%d",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "dodgerblue3"))(50),
      main = "Trimers: organelle x validation (counts)",
      fontsize = 6,
      fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA,
      cellheight = 12,
      cellwidth = 12,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation.pdf"),
      width = 5,
      height = max(4, nrow(mat) * 0.25)
    )

    # Percentage heatmap
    mat_pct <- sweep(mat, 1, org_validation_matrix$n_total, "/") * 100

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat_pct,
      display_numbers = TRUE,
      number_format = "%.0f",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(50),
      main = "Trimers: organelle x validation (% of trimers)",
      fontsize = 6,
      fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA,
      cellheight = 12,
      cellwidth = 12,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation_pct.pdf"),
      width = 5,
      height = max(4, nrow(mat) * 0.25)
    )

    message("Heatmaps saved: organelle x validation")
  }
} else {
  message("No organelle annotations available for heatmap (binary_matrix not found)")
  trimers_df$shared_organelle <- NA_character_
  trimers_df$majority_organelle <- NA_character_
}

# --- Summary stats ---
trimer_stats <- data.frame(
  metric = c("total_trimers", "trimers_PDB_exact_all3", "trimers_CORUM_all3", "trimers_ComplexPortal_all3",
             "trimers_CORUM_strict", "trimers_ComplexPortal_strict",
```

# Module 4: Tetramer Detection and Validation
Detects 4-cliques from gold-tier baseline, validates against PDB/CORUM/ComplexPortal
Requires: baseline_ppi_v3 from Module 2, g (graph), corum_complex_members, complexportal

## Chunk 1: Tetramer Detection (Tier 1)
```{r tetramer_detection}
# =============================================================================
# Tetramers: Detection from Tier-1 Baseline (4-cliques)
# =============================================================================

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_tetramer <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tetramers")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Find 4-cliques ---
message("=== Finding tetramers (4-cliques) ===")

cliques_4 <- igraph::cliques(g, min = 4, max = 4)
message("4-cliques found: ", length(cliques_4))

if (length(cliques_4) > 0) {
  tetramers_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cliques_4, function(cl) {
    genes <- sort(igraph::V(g)$name[cl])
    data.frame(
      tetramer_id = paste(genes, collapse = "::"),
      Gene1 = genes[1], Gene2 = genes[2], Gene3 = genes[3], Gene4 = genes[4],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(tetramer_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  message("Unique tetramers: ", nrow(tetramers_df))
} else {
  message("No 4-cliques found. Creating empty tetramer table.")
  tetramers_df <- data.frame(
    tetramer_id = character(), Gene1 = character(), Gene2 = character(),
    Gene3 = character(), Gene4 = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Get edge keys (6 edges per tetramer) ---
if (nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) {
  message("Retrieving edge data for tetramers...")

  tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      edge1_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2),
      edge2_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene3),
      edge3_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene4),
      edge4_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene3),
      edge5_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene4),
      edge6_key = .get_edge_key(Gene3, Gene4)
    )

  # Join edge data for each of 6 edges
  for (j in 1:6) {
    edge_col <- paste0("edge", j, "_key")
    suffix <- paste0("_e", j)
    tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
      dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, suffix), -edge_key),
                       by = setNames("edge_key", edge_col))
  }
}
```


## Chunk 2: Tetramer Scoring and Validation
```{r tetramer_scoring_validation}
# =============================================================================
# Tetramers: Scoring and Multi-Database Validation
# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION TIERS (ordered from strongest to weakest evidence):
#   PDB_exact_6:           All 6 edges have exact PDB structure evidence
#   known_complex_6:       All 6 edges found in CORUM OR ComplexPortal (reported separately below)
#   PDB_exact_4plus:       4+ of 6 edges have exact PDB structure evidence
#   known_complex_4plus:   4+ of 6 edges in CORUM OR ComplexPortal
#   partial_support_3plus: 3+ edges have PDB/CORUM/ComplexPortal support
#   partial_support:       At least 1 edge has support
#   novel:                 No database evidence for any edge
#
# KNOWN COMPLEX MATCHING:
#   - CORUM: gene-based matching (subunits_gene_name column)
#   - ComplexPortal: UniProt ID-based matching
#   - strict match: all 4 proteins found in same reference complex
#   - relaxed match: at least 3/4 proteins found in same reference complex
# =============================================================================

if (nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) {
  message("Computing tetramer scores...")

  tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mean_AFMprob = safe_mean(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3, AFMprob_e4, AFMprob_e5, AFMprob_e6)),
      min_AFMprob = safe_min(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3, AFMprob_e4, AFMprob_e5, AFMprob_e6)),
      mean_RFprob = safe_mean(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3, RFprob_e4, RFprob_e5, RFprob_e6)),
      min_RFprob = safe_min(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3, RFprob_e4, RFprob_e5, RFprob_e6)),
      mean_ipTM = safe_mean(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3, ipTM_max_e4, ipTM_max_e5, ipTM_max_e6)),
      min_ipTM = safe_min(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3, ipTM_max_e4, ipTM_max_e5, ipTM_max_e6)),
      mean_SPOC = safe_mean(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3, SPOC_score_e4, SPOC_score_e5, SPOC_score_e6)),
      min_SPOC = safe_min(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3, SPOC_score_e4, SPOC_score_e5, SPOC_score_e6)),
      # Support scores
      support_total = sum(c(support_score_e1, support_score_e2, support_score_e3, support_score_e4, support_score_e5, support_score_e6), na.rm = TRUE),
      support_mean = support_total / 6,
      # Database flags per edge
      n_edges_PDB = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3, filter_PDB_e4, filter_PDB_e5, filter_PDB_e6) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_PDB_exact = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3, filter_PDB_e4, filter_PDB_e5, filter_PDB_e6) == "exact", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_CORUM = sum(c(filter_CORUM_e1, filter_CORUM_e2, filter_CORUM_e3, filter_CORUM_e4, filter_CORUM_e5, filter_CORUM_e6) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_ComplexPortal = sum(c(filter_ComplexPortal_e1, filter_ComplexPortal_e2, filter_ComplexPortal_e3, filter_ComplexPortal_e4, filter_ComplexPortal_e5, filter_ComplexPortal_e6) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_STRING = sum(c(filter_STRING_e1, filter_STRING_e2, filter_STRING_e3, filter_STRING_e4, filter_STRING_e5, filter_STRING_e6) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_BIOGRID = sum(c(filter_BIOGRID_e1, filter_BIOGRID_e2, filter_BIOGRID_e3, filter_BIOGRID_e4, filter_BIOGRID_e5, filter_BIOGRID_e6) == "present", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # --- Validation flags ---
  tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      all_edges_PDB = n_edges_PDB == 6,
      all_edges_PDB_exact = n_edges_PDB_exact == 6,
      all_edges_CORUM = n_edges_CORUM == 6,
      all_edges_ComplexPortal = n_edges_ComplexPortal == 6,
      all_edges_STRING = n_edges_STRING == 6,
      all_edges_BIOGRID = n_edges_BIOGRID == 6,
      # Majority (4+ of 6)
      majority_PDB = n_edges_PDB >= 4,
      majority_PDB_exact = n_edges_PDB_exact >= 4,
      majority_CORUM = n_edges_CORUM >= 4,
      majority_ComplexPortal = n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 4,
      # Validation tier
      validation_tier = dplyr::case_when(
        all_edges_PDB_exact ~ "PDB_exact_6",
        all_edges_CORUM | all_edges_ComplexPortal ~ "known_complex_6",
        majority_PDB_exact ~ "PDB_exact_4plus",
        majority_CORUM | majority_ComplexPortal ~ "known_complex_4plus",
        n_edges_PDB >= 3 | n_edges_CORUM >= 3 | n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 3 ~ "partial_support_3plus",
        n_edges_PDB >= 1 | n_edges_CORUM >= 1 | n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 1 ~ "partial_support",
        TRUE ~ "novel"
      )
    )

  # --- Get UniProt IDs ---
  # Create uniprot_lookup from baseline (or master_ppi_v3 if baseline not available)
  message("Creating UniProt lookup for tetramers...")

  ppi_source <- if (exists("baseline_ppi_v3") && nrow(baseline_ppi_v3) > 0) baseline_ppi_v3 else master_ppi_v3

  uniprot_lookup <- ppi_source %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene1) & !is.na(Protein1) & Gene1 != "" & Protein1 != "") %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene = Gene1, uniprot = Protein1) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      ppi_source %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene2, Protein2) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene2) & !is.na(Protein2) & Gene2 != "" & Protein2 != "") %>%
        dplyr::rename(gene = Gene2, uniprot = Protein2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  message("  UniProt lookup entries: ", nrow(uniprot_lookup))

  # Initialize Protein columns
  tetramers_df$Protein1 <- NA_character_
  tetramers_df$Protein2 <- NA_character_
  tetramers_df$Protein3 <- NA_character_
  tetramers_df$Protein4 <- NA_character_

  # Map Gene to UniProt
  if (nrow(uniprot_lookup) > 0) {
    gene_to_prot <- setNames(uniprot_lookup$uniprot, uniprot_lookup$gene)
    tetramers_df$Protein1 <- gene_to_prot[tetramers_df$Gene1]
    tetramers_df$Protein2 <- gene_to_prot[tetramers_df$Gene2]
    tetramers_df$Protein3 <- gene_to_prot[tetramers_df$Gene3]
    tetramers_df$Protein4 <- gene_to_prot[tetramers_df$Gene4]
  }

  n_with_proteins <- sum(!is.na(tetramers_df$Protein1) & !is.na(tetramers_df$Protein2) &
                          !is.na(tetramers_df$Protein3) & !is.na(tetramers_df$Protein4))
  message("  Tetramers with all 4 proteins mapped: ", n_with_proteins, " / ", nrow(tetramers_df))

  # --- ComplexPortal exact match check ---
  message("Checking ComplexPortal exact matches...")

  .check_cp_match_4 <- function(p1, p2, p3, p4, complex_to_proteins) {
    if (is.na(p1) || is.na(p2) || is.na(p3) || is.na(p4)) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
    proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3, p4)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
      complex_proteins <- complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]]
      n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_proteins)
      if (n_match == 4) return(list(strict = TRUE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
      if (n_match >= 3) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
    }
    return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
  }

  # Check if complex_to_proteins exists and has data
  if (exists("complex_to_proteins") && nrow(complex_to_proteins) > 0 && n_with_proteins > 0) {
    cp_matches_4 <- purrr::pmap(
      list(tetramers_df$Protein1, tetramers_df$Protein2, tetramers_df$Protein3, tetramers_df$Protein4),
      ~ .check_cp_match_4(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4, complex_to_proteins)
    )

    tetramers_df$cp_strict_match <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches_4, "strict")
    tetramers_df$cp_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches_4, "relaxed")
    tetramers_df$cp_matched_id <- purrr::map_chr(cp_matches_4, "complex_id")
  } else {
    message("  Skipping ComplexPortal check (no protein mapping or no complex data)")
    tetramers_df$cp_strict_match <- FALSE
    tetramers_df$cp_relaxed_match <- FALSE
    tetramers_df$cp_matched_id <- NA_character_
  }

  message("  ComplexPortal strict (4/4): ", sum(tetramers_df$cp_strict_match))
  message("  ComplexPortal relaxed (3/4): ", sum(tetramers_df$cp_relaxed_match))

  # --- CORUM exact match check (UniProt-based) ---
  message("Checking CORUM exact matches (UniProt-based)...")

  if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0 && n_with_proteins > 0) {
    .check_corum_match_4_uniprot <- function(p1, p2, p3, p4, corum_members) {
      proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3, p4)
      proteins <- proteins[!is.na(proteins)]
      if (length(proteins) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_))

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_members))) {
        complex_proteins <- corum_members$proteins[[i]]
        n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_proteins)
        if (n_match == 4) return(list(strict = TRUE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
        if (n_match >= 3) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
      }
      return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_))
    }

    corum_matches_4 <- purrr::pmap(
      list(tetramers_df$Protein1, tetramers_df$Protein2, tetramers_df$Protein3, tetramers_df$Protein4),
      ~ .check_corum_match_4_uniprot(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4, corum_complex_members)
    )

    tetramers_df$corum_strict_match <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches_4, "strict")
    tetramers_df$corum_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches_4, "relaxed")
    tetramers_df$corum_matched_id <- purrr::map_int(corum_matches_4, "complex_id")
    tetramers_df$corum_matched_name <- purrr::map_chr(corum_matches_4, "complex_name")

    message("  CORUM strict (4/4): ", sum(tetramers_df$corum_strict_match))
    message("  CORUM relaxed (3/4): ", sum(tetramers_df$corum_relaxed_match))
  } else {
    message("  Skipping CORUM check (no protein mapping or no CORUM data)")
    tetramers_df$corum_strict_match <- FALSE
    tetramers_df$corum_relaxed_match <- FALSE
    tetramers_df$corum_matched_id <- NA_integer_
    tetramers_df$corum_matched_name <- NA_character_
  }

  # --- Flag: in known complex ---
  tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      in_known_complex = cp_strict_match | corum_strict_match | all_edges_PDB_exact,
      in_known_complex_relaxed = cp_relaxed_match | corum_relaxed_match | majority_PDB
    )

  message("\nTetramers in known complex (strict): ", sum(tetramers_df$in_known_complex))
  message("Tetramers in known complex (relaxed): ", sum(tetramers_df$in_known_complex_relaxed))
}
```

```{r tetramer_qc_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
  # --- Plot 5: Support score distribution ---

  readr::write_csv(support_hist_data_tet, file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "qc", "sourcedata_support_score.csv"))

  p_scores_known_tet <- ggplot(scores_by_known_tet_long, aes(x = status, y = value, fill = status)) +

  # --- Plot 7: Heatmap organelle x validation ---
  message("Creating organelle x validation heatmap...")

  # Use node-level (protein) annotations with MAJORITY VOTING
  # For tetramers: 3/4 = strict majority, 2/4 = relaxed majority
  if (exists("binary_matrix") && nrow(binary_matrix) > 0) {
    organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
    gene_to_org <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags))

    # Function to get majority organelle for a set of 4 genes
    # Returns: list(strict = org if 3+/4, relaxed = org if 2+/4, organelle = best match)
    .get_majority_organelle_4 <- function(genes, gene_to_org, org_tags) {
      org_votes <- lapply(genes, function(g) {
        row <- gene_to_org %>% dplyr::filter(Genes == g)
        if (nrow(row) == 0) return(character(0))
        orgs <- org_tags[as.logical(row[1, org_tags])]
        return(orgs)
      })
      all_orgs <- unlist(org_votes)
      if (length(all_orgs) == 0) return(list(organelle = NA_character_, strict = NA_character_, relaxed = NA_character_, n_agree = 0L))

      org_counts <- table(all_orgs)
      max_count <- max(org_counts)
      majority_org <- names(org_counts)[which.max(org_counts)]

      return(list(
        organelle = majority_org,
        strict = if (max_count >= 3) majority_org else NA_character_,
        relaxed = if (max_count >= 2) majority_org else NA_character_,
        n_agree = as.integer(max_count)
      ))
    }

    # Apply to each tetramer
    tetramer_org_results <- purrr::pmap(
      list(tetramers_df$Gene1, tetramers_df$Gene2, tetramers_df$Gene3, tetramers_df$Gene4),
      ~ .get_majority_organelle_4(c(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4), gene_to_org, organelle_tags)
    )

    tetramers_df$majority_organelle <- purrr::map_chr(tetramer_org_results, "organelle")
    tetramers_df$organelle_strict <- purrr::map_chr(tetramer_org_results, "strict")
    tetramers_df$organelle_relaxed <- purrr::map_chr(tetramer_org_results, "relaxed")
    tetramers_df$organelle_n_agree <- purrr::map_int(tetramer_org_results, "n_agree")

    # Use relaxed (2/4) for shared_organelle in heatmap (for better coverage)
    tetramers_df$shared_organelle <- tetramers_df$organelle_relaxed

    n_with_org <- sum(!is.na(tetramers_df$majority_organelle))
    n_strict <- sum(!is.na(tetramers_df$organelle_strict))
    n_relaxed <- sum(!is.na(tetramers_df$organelle_relaxed))
    message("  Tetramers with any organelle annotation: ", n_with_org, " / ", nrow(tetramers_df))
    message("  Tetramers with strict majority (3/4): ", n_strict)
    message("  Tetramers with relaxed majority (2/4): ", n_relaxed)

    # Build matrix: organelle x validation source (using relaxed 2/4 annotation)
    org_validation_matrix_tet <- tetramers_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(organelle_relaxed)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(organelle_relaxed) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_total = dplyr::n(),
        PDB_exact = sum(all_edges_PDB_exact),
        PDB_any = sum(all_edges_PDB),
        CORUM = sum(all_edges_CORUM),
        ComplexPortal = sum(all_edges_ComplexPortal),
        STRING = sum(all_edges_STRING),
        BIOGRID = sum(all_edges_BIOGRID),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_total >= 3)  # Lowered threshold for heatmap

    readr::write_csv(org_validation_matrix_tet, file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "qc", "sourcedata_heatmap_organelle_validation.csv"))

    if (nrow(org_validation_matrix_tet) > 1) {
      mat_tet <- org_validation_matrix_tet %>%
        dplyr::select(organelle_relaxed, PDB_exact, CORUM, ComplexPortal, STRING, BIOGRID) %>%
        tibble::column_to_rownames("organelle_relaxed") %>%
        as.matrix()

      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        mat_tet,
        display_numbers = FALSE,
        number_format = "%d",
        color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "dodgerblue3"))(50),
        main = "Tetramers: organelle x validation (counts)",
        fontsize = 6,
        fontsize_number = 5,
        border_color = NA,
        cellheight = 12,
        cellwidth = 12,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        filename = file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation.pdf"),
        width = 5,
        height = max(4, nrow(mat_tet) * 0.25)
      )

      # Percentage heatmap
      mat_pct_tet <- sweep(mat_tet, 1, org_validation_matrix_tet$n_total, "/") * 100

      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        mat_pct_tet,
        display_numbers = TRUE,
        number_format = "%.0f",
        color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(50),
        main = "Tetramers: organelle x validation (% of tetramers)",
        fontsize = 6,
        fontsize_number = 5,
        border_color = NA,
        cellheight = 12,
        cellwidth = 12,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        filename = file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation_pct.pdf"),
        width = 5,
        height = max(4, nrow(mat_tet) * 0.25)
      )

      message("Heatmaps saved: organelle x validation")
    }
  } else {
    message("No organelle annotations available for heatmap (binary_matrix not found)")
    tetramers_df$shared_organelle <- NA_character_
    tetramers_df$majority_organelle <- NA_character_
  }
}

# --- Summary stats ---
tetramer_stats <- data.frame(
  metric = c("total_tetramers", "tetramers_PDB_exact_all6", "tetramers_CORUM_all6", "tetramers_ComplexPortal_all6",
             "tetramers_CORUM_strict", "tetramers_ComplexPortal_strict",
             "tetramers_in_known_complex", "tetramers_novel", "median_support_score", "median_mean_AFMprob"),
  value = c(nrow(tetramers_df),
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) sum(tetramers_df$all_edges_PDB_exact) else 0,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) sum(tetramers_df$all_edges_CORUM) else 0,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) sum(tetramers_df$all_edges_ComplexPortal) else 0,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) sum(tetramers_df$corum_strict_match) else 0,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) sum(tetramers_df$cp_strict_match) else 0,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) sum(tetramers_df$in_known_complex) else 0,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) sum(!tetramers_df$in_known_complex_relaxed) else 0,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) round(median(tetramers_df$support_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA,
            if(nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) round(median(tetramers_df$mean_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3) else NA)
)

readr::write_csv(tetramer_stats, file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "tables", "tetramer_stats.csv"))

# --- Save tetramer evidence table ---
if (nrow(tetramers_df) > 0) {
  # Ensure shared_organelle exists
 if (!"shared_organelle" %in% colnames(tetramers_df)) tetramers_df$shared_organelle <- NA_character_

  tetramer_evidence <- tetramers_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      tetramer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4, Protein1, Protein2, Protein3, Protein4,
      edge1_key, edge2_key, edge3_key, edge4_key, edge5_key, edge6_key,
      mean_AFMprob, min_AFMprob, mean_RFprob, min_RFprob, mean_ipTM, min_ipTM, mean_SPOC, min_SPOC,
      support_total, support_mean,
      n_edges_PDB, n_edges_PDB_exact, n_edges_CORUM, n_edges_ComplexPortal, n_edges_STRING, n_edges_BIOGRID,
      all_edges_PDB_exact, all_edges_CORUM, all_edges_ComplexPortal,
      validation_tier, shared_organelle,
      cp_strict_match, cp_relaxed_match, cp_matched_id,
      corum_strict_match, corum_relaxed_match, corum_matched_id, corum_matched_name,
      in_known_complex, in_known_complex_relaxed
    )
} else {
  tetramer_evidence <- data.frame()
}

readr::write_csv(tetramer_evidence, file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "tables", "tetramer_evidence.csv"))

message("\nModule 4 complete. ", nrow(tetramer_evidence), " tetramers saved")
if (nrow(tetramer_evidence) > 0) {
  message("  Known complex (strict): ", sum(tetramer_evidence$in_known_complex))
  message("  Novel: ", sum(!tetramer_evidence$in_known_complex_relaxed))
}
message("QC plots saved to: ", file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "qc"))
```

# Module 5: Complex Growing from Trimers and Tetramers
Grows complexes by iteratively adding neighbors connected to ≥2 members
Requires: baseline_ppi_v3, trimer_evidence, tetramer_evidence

ALGORITHM:
   1. Start with trimer/tetramer seeds (3-4 protein subunits)
   2. Iteratively grow by adding neighbors connected to ≥2 current members (min_edges=2)
   3. Continue until no more candidates or max_size reached
   4. Merge overlapping complexes at 80% threshold

 VALIDATION:
   - CORUM: gene-based matching, strict = all members in same CORUM complex
   - ComplexPortal: UniProt-based matching, strict = all members in same CP complex
   - relaxed match: ≥50% of members found in reference complex

## Chunk 1: Build Adjacency and Growth Functions
```{r complex_setup}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Growing: Setup
# =============================================================================

out_dir_complex <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "complexes")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_complex, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_complex, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("=== Complex Growing from Trimers/Tetramers ===")

# --- Build adjacency list from gold-only baseline ---
message("Building adjacency structures from baseline (gold-only)...")

adj_list <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  {
    edges <- rbind(
      data.frame(from = .$Gene1, to = .$Gene2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      data.frame(from = .$Gene2, to = .$Gene1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
    split(edges$to, edges$from)
  }

message("Adjacency list: ", length(adj_list), " nodes")

# =============================================================================
# Compartment constraints for complex expansion
# =============================================================================

compartment_groups <- list(
  SynapticGeneral = c("SynGO", "SynapseSVs", "Postsynaptic", "Presynaptic",
                      "Svendocytosis", "Svexocytosis", "SVfusion", "vATPase"),
  Nucleus         = c("Nucleus"),
  ER              = c("ER"),
  Golgi           = c("Golgi","ER","EarlyEndosome"),
  Mito            = c("Mito", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "MitoIMS", "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI"),
  Endosome        = c("Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome",
                      "Lysosome", "vATPase"),
  Autophagy       = c("Autophagy", "Lysosome", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "vATPase")
)

# ER -> Golgi -> Endosome -> Lysosome -> Autophagy: one continuous pathway
# Tags shared across these groups (ER, EarlyEndosome, Lysosome, vATPase, Endo_iN_curated_Hundley)
# are biologically valid in all of them -> mark all as compatible
compatible_multi_groups <- c("ER", "Golgi", "Lysosome", "Endosome", "Autophagy")

# Build tag -> groups lookup
tag_to_groups <- list()
for (.grp in names(compartment_groups))
  for (.tg in compartment_groups[[.grp]]) tag_to_groups[[.tg]] <- unique(c(tag_to_groups[[.tg]], .grp))

# Build protein -> allowed_groups from gene_to_org
# Drop proteins spanning incompatible groups (e.g. Nucleus + SynGO)
# For compatible multi-group proteins: allowed = their actual groups (not the full set)
.present_cx_tags <- intersect(unique(unlist(compartment_groups)), colnames(gene_to_org))

protein_allowed_df <- gene_to_org %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(.present_cx_tags)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "tag", values_to = "present") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(present) & as.logical(present)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(groups = list(unique(unlist(purrr::map(tag, ~tag_to_groups[[.x]])))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(length(groups) == 1 | all(groups %in% compatible_multi_groups)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(allowed = list(if (all(groups %in% compatible_multi_groups)) unlist(groups) else groups[[1]])) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Named list: gene -> character vector of allowed groups
protein_allowed <- setNames(protein_allowed_df$allowed, protein_allowed_df$Genes)

message("Compartment-constrained proteins: ", length(protein_allowed), " / ", nrow(gene_to_org))

# Determine allowed expansion groups from seed members:
# If all seed groups are within compatible_multi_groups -> return their union (secretory/endolysosomal)
# Otherwise majority vote -> single dominant group
.get_seed_allowed <- function(seed_members) {
  all_grps <- unlist(purrr::map(seed_members, ~protein_allowed[[.x]]))
  if (length(all_grps) == 0) return(NULL)
  unique_grps <- unique(all_grps)
  if (all(unique_grps %in% compatible_multi_groups)) return(unique_grps)
  names(sort(table(all_grps), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

# --- Growth functions (compartment-constrained) ---
# protein_allowed is resolved from enclosing environment
.grow_complex <- function(members, adj_list, min_edges = 2, allowed_groups = NULL) {
  all_neighbors <- unlist(adj_list[members])
  if (is.null(all_neighbors) || length(all_neighbors) == 0) return(character(0))
  neighbor_counts <- table(all_neighbors)
  candidates <- names(neighbor_counts)[neighbor_counts >= min_edges]
  candidates <- setdiff(candidates, members)
  if (!is.null(allowed_groups) && length(candidates) > 0) {
    candidates <- candidates[vapply(candidates, function(cand) {
      cg <- protein_allowed[[cand]]
      !is.null(cg) && any(cg %in% allowed_groups)
    }, logical(1))]
  }
  return(candidates)
}

.grow_complex_iterative <- function(seed_members, adj_list, min_edges = 2, max_size = 100, allowed_groups = NULL) {
  current <- seed_members
  repeat {
    if (length(current) >= max_size) break
    candidates <- .grow_complex(current, adj_list, min_edges, allowed_groups)
    if (length(candidates) == 0) break
    current <- c(current, candidates)
  }
  return(sort(current))
}

.overlap_fraction <- function(a, b) {
  length(intersect(a, b)) / min(length(a), length(b))
}
```


## Chunk 2: Grow Complexes from Seeds
```{r complex_growing}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Growing: From Trimers and Tetramers
# =============================================================================

# --- Grow from trimers ---
message("Growing complexes from trimers...")

trimer_seeds <- trimer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(seed_members = list(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

grown_from_trimers <- trimer_seeds %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    seed_allowed  = list(.get_seed_allowed(seed_members)),
    grown_members = list(.grow_complex_iterative(seed_members, adj_list, min_edges = 2, allowed_groups = seed_allowed)),
    grown_size    = length(grown_members),
    complex_id    = paste(sort(grown_members), collapse = "::")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("  Trimers grown: ", nrow(grown_from_trimers))
message("  Trimers with compartment constraint: ", sum(!sapply(grown_from_trimers$seed_allowed, is.null)), " / ", nrow(grown_from_trimers))
message("  Unique complexes from trimers: ", length(unique(grown_from_trimers$complex_id)))

# --- Grow from tetramers ---
message("Growing complexes from tetramers...")

if (nrow(tetramer_evidence) > 0) {
  tetramer_seeds <- tetramer_evidence %>%
    dplyr::select(tetramer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(seed_members = list(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  grown_from_tetramers <- tetramer_seeds %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      seed_allowed  = list(.get_seed_allowed(seed_members)),
      grown_members = list(.grow_complex_iterative(seed_members, adj_list, min_edges = 2, allowed_groups = seed_allowed)),
      grown_size    = length(grown_members),
      complex_id    = paste(sort(grown_members), collapse = "::")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  message("  Tetramers grown: ", nrow(grown_from_tetramers))
  message("  Tetramers with compartment constraint: ", sum(!sapply(grown_from_tetramers$seed_allowed, is.null)), " / ", nrow(grown_from_tetramers))
  message("  Unique complexes from tetramers: ", length(unique(grown_from_tetramers$complex_id)))
} else {
  grown_from_tetramers <- data.frame(
    tetramer_id = character(), grown_members = I(list()), grown_size = integer(),
    complex_id = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Internal QC: Trimer+1 vs Tetramer ---
message("\n=== Internal QC: Trimer+1 vs Tetramer ===")

trimer_plus_one <- grown_from_trimers %>% dplyr::filter(grown_size == 4)
message("Trimers that grew to size 4: ", nrow(trimer_plus_one))

if (nrow(tetramer_evidence) > 0 && nrow(trimer_plus_one) > 0) {
  tetramer_ids <- tetramer_evidence %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(complex_id = paste(sort(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4)), collapse = "::")) %>%
    dplyr::pull(complex_id)

  trimer_plus_one_overlap <- trimer_plus_one %>%
    dplyr::mutate(matches_tetramer = complex_id %in% tetramer_ids)

  message("  Trimer+1 matching de novo tetramers: ", sum(trimer_plus_one_overlap$matches_tetramer), " / ", nrow(trimer_plus_one_overlap))
  message("  Match rate: ", round(100 * mean(trimer_plus_one_overlap$matches_tetramer), 1), "%")
}

# --- Combine and count seeds ---
message("\nCombining complexes from all seeds...")

all_grown <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  grown_from_trimers %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, grown_members, grown_size) %>% dplyr::mutate(seed_type = "trimer"),
  grown_from_tetramers %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, grown_members, grown_size) %>% dplyr::mutate(seed_type = "tetramer")
)

complex_seed_counts <- all_grown %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_trimer_seeds = sum(seed_type == "trimer"),
    n_tetramer_seeds = sum(seed_type == "tetramer"),
    n_total_seeds = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

unique_complexes <- all_grown %>%
  dplyr::distinct(complex_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_seed_counts, by = "complex_id")

message("Unique complexes (before merging): ", nrow(unique_complexes))
```


## Chunk 3: Merge Overlapping Complexes
```{r complex_merging}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Growing: Merge Overlapping Complexes (80% threshold)
# =============================================================================

message("Merging overlapping complexes (80% threshold)...")

unique_complexes <- unique_complexes %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(grown_size))

merged_complexes <- list()
used <- rep(FALSE, nrow(unique_complexes))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(unique_complexes))) {
  if (used[i]) next
  current <- unique_complexes$grown_members[[i]]
  current_seeds <- c(unique_complexes$n_trimer_seeds[i], unique_complexes$n_tetramer_seeds[i])

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(unique_complexes))) {
    if (i == j || used[j]) next
    other <- unique_complexes$grown_members[[j]]
    overlap <- .overlap_fraction(current, other)
    if (overlap >= 0.8) {
      current <- union(current, other)
      current_seeds <- current_seeds + c(unique_complexes$n_trimer_seeds[j], unique_complexes$n_tetramer_seeds[j])
      used[j] <- TRUE
    }
  }

  merged_complexes[[length(merged_complexes) + 1]] <- list(
    members = sort(current),
    size = length(current),
    n_trimer_seeds = current_seeds[1],
    n_tetramer_seeds = current_seeds[2]
  )
  used[i] <- TRUE
}

message("Complexes after merging: ", length(merged_complexes))

# --- Convert to dataframe ---
complex_evidence <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(merged_complexes), function(i) {
  data.frame(
    complex_id = paste(merged_complexes[[i]]$members, collapse = "::"),
    complex_size = merged_complexes[[i]]$size,
    n_trimer_seeds = merged_complexes[[i]]$n_trimer_seeds,
    n_tetramer_seeds = merged_complexes[[i]]$n_tetramer_seeds,
    members = I(list(merged_complexes[[i]]$members)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(complex_idx = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_idx, complex_id, complex_size, n_trimer_seeds, n_tetramer_seeds, members)

message("Final complex count: ", nrow(complex_evidence))

# Size distribution
size_dist <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::count(complex_size, name = "n_complexes") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(complex_size)

message("\nComplex size distribution:")
print(size_dist)
```


## Chunk 4: Add Support Scores and Validation
```{r complex_scoring}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Growing: Support Scores and Validation
# =============================================================================
# SUPPORT SCORING (per edge, max = 9):
#   PDB exact structure:    +3 points
#   PDB homolog:            +1 point
#   ComplexPortal strict:   +3 points
#   ComplexPortal relaxed:  +1 point
#   STRING:                 +1 point
#   BIOGRID:                +1 point
#   CORUM:                  +1 point
#
# COMPLEX SUPPORT: sum/mean of all edge support scores within the complex
#
# VALIDATION STATUS:
#   strict_match:  All members found in same CORUM OR ComplexPortal reference complex
#   relaxed_match: ≥50% of members found in same reference complex
#   novel:         No significant overlap with known complexes
# =============================================================================

message("\nComputing support scores for complexes...")

# Create support lookup
support_lookup <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(edge_key = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(edge_key, support_score, filter_BIOGRID, filter_STRING, filter_PDB, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_CORUM,
                corum_complex_ids, corum_complex_names)

# Function to compute support
.compute_complex_support <- function(members, support_lookup) {
  if (length(members) < 2) return(list(n_edges = 0, support_total = 0, support_mean = NA_real_,
                                        n_with_PDB_exact = 0, n_with_PDB_homolog = 0))

  pairs <- t(combn(sort(unique(members)), 2))
  edge_keys <- apply(pairs, 1, function(p) .make_undirected_key(p[1], p[2]))

  matched <- support_lookup %>% dplyr::filter(edge_key %in% edge_keys)

  list(
    n_edges = nrow(matched),
    n_edges_possible = length(edge_keys),
    support_total = sum(matched$support_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    support_mean = if (nrow(matched) > 0) round(mean(matched$support_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA_real_,
    n_in_CORUM = sum(matched$filter_CORUM == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_with_PDB = sum(matched$filter_PDB != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_with_PDB_exact = sum(matched$filter_PDB == "exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_with_PDB_homolog = sum(matched$filter_PDB == "homolog", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_in_ComplexPortal = sum(matched$filter_ComplexPortal != "none", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    support_info = list(.compute_complex_support(members, support_lookup)),
    n_edges_in_baseline = support_info$n_edges,
    n_edges_possible = support_info$n_edges_possible,
    edge_coverage = round(n_edges_in_baseline / n_edges_possible, 2),
    complex_support_total = support_info$support_total,
    complex_support_mean = support_info$support_mean,
    n_edges_in_CORUM = support_info$n_in_CORUM,
    n_edges_with_PDB = support_info$n_with_PDB,
    n_edges_with_PDB_exact = support_info$n_with_PDB_exact,
    n_edges_with_PDB_homolog = support_info$n_with_PDB_homolog,
    n_edges_in_ComplexPortal = support_info$n_in_ComplexPortal,
    pct_edges_CORUM = round(100 * n_edges_in_CORUM / n_edges_in_baseline, 1),
    pct_edges_PDB = round(100 * n_edges_with_PDB / n_edges_in_baseline, 1),
    pct_edges_PDB_exact = round(100 * n_edges_with_PDB_exact / n_edges_in_baseline, 1),
    pct_edges_PDB_homolog = round(100 * n_edges_with_PDB_homolog / n_edges_in_baseline, 1),
    # PDB-based validation flags (majority of edges have PDB support)
    has_PDB_exact_majority = (n_edges_with_PDB_exact / n_edges_in_baseline) >= 0.5,
    has_PDB_any_majority = (n_edges_with_PDB / n_edges_in_baseline) >= 0.5
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-support_info) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Mean complex support score: ", round(mean(complex_evidence$complex_support_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2))

# --- Create uniprot_lookup if not exists ---
if (!exists("uniprot_lookup") || nrow(uniprot_lookup) == 0) {
  uniprot_lookup <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene = Gene1, uniprot = Protein1) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(baseline_ppi_v3 %>% dplyr::select(Gene2, Protein2) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = Gene2, uniprot = Protein2)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# --- ComplexPortal validation ---
message("\nValidating complexes against ComplexPortal...")

if (exists("complex_to_proteins") && exists("uniprot_lookup")) {
  .check_complex_match_any <- function(members, complex_to_proteins, uniprot_lookup) {
    uniprots <- uniprot_lookup$uniprot[match(members, uniprot_lookup$gene)]
    uniprots <- uniprots[!is.na(uniprots)]

    if (length(uniprots) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_, match_fraction = 0))

    best_match <- list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_, match_fraction = 0)

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
      complex_proteins <- complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]]
      n_match <- sum(uniprots %in% complex_proteins)
      match_frac <- n_match / length(uniprots)

      if (match_frac > best_match$match_fraction) {
        best_match$match_fraction <- match_frac
        best_match$complex_id <- complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]
        best_match$strict <- (n_match == length(uniprots) && n_match == length(complex_proteins))
        best_match$relaxed <- (match_frac >= 0.5)
      }
    }
    return(best_match)
  }

  complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cp_match = list(.check_complex_match_any(members, complex_to_proteins, uniprot_lookup)),
      cp_strict_match = cp_match$strict,
      cp_relaxed_match = cp_match$relaxed,
      cp_matched_id = cp_match$complex_id,
      cp_match_fraction = round(cp_match$match_fraction, 2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-cp_match) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  message("  ComplexPortal strict match: ", sum(complex_evidence$cp_strict_match))
  message("  ComplexPortal relaxed match (>=50%): ", sum(complex_evidence$cp_relaxed_match))
} else {
  complex_evidence$cp_strict_match <- NA
  complex_evidence$cp_relaxed_match <- NA
  complex_evidence$cp_matched_id <- NA_character_
  complex_evidence$cp_match_fraction <- NA_real_
}

# Join ComplexPortal metadata
if (exists("cp_metadata")) {
  complex_evidence <- dplyr::left_join(complex_evidence, cp_metadata, by = c("cp_matched_id" = "complex_id"))
} else {
  complex_evidence$cp_name        <- NA_character_
  complex_evidence$cp_description <- NA_character_
}

# --- CORUM validation (UniProt-based) ---
message("Validating complexes against CORUM (UniProt-based)...")

if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0) {
  # UniProt-based matching for complexes
  .check_corum_match_any_uniprot <- function(members, corum_members, uniprot_lookup) {
    # Convert gene names to UniProt IDs
    member_uniprots <- uniprot_lookup$uniprot[match(members, uniprot_lookup$gene)]
    member_uniprots <- member_uniprots[!is.na(member_uniprots)]

    if (length(member_uniprots) == 0) {
      return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_, match_fraction = 0))
    }

    best_match <- list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_, match_fraction = 0)

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_members))) {
      complex_proteins <- corum_members$proteins[[i]]
      n_match <- sum(member_uniprots %in% complex_proteins)
      match_frac <- n_match / length(member_uniprots)

      if (match_frac > best_match$match_fraction) {
        best_match$match_fraction <- match_frac
        best_match$complex_id <- corum_members$complex_id[i]
        best_match$complex_name <- corum_members$complex_name[i]
        best_match$strict <- (n_match == length(member_uniprots) && n_match == length(complex_proteins))
        best_match$relaxed <- (match_frac >= 0.5)
      }
    }
    return(best_match)
  }

  complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      corum_match = list(.check_corum_match_any_uniprot(members, corum_complex_members, uniprot_lookup)),
      corum_strict_match = corum_match$strict,
      corum_relaxed_match = corum_match$relaxed,
      corum_matched_id = corum_match$complex_id,
      corum_matched_name = corum_match$complex_name,
      corum_match_fraction = round(corum_match$match_fraction, 2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-corum_match) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  message("  CORUM strict match: ", sum(complex_evidence$corum_strict_match, na.rm = TRUE))
  message("  CORUM relaxed match (>=50%): ", sum(complex_evidence$corum_relaxed_match, na.rm = TRUE))
} else {
  complex_evidence$corum_strict_match <- NA
  complex_evidence$corum_relaxed_match <- NA
  complex_evidence$corum_matched_id <- NA_integer_
  complex_evidence$corum_matched_name <- NA_character_
  complex_evidence$corum_match_fraction <- NA_real_
}

# --- Origin classification ---
complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    origin = dplyr::case_when(
      n_trimer_seeds > 0 & n_tetramer_seeds > 0 ~ "both",
      n_trimer_seeds > 0 ~ "trimer_only",
      n_tetramer_seeds > 0 ~ "tetramer_only",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    has_known_match = (cp_relaxed_match %in% TRUE) | (corum_relaxed_match %in% TRUE),
    validation_status = dplyr::case_when(
      (cp_strict_match %in% TRUE) | (corum_strict_match %in% TRUE) ~ "strict_match",
      (cp_relaxed_match %in% TRUE) | (corum_relaxed_match %in% TRUE) ~ "relaxed_match",
      TRUE ~ "novel"
    )
  )

message("\nOrigin summary:")
print(complex_evidence %>% dplyr::count(origin))
```


## Chunk 5: QC Plots
```{r complex_qc_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Growing: QC Plots
# All plots export source data CSV for journal compliance
# =============================================================================

# --- Plot 0: Compartment group QC (verify constraints worked) ---
# Derive compartment group per complex from members + protein_allowed
complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    member_groups     = list(unique(unlist(purrr::map(members, ~protein_allowed[[.x]])))),
    compartment_group = {
      grps <- member_groups
      if (is.null(grps) || length(grps) == 0) "unannotated"
      else if (length(grps) == 1)             grps
      else {
        # Majority group vote across all member annotations (not unique)
        all_grps <- unlist(purrr::map(members, ~protein_allowed[[.x]]))
        if (is.null(all_grps) || length(all_grps) == 0) "unannotated"
        else names(sort(table(all_grps), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Save complex_evidence (list columns collapsed to ";"-separated strings)
complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    members       = purrr::map_chr(members, ~paste(.x, collapse = ";")),
    member_groups = purrr::map_chr(member_groups, ~paste(.x, collapse = ";"))
  ) %>%
  readr::write_csv(file.path(out_dir_complex, "tables", "complex_evidence.csv"))

cx_group_counts <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::count(compartment_group, name = "n_complexes") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_complexes))

readr::write_csv(cx_group_counts, file.path(out_dir_complex, "qc", "sourcedata_compartment_groups.csv"))
message("Compartment group distribution:")
print(cx_group_counts)

# Flag any cross-compartment complexes (should be zero if constraints worked)
n_cross <- sum(!cx_group_counts$compartment_group %in% c(names(compartment_groups), "unannotated"))
message("Cross-compartment complexes (expect 0): ", n_cross)

p_cx_groups <- ggplot(cx_group_counts,
                      aes(x = reorder(compartment_group, n_complexes), y = n_complexes,
                          fill = compartment_group %in% c(names(compartment_groups), "unannotated"))) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_complexes), hjust = -0.2, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "#E41A1C"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "valid", "FALSE" = "cross-compartment (BAD)"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  coord_flip() +

# --- Plot 7: Heatmap organelle x validation ---
message("Creating organelle x validation heatmap for complexes...")

if (exists("shared_long_baseline") && nrow(shared_long_baseline) > 0) {
  # Get organelle annotations for each complex based on its members
  complex_organelles <- complex_evidence %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      member_orgs = {
        member_genes <- members
        # Get organelles for each member gene
        orgs <- shared_long_baseline %>%
          dplyr::filter(key %in% baseline_ppi_v3$key[baseline_ppi_v3$Gene1 %in% member_genes | baseline_ppi_v3$Gene2 %in% member_genes]) %>%
          dplyr::pull(tag) %>%
          unique()
        if (length(orgs) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(orgs, collapse = ";")
      }
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  complex_evidence$shared_organelle <- complex_organelles$member_orgs

  # Build matrix: organelle x validation
  org_validation_complex <- complex_evidence %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(shared_organelle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total = dplyr::n(),
      PDB_exact = sum(has_PDB_exact_majority %in% TRUE),
      PDB_homolog = sum((has_PDB_any_majority %in% TRUE) & !(has_PDB_exact_majority %in% TRUE)),
      CORUM_strict = sum(corum_strict_match %in% TRUE),
      CORUM_relaxed = sum((corum_relaxed_match %in% TRUE) & !(corum_strict_match %in% TRUE)),
      CP_strict = sum(cp_strict_match %in% TRUE),
      CP_relaxed = sum((cp_relaxed_match %in% TRUE) & !(cp_strict_match %in% TRUE)),
      Novel = sum(validation_status == "novel"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_total >= 5)  # Lowered threshold

  readr::write_csv(org_validation_complex, file.path(out_dir_complex, "qc", "sourcedata_heatmap_organelle_validation.csv"))

  if (nrow(org_validation_complex) > 1) {
    mat_complex <- org_validation_complex %>%
      dplyr::select(shared_organelle, PDB_exact, PDB_homolog, CORUM_strict, CORUM_relaxed, CP_strict, CP_relaxed, Novel) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("shared_organelle") %>%
      as.matrix()

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat_complex,
      display_numbers = FALSE,
      number_format = "%d",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "dodgerblue3"))(50),
      main = "Complexes: organelle x validation (counts)",
      fontsize = 6,
      fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA,
      cellheight = 12,
      cellwidth = 12,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_complex, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation.pdf"),
      width = 7,
      height = max(4, nrow(mat_complex) * 0.25)
    )

    message("Heatmap saved: organelle x validation")
  }
} else {
  message("No organelle annotations available for heatmap")
  complex_evidence$shared_organelle <- NA_character_
}

# --- Summary stats ---

  metric = c("total_complexes", "complexes_size_3", "complexes_size_4", "complexes_size_5_10", "complexes_size_11_plus",
             "max_complex_size", "median_complex_size", "mean_support_score",
```
