```{r complex_qc_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
             "complexes_strict_match", "complexes_relaxed_match", "complexes_novel",
             "complexes_from_trimer_only", "complexes_from_tetramer_only", "complexes_from_both"),
  value = c(nrow(complex_evidence), sum(complex_evidence$complex_size == 3), sum(complex_evidence$complex_size == 4),
            sum(complex_evidence$complex_size >= 5 & complex_evidence$complex_size <= 10),
            sum(complex_evidence$complex_size >= 11), max(complex_evidence$complex_size), median(complex_evidence$complex_size),
            round(mean(complex_evidence$complex_support_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            sum(complex_evidence$corum_strict_match %in% TRUE),
            sum(complex_evidence$cp_strict_match %in% TRUE),
            sum(complex_evidence$validation_status == "strict_match"),
            sum(complex_evidence$validation_status == "relaxed_match"),
            sum(complex_evidence$validation_status == "novel"),
            sum(complex_evidence$origin == "trimer_only"), sum(complex_evidence$origin == "tetramer_only"),
            sum(complex_evidence$origin == "both"))

readr::write_csv(complex_stats, file.path(out_dir_complex, "tables", "complex_stats.csv"))
```

# Module 6: Top-Down vs Bottom-Up Comparison
Flags detected structures that belong to known complexes
Computes coverage metrics (ratio + missing proteins)
Requires: baseline_ppi_v3, trimer_evidence, tetramer_evidence, complex_evidence, corum_complex_members

## Chunk 1: Top-Down Complex Coverage
```{r topdown_coverage}
# =============================================================================
# Top-Down: Compute Coverage of Known Complexes
# =============================================================================

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_topdown <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "topdown_comparison")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_topdown, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_topdown, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("=== Top-down complex coverage analysis ===")

# Get all detected proteins in baseline
detected_proteins <- unique(c(baseline_ppi_v3$Gene1, baseline_ppi_v3$Gene2))
message("Detected proteins in baseline: ", length(detected_proteins))

# --- CORUM coverage ---
if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0) {
  message("\nComputing CORUM coverage...")

  corum_coverage <- corum_complex_members %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      detected_genes = list(intersect(genes, detected_proteins)),
      n_detected = length(detected_genes),
      n_total = n_subunits,
      coverage_ratio = round(n_detected / n_total, 3),
      coverage_pct = round(100 * n_detected / n_total, 1),
      missing_genes = list(setdiff(genes, detected_proteins)),
      n_missing = length(missing_genes),
      missing_genes_str = paste(missing_genes, collapse = ";"),
      detected_genes_str = paste(detected_genes, collapse = ";"),
      # Coverage tier
      coverage_tier = dplyr::case_when(
        coverage_ratio == 1 ~ "complete",
        coverage_ratio >= 0.8 ~ "high_80pct",
        coverage_ratio >= 0.5 ~ "partial_50pct",
        coverage_ratio > 0 ~ "low",
        TRUE ~ "none"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, n_total, n_detected, n_missing,
                  coverage_ratio, coverage_pct, coverage_tier,
                  detected_genes_str, missing_genes_str)

  corum_coverage_summary <- corum_coverage %>%
    dplyr::count(coverage_tier, name = "n_complexes") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_complexes / sum(n_complexes), 1))

  message("\nCORUM coverage summary:")
  print(corum_coverage_summary)

  # Complexes with any detected proteins
  n_corum_detected <- sum(corum_coverage$n_detected > 0)
  n_corum_complete <- sum(corum_coverage$coverage_tier == "complete")
  n_corum_high <- sum(corum_coverage$coverage_tier == "high_80pct")

  message("\nCORUM complexes detected: ", n_corum_detected, " / ", nrow(corum_coverage))
  message("  Complete coverage: ", n_corum_complete)
  message("  High coverage (>=80%): ", n_corum_high)
}

# --- ComplexPortal coverage ---
message("\nComputing ComplexPortal coverage...")

if (exists("cp_gene_members") && nrow(cp_gene_members) > 0) {
  cp_coverage <- cp_gene_members %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      detected_genes = list(intersect(genes, detected_proteins)),
      n_detected = length(detected_genes),
      n_total = length(genes),
      coverage_ratio = round(n_detected / n_total, 3),
      coverage_pct = round(100 * n_detected / n_total, 1),
      missing_genes = list(setdiff(genes, detected_proteins)),
      n_missing = length(missing_genes),
      missing_genes_str = paste(missing_genes, collapse = ";"),
      detected_genes_str = paste(detected_genes, collapse = ";"),
      coverage_tier = dplyr::case_when(
        coverage_ratio == 1 ~ "complete",
        coverage_ratio >= 0.8 ~ "high_80pct",
        coverage_ratio >= 0.5 ~ "partial_50pct",
        coverage_ratio > 0 ~ "low",
        TRUE ~ "none"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, n_total, n_detected, n_missing,
                  coverage_ratio, coverage_pct, coverage_tier,
                  detected_genes_str, missing_genes_str)

  cp_coverage_summary <- cp_coverage %>%
    dplyr::count(coverage_tier, name = "n_complexes") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_complexes / sum(n_complexes), 1))

  message("\nComplexPortal coverage summary:")
  print(cp_coverage_summary)
}
```


## Chunk 2: Flag Detected Structures
```{r topdown_flagging}
# =============================================================================
# Top-Down: Flag PPIs/Trimers/Tetramers in Known Complexes
# =============================================================================

message("\nFlagging detected structures belonging to known complexes...")

# --- Flag PPIs ---
# Already have filter_CORUM and filter_ComplexPortal in baseline_ppi_v3
baseline_ppi_v3 <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_known_complex_ppi = (filter_CORUM == "present") | (filter_ComplexPortal != "none") | (filter_PDB == "exact"),
    known_complex_source = dplyr::case_when(
      filter_PDB == "exact" & filter_CORUM == "present" & filter_ComplexPortal != "none" ~ "PDB+CORUM+CP",
      filter_PDB == "exact" & filter_CORUM == "present" ~ "PDB+CORUM",
      filter_PDB == "exact" & filter_ComplexPortal != "none" ~ "PDB+CP",
      filter_CORUM == "present" & filter_ComplexPortal != "none" ~ "CORUM+CP",
      filter_PDB == "exact" ~ "PDB",
      filter_CORUM == "present" ~ "CORUM",
      filter_ComplexPortal != "none" ~ "CP",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    )
  )

ppi_known_summary <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::count(known_complex_source, name = "n_edges") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_edges / sum(n_edges), 1)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_edges))

message("\nPPI known complex membership:")
print(ppi_known_summary)

# --- Flag Trimers ---
if (exists("trimer_evidence") && nrow(trimer_evidence) > 0) {
  trimer_evidence <- trimer_evidence %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      topdown_status = dplyr::case_when(
        in_known_complex ~ "known_complex",
        in_known_complex_relaxed ~ "partial_known",
        TRUE ~ "novel"
      )
    )

  trimer_topdown_summary <- trimer_evidence %>%
    dplyr::count(topdown_status, name = "n_trimers") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_trimers / sum(n_trimers), 1))

  message("\nTrimer top-down status:")
  print(trimer_topdown_summary)
}

# --- Flag Tetramers ---
if (exists("tetramer_evidence") && nrow(tetramer_evidence) > 0) {
  tetramer_evidence <- tetramer_evidence %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      topdown_status = dplyr::case_when(
        in_known_complex ~ "known_complex",
        in_known_complex_relaxed ~ "partial_known",
        TRUE ~ "novel"
      )
    )

  tetramer_topdown_summary <- tetramer_evidence %>%
    dplyr::count(topdown_status, name = "n_tetramers") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_tetramers / sum(n_tetramers), 1))

  message("\nTetramer top-down status:")
  print(tetramer_topdown_summary)
}

# --- Flag Bottom-Up Complexes ---
if (exists("complex_evidence") && nrow(complex_evidence) > 0) {
  complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      topdown_status = dplyr::case_when(
        has_known_match ~ "known_complex",
        (corum_relaxed_match %in% TRUE) | (cp_relaxed_match %in% TRUE) ~ "partial_known",
        TRUE ~ "novel"
      )
    )

  complex_topdown_summary <- complex_evidence %>%
    dplyr::count(topdown_status, name = "n_complexes") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_complexes / sum(n_complexes), 1))

  message("\nBottom-up complex top-down status:")
  print(complex_topdown_summary)
}
```


## Chunk 3: QC Plots
```{r topdown_qc_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# Top-Down: QC Plots
# =============================================================================

# --- Plot 1: CORUM coverage distribution ---
if (exists("corum_coverage")) {
  coverage_dist_corum <- corum_coverage %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_detected > 0) %>%
    dplyr::count(coverage_tier, name = "n_complexes") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(coverage_tier = factor(coverage_tier, levels = c("complete", "high_80pct", "partial_50pct", "low")))

  p_corum_coverage <- ggplot(coverage_dist_corum, aes(x = coverage_tier, y = n_complexes, fill = coverage_tier)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_complexes), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("complete" = "grey40", "high_80pct" = "grey55",
                                  "partial_50pct" = "grey75", "low" = "#E41A1C"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "CORUM complex coverage in detected proteome", x = "Coverage tier", y = "Number of complexes") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_topdown, "qc", "barplot_corum_coverage.pdf"), p_corum_coverage, width = 3, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)

  # Histogram of coverage ratios
  p_corum_hist <- ggplot(corum_coverage %>% dplyr::filter(n_detected > 0), aes(x = coverage_pct)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(50, 80, 100), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(title = "CORUM coverage distribution", x = "Coverage (%)", y = "Number of complexes") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_topdown, "qc", "histogram_corum_coverage.pdf"), p_corum_hist, width = 3, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# --- Plot 2: Coverage by complex size ---
if (exists("corum_coverage")) {
  coverage_by_size <- corum_coverage %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_detected > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(size_bin = cut(n_total, breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 20, 50, Inf),
                                  labels = c("2-5", "6-10", "11-20", "21-50", "50+"))) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(size_bin) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_complexes = dplyr::n(),
      mean_coverage = round(mean(coverage_pct), 1),
      n_complete = sum(coverage_tier == "complete"),
      pct_complete = round(100 * n_complete / n_complexes, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_coverage_size <- ggplot(coverage_by_size, aes(x = size_bin, y = mean_coverage, fill = size_bin)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(mean_coverage, "%")), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "Mean CORUM coverage by complex size", x = "Complex size", y = "Mean coverage (%)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_topdown, "qc", "barplot_coverage_by_size.pdf"), p_coverage_size, width = 3.5, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# --- Plot 2b: ComplexPortal coverage distribution ---
if (exists("cp_coverage") && nrow(cp_coverage) > 0) {
  coverage_dist_cp <- cp_coverage %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_detected > 0) %>%

  p_cp_coverage <- ggplot(coverage_dist_cp, aes(x = coverage_tier, y = n_complexes, fill = coverage_tier)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_complexes), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("complete" = "grey40", "high_80pct" = "grey55",
                                  "partial_50pct" = "grey75", "low" = "#E41A1C"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "ComplexPortal coverage in detected proteome", x = "Coverage tier", y = "Number of complexes") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_topdown, "qc", "barplot_cp_coverage.pdf"), p_cp_coverage, width = 3.5, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)

  # Histogram of coverage ratios
  p_cp_hist <- ggplot(cp_coverage %>% dplyr::filter(n_detected > 0), aes(x = coverage_pct)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "royalblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +

    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +

  message("  ComplexPortal complexes detected: ", sum(cp_coverage$n_detected > 0), " / ", nrow(cp_coverage))
```

# Module 7: Complex Network Visualization
Generates network plots for each complex with edge coloring by evidence tier
Exports source CSV per complex with protein/edge information
Requires: complex_evidence (from Module 5), baseline_ppi_v3

## Chunk 1: Setup and Edge Palette
```{r network_setup}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Networks: Setup
# =============================================================================
# EDGE COLORING BY EVIDENCE TIER:
#   gold:   All 3 conditions met (in_both_predictions AND high AF/RF AND SPOC>=0.95)
#           OR PDB exact structure evidence
#   silver: 2 of 3 conditions met OR PDB homolog
#   bronze: 1 condition met
#   base:   No special evidence (still in gold baseline)
#
# SUPPORT SCORE (shown in title): mean support score across all edges
# =============================================================================

library(igraph)

out_dir_networks <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "complexes", "network_plots")
out_dir_networks_csv <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "complexes", "network_csv")
dir.create(out_dir_networks, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_networks_csv, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("=== Complex Network Visualization ===")

# --- Evidence tier color palette ---
evidence_palette <- c(
  "PDB_exact" = "#8B0000",     # Dark red - strongest evidence
  "PDB_homolog" = "#FF6B6B",   # Light red
  "CORUM" = "#228B22",         # Forest green
  "ComplexPortal" = "#4169E1", # Royal blue
  "STRING" = "#FFD700",        # Gold
  "BIOGRID" = "#FF8C00",       # Dark orange
  "multi_db" = "#800080",      # Purple - multiple database support
  "baseline" = "#A9A9A9"       # Gray - baseline only
)

# Support score color palette (gradient)
support_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#E8E8E8", "#87CEEB", "#4169E1", "#191970"))(100)

# --- Filter complexes for plotting (max 50 members) ---
complexes_to_plot <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_size <= 50) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(complex_idx)

message("Complexes to plot (size <= 50): ", nrow(complexes_to_plot), " / ", nrow(complex_evidence))

# --- Edge lookup with evidence ---
edge_data <- baseline_ppi_v3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(edge_key = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(edge_key, Gene1, Gene2, Protein1, Protein2,
                AFMprob, RFprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max, support_score,
                filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID,
                in_both_predictions)

# --- Classify edge evidence tier ---
edge_data <- edge_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Count database support
    n_databases = (filter_PDB != "none") + (filter_CORUM == "present") +
                  (filter_ComplexPortal != "none") + (filter_STRING == "present") +
                  (filter_BIOGRID == "present"),
    # Classify evidence tier
    evidence_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      filter_PDB == "exact" ~ "PDB_exact",
      n_databases >= 3 ~ "multi_db",
      filter_PDB == "homolog" ~ "PDB_homolog",
      filter_CORUM == "present" ~ "CORUM",
      filter_ComplexPortal != "none" ~ "ComplexPortal",
      filter_STRING == "present" ~ "STRING",
      filter_BIOGRID == "present" ~ "BIOGRID",
      TRUE ~ "baseline"
    ),
    # Edge color
    edge_color = evidence_palette[evidence_tier]
  )
```


## Chunk 2: Generate Network Plots
```{r network_plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Networks: Generate Plots
# =============================================================================

message("Generating network plots...")

plot_count <- 0
skipped <- 0

for (i in seq_len(nrow(complexes_to_plot))) {
  cx <- complexes_to_plot[i, ]
  members <- cx$members[[1]]

  # Filter edges within this complex
  edges <- edge_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% members & Gene2 %in% members)

  if (nrow(edges) < 2) {
    skipped <- skipped + 1
    next
  }

  # --- Export source CSV ---
  # Protein info
  protein_info <- data.frame(
    gene = members,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_data %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>%
        dplyr::distinct() %>%
        dplyr::rename(gene = Gene1, uniprot = Protein1),
      by = "gene"
    )

  # Edge info
  edge_info <- edges %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, Protein1, Protein2,
                  AFMprob, RFprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max, support_score,
                  filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID,
                  evidence_tier, n_databases)

  # Complex summary
  complex_summary <- data.frame(
    complex_idx = cx$complex_idx,
    complex_size = cx$complex_size,
    n_edges = nrow(edges),
    mean_support = round(mean(edges$support_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_AFMprob = round(mean(edges$AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    pct_PDB = round(100 * sum(edges$filter_PDB != "none") / nrow(edges), 1),
    pct_CORUM = round(100 * sum(edges$filter_CORUM == "present") / nrow(edges), 1),
    pct_ComplexPortal = round(100 * sum(edges$filter_ComplexPortal != "none") / nrow(edges), 1),
    validation_status = cx$validation_status,
    corum_matched_name = ifelse(is.na(cx$corum_matched_name), "", cx$corum_matched_name),
    cp_matched_id = ifelse(is.na(cx$cp_matched_id), "", cx$cp_matched_id)
  )

  # Save CSV
  csv_path <- file.path(out_dir_networks_csv, paste0(sprintf("%03d", cx$complex_idx), "_complex_data.csv"))

  # Write as multi-section CSV
  con <- file(csv_path, "w")
  writeLines("## COMPLEX_SUMMARY", con)
  close(con)
  readr::write_csv(complex_summary, csv_path, append = TRUE)

  con <- file(csv_path, "a")
  writeLines("\n## PROTEINS", con)
  close(con)
  readr::write_csv(protein_info, csv_path, append = TRUE)

  con <- file(csv_path, "a")
  writeLines("\n## EDGES", con)
  close(con)
  readr::write_csv(edge_info, csv_path, append = TRUE)

  # --- Build igraph object ---
  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    edges %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = data.frame(name = members)
  )

  # --- Layout ---
  if (cx$complex_size <= 10) {
    layout <- igraph::layout_in_circle(g)
  } else if (cx$complex_size <= 20) {
    layout <- igraph::layout_with_kk(g)
  } else {
    layout <- igraph::layout_with_fr(g)
  }

  # --- Edge attributes ---
  edge_list <- igraph::as_edgelist(g)
  edge_keys <- apply(edge_list, 1, function(e) .make_undirected_key(e[1], e[2]))

  edge_match <- match(edge_keys, edges$edge_key)

  E(g)$color <- edges$edge_color[edge_match]
  E(g)$width <- scales::rescale(edges$support_score[edge_match], to = c(0.8, 4), from = c(0, 9))
  E(g)$evidence <- edges$evidence_tier[edge_match]

  # --- Validation status for title ---
  validation_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    cx$validation_status == "strict_match" ~ "KNOWN (strict)",
    cx$validation_status == "relaxed_match" ~ "KNOWN (relaxed)",
    TRUE ~ "NOVEL"
  )

  matched_name <- ""
  if (!is.na(cx$corum_matched_name) && cx$corum_matched_name != "") {
    matched_name <- paste0("\n", substr(cx$corum_matched_name, 1, 50))
  } else if (!is.na(cx$cp_matched_id) && cx$cp_matched_id != "") {
    matched_name <- paste0("\nCP: ", cx$cp_matched_id)
  }

  mean_support <- round(mean(edges$support_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  mean_afm <- round(mean(edges$AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3)

  plot_title <- paste0(
    "Complex ", cx$complex_idx, " | Size: ", cx$complex_size, " | Edges: ", nrow(edges),
    "\n", validation_label, " | Mean Support: ", mean_support, " | Mean AFMprob: ", mean_afm,
    matched_name
  )

  # --- Generate PDF ---
  pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir_networks, paste0(sprintf("%03d", cx$complex_idx), "_network.pdf"))

  pdf(pdf_path, width = 8, height = 8)

  par(mar = c(1, 1, 4, 1))

  plot(g,
       layout = layout,
       vertex.size = ifelse(cx$complex_size > 30, 6, ifelse(cx$complex_size > 15, 8, 10)),
       vertex.label.cex = ifelse(cx$complex_size > 30, 0.4, ifelse(cx$complex_size > 15, 0.5, 0.6)),
       vertex.color = "grey90",
       vertex.frame.color = "grey50",
       edge.color = E(g)$color,
       edge.width = E(g)$width,
       main = plot_title)

  # --- Legend ---
  # Evidence tier legend
  evidence_present <- unique(edges$evidence_tier)
  legend_colors <- evidence_palette[evidence_present]
  legend_labels <- evidence_present

  legend("bottomleft",
         legend = legend_labels,
         col = legend_colors,
         lwd = 3,
         bty = "n",
         cex = 0.6,
         title = "Edge evidence")

  # Width legend
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = c("Low support", "High support"),
         lwd = c(1, 4),
         col = "gray50",
         bty = "n",
         cex = 0.6,
         title = "Edge width")

  dev.off()

  plot_count <- plot_count + 1

  if (plot_count %% 50 == 0) {
    message("  Generated ", plot_count, " plots...")
  }
}

message("\nNetwork plots complete:")
message("  Generated: ", plot_count, " plots")
message("  Skipped (too few edges): ", skipped)
message("  Output: ", out_dir_networks)
message("  CSV source data: ", out_dir_networks_csv)
```

# Module 8: Stoichiometry Analysis
Analyzes stoichiometry of matched complexes from both CORUM and ComplexPortal
Requires: trimer_evidence, tetramer_evidence, corum_complex_members, complexportal

## Chunk 1: Parse CORUM and ComplexPortal Stoichiometry
```{r stoich_parse}
# =============================================================================
# Stoichiometry: Parse Subunit Stoichiometry from Both Databases
# =============================================================================
# CORUM stoichiometry: subunits_stoechiometrie column (format: "1;1;2")
# ComplexPortal stoichiometry: embedded in proteins_raw (format: "P84022(1)|Q13485(2)")
# =============================================================================

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_stoich <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "stoichiometry")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_stoich, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("=== Stoichiometry Analysis (CORUM + ComplexPortal) ===")

# --- Parse CORUM stoichiometry ---
if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0) {
  message("Parsing CORUM stoichiometry...")

  corum_stoich <- corum_complex_members %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stoich_values = list({
        if (is.null(stoich) || length(stoich) == 0 || all(is.na(stoich)) || all(stoich == "")) {
          rep(1L, length(genes))
        } else {
          vals <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stoich))
          vals[is.na(vals)] <- 1L
          if (length(vals) != length(genes)) rep(1L, length(genes)) else vals
        }
      }),
      gene_stoich = list(data.frame(gene = genes, copies = stoich_values, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)),
      n_unique_subunits = length(genes),
      n_total_copies = sum(stoich_values),
      has_multimeric = any(stoich_values > 1),
      max_copies = max(stoich_values)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  corum_stoich_summary <- corum_stoich %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_complexes = dplyr::n(),
      n_with_multimeric = sum(has_multimeric),
      pct_multimeric = round(100 * n_with_multimeric / total_complexes, 1)
    )

  message("  CORUM complexes: ", corum_stoich_summary$total_complexes)
  message("  CORUM with multimeric subunits: ", corum_stoich_summary$n_with_multimeric,
          " (", corum_stoich_summary$pct_multimeric, "%)")
} else {
  corum_stoich <- NULL
  corum_stoich_summary <- NULL
  message("CORUM not available")
}

# --- Parse ComplexPortal stoichiometry ---
if (exists("complexportal") && nrow(complexportal) > 0) {
  message("\nParsing ComplexPortal stoichiometry...")

  # Format: "P84022(1)|Q13485(1)|Q15796(2)" or similar
  complexportal_stoich <- complexportal %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, proteins_raw, n_proteins) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stoich_list = stringr::str_extract_all(proteins_raw, "[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5}\\(\\d+\\)"),
      stoich_parsed = purrr::map(stoich_list, function(x) {
        if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(protein = character(), copies = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
        proteins <- stringr::str_extract(x, "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5}")
        copies <- as.integer(stringr::str_extract(x, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\))"))
        copies[is.na(copies)] <- 1L
        data.frame(protein = proteins, copies = copies, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }),
      n_unique_proteins = purrr::map_int(stoich_parsed, ~length(unique(.x$protein))),
      n_total_subunits = purrr::map_int(stoich_parsed, ~if(nrow(.x) == 0) 0L else sum(.x$copies)),
      has_multimeric = purrr::map_lgl(stoich_parsed, ~if(nrow(.x) == 0) FALSE else any(.x$copies > 1)),
      max_copies = purrr::map_int(stoich_parsed, ~if(nrow(.x) == 0) 0L else max(.x$copies))
    )

  cp_stoich_summary <- complexportal_stoich %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_complexes = dplyr::n(),
      n_with_multimeric = sum(has_multimeric),
      pct_multimeric = round(100 * n_with_multimeric / total_complexes, 1)
    )

  message("  ComplexPortal complexes: ", cp_stoich_summary$total_complexes)
  message("  ComplexPortal with multimeric subunits: ", cp_stoich_summary$n_with_multimeric,
          " (", cp_stoich_summary$pct_multimeric, "%)")
} else {
  complexportal_stoich <- NULL
  cp_stoich_summary <- NULL
  message("ComplexPortal not available")
}
```


## Chunk 2: Trimer Stoichiometry (Both Databases)
```{r stoich_trimers}
# =============================================================================
# Stoichiometry: Trimers Matched to CORUM and ComplexPortal
# =============================================================================

if (exists("trimer_evidence") && nrow(trimer_evidence) > 0) {
  message("\n=== Trimer Stoichiometry Analysis ===")

  # --- CORUM-matched trimers ---
  if (!is.null(corum_stoich)) {
    trimers_corum <- trimer_evidence %>%
      dplyr::filter(corum_strict_match) %>%
      dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, corum_matched_id, corum_matched_name)

    if (nrow(trimers_corum) > 0) {
      trimer_stoich_corum <- trimers_corum %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          corum_stoich %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, gene_stoich, has_multimeric),
          by = c("corum_matched_id" = "complex_id")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rowwise() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          copies_g1 = if (is.null(gene_stoich) || nrow(gene_stoich) == 0) NA_integer_ else {
            idx <- which(gene_stoich$gene == Gene1); if (length(idx) > 0) gene_stoich$copies[idx] else NA_integer_
          },
          copies_g2 = if (is.null(gene_stoich) || nrow(gene_stoich) == 0) NA_integer_ else {
            idx <- which(gene_stoich$gene == Gene2); if (length(idx) > 0) gene_stoich$copies[idx] else NA_integer_
          },
          copies_g3 = if (is.null(gene_stoich) || nrow(gene_stoich) == 0) NA_integer_ else {
            idx <- which(gene_stoich$gene == Gene3); if (length(idx) > 0) gene_stoich$copies[idx] else NA_integer_
          },
          trimer_has_multimeric = any(c(copies_g1, copies_g2, copies_g3) > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
          trimer_total_copies = sum(c(copies_g1, copies_g2, copies_g3), na.rm = TRUE)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(source = "CORUM")

      trimer_corum_summary <- data.frame(
        source = "CORUM",
        n_matched = nrow(trimer_stoich_corum),
        n_multimeric = sum(trimer_stoich_corum$trimer_has_multimeric, na.rm = TRUE),
        pct_multimeric = round(100 * sum(trimer_stoich_corum$trimer_has_multimeric, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(trimer_stoich_corum), 1)
      )

      message("  CORUM-matched trimers: ", trimer_corum_summary$n_matched)
      message("    With multimeric subunit: ", trimer_corum_summary$n_multimeric, " (", trimer_corum_summary$pct_multimeric, "%)")

      readr::write_csv(trimer_stoich_corum %>% dplyr::select(-gene_stoich),
                       file.path(out_dir_stoich, "tables", "trimers_stoichiometry_CORUM.csv"))
    } else {
      trimer_stoich_corum <- NULL
      trimer_corum_summary <- data.frame(source = "CORUM", n_matched = 0, n_multimeric = 0, pct_multimeric = 0)
    }
  } else {
    trimer_stoich_corum <- NULL
    trimer_corum_summary <- data.frame(source = "CORUM", n_matched = 0, n_multimeric = 0, pct_multimeric = 0)
  }

  # --- ComplexPortal-matched trimers ---
  if (!is.null(complexportal_stoich)) {
    trimers_cp <- trimer_evidence %>%
      dplyr::filter(cp_strict_match) %>%
      dplyr::select(trimer_id, Protein1, Protein2, Protein3, cp_matched_id)

    if (nrow(trimers_cp) > 0) {
      trimer_stoich_cp <- trimers_cp %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          complexportal_stoich %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, stoich_parsed, has_multimeric),
          by = c("cp_matched_id" = "complex_id")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rowwise() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          copies_p1 = if (is.null(stoich_parsed) || nrow(stoich_parsed) == 0) NA_integer_ else {
            idx <- which(stoich_parsed$protein == Protein1); if (length(idx) > 0) stoich_parsed$copies[idx] else NA_integer_
          },
          copies_p2 = if (is.null(stoich_parsed) || nrow(stoich_parsed) == 0) NA_integer_ else {
            idx <- which(stoich_parsed$protein == Protein2); if (length(idx) > 0) stoich_parsed$copies[idx] else NA_integer_
          },
          copies_p3 = if (is.null(stoich_parsed) || nrow(stoich_parsed) == 0) NA_integer_ else {
            idx <- which(stoich_parsed$protein == Protein3); if (length(idx) > 0) stoich_parsed$copies[idx] else NA_integer_
          },
          trimer_has_multimeric = any(c(copies_p1, copies_p2, copies_p3) > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
          trimer_total_copies = sum(c(copies_p1, copies_p2, copies_p3), na.rm = TRUE)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(source = "ComplexPortal")

      trimer_cp_summary <- data.frame(
        source = "ComplexPortal",
        n_matched = nrow(trimer_stoich_cp),
        n_multimeric = sum(trimer_stoich_cp$trimer_has_multimeric, na.rm = TRUE),
        pct_multimeric = round(100 * sum(trimer_stoich_cp$trimer_has_multimeric, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(trimer_stoich_cp), 1)
      )

      message("  ComplexPortal-matched trimers: ", trimer_cp_summary$n_matched)
      message("    With multimeric subunit: ", trimer_cp_summary$n_multimeric, " (", trimer_cp_summary$pct_multimeric, "%)")

      readr::write_csv(trimer_stoich_cp %>% dplyr::select(-stoich_parsed),
                       file.path(out_dir_stoich, "tables", "trimers_stoichiometry_ComplexPortal.csv"))
    } else {
      trimer_stoich_cp <- NULL
      trimer_cp_summary <- data.frame(source = "ComplexPortal", n_matched = 0, n_multimeric = 0, pct_multimeric = 0)
    }
  } else {
    trimer_stoich_cp <- NULL
    trimer_cp_summary <- data.frame(source = "ComplexPortal", n_matched = 0, n_multimeric = 0, pct_multimeric = 0)
  }

  trimer_stoich_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(trimer_corum_summary, trimer_cp_summary)
} else {
  trimer_stoich_corum <- NULL
  trimer_stoich_cp <- NULL
  trimer_stoich_combined <- data.frame(source = character(), n_matched = integer(), n_multimeric = integer(), pct_multimeric = numeric())
}
```

## Chunk 4: QC Plots
```{r stoich_qc_plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# =============================================================================
# Stoichiometry: QC Plots
# All plots export source data CSV for journal compliance
# =============================================================================

# --- Plot 1: Database comparison - multimeric prevalence ---
if (!is.null(corum_stoich_summary) || !is.null(cp_stoich_summary)) {
  db_multimeric <- data.frame(
    database = c("CORUM", "ComplexPortal"),
    total = c(if(!is.null(corum_stoich_summary)) corum_stoich_summary$total_complexes else 0,
              if(!is.null(cp_stoich_summary)) cp_stoich_summary$total_complexes else 0),
    multimeric = c(if(!is.null(corum_stoich_summary)) corum_stoich_summary$n_with_multimeric else 0,
                   if(!is.null(cp_stoich_summary)) cp_stoich_summary$n_with_multimeric else 0),
    pct = c(if(!is.null(corum_stoich_summary)) corum_stoich_summary$pct_multimeric else 0,
            if(!is.null(cp_stoich_summary)) cp_stoich_summary$pct_multimeric else 0)
  )

  readr::write_csv(db_multimeric, file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "sourcedata_database_multimeric.csv"))

  p_db_multimeric <- ggplot(db_multimeric, aes(x = database, y = pct, fill = database)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(multimeric, "/", total, "\n(", pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.1, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("CORUM" = "#f0f0f1", "ComplexPortal" = "#cfd1d2"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "Complexes with multimeric subunits by database", x = NULL, y = "% with multimeric") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(db_multimeric$pct) * 1.3)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "barplot_database_multimeric.pdf"), p_db_multimeric, width = 2, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# --- Plot 2: Trimer stoichiometry by source ---
if (nrow(trimer_stoich_combined) > 0 && sum(trimer_stoich_combined$n_matched) > 0) {
  trimer_stoich_plot <- trimer_stoich_combined %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_non_multimeric = n_matched - n_multimeric) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(n_multimeric, n_non_multimeric), names_to = "type", values_to = "n") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(type = ifelse(type == "n_multimeric", "With multimeric", "Without multimeric"))

  readr::write_csv(trimer_stoich_combined, file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "sourcedata_trimer_stoichiometry.csv"))

  p_trimer_stoich <- ggplot(trimer_stoich_plot, aes(x = source, y = n, fill = type)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, position = "stack") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("With multimeric" = "grey40", "Without multimeric" = "grey70"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "Trimer stoichiometry by database", x = NULL, y = "Number of trimers") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), legend.position = "top")

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "barplot_trimer_stoichiometry.pdf"), p_trimer_stoich, width = 2, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# --- Plot 3: Tetramer stoichiometry by source ---
if (nrow(tetramer_stoich_combined) > 0 && sum(tetramer_stoich_combined$n_matched) > 0) {
  tetramer_stoich_plot <- tetramer_stoich_combined %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_non_multimeric = n_matched - n_multimeric) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(n_multimeric, n_non_multimeric), names_to = "type", values_to = "n") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(type = ifelse(type == "n_multimeric", "With multimeric", "Without multimeric"))

  readr::write_csv(tetramer_stoich_combined, file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "sourcedata_tetramer_stoichiometry.csv"))

  p_tetramer_stoich <- ggplot(tetramer_stoich_plot, aes(x = source, y = n, fill = type)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, position = "stack") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("With multimeric" = "#4DAF4A", "Without multimeric" = "grey70"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "Tetramer stoichiometry by database", x = NULL, y = "Number of tetramers") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), legend.position = "top")

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "barplot_tetramer_stoichiometry.pdf"), p_tetramer_stoich, width = 2, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# --- Plot 4: Combined comparison (Trimers vs Tetramers, CORUM vs CP) ---
all_stoich <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  trimer_stoich_combined %>% dplyr::mutate(level = "Trimers"),
  tetramer_stoich_combined %>% dplyr::mutate(level = "Tetramers")
)

if (nrow(all_stoich) > 0 && sum(all_stoich$n_matched) > 0) {
  readr::write_csv(all_stoich, file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "sourcedata_combined_stoichiometry.csv"))

  p_combined <- ggplot(all_stoich, aes(x = interaction(level, source), y = pct_multimeric, fill = source)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n_multimeric, "/", n_matched)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("CORUM" = "#f0f0f1", "ComplexPortal" = "#cfd1d2"), name = "Database") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Trimers.CORUM" = "Trimers\nCORUM", "Trimers.ComplexPortal" = "Trimers\nCP",
                                "Tetramers.CORUM" = "Tetramers\nCORUM", "Tetramers.ComplexPortal" = "Tetramers\nCP")) +
    labs(title = "Multimeric subunits in matched structures", x = NULL, y = "% with multimeric subunit") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), legend.position = "top")

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_stoich, "qc", "barplot_combined_stoichiometry.pdf"), p_combined, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# --- Summary table ---
stoich_stats <- data.frame(
  metric = c("corum_total_complexes", "corum_multimeric", "corum_pct_multimeric",
             "cp_total_complexes", "cp_multimeric", "cp_pct_multimeric",
             "trimers_corum_matched", "trimers_corum_multimeric", "trimers_corum_pct",
             "trimers_cp_matched", "trimers_cp_multimeric", "trimers_cp_pct",
             "tetramers_corum_matched", "tetramers_corum_multimeric", "tetramers_corum_pct",
             "tetramers_cp_matched", "tetramers_cp_multimeric", "tetramers_cp_pct"),
  value = c(
    if(!is.null(corum_stoich_summary)) corum_stoich_summary$total_complexes else 0,
    if(!is.null(corum_stoich_summary)) corum_stoich_summary$n_with_multimeric else 0,
    if(!is.null(corum_stoich_summary)) corum_stoich_summary$pct_multimeric else 0,
    if(!is.null(cp_stoich_summary)) cp_stoich_summary$total_complexes else 0,
    if(!is.null(cp_stoich_summary)) cp_stoich_summary$n_with_multimeric else 0,

    if(nrow(trimer_stoich_combined) > 0) trimer_stoich_combined$n_matched[trimer_stoich_combined$source == "CORUM"] else 0,
    if(nrow(trimer_stoich_combined) > 0) trimer_stoich_combined$n_multimeric[trimer_stoich_combined$source == "CORUM"] else 0,
    if(nrow(trimer_stoich_combined) > 0) trimer_stoich_combined$pct_multimeric[trimer_stoich_combined$source == "CORUM"] else 0,
    if(nrow(trimer_stoich_combined) > 0) trimer_stoich_combined$n_matched[trimer_stoich_combined$source == "ComplexPortal"] else 0,
    if(nrow(trimer_stoich_combined) > 0) trimer_stoich_combined$n_multimeric[trimer_stoich_combined$source == "ComplexPortal"] else 0,
    if(nrow(trimer_stoich_combined) > 0) trimer_stoich_combined$pct_multimeric[trimer_stoich_combined$source == "ComplexPortal"] else 0,
    if(nrow(tetramer_stoich_combined) > 0) tetramer_stoich_combined$n_matched[tetramer_stoich_combined$source == "CORUM"] else 0,
    if(nrow(tetramer_stoich_combined) > 0) tetramer_stoich_combined$n_multimeric[tetramer_stoich_combined$source == "CORUM"] else 0,
    if(nrow(tetramer_stoich_combined) > 0) tetramer_stoich_combined$pct_multimeric[tetramer_stoich_combined$source == "CORUM"] else 0,
    if(nrow(tetramer_stoich_combined) > 0) tetramer_stoich_combined$n_matched[tetramer_stoich_combined$source == "ComplexPortal"] else 0,
    if(nrow(tetramer_stoich_combined) > 0) tetramer_stoich_combined$n_multimeric[tetramer_stoich_combined$source == "ComplexPortal"] else 0,
    if(nrow(tetramer_stoich_combined) > 0) tetramer_stoich_combined$pct_multimeric[tetramer_stoich_combined$source == "ComplexPortal"] else 0
  )
)

readr::write_csv(stoich_stats, file.path(out_dir_stoich, "tables", "stoichiometry_stats.csv"))

message("\nModule 7 complete.")
message("Stoichiometry analysis for both CORUM and ComplexPortal.")
```

# OLD Module 9: KO Vulnerability Analysis v6 (Significance-Filtered)

## Overview
Adapted vulnerability analysis with:
- Significance filtering using p/q values (-log10(0.05) = 1.3 threshold)
- Assessment from existing structures (trimers/tetramers/complexes)
- Loss of PPI analysis (proteins lost/dropped in KO)
- Complex vulnerability heatmap (352 complexes x 23 KOs x 2 neurons)
- Sphingosine pathway analysis

## Chunk 0: Setup and Configuration

## Chunk 1: Build Significance-Filtered Proteome Data
````{r significance_filter}
# =============================================================================
# Build Significance-Filtered Proteome Data
# =============================================================================
message("Building significance-filtered proteome data...")

fc_cols <- names(complete_data_annotated_day50)[grepl("_log2_fold_change$", names(complete_data_annotated_day50))]
pval_cols <- names(complete_data_annotated_day50)[grepl("_neg_log10_p_value$", names(complete_data_annotated_day50))]
qval_cols <- names(complete_data_annotated_day50)[grepl("_neg_log10_q_value$", names(complete_data_annotated_day50))]

message("  Found ", length(fc_cols), " log2FC columns")
message("  Found ", length(pval_cols), " -log10(p) columns")
message("  Found ", length(qval_cols), " -log10(q) columns")

# Build long-format proteome table
prot_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(fc_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "sample_col", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(genotype = sub("^(.+)_(iN|iDA)_log2_fold_change$", "\\1", sample_col),
                neuron = sub("^.+_(iN|iDA)_log2_fold_change$", "\\1", sample_col),
                genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, log2FC)

# Add p-values (already -log10 transformed)
if (length(pval_cols) > 0) {
  pval_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(pval_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "sample_col", values_to = "neglog10_p") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = sub("^(.+)_(iN|iDA)_neg_log10_p_value$", "\\1", sample_col),
                  neuron = sub("^.+_(iN|iDA)_neg_log10_p_value$", "\\1", sample_col),
                  genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, genotype_neuron, neglog10_p)
  prot_long <- prot_long %>% dplyr::left_join(pval_long, by = c("Genes", "genotype_neuron"))
}

# Add q-values (already -log10 transformed)
if (length(qval_cols) > 0) {
  qval_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(qval_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "sample_col", values_to = "neglog10_q") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = sub("^(.+)_(iN|iDA)_neg_log10_q_value$", "\\1", sample_col),
                  neuron = sub("^.+_(iN|iDA)_neg_log10_q_value$", "\\1", sample_col),
                  genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, genotype_neuron, neglog10_q)
  prot_long <- prot_long %>% dplyr::left_join(qval_long, by = c("Genes", "genotype_neuron"))
}

# Compute significance status for BOTH p and q values
prot_long <- prot_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_sig_p = !is.na(neglog10_p) & neglog10_p >= p_threshold,
    is_sig_q = !is.na(neglog10_q) & neglog10_q >= q_threshold,
    is_lost_p = is_sig_p & !is.na(log2FC) & log2FC < 0,
    is_lost_q = is_sig_q & !is.na(log2FC) & log2FC < 0,
    is_gained_p = is_sig_p & !is.na(log2FC) & log2FC > 0,
    is_gained_q = is_sig_q & !is.na(log2FC) & log2FC > 0
  )

ko_neuron_grid <- prot_long %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron)
message("  KO x Neuron combinations: ", nrow(ko_neuron_grid))

# Summary with both p and q columns
sig_summary <- prot_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_proteins = dplyr::n(),
    n_sig_p = sum(is_sig_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_q = sum(is_sig_q, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p = sum(is_lost_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_q = sum(is_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_gained_p = sum(is_gained_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_gained_q = sum(is_gained_q, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(sig_summary, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "significance_filtering_summary.csv"))
message("  Total proteins with significance data: ", nrow(prot_long))
message("  Saved: significance_filtering_summary.csv")

message("Module 1 complete: Significance-filtered proteome data built")
````

## Chunk 2: Build KO Edge States Table (Significance-Filtered)
```{r edge_states}
# =============================================================================
# Build KO Edge States Table (Significance-Filtered, both p and q)
# =============================================================================
message("Building KO edge states table...")

baseline_filtered <- baseline_filtered
message("  Baseline PPIs (Tier 1): ", nrow(baseline_filtered))

baseline_expanded <- baseline_filtered %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ko_neuron_grid %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1), by = "dummy", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dummy)

# Join significance data for both partners (both p and q)
prot_sig <- prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC, is_lost_p, is_lost_q, is_gained_p, is_gained_q)

ko_edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
  dplyr::left_join(prot_sig, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(log2FC_A = log2FC, lost_A_p = is_lost_p, lost_A_q = is_lost_q, gained_A_p = is_gained_p, gained_A_q = is_gained_q) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(prot_sig, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(log2FC_B = log2FC, lost_B_p = is_lost_p, lost_B_q = is_lost_q, gained_B_p = is_gained_p, gained_B_q = is_gained_q) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # States for q-value (primary)
    state_q = dplyr::case_when(
      lost_A_q | lost_B_q ~ "lost",
      !is.na(log2FC_A) | !is.na(log2FC_B) ~ "retained",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    # States for p-value (comparison)
    state_p = dplyr::case_when(
      lost_A_p | lost_B_p ~ "lost",
      !is.na(log2FC_A) | !is.na(log2FC_B) ~ "retained",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    loss_driver_q = dplyr::case_when(lost_A_q & lost_B_q ~ "both", lost_A_q ~ "Gene1", lost_B_q ~ "Gene2", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    loss_driver_p = dplyr::case_when(lost_A_p & lost_B_p ~ "both", lost_A_p ~ "Gene1", lost_B_p ~ "Gene2", TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )

# Add disease class mapping
disease_map <- disease_class_df %>% dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
ko_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>% dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample"))

# disease_map <- disease_class_df %>% dplyr::distinct(KO, DiseaseClass, DiseaseColor)
# ko_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>% dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "KO"))

# Add shared organelle information
message("  Computing shared organelle annotations...")
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")
existing_org1 <- intersect(org1_cols, names(ko_edge_states))
existing_org2 <- intersect(org2_cols, names(ko_edge_states))

if (length(existing_org1) > 0 && length(existing_org2) > 0) {
  existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1)
  m1 <- as.matrix(ko_edge_states[, existing_org1]); m1[is.na(m1)] <- FALSE
  m2 <- as.matrix(ko_edge_states[, existing_org2]); m2[is.na(m2)] <- FALSE
  shared_mat <- m1 & m2
  ko_edge_states$OrgPair <- ifelse(rowSums(shared_mat) > 0, "same", "cross")
  ko_edge_states$shared_organelle <- apply(shared_mat, 1, function(row) {
    idx <- which(row); if (length(idx) > 0) existing_tags[idx[1]] else NA_character_
  })
} else {
  ko_edge_states$OrgPair <- NA_character_
  ko_edge_states$shared_organelle <- NA_character_
}

readr::write_csv(ko_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "ko_edge_states.csv"))
message("  Saved: ko_edge_states.csv (", nrow(ko_edge_states), " rows)")

# Summary with both p and q
ko_summary_global <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges = dplyr::n(),
    n_lost_q = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained_q = sum(state_q == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained_p = sum(state_p == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost_q = n_lost_q / total_edges,
    frac_lost_p = n_lost_p / total_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(ko_summary_global, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_global.csv"))

ko_summary_by_organelle <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same", !is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass, shared_organelle) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges = dplyr::n(),
    n_lost_q = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost_q = n_lost_q / n_edges,
    frac_lost_p = n_lost_p / n_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(ko_summary_by_organelle, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_by_organelle.csv"))

message("Module 2 complete: KO edge states table built")
```


## Chunk 3: Trimer Vulnerability Analysis (From Existing Structures)
`````{r trimer}
# =============================================================================
# Trimer Vulnerability Analysis (From Existing Structures)
# =============================================================================
message("Analyzing trimer vulnerability from existing structures...")

trimer_genes <- trimer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, validation_tier, shared_organelle, cp_strict_match, cp_relaxed_match, in_known_complex)

trimer_vuln_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_grid))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype[i]
  neur <- ko_neuron_grid$neuron[i]
  gn <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype_neuron[i]

  loss_data <- prot_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == neur) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC, is_lost_p, is_lost_q)

  trimer_status <- trimer_genes %>%
    dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc1 = log2FC, lost1_p = is_lost_p, lost1_q = is_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc2 = log2FC, lost2_p = is_lost_p, lost2_q = is_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene3" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc3 = log2FC, lost3_p = is_lost_p, lost3_q = is_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      genotype = geno, neuron = neur, genotype_neuron = gn,
      n_lost_q = rowSums(cbind(lost1_q, lost2_q, lost3_q), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lost_p = rowSums(cbind(lost1_p, lost2_p, lost3_p), na.rm = TRUE),
      state_q = dplyr::case_when(n_lost_q >= 1 ~ "disrupted", TRUE ~ "intact"),
      state_p = dplyr::case_when(n_lost_p >= 1 ~ "disrupted", TRUE ~ "intact")
    )
  trimer_vuln_list[[i]] <- trimer_status
}

trimer_ko_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(trimer_vuln_list) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample"))

readr::write_csv(trimer_ko_states, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "trimer_ko_states.csv"))
message("  Saved: trimer_ko_states.csv")

trimer_summary_ko <- trimer_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_trimers = dplyr::n(),
    n_disrupted_q = sum(state_q == "disrupted"),
    n_disrupted_p = sum(state_p == "disrupted"),
    frac_disrupted_q = n_disrupted_q / total_trimers,
    frac_disrupted_p = n_disrupted_p / total_trimers,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(trimer_summary_ko, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "trimer_summary_ko.csv"))

message("Module 3 complete: Trimer vulnerability analysis")
`````

## Chunk 5: Complex Vulnerability Analysis with Heatmap
```{r complex}
# =============================================================================
# Complex Vulnerability Analysis with Heatmap
# =============================================================================
message("Analyzing complex vulnerability...")

complex_members_parsed <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_idx, complex_id, complex_size, origin, compartment_group, shared_organelle, cp_strict_match, cp_relaxed_match, has_known_match, validation_status, corum_matched_name, corum_matched_id, cp_matched_id, cp_name, cp_description, members) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(members_list = members)

message("  Total complexes: ", nrow(complex_members_parsed))

complex_vuln_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_grid))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype[i]
  neur <- ko_neuron_grid$neuron[i]
  gn <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype_neuron[i]

  loss_data_q <- prot_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == neur) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, is_lost_q) %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  loss_data_p <- prot_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == neur) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, is_lost_p) %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  complex_status <- complex_members_parsed %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_members = length(members_list),
      n_lost_q = sum(loss_data_q[members_list], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lost_p = sum(loss_data_p[members_list], na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost_q = n_lost_q / n_members,
      frac_lost_p = n_lost_p / n_members,
      state_q = dplyr::case_when(
        n_members <= 4 & n_lost_q >= 1 ~ "disrupted",
        n_members > 4 & frac_lost_q >= 0.25 ~ "disrupted",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      ),
      state_p = dplyr::case_when(
        n_members <= 4 & n_lost_p >= 1 ~ "disrupted",
        n_members > 4 & frac_lost_p >= 0.25 ~ "disrupted",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = geno, neuron = neur, genotype_neuron = gn)

  complex_vuln_list[[i]] <- complex_status
}

complex_ko_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(complex_vuln_list) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample"))

complex_ko_states_export <- complex_ko_states %>% dplyr::select(-members_list)
readr::write_csv(complex_ko_states_export, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "complex_ko_states.csv"))
message("  Saved: complex_ko_states.csv")

complex_summary_ko <- complex_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_complexes = dplyr::n(),
    n_disrupted_q = sum(state_q == "disrupted"),
    n_disrupted_p = sum(state_p == "disrupted"),
    frac_disrupted_q = n_disrupted_q / total_complexes,
    frac_disrupted_p = n_disrupted_p / total_complexes,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(complex_summary_ko, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "complex_summary_ko.csv"))


# =============================================================================
# Complex Vulnerability Heatmap (q-value based, primary)
# =============================================================================
message("Generating complex vulnerability heatmaps (q-value filtered)...")

for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {

  hm_data <- complex_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(disrupted_binary = as.integer(state_q == "disrupted")) %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, genotype, disrupted_binary) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = genotype, values_from = disrupted_binary, values_fill = 0L)


  if (nrow(hm_data) < 2 || ncol(hm_data) < 3) {
    message("  Insufficient data for heatmap (", neuron_type, ")")
    next
  }

  hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, -1])
  rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$complex_id

  complex_annot <- complex_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(complex_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, origin, compartment_group) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(complex_annot) <- complex_annot$complex_id
  complex_annot <- complex_annot[rownames(hm_mat), , drop = FALSE]
  row_annot <- data.frame(origin = complex_annot$origin,
                          compartment_group = complex_annot$compartment_group,
                          row.names = rownames(complex_annot))

  col_annot <- disease_map %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = sub("_(iN|iDA)$", "", sample)) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype %in% colnames(hm_mat)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(col_annot) <- col_annot$genotype
  col_annot <- col_annot[colnames(hm_mat), "DiseaseClass", drop = FALSE]

  origin_levels <- unique(na.omit(row_annot$origin))
  origin_pal    <- setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(origin_levels)), "Dark2")[seq_along(origin_levels)], origin_levels)
  disease_levels <- unique(na.omit(col_annot$DiseaseClass))
  disease_pal    <- disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), disease_levels)]
  cg_levels <- unique(na.omit(row_annot$compartment_group))
  cg_pal    <- setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(cg_levels)), "Set1")[seq_along(cg_levels)], cg_levels)
  ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_pal, origin = origin_pal, compartment_group = cg_pal)

  row_sums <- rowSums(hm_mat)
  row_order <- order(row_sums, decreasing = TRUE)
  hm_mat_ordered <- hm_mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
  row_annot_ordered <- row_annot[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(hm_mat_ordered) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("complex_id"),
    file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", paste0("complex_heatmap_qval_", neuron_type, "_sourcedata.csv")))

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/complexes", paste0("heatmap_complex_vuln_qval_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 12, height = 20)
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    hm_mat_ordered, 
    color = c("grey95", "#C51B7D"), 
    breaks = c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5),
    cluster_rows = FALSE, 
    cluster_cols = TRUE, 
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_row = row_annot_ordered, 
    annotation_col = col_annot, 
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_rownames = FALSE, 
    fontsize = 6, 
    fontsize_col = 7, 
    cellwidth = 8, 
    border_color = NA,
    main = paste0("Complex Vulnerability (", neuron_type, ", q < 0.05)\n", nrow(hm_mat), " complexes x ", ncol(hm_mat), " KOs"))
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: heatmap_complex_vuln_qval_", neuron_type, ".pdf")

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/complexes", paste0("heatmap_complex_vuln_qval_clustered_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 12, height = 20)
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    hm_mat, 
    color = c("grey95", "#C51B7D"), 
    breaks = c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5),
    cluster_rows = TRUE, 
    cluster_cols = TRUE, 
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_row = row_annot, 
    annotation_col = col_annot, 
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_rownames = FALSE, 
    fontsize = 6,
    fontsize_col = 7, 
    cellwidth = 8, 
    border_color = NA,
    main = paste0("Complex Vulnerability Clustered (", neuron_type, ", q < 0.05)\n", nrow(hm_mat), " complexes x ", ncol(hm_mat), " KOs"))
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: heatmap_complex_vuln_qval_clustered_", neuron_type, ".pdf")
}

message("Module 5 complete: Complex vulnerability analysis with heatmaps")
```

```{r ppi_viz}
# =============================================================================

message("Generating PPI vulnerability visualizations...")

# --- Barplot: PPI states (q-value, absolute) ---

p_ppi_states <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data_ppi, ggplot2::aes(x = genotype, y = n, fill = state_q)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~neuron, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey80", lost = "#C51B7D", unknown = "grey50")) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of PPI edges", title = "PPI edge states per KO (q < 0.05)") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), 
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
                 strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"), 
    legend.position = "right")

save_plot_with_sourcedata(p_ppi_states, "plots/global/barplot_ppi_states_qval", plot_data_ppi, width = 10, height = 8)

# --- Scatter plot: iN vs iDA (q-value) ---
scatter_data <- ko_summary_global %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, neuron, frac_lost_q, DiseaseClass) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = neuron, values_from = frac_lost_q) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(diff = abs(iDA - iN), deviation = ifelse(diff <= 0.05, "within_band", "outside_band"))

axis_max <- max(c(scatter_data$iN, scatter_data$iDA), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
axis_lim <- c(0, axis_max)

p_scatter <- ggplot2::ggplot(scatter_data, ggplot2::aes(x = iN, y = iDA)) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0.05, linetype = "solid", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -0.05, linetype = "solid", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(fill = DiseaseClass, shape = deviation), size = 3, stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = genotype), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, name = "Disease Class") +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(within_band = 21, outside_band = 24), name = "Deviation") +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_lim, ylim = axis_lim, clip = "on") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Fraction lost PPIs (iN)", y = "Fraction lost PPIs (iDA)", title = "PPI vulnerability: iN vs iDA (q < 0.05)") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank())

save_plot_with_sourcedata(p_scatter, "plots/global/scatter_ppi_loss_iN_vs_iDA_qval", scatter_data, width = 5.5, height = 5.5)

# --- Organelle x KO heatmaps (iN and iDA separately, q-value) ---

    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = paste0("Number lost/disrupted (", sig_label, ")"),
                  title = paste0("Structure vulnerability by KO and neuron type (", sig_label, ")")) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
                   strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"))
  
  save_plot_with_sourcedata(p_facet, paste0("plots/global/barplot_structure_loss_faceted_", sig_type, "val"), comparison_data, width = 9, height = 12)
}

message("Module 6 complete: PPI vulnerability visualizations")
```

```{r ko_neuron_extended}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.4 Per-KO bubble plots: iN vs iDA by annotation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_ko_bubble_in_vs_ida <- function(df, metric_name, state_col, annot_col, out_subdir) {

  out_path <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/KOxNeuron/per_ko_bubble", out_subdir)
  dir.create(out_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  sourcedata_path <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", "per_ko_bubble", out_subdir)
  dir.create(sourcedata_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[state_col]] %in% c("lost", "disrupted")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, .data[[annot_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  totals <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, .data[[annot_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_total = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  counts <- dplyr::left_join(counts, totals, by = c("genotype", "neuron", annot_col)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(frac_lost = ifelse(n_total > 0, n_lost / n_total, NA_real_)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[annot_col]]))

  counts_wide <- counts %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = neuron, values_from = c(n_lost, frac_lost, n_total), values_fill = 0)

  if (!all(c("n_lost_iN", "n_lost_iDA", "frac_lost_iN", "frac_lost_iDA") %in% colnames(counts_wide))) {
    message("  Skipping ", metric_name, ": missing iN/iDA columns")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (geno in unique(counts_wide$genotype)) {
    df_ko <- counts_wide %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == geno)
    if (nrow(df_ko) == 0) next
    message("Processing: ", geno, " | nrow: ", nrow(df_ko), " | max_abs: ", max(c(df_ko$n_lost_iN, df_ko$n_lost_iDA), na.rm = TRUE))
    df_ko <- df_ko %>% dplyr::mutate(total_lost = n_lost_iN + n_lost_iDA)

    readr::write_csv(df_ko, file.path(sourcedata_path, paste0(geno, "_sourcedata.csv")))

    max_val_abs <- max(c(df_ko$n_lost_iN, df_ko$n_lost_iDA), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(max_val_abs) && max_val_abs > 0) {
      axis_lim_abs <- c(0, max_val_abs * 1.1)
      n_annot <- length(unique(df_ko[[annot_col]]))

      p_abs <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_ko, ggplot2::aes(x = n_lost_iN, y = n_lost_iDA, fill = .data[[annot_col]], size = total_lost)) +
        ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.2) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(n_annot)) +
        ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = .data[[annot_col]]), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
        ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), guide = "none") +
        ggplot2::coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_lim_abs, ylim = axis_lim_abs, clip = "on") +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(geno, " - Lost ", metric_name, " (absolute, q<0.05)"), x = paste0("Lost in iN"), y = paste0("Lost in iDA")) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
        ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

      ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_path, paste0(geno, "_bubble_absolute_iN_vs_iDA.pdf")), p_abs, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    }

    max_val_rel <- max(c(df_ko$frac_lost_iN, df_ko$frac_lost_iDA), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(max_val_rel) && max_val_rel > 0) {
      axis_lim_rel <- c(0, max_val_rel * 1.1)
      n_annot <- length(unique(df_ko[[annot_col]]))

      p_rel <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_ko, ggplot2::aes(x = frac_lost_iN, y = frac_lost_iDA, fill = .data[[annot_col]], size = total_lost)) +
        ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.2) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(n_annot)) +
        ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = .data[[annot_col]]), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
        ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), guide = "none") +
        ggplot2::coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_lim_rel, ylim = axis_lim_rel, clip = "on") +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(geno, " - Lost ", metric_name, " (relative, q<0.05)"), x = "Fraction lost in iN", y = "Fraction lost in iDA") +
        ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
        ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

      ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_path, paste0(geno, "_bubble_relative_iN_vs_iDA.pdf")), p_rel, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
  message("  Saved per-KO bubble plots + source data for ", metric_name)
}

# state_col is now "state_q" throughout; complex uses shared_organelle

for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {

  ppi_hm_data <- ppi_ko_by_annot %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, shared_organelle, frac_lost_q) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = frac_lost_q, values_fill = NA, values_fn = max)

  if (nrow(ppi_hm_data) >= 2 && ncol(ppi_hm_data) >= 3) {

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat, 
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100), 
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = TRUE, 
      clustering_method = "ward.D2", 
      display_numbers = FALSE, 
      fontsize = 6, 
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA, 
      annotation_row = row_annot, 
      annotation_colors = ann_colors, 
      main = paste0("Fraction PPIs lost by KO x annotation (", nt, ", q<0.05)"))
    dev.off()
    message("  Saved: heatmap_ppi_KO_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")
  }

  # --- Trimer heatmap ---
  trimer_hm_data <- trimer_ko_by_annot %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, shared_organelle, frac_disrupted) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = frac_disrupted, values_fill = NA)

  if (nrow(trimer_hm_data) >= 2 && ncol(trimer_hm_data) >= 3) {
    hm_mat <- as.matrix(trimer_hm_data[, -1]); rownames(hm_mat) <- trimer_hm_data$genotype
    row_annot <- row_annot_base[rownames(hm_mat), "DiseaseClass", drop = FALSE]
    ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(row_annot$DiseaseClass)))])

    readr::write_csv(trimer_hm_data, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_trimer_KO_annotation_", nt, "_sourcedata.csv")))
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/KOxNeuron", paste0("heatmap_trimer_KO_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 12, height = 10)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat, 
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#7570B3"))(100), 
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = TRUE, 
      clustering_method = "ward.D2", 
      display_numbers = FALSE, 
      fontsize = 6, 
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA, 
      annotation_row = row_annot, 
      annotation_colors = ann_colors, 
      main = paste0("Fraction trimers disrupted by KO x annotation (", nt, ", q<0.05)"))
    dev.off()
    message("  Saved: heatmap_trimer_KO_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")
  }

  # --- Tetramer heatmap ---
  tetramer_hm_data <- tetramer_ko_by_annot %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, shared_organelle, frac_disrupted) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = frac_disrupted, values_fill = NA)

  if (nrow(tetramer_hm_data) >= 2 && ncol(tetramer_hm_data) >= 3) {
    hm_mat <- as.matrix(tetramer_hm_data[, -1]); rownames(hm_mat) <- tetramer_hm_data$genotype
    row_annot <- row_annot_base[rownames(hm_mat), "DiseaseClass", drop = FALSE]
    ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(row_annot$DiseaseClass)))])

    readr::write_csv(tetramer_hm_data, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_tetramer_KO_annotation_", nt, "_sourcedata.csv")))
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/KOxNeuron", paste0("heatmap_tetramer_KO_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 12, height = 10)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat, 
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#E6AB02"))(100), 
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = TRUE, 
      clustering_method = "ward.D2", 
      display_numbers = FALSE, 
      fontsize = 6, 
      cellwidth = 10,
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA, 
      annotation_row = row_annot, 
      annotation_colors = ann_colors, 
      main = paste0("Fraction tetramers disrupted by KO x annotation (", nt, ", q<0.05)"))
    dev.off()
    message("  Saved: heatmap_tetramer_KO_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")
  }

  # --- Complex heatmap ---
  complex_hm_data <- complex_ko_by_annot %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, compartment_group, frac_disrupted) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = compartment_group, values_from = frac_disrupted, values_fill = NA)
  

  if (nrow(complex_hm_data) >= 2 && ncol(complex_hm_data) >= 3) {
    hm_mat <- as.matrix(complex_hm_data[, -1]); rownames(hm_mat) <- complex_hm_data$genotype
    frac_threshold <- 0.05
    keep_cols <- apply(hm_mat, 2, function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) >= frac_threshold)
    hm_mat <- hm_mat[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
    if (ncol(hm_mat) < 2) next
    row_annot <- row_annot_base[rownames(hm_mat), "DiseaseClass", drop = FALSE]
    ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(row_annot$DiseaseClass)))])

    readr::write_csv(complex_hm_data, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_complex_KO_annotation_", nt, "_sourcedata.csv")))
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/KOxNeuron", paste0("heatmap_complex_KO_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 12, height = 10)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#1B9E77"))(100), 
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = TRUE, 
      clustering_method = "ward.D2", 
      display_numbers = FALSE, 
      fontsize = 6, 
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA, 
      annotation_row = row_annot, 
      annotation_colors = ann_colors, 
      main = paste0("Fraction complexes disrupted by KO x annotation, at least 1% lost (", nt, ", q<0.05)"))
    dev.off()
    message("  Saved: heatmap_complex_KO_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")

}
```
