```{r ko_neuron_extended}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.7 PPI Confidence Boxplots: RFprob, AFMprob, CFprob per KO
# Retained vs lost, faceted by state, colored by organelle annotation
# Separate plots per KO x neuron x score; one source data CSV per KO x neuron
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("7.7: Generating confidence boxplots per KO...")

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/KOxNeuron/per_ko_bubble/confidence"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/confidence"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Derive organelle tags dynamically from ko_edge_states column names
prot1_cols_conf <- grep("_prot1$", colnames(ko_edge_states), value = TRUE)
organelle_tags_for_conf <- sub("_prot1$", "", prot1_cols_conf)

# Build edge x organelle lookup (one row per edge x tag, unique edges)
shared_long_full_list <- list()
for (tag in organelle_tags_for_conf) {
  col_p1 <- paste0(tag, "_prot1")
  col_p2 <- paste0(tag, "_prot2")
  if (col_p1 %in% colnames(ko_edge_states) && col_p2 %in% colnames(ko_edge_states)) {
    edges_with_tag <- ko_edge_states %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data[[col_p1]] == TRUE | .data[[col_p2]] == TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(key) %>%
      dplyr::distinct() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(tag = tag)
    shared_long_full_list[[tag]] <- edges_with_tag
  }
}
shared_long_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(shared_long_full_list) %>% dplyr::distinct()
message("  shared_long_full: ", nrow(shared_long_full), " edge-tag pairs across ", dplyr::n_distinct(shared_long_full$tag), " organelles")


# --- 7.7.1 PPI Confidence Boxplots ---
message("  PPI confidence boxplots...")

ko_ppi_profiles <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state_q, RFprob, AFMprob, CFprob) %>%
  dplyr::rename(state = state_q) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(shared_long_full, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::filter(state %in% c("lost", "retained")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained", "lost")))

n_tags_ppi <- length(unique(ko_ppi_profiles$tag))
organelle_colors_conf <- setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(n_tags_ppi), sort(unique(ko_ppi_profiles$tag)))

conf_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/KOxNeuron/per_ko_bubble/confidence")

ko_neuron_combos_ppi <- ko_ppi_profiles %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos_ppi))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_combos_ppi$genotype[i]
  nt   <- ko_neuron_combos_ppi$neuron[i]
  ko_label <- paste0(geno, "_", nt)

  df_ko <- ko_ppi_profiles %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt)
  if (nrow(df_ko) < 10) next

  # Source data: one CSV per KO x neuron (all scores)
  readr::write_csv(df_ko %>% dplyr::select(key, tag, state, RFprob, AFMprob, CFprob),
    file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/confidence", paste0(ko_label, "_ppi_confidence_sourcedata.csv")))

  for (score in c("RFprob", "AFMprob", "CFprob")) {
    df_score <- df_ko %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[score]]))
    if (nrow(df_score) < 10) next

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_score, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(tag, .data[[score]], median, na.rm = TRUE), y = .data[[score]], fill = tag)) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~state, nrow = 1) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors_conf, guide = "none") +
      ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(score, " by organelle (q<0.05)"), subtitle = ko_label, x = NULL, y = score) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), 
        strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"), 
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(conf_out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_boxplot_", score, "_by_organelle.pdf")), p, width = 12, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}
message("  PPI confidence boxplots done")


# --- 7.7.2 Trimer Confidence Boxplots (mean of 3 constituent PPIs) ---
message("  Trimer confidence boxplots...")

# Unique edge confidence scores (key-level, not duplicated by KO x neuron)
edge_conf_lookup <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, RFprob, AFMprob, CFprob)

trimer_confidence <- trimer_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, genotype, neuron, state_q, shared_organelle, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    key_AB = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2),
    key_BC = .make_undirected_key(Gene2, Gene3),
    key_AC = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_conf_lookup, by = c("key_AB" = "key")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(RFprob_AB = RFprob, AFMprob_AB = AFMprob, CFprob_AB = CFprob) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_conf_lookup, by = c("key_BC" = "key")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(RFprob_BC = RFprob, AFMprob_BC = AFMprob, CFprob_BC = CFprob) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_conf_lookup, by = c("key_AC" = "key")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(RFprob_AC = RFprob, AFMprob_AC = AFMprob, CFprob_AC = CFprob) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_RFprob  = rowMeans(cbind(RFprob_AB,  RFprob_BC,  RFprob_AC),  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_AFMprob = rowMeans(cbind(AFMprob_AB, AFMprob_BC, AFMprob_AC), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_CFprob  = rowMeans(cbind(CFprob_AB,  CFprob_BC,  CFprob_AC),  na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(state_q %in% c("intact", "disrupted"), !is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = dplyr::recode(state_q, "intact" = "retained", "disrupted" = "lost"),
                state = factor(state, levels = c("retained", "lost"))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(tag = shared_organelle)

n_tags_tri <- length(unique(trimer_confidence$tag))
if (n_tags_tri > 0) {
  organelle_colors_tri <- setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(n_tags_tri), sort(unique(trimer_confidence$tag)))
  ko_neuron_combos_tri <- trimer_confidence %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos_tri))) {
    geno <- ko_neuron_combos_tri$genotype[i]
    nt   <- ko_neuron_combos_tri$neuron[i]
    ko_label <- paste0(geno, "_", nt)

    df_ko <- trimer_confidence %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(df_ko) < 5) next

    readr::write_csv(df_ko %>% dplyr::select(trimer_id, tag, state, mean_RFprob, mean_AFMprob, mean_CFprob),
      file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/confidence", paste0(ko_label, "_trimer_confidence_sourcedata.csv")))

    for (score in c("mean_RFprob", "mean_AFMprob", "mean_CFprob")) {
      df_score <- df_ko %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[score]]))
      if (nrow(df_score) < 5) next

      p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_score, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(tag, .data[[score]], median, na.rm = TRUE), y = .data[[score]], fill = tag)) +
        ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~state, nrow = 1) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors_tri, guide = "none") +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Trimer ", score, " (mean of 3 PPIs, q<0.05)"), subtitle = ko_label, x = NULL, y = score) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
        ggplot2::theme(
          panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), 
          strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"), 
          axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

      ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(conf_out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_trimer_boxplot_", score, "_by_organelle.pdf")), p, width = 12, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
}
message("  Trimer confidence boxplots done")


# --- 7.7.3 Tetramer Confidence Boxplots (mean of 6 constituent PPIs) ---
message("  Tetramer confidence boxplots...")

tetramer_confidence <- tetramer_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::select(tetramer_id, genotype, neuron, state_q, shared_organelle, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

  dplyr::left_join(edge_conf_lookup, by = c("key_BC" = "key")) %>% dplyr::rename(RFprob_BC = RFprob, AFMprob_BC = AFMprob, CFprob_BC = CFprob) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_conf_lookup, by = c("key_BD" = "key")) %>% dplyr::rename(RFprob_BD = RFprob, AFMprob_BD = AFMprob, CFprob_BD = CFprob) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_conf_lookup, by = c("key_CD" = "key")) %>% dplyr::rename(RFprob_CD = RFprob, AFMprob_CD = AFMprob, CFprob_CD = CFprob) %>%

    mean_CFprob  = rowMeans(cbind(CFprob_AB,  CFprob_AC,  CFprob_AD,  CFprob_BC,  CFprob_BD,  CFprob_CD),  na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(state_q %in% c("intact", "disrupted"), !is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%

      file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/confidence", paste0(ko_label, "_tetramer_confidence_sourcedata.csv")))

    for (score in c("mean_RFprob", "mean_AFMprob", "mean_CFprob")) {
      df_score <- df_ko %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[score]]))
      if (nrow(df_score) < 5) next

      p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_score, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(tag, .data[[score]], median, na.rm = TRUE), y = .data[[score]], fill = tag)) +
        ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~state, nrow = 1) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors_tet, guide = "none") +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Tetramer ", score, " (mean of 6 PPIs, q<0.05)"), subtitle = ko_label, x = NULL, y = score) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
        ggplot2::theme(
          panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), 
          strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"), 
          axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

      ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(conf_out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_tetramer_boxplot_", score, "_by_organelle.pdf")), p, width = 12, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
}
message("  Tetramer confidence boxplots done")
```

### Section 7.1: Complex Network Plots per KO x Neuron
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# One PDF per disrupted complex x KO x neuron (state_q == "disrupted")
# Baseline layout fixed per complex for cross-KO comparability
# Lost PPIs: dashed red | Retained PPIs: solid grey
# =============================================================================

out_dir_cx_nets    <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/complex_networks")
out_dir_cx_nets_sd <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/complex_networks")
dir.create(out_dir_cx_nets,    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_cx_nets_sd, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# All distinct edge structures for layout building
all_edges_distinct <- ko_edge_states %>% dplyr::distinct(key, Gene1, Gene2)

# Disrupted complexes (q-value filtered)
disrupted_cx_ko <- complex_ko_states %>% dplyr::filter(state_q == "disrupted")
message("Disrupted complex x KO x neuron: ", nrow(disrupted_cx_ko))

# --- Precompute baseline layout once per complex ---
cx_indices_to_plot <- complex_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(state_q == "disrupted" | state_p == "disrupted") %>%
  dplyr::pull(complex_idx) %>%
  unique()

# cx_indices_to_plot <- unique(disrupted_cx_ko$complex_idx)
# message("Unique complexes: ", length(cx_indices_to_plot))

baseline_layouts <- list()

for (cidx in cx_indices_to_plot) {
  cx_row <- complex_evidence %>% dplyr::filter(complex_idx == cidx)
  if (nrow(cx_row) == 0) next
  members <- cx_row$members[[1]]
  if (length(members) < 2) next

  edges_base <- all_edges_distinct %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% members, Gene2 %in% members)
  if (nrow(edges_base) < 1) next

  g_base <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edges_base %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
    directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = members))

  cx_size <- length(members)
  layout_mat <- if (cx_size <= 10) igraph::layout_in_circle(g_base) else
                if (cx_size <= 20) igraph::layout_with_kk(g_base) else
                igraph::layout_with_fr(g_base)
  rownames(layout_mat) <- igraph::V(g_base)$name

  baseline_layouts[[as.character(cidx)]] <- list(layout = layout_mat, members = members)
}
message("Layouts precomputed: ", length(baseline_layouts))

# --- Plot function ---
plot_complex_ko_network <- function(cx_idx, ko_geno, ko_neur,
                                    ko_edge_states, complex_evidence,
                                    complex_ko_states, baseline_layouts,
                                    out_dir, out_dir_sd,
                                    sig_col = "state_q") {   # <-- new param
  bl <- baseline_layouts[[as.character(cx_idx)]]
  if (is.null(bl)) return(invisible(NULL))
  members    <- bl$members
  layout_mat <- bl$layout

  edges_ko <- ko_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$genotype == ko_geno, .data$neuron == ko_neur,
                  Gene1 %in% members, Gene2 %in% members) %>%
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, state_q, state_p, RFprob, AFMprob, CFprob)
  if (nrow(edges_ko) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  cx_sum <- complex_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$complex_idx == cx_idx, .data$genotype == ko_geno, .data$neuron == ko_neur)
  if (nrow(cx_sum) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  cx_meta  <- complex_evidence %>% dplyr::filter(.data$complex_idx == cx_idx)
  cx_size  <- cx_meta$complex_size[1]
  cx_name  <- dplyr::coalesce(cx_meta$corum_matched_name[1], "")
  cx_name  <- if (nchar(cx_name) > 0) paste0("\n", substr(cx_name, 1, 50)) else ""

  # Node states derived from edge states (edge-based definition, no protein-level data needed)
  # lost = all edges in complex lost; disrupted = some edges lost; retained = no edges lost
  node_edge_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    edges_ko %>% dplyr::select(node = Gene1, edge_state = dplyr::all_of(sig_col)),
    edges_ko %>% dplyr::select(node = Gene2, edge_state = dplyr::all_of(sig_col))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(node) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_edges_cx = dplyr::n(), n_edges_lost = sum(edge_state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(node_state = dplyr::case_when(n_edges_lost == n_edges_cx ~ "lost", n_edges_lost > 0 ~ "disrupted", TRUE ~ "retained"))

  n_lost_nodes      <- sum(node_edge_states$node_state == "lost")
  n_disrupted_nodes <- sum(node_edge_states$node_state == "disrupted")

  edge_state_vec <- edges_ko[[sig_col]]

  g_ko <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edges_ko %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
    directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = members))

  igraph::E(g_ko)$color <- ifelse(edge_state_vec == "lost", "#CC0000", "grey40")
  igraph::E(g_ko)$lty   <- ifelse(edge_state_vec == "lost", 2L, 1L)
  igraph::E(g_ko)$width <- 1.8

  vnames      <- igraph::V(g_ko)$name
  layout_plot <- layout_mat[match(vnames, rownames(layout_mat)), , drop = FALSE]

  # Map node states to vertex colors
  node_palette   <- c(lost = "#CC0000", disrupted = "#FD8D3C", retained = "white")
  node_state_vec <- node_edge_states$node_state[match(vnames, node_edge_states$node)]
  node_state_vec[is.na(node_state_vec)] <- "retained"
  vertex_colors  <- node_palette[node_state_vec]

  vsize <- ifelse(cx_size > 30, 6, ifelse(cx_size > 15, 8, 10))
  vlcex <- ifelse(cx_size > 30, 0.4, ifelse(cx_size > 15, 0.5, 0.6))

  sig_label  <- toupper(sub("state_", "", sig_col))
  plot_title <- paste0(
    "Complex ", cx_idx, " | ", ko_geno, " (", ko_neur, ") [", sig_label, "]",
    "\nSize: ", cx_size, " | Edges: ", nrow(edges_ko),
    " | Lost nodes: ", n_lost_nodes, " | Disrupted nodes: ", n_disrupted_nodes, cx_name)

  cx_label <- sprintf("%03d", cx_idx)
  pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(cx_label, "_", ko_geno, "_", ko_neur, "_network.pdf"))

  pdf(pdf_path, width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 4, 1))
  plot(g_ko, layout = layout_plot,
       vertex.size = vsize, vertex.label.cex = vlcex,
       vertex.color = vertex_colors, vertex.frame.color = "grey50",
       edge.color = igraph::E(g_ko)$color,
       edge.width = igraph::E(g_ko)$width,
       edge.lty   = igraph::E(g_ko)$lty,
       main = plot_title)
  legend("bottomleft",
    legend = c("Retained", "Lost", "Node: retained", "Node: disrupted", "Node: lost"),
    col    = c("grey40", "#CC0000", "grey50", "grey50", "grey50"),
    pt.bg  = c(NA, NA, "white", "#FD8D3C", "#CC0000"),
    lwd    = c(2, 2, NA, NA, NA), pch = c(NA, NA, 21, 21, 21),
    lty    = c(1, 2, NA, NA, NA), pt.cex = c(NA, NA, 1.2, 1.2, 1.2),
    bty    = "n", cex = 0.7, title = paste0("PPI state (", sig_label, ")"))
  dev.off()

  readr::write_csv(
    edges_ko %>% dplyr::mutate(complex_idx = cx_idx, genotype = ko_geno, neuron = ko_neur,
                                sig_col = sig_col, n_lost_nodes = n_lost_nodes, n_disrupted_nodes = n_disrupted_nodes),
    file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0(cx_label, "_", ko_geno, "_", ko_neur, "_sourcedata.csv")))

  readr::write_csv(
    node_edge_states %>% dplyr::mutate(complex_idx = cx_idx, genotype = ko_geno, neuron = ko_neur, sig = sig_label),
    file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0(cx_label, "_", ko_geno, "_", ko_neur, "_nodestates.csv")))

  invisible(NULL)
}

# --- Run for all disrupted complex x KO x neuron combinations ---
plot_count_cx <- 0
skipped_cx    <- 0

for (sig in c("state_q", "state_p")) {
  sig_tag <- sub("state_", "", sig)   # "q" or "p"

  out_dir_sig    <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, paste0("plots/complex_networks_", sig_tag))
  out_dir_sig_sd <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, paste0("sourcedata/complex_networks_", sig_tag))
  dir.create(out_dir_sig,    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(out_dir_sig_sd, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  disrupted_sig <- complex_ko_states %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[sig]] == "disrupted")
  message("Running ", toupper(sig_tag), ": ", nrow(disrupted_sig), " plots")

  plot_count_cx <- 0; skipped_cx <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(disrupted_sig))) {
    row <- disrupted_sig[i, ]
    result <- tryCatch(
      plot_complex_ko_network(
        cx_idx = row$complex_idx, ko_geno = row$genotype, ko_neur = row$neuron,
        ko_edge_states = ko_edge_states, complex_evidence = complex_evidence,
        complex_ko_states = complex_ko_states, baseline_layouts = baseline_layouts,
        out_dir = out_dir_sig, out_dir_sd = out_dir_sig_sd, sig_col = sig),
      error = function(e) {
        message("  SKIP complex ", row$complex_idx, " / ", row$genotype, " / ", row$neuron, ": ", e$message)
        "error"
      })
    if (identical(result, "error")) skipped_cx <- skipped_cx + 1 else plot_count_cx <- plot_count_cx + 1
    if ((plot_count_cx + skipped_cx) %% 100 == 0) message("  ", plot_count_cx, " done / ", skipped_cx, " skipped")
  }
  message(toupper(sig_tag), " complete: ", plot_count_cx, " plots, ", skipped_cx, " skipped")
}

  print(p_bar)
  dev.off()
```

## Chunk 8: Radar / Spider Plots
```{r radar}
# =============================================================================
# Radar / Spider Plots (ALL 12 annotations)
# Uses fmsb::radarchart - shows all 12 annotations defined in radar_annotations
# =============================================================================
message("Generating radar plots...")

out_dir_radar     <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/radar")
out_dir_radarDisClass <- file.path(out_dir_radar, "DisClassDetailed")
dir.create(out_dir_radar,         recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_radarDisClass, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/radar"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Prepare: disease class level (loss_per_KO per DiseaseClass x tag) ---
prepare_radar_data <- function(df_states, shared_long_full, neuron_type, radar_annotations) {
  shared_tags <- shared_long_full %>% dplyr::distinct(key, tag)

  df_tagged <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass), tag %in% radar_annotations)

  n_KOs_per_class <- df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::count(DiseaseClass, name = "n_KOs")

  radar_data <- df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::filter(state_q == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(n_KOs_per_class, by = "DiseaseClass") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(loss_per_KO = n_lost / n_KOs) %>%
    dplyr::select(DiseaseClass, tag, loss_per_KO) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = loss_per_KO, values_fill = 0)

  for (ann in radar_annotations) {
    if (!ann %in% colnames(radar_data)) radar_data[[ann]] <- 0
  }
  radar_data %>% dplyr::select(DiseaseClass, dplyr::all_of(radar_annotations))
}

prepare_radar_data_by_genotype <- function(df_states, shared_long_full, neuron_type, radar_annotations) {
  shared_tags <- shared_long_full %>% dplyr::distinct(key, tag)

  df_tagged <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass), tag %in% radar_annotations)

  radar_data <- df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::filter(state_q == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, DiseaseClass, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)

  for (ann in radar_annotations) {
    if (!ann %in% colnames(radar_data)) radar_data[[ann]] <- 0
  }
  radar_data
}

# --- Plot: one line per disease class ---
plot_radar_ppi <- function(radar_data, disease_class_palette, neuron_type, out_dir, radar_annotations, out_dir_sourcedata) {
  annot_cols <- radar_annotations
  if (length(annot_cols) < 3) { message("  Insufficient annotations for radar plot (", neuron_type, ")"); return(invisible(NULL)) }

  data_matrix  <- as.data.frame(radar_data[, annot_cols])
  rownames(data_matrix) <- radar_data$DiseaseClass
  max_val      <- max(data_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  min_val      <- 0
  radar_df     <- rbind(rep(max_val, ncol(data_matrix)), rep(min_val, ncol(data_matrix)), data_matrix)
  colnames(radar_df) <- annot_cols

  disease_classes <- radar_data$DiseaseClass
  line_colors     <- disease_class_palette[disease_classes]
  fill_colors     <- adjustcolor(line_colors, alpha.f = 0.15)

  pdf(file.path(out_dir, paste0("radar_ppi_vulnerability_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
  fmsb::radarchart(radar_df,
    axistype  = 1,
    pcol      = line_colors, pfcol = fill_colors,
    plwd      = 2, plty = 1,
    cglcol    = "grey70", cglty = 1, cglwd = 0.8,
    axislabcol = "grey30",
    vlcex     = 0.7, calcex = 0.6,
    title     = paste0("PPI Vulnerability Profile by Disease Class (", neuron_type, ")\nNormalized lost PPIs per KO - All 12 annotations"))
  legend("topright", legend = disease_classes, col = line_colors, lwd = 2, lty = 1, bty = "n", cex = 0.7)
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: radar_ppi_vulnerability_", neuron_type, ".pdf")

  # Sourcedata
  readr::write_csv(radar_data, file.path(out_dir_sourcedata, paste0("radar_ppi_global_", neuron_type, "_sourcedata.csv")))
}

# --- Run global radars ---
radar_data_iN  <- prepare_radar_data(ko_edge_states, shared_long_full, "iN",  radar_annotations)
radar_data_iDA <- prepare_radar_data(ko_edge_states, shared_long_full, "iDA", radar_annotations)

plot_radar_ppi(radar_data_iN,  disease_class_palette, "iN",  out_dir_radar, radar_annotations, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/radar"))
plot_radar_ppi(radar_data_iDA, disease_class_palette, "iDA", out_dir_radar, radar_annotations, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/radar"))

readr::write_csv(radar_data_iN,  file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "radar_ppi_data_iN.csv"))
readr::write_csv(radar_data_iDA, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "radar_ppi_data_iDA.csv"))



# --- Plot: one line per genotype within a disease class ---
plot_radar_diseaseclass <- function(radar_data_bygenotype, disease_class, disease_class_palette,
                                    neuron_type, out_dir, radar_annotations, out_dir_sourcedata) {
  dc_data <- radar_data_bygenotype %>% dplyr::filter(DiseaseClass == disease_class)
  if (nrow(dc_data) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  annot_cols   <- radar_annotations[radar_annotations %in% colnames(dc_data)]
  if (length(annot_cols) < 3) return(invisible(NULL))

  data_matrix  <- as.data.frame(dc_data[, annot_cols])
  rownames(data_matrix) <- dc_data$genotype
  max_val      <- max(data_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  if (max_val == 0) max_val <- 1
  radar_df     <- rbind(rep(max_val, ncol(data_matrix)), rep(0, ncol(data_matrix)), data_matrix)
  colnames(radar_df) <- annot_cols

  n_geno       <- nrow(dc_data)
  base_color   <- disease_class_palette[disease_class]
  line_colors  <- colorRampPalette(c(base_color, adjustcolor(base_color, red.f = 1.3, green.f = 1.3, blue.f = 1.3)))(n_geno)
  fill_colors  <- adjustcolor(line_colors, alpha.f = 0.1)

  dc_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", disease_class)
  pdf(file.path(out_dir, paste0("radar_ppi_", dc_label, "_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
  fmsb::radarchart(radar_df,
    axistype   = 1,
    pcol       = line_colors, pfcol = fill_colors,
    plwd       = 2, plty = 1,
    cglcol     = "grey70", cglty = 1, cglwd = 0.8,
    axislabcol = "grey30",
    vlcex      = 0.7, calcex = 0.6,
    title      = paste0(disease_class, " - PPI Vulnerability (", neuron_type, ")\nLost PPIs per annotation"))
  legend("topright", legend = dc_data$genotype, col = line_colors, lwd = 2, lty = 1, bty = "n", cex = 0.65)
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: radar_ppi_", dc_label, "_", neuron_type, ".pdf")

  # Sourcedata
  src <- dc_data %>% dplyr::select(genotype, DiseaseClass, dplyr::all_of(annot_cols))
  readr::write_csv(src, file.path(out_dir_sourcedata, paste0("radar_ppi_", dc_label, "_", neuron_type, "_sourcedata.csv")))
}
```

## Chunk 9: Ternary Plots - PPI Loss by Organelle Class and Disease Class
```{r ternary}
# =============================================================================
# Ternary Plots (Ternary package)
# Each point = one KO x neuron, positioned by % lost PPIs across 3 annotation classes
# Uses state_q == "lost" (q-value filtered)
# =============================================================================
message("Generating ternary plots...")

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/ternary"),                recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/ternary/all_combinations"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/ternary"),            recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Build edge-tag lookup from ko_edge_states using organelle_tags ---
# Checks column presence - safe if a tag is missing from ko_edge_states
shared_long_ternary <- purrr::map_dfr(organelle_tags, function(tag) {
  p1 <- paste0(tag, "_prot1")
  p2 <- paste0(tag, "_prot2")
  if (!p1 %in% colnames(ko_edge_states) || !p2 %in% colnames(ko_edge_states)) return(NULL)
  ko_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[p1]] == 1 | .data[[p2]] == 1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(key) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tag = tag)
}) %>% dplyr::distinct()

message("Edge-tag pairs: ", nrow(shared_long_ternary),
        " | Tags present: ", length(unique(shared_long_ternary$tag)),
        " | Unique edges: ", length(unique(shared_long_ternary$key)))

# --- Ternary plot function (single triplet) ---
plot_ternary_ppi_loss <- function(df_states, shared_long_ternary, out_dir,
                                  disease_class_palette,
                                  tern_classes = c("SynGO", "Mito", "EndoLyso")) {
  tern_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots/ternary")
  tern_suffix  <- paste(tern_classes, collapse = "_")

  shared_class <- shared_long_ternary %>%
    dplyr::filter(tag %in% tern_classes) %>%
    dplyr::rename(class = tag) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(key, class)
  if (nrow(shared_class) == 0) { message("  No edges for: ", tern_suffix); return(NULL) }

  lost_edges <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(state_q == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  lost_by_class <- lost_edges %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, class) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  loss_wide <- lost_by_class %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)

  for (tc in tern_classes) if (!tc %in% names(loss_wide)) loss_wide[[tc]] <- 0

  loss_wide <- loss_wide %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] + .data[[tern_classes[2]]] + .data[[tern_classes[3]]],
      p_1   = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] / total,
      p_2   = .data[[tern_classes[2]]] / total,
      p_3   = .data[[tern_classes[3]]] / total) %>%
    dplyr::filter(total > 0, !is.na(DiseaseClass))

  if (nrow(loss_wide) < 3) { message("  Insufficient data for: ", tern_suffix); return(NULL) }
  message("  Ternary data: ", nrow(loss_wide), " KO x neuron points for ", tern_suffix)

  # Plot 1: combined
  pdf(file.path(tern_out_dir, paste0("ternary_combined_", tern_suffix, ".pdf")), width = 6, height = 6)
  Ternary::TernaryPlot(alab = tern_classes[1], blab = tern_classes[2], clab = tern_classes[3],
    lab.cex = 0.8, grid.lines = 5, grid.lty = "dashed", grid.minor.lines = 0,
    axis.cex = 0.6, main = "PPI loss composition - all neurons")
  Ternary::TernaryPoints(loss_wide[, c("p_1", "p_2", "p_3")],
    col = disease_class_palette[as.character(loss_wide$DiseaseClass)],
    pch = ifelse(loss_wide$neuron == "iN", 19, 17), cex = 1.2)
  legend("topright",   legend = names(disease_class_palette), fill = disease_class_palette,  cex = 0.5, bty = "n", title = "Disease Class")
  legend("bottomright", legend = c("iN", "iDA"), pch = c(19, 17), cex = 0.6, bty = "n", title = "Neuron")
  dev.off()

  # Plot 2: faceted by disease class x neuron
  disease_classes <- loss_wide %>%
    dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_geno = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_geno >= 3) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::pull(DiseaseClass)
  disease_classes <- intersect(unique(loss_wide$DiseaseClass), disease_classes)
  n_dc <- length(disease_classes)

  if (n_dc > 0) {
    pdf(file.path(tern_out_dir, paste0("ternary_faceted_", tern_suffix, ".pdf")),
        width = 3 * n_dc, height = 6)
    par(mfrow = c(2, n_dc), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
    for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
      for (dc in disease_classes) {
        dd <- loss_wide %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == nt, DiseaseClass == dc)
        Ternary::TernaryPlot(alab = tern_classes[1], blab = tern_classes[2], clab = tern_classes[3],
          lab.cex = 0.5, grid.lines = 4, grid.lty = "dashed", grid.minor.lines = 0,
          axis.cex = 0.5, main = paste0(dc, "\n(", nt, ")"))
        if (nrow(dd) >= 3) {
          coords <- as.matrix(dd[, c("p_1", "p_2", "p_3")])
          if (nrow(coords) >= 5) tryCatch(
            Ternary::TernaryDensityContour(coords, resolution = 50,
              col = viridisLite::viridis, nlevels = 10, lwd = 0.25, labcex = 0.4),
            error = function(e) NULL)
          Ternary::TernaryPoints(coords, pch = 19, cex = 0.8, col = "red")
          Ternary::TernaryText(coords, labels = dd$genotype, cex = 0.5, pos = 3, offset = 0.3)
        }
      }
    }
    dev.off()
  }

  readr::write_csv(loss_wide, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata/ternary",
    paste0("ternary_loss_", tern_suffix, "_sourcedata.csv")))
  invisible(loss_wide)
}

# --- Priority triplet ---
plot_ternary_ppi_loss(ko_edge_states, shared_long_ternary, out_dir_vuln,
  disease_class_palette, tern_classes = c("SynapseSVs", "Mito", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley"))


# --- All combinations function ---
plot_all_ternary_combinations <- function(df_states, shared_long_ternary, out_dir,
                                          disease_class_palette, tags) {
  combo_out_dir    <- file.path(out_dir, "plots/ternary/all_combinations")
  combo_sd_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "sourcedata/ternary/all_combinations")
  dir.create(combo_out_dir,    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(combo_sd_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  combos   <- combn(tags, 3, simplify = FALSE)
  n_combos <- length(combos)
  message("Generating ", n_combos, " ternary plots from ", length(tags), " tags...")

  # Precompute lost edges once
  lost_edges <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(state_q == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  for (i in seq_along(combos)) {
    tern_classes <- combos[[i]]
    tern_suffix  <- paste(tern_classes, collapse = "_")
    if (i %% 50 == 0) message("[", i, "/", n_combos, "] ", tern_suffix)

    tryCatch({
      shared_class <- shared_long_ternary %>%
        dplyr::filter(tag %in% tern_classes) %>%
        dplyr::rename(class = tag) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(key, class)
      if (nrow(shared_class) == 0) return(NULL)

      lost_by_class <- lost_edges %>%
        dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, class) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

      loss_wide <- lost_by_class %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)

      for (tc in tern_classes) if (!tc %in% names(loss_wide)) loss_wide[[tc]] <- 0

      loss_wide <- loss_wide %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          total = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] + .data[[tern_classes[2]]] + .data[[tern_classes[3]]],
          p_1   = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] / total,
          p_2   = .data[[tern_classes[2]]] / total,
          p_3   = .data[[tern_classes[3]]] / total) %>%
        dplyr::filter(total > 0, !is.na(DiseaseClass))

      if (nrow(loss_wide) < 3) return(NULL)

      disease_classes <- loss_wide %>%
        dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, neuron) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n_geno = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::filter(n_geno >= 3) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(DiseaseClass) %>%
        dplyr::pull(DiseaseClass)
      disease_classes <- intersect(unique(loss_wide$DiseaseClass), disease_classes)
      if (length(disease_classes) == 0) return(NULL)

      n_dc <- length(disease_classes)
      pdf(file.path(combo_out_dir, paste0("ternary_", tern_suffix, ".pdf")),
          width = 3 * n_dc, height = 7)
      par(mfrow = c(2, n_dc), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0))

      for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
        for (dc in disease_classes) {
          dd <- loss_wide %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == nt, DiseaseClass == dc)
          Ternary::TernaryPlot(
            alab = tern_classes[1], blab = tern_classes[2], clab = tern_classes[3],
            lab.cex = 0.5, grid.lines = 4, grid.lty = "dashed", grid.col = "skyblue",
            grid.lwd = 0.25, grid.minor.lines = 0, axis.cex = 0.5,
            main = paste0(dc, "\n(", nt, ")"))
          if (nrow(dd) >= 3) {
            coords <- as.matrix(dd[, c("p_1", "p_2", "p_3")])
            if (nrow(coords) >= 3) tryCatch(
              Ternary::TernaryDensityContour(coords, resolution = 50,
                col = function(n) grey.colors(n, start = 1, end = 0.1),
                filled = TRUE, nlevels = 10, lwd = 0.25, labcex = 0.3),
              error = function(e) NULL)
            Ternary::TernaryPoints(coords, pch = 19, cex = 0.8, col = "red")
            Ternary::TernaryText(coords, labels = dd$genotype, cex = 0.5,
                                 pos = 3, offset = 0.3, col = "red")
          }
        }
      }
      mtext("Each KO: % lost PPIs per annotation. Darker = more KOs with similar profile.",
            outer = TRUE, cex = 0.6, line = 0.5)
      dev.off()

      readr::write_csv(loss_wide, file.path(combo_sd_out_dir,
        paste0("ternary_", tern_suffix, "_sourcedata.csv")))

    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  message("Done. ", n_combos, " combinations processed.")
}

# --- Run: 16-tag curated subset (560 combinations) ---
ternary_tags_16 <- c(
  "Golgi", "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley",
  "OXPHOS", "MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "mtComplexI",
  "Lysosome", "Presynaptic", "Postsynaptic", "SynapseSVs",

message("Chunk 9 complete: Ternary plots")
```

## Chunk 10: PPI Network Connectivity Analysis
```{r network_connectivity}
# =============================================================================
# Network topology disruption analysis per KO x neuron
# Baseline: gold-tier PPIs from baseline_filtered
# KO states: state_q filtered
# =============================================================================
message(strrep("=", 70))
message("CHUNK 10: PPI Network Connectivity Analysis")
message(strrep("=", 70))

library(igraph)
library(corrplot)

out_dir_network <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "Network_evaluation")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline"),              recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M1_hub_vulnerability"),        recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M2_fragmentation"),            recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges"),   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges/per_KO"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M4_disease_convergence"),      recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "sourcedata"),                  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# =============================================================================
# STEP 0: BASELINE NETWORK & TOPOLOGY
# =============================================================================
message("\n--- STEP 0: Building baseline network ---")

# --- 0.1 Build igraph from baseline_filtered ---
baseline_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  d = baseline_filtered %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, key, confidence_tier),
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(baseline_filtered$Gene1, baseline_filtered$Gene2)))
)
message("Baseline: ", igraph::vcount(baseline_net), " proteins | ", igraph::ecount(baseline_net), " edges")


# --- 0.2 Build gene -> organelle annotation from baseline_filtered _prot1/_prot2 columns ---
# Replaces complete_data_annotated_day50 - fully self-contained
gene_annotations <- purrr::map_dfr(organelle_tags, function(tag) {
  p1 <- paste0(tag, "_prot1"); p2 <- paste0(tag, "_prot2")
  if (!p1 %in% colnames(baseline_filtered) || !p2 %in% colnames(baseline_filtered)) return(NULL)
  g1 <- baseline_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[p1]] == 1) %>% dplyr::distinct(Gene1) %>% dplyr::rename(Genes = Gene1)
  g2 <- baseline_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[p2]] == 1) %>% dplyr::distinct(Gene2) %>% dplyr::rename(Genes = Gene2)
  dplyr::bind_rows(g1, g2) %>% dplyr::distinct() %>% dplyr::mutate(annotation = tag)
}) %>% dplyr::distinct()

gene_primary_annotation <- gene_annotations %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(annotations = paste(annotation, collapse = ";"),
                   primary_annotation = dplyr::first(annotation),
                   n_annotations = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

all_annotations <- unique(gene_primary_annotation$primary_annotation)
all_annotations <- all_annotations[!is.na(all_annotations)]
organelle_colors_network <- setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(length(all_annotations)), all_annotations)

igraph::V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation <- gene_primary_annotation$primary_annotation[match(igraph::V(baseline_net)$name, gene_primary_annotation$Genes)]
igraph::V(baseline_net)$all_annotations    <- gene_primary_annotation$annotations[match(igraph::V(baseline_net)$name, gene_primary_annotation$Genes)]
igraph::V(baseline_net)$n_annotations      <- gene_primary_annotation$n_annotations[match(igraph::V(baseline_net)$name, gene_primary_annotation$Genes)]
igraph::V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation[is.na(igraph::V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation)] <- "Unannotated"
igraph::V(baseline_net)$all_annotations[is.na(igraph::V(baseline_net)$all_annotations)]       <- "Unannotated"
igraph::V(baseline_net)$n_annotations[is.na(igraph::V(baseline_net)$n_annotations)]           <- 0


# --- 0.3 Node topology metrics ---
message("Computing node topology metrics...")
igraph::V(baseline_net)$degree          <- igraph::degree(baseline_net)
igraph::V(baseline_net)$betweenness     <- igraph::betweenness(baseline_net, normalized = TRUE)
igraph::V(baseline_net)$clustering_coef <- igraph::transitivity(baseline_net, type = "local")

degree_threshold_top10 <- quantile(igraph::V(baseline_net)$degree, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
degree_threshold_top5  <- quantile(igraph::V(baseline_net)$degree, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
igraph::V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10 <- igraph::V(baseline_net)$degree >= degree_threshold_top10
igraph::V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5  <- igraph::V(baseline_net)$degree >= degree_threshold_top5
message("  Hub threshold (top 10%): degree >= ", degree_threshold_top10, " | n hubs: ", sum(igraph::V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10))


# --- 0.4 Connected components ---
components_baseline <- igraph::components(baseline_net)
message("  Components: ", components_baseline$no,
        " | Largest: ", max(components_baseline$csize),
        " proteins (", round(max(components_baseline$csize) / igraph::vcount(baseline_net) * 100, 1), "%)")
igraph::V(baseline_net)$component_id <- components_baseline$membership


# --- 0.5 Classify edges as intra- / inter-organelle ---
message("Classifying edges...")
edge_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(baseline_net, what = "edges") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_primary_annotation %>% dplyr::select(Genes, primary_annotation), by = c("from" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(annotation_from = primary_annotation) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_primary_annotation %>% dplyr::select(Genes, primary_annotation), by = c("to" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(annotation_to = primary_annotation) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    annotation_from = tidyr::replace_na(annotation_from, "Unannotated"),
    annotation_to   = tidyr::replace_na(annotation_to,   "Unannotated"),
    edge_type       = dplyr::case_when(
      annotation_from == annotation_to ~ "intra",
      annotation_from == "Unannotated" | annotation_to == "Unannotated" ~ "unknown",
      TRUE ~ "inter"),
    annotation_pair = ifelse(annotation_from <= annotation_to,
      paste(annotation_from, annotation_to, sep = "::"),
      paste(annotation_to, annotation_from, sep = "::")))

igraph::E(baseline_net)$edge_type       <- edge_df$edge_type
igraph::E(baseline_net)$annotation_pair <- edge_df$annotation_pair

edge_type_summary <- table(edge_df$edge_type)
message("  Intra: ", edge_type_summary["intra"], " | Inter: ", edge_type_summary["inter"])


# --- 0.6 Inter-organelle edge matrix (baseline) ---
annotation_pairs_all <- edge_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(edge_type %in% c("intra", "inter")) %>%
  dplyr::count(annotation_from, annotation_to, name = "n_edges")

all_annots <- unique(c(edge_df$annotation_from, edge_df$annotation_to))
all_annots <- all_annots[all_annots != "Unannotated"]

inter_matrix_baseline <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_annots), ncol = length(all_annots),
  dimnames = list(all_annots, all_annots))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(annotation_pairs_all))) {
  a1 <- as.character(annotation_pairs_all$annotation_from[i])
  a2 <- as.character(annotation_pairs_all$annotation_to[i])
  if (a1 %in% all_annots && a2 %in% all_annots) {
    inter_matrix_baseline[a1, a2] <- inter_matrix_baseline[a1, a2] + annotation_pairs_all$n_edges[i]
    if (a1 != a2) inter_matrix_baseline[a2, a1] <- inter_matrix_baseline[a2, a1] + annotation_pairs_all$n_edges[i]
  }
}


# --- 0.7 Save baseline ---
node_metrics_baseline <- data.frame(
  Gene = igraph::V(baseline_net)$name, degree = igraph::V(baseline_net)$degree,
  betweenness = igraph::V(baseline_net)$betweenness, clustering_coef = igraph::V(baseline_net)$clustering_coef,
  is_hub_top10 = igraph::V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10, is_hub_top5 = igraph::V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5,
  primary_annotation = igraph::V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation,
  all_annotations = igraph::V(baseline_net)$all_annotations,
  component_id = igraph::V(baseline_net)$component_id) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(degree))

readr::write_csv(node_metrics_baseline, file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "node_metrics_baseline.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edge_df,               file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "edge_classification_baseline.csv"))
write.csv(inter_matrix_baseline,        file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "inter_organelle_matrix_baseline.csv"))

baseline_summary <- list(
  n_proteins = igraph::vcount(baseline_net), n_edges = igraph::ecount(baseline_net),
```

### Section 10.1 Hub vulnearbility
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# MODULE 1: HUB VULNERABILITY
# =============================================================================
message("\n--- MODULE 1: Hub Vulnerability ---")

baseline_degree  <- data.frame(Gene = igraph::V(baseline_net)$name,
  baseline_degree = igraph::V(baseline_net)$degree,
  is_hub_top10    = igraph::V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10,
  is_hub_top5     = igraph::V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5)

ko_neuron_combos <- ko_edge_states %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)
hub_vulnerability_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
  nt   <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]

  retained_edges <- ko_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$genotype == geno, .data$neuron == nt, state_q == "retained") %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2)

  if (nrow(retained_edges) > 0) {
    retained_net    <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(retained_edges, directed = FALSE,
      vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(retained_edges$Gene1, retained_edges$Gene2))))
    retained_degree <- data.frame(Gene = igraph::V(retained_net)$name,
      retained_degree = igraph::degree(retained_net))
  } else {
    retained_degree <- data.frame(Gene = character(0), retained_degree = integer(0))
  }

  hub_vulnerability_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- baseline_degree %>%
    dplyr::left_join(retained_degree, by = "Gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(retained_degree = tidyr::replace_na(retained_degree, 0),
                  lost_degree      = baseline_degree - retained_degree,
                  frac_degree_lost = ifelse(baseline_degree > 0, lost_degree / baseline_degree, 0),
                  genotype = geno, neuron = nt)
}

hub_vulnerability_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(hub_vulnerability_list)
readr::write_csv(hub_vulnerability_all, file.path(out_dir_network, "M1_hub_vulnerability", "hub_vulnerability_all_proteins.csv"))

hub_vuln_summary <- hub_vulnerability_all %>%

  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_hubs            = dplyr::n(),
    mean_frac_lost    = mean(frac_degree_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_frac_lost  = median(frac_degree_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_degree_lost = sum(lost_degree, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_hubs_50pct_lost = sum(frac_degree_lost >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_class_lookup, by = "genotype") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_frac_lost))

readr::write_csv(hub_vuln_summary, file.path(out_dir_network, "M1_hub_vulnerability", "hub_vulnerability_summary.csv"))
```

### Section 10.2 Network Fragmentation
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# MODULE 2: NETWORK FRAGMENTATION
# =============================================================================
message("\n--- MODULE 2: Network Fragmentation ---")

fragmentation_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
  nt   <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]

  retained_edges <- ko_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$genotype == geno, .data$neuron == nt, state_q == "retained") %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2)

  if (nrow(retained_edges) > 0) {
    retained_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(retained_edges, directed = FALSE,
      vertices = data.frame(name = igraph::V(baseline_net)$name))
    comp    <- igraph::components(retained_net)
    orphans <- sum(igraph::degree(retained_net) == 0)
    fragmentation_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
      genotype = geno, neuron = nt,
      n_components           = comp$no,
      largest_component_size = max(comp$csize),
      largest_component_pct  = max(comp$csize) / igraph::vcount(retained_net) * 100,
      n_orphans              = orphans,
      orphan_pct             = orphans / igraph::vcount(retained_net) * 100,
      n_edges_retained       = igraph::ecount(retained_net),
      n_edges_lost           = igraph::ecount(baseline_net) - igraph::ecount(retained_net),
      frac_edges_lost        = (igraph::ecount(baseline_net) - igraph::ecount(retained_net)) / igraph::ecount(baseline_net))
  } else {
    fragmentation_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
      genotype = geno, neuron = nt,
      n_components           = igraph::vcount(baseline_net),
      largest_component_size = 1,
      largest_component_pct  = 1 / igraph::vcount(baseline_net) * 100,
      n_orphans              = igraph::vcount(baseline_net),
      orphan_pct             = 100,
      n_edges_retained       = 0,
      n_edges_lost           = igraph::ecount(baseline_net),
      frac_edges_lost        = 1)
  }
}

fragmentation_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(fragmentation_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_components   = n_components - baseline_summary$n_components,
    delta_largest_pct  = baseline_summary$largest_component_pct - largest_component_pct,
    fragmentation_score = (delta_components / baseline_summary$n_components) + (delta_largest_pct / 100) + (orphan_pct / 100)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_class_lookup, by = "genotype") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(fragmentation_score))

readr::write_csv(fragmentation_all, file.path(out_dir_network, "M2_fragmentation", "fragmentation_metrics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(fragmentation_all, file.path(out_dir_network, "sourcedata", "M2_fragmentation_sourcedata.csv"))

  ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette) +

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_network, "M2_fragmentation", "barplot_fragmentation_per_KO.pdf"), p_frag_bar, width = 4.5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
```

### Section 10.3 Inter-organelle bridge disruption
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# MODULE 3: INTER-ORGANELLE BRIDGE DISRUPTION
# =============================================================================
message("\n--- MODULE 3: Inter-organelle Bridge Analysis ---")

inter_organelle_ko_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
  nt   <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]

  # Rename state_q -> state at source so downstream code is unchanged
  edge_states_ko <- ko_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$genotype == geno, .data$neuron == nt) %>%
    dplyr::select(key, state = state_q)

  edges_with_state <- edge_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(edge_states_ko, by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "unknown"))

  inter_organelle_ko_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- edges_with_state %>%
    dplyr::filter(edge_type == "inter") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(annotation_pair) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_baseline = dplyr::n(),
      n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lost     = sum(state == "lost",     na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost  = n_lost / n_baseline, .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = geno, neuron = nt)
}

inter_organelle_ko_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(inter_organelle_ko_list) %>%
  tidyr::separate(annotation_pair, into = c("annot_A", "annot_B"), sep = "::", remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_class_lookup, by = "genotype")

readr::write_csv(inter_organelle_ko_all, file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", "inter_organelle_edges_per_KO.csv"))

inter_organelle_summary <- inter_organelle_ko_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(annotation_pair, annot_A, annot_B) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_frac_lost      = mean(frac_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_frac_lost    = median(frac_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_baseline      = sum(n_baseline) / dplyr::n_distinct(paste(genotype, neuron)),
    n_KOs_gt30pct_lost  = sum(frac_lost > 0.3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_frac_lost))

readr::write_csv(inter_organelle_summary, file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", "inter_organelle_summary.csv"))


# --- 3.3 Build inter-organelle loss matrix ---
build_inter_matrix_ko <- function(inter_ko_df, all_annots) {
  mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(all_annots), ncol = length(all_annots),
    dimnames = list(all_annots, all_annots))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(inter_ko_df))) {
    a1 <- inter_ko_df$annot_A[j]; a2 <- inter_ko_df$annot_B[j]
    if (a1 %in% all_annots && a2 %in% all_annots) {
      mat[a1, a2] <- inter_ko_df$frac_lost[j]
      mat[a2, a1] <- inter_ko_df$frac_lost[j]
    }
  }
  diag(mat) <- NA
  mat
}

annots_for_matrix <- unique(c(inter_organelle_ko_all$annot_A, inter_organelle_ko_all$annot_B))
annots_for_matrix <- annots_for_matrix[!is.na(annots_for_matrix) & annots_for_matrix != "Unannotated"]


# --- 3.4 Global heatmap (mean loss across all KOs) ---
mean_loss_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(annots_for_matrix), ncol = length(annots_for_matrix),
  dimnames = list(annots_for_matrix, annots_for_matrix))
for (ap in unique(inter_organelle_summary$annotation_pair)) {
  row_data <- inter_organelle_summary %>% dplyr::filter(annotation_pair == ap)
  a1 <- row_data$annot_A; a2 <- row_data$annot_B
  if (a1 %in% annots_for_matrix && a2 %in% annots_for_matrix) {
    mean_loss_matrix[a1, a2] <- row_data$mean_frac_lost
    mean_loss_matrix[a2, a1] <- row_data$mean_frac_lost
  }
}
diag(mean_loss_matrix) <- NA

pairs_with_edges   <- inter_organelle_summary %>% dplyr::filter(total_baseline >= 5) %>% dplyr::pull(annotation_pair)
annots_with_edges  <- unique(c(
  inter_organelle_summary$annot_A[inter_organelle_summary$annotation_pair %in% pairs_with_edges],
  inter_organelle_summary$annot_B[inter_organelle_summary$annotation_pair %in% pairs_with_edges]))
mean_loss_matrix_f <- mean_loss_matrix[annots_with_edges, annots_with_edges]

if (nrow(mean_loss_matrix_f) >= 2) {
  mat_for_plot <- mean_loss_matrix_f
  mat_for_plot[is.na(mat_for_plot)] <- 0
  pdf(file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", "heatmap_mean_inter_organelle_loss.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)
  corrplot::corrplot(mat_for_plot, method = "color", type = "lower",
    col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDAE61", "#D53E4F"))(100),
    is.corr = FALSE, cl.lim = c(0, max(mat_for_plot, na.rm = TRUE)),
    tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.5, cl.cex = 0.5, diag = FALSE,
    title = "Mean fraction inter-organelle edges lost (all KOs)", mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  corrplot::corrplot(mat_for_plot, method = "number", type = "upper", col = "black",
    is.corr = FALSE, number.cex = 0.4, tl.pos = "n", cl.pos = "n", diag = FALSE, add = TRUE)
  dev.off()
  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(mean_loss_matrix_f) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("annotation"),
    file.path(out_dir_network, "sourcedata", "M3_mean_inter_organelle_loss_sourcedata.csv"))
}


# --- 3.5 Per-KO heatmaps ---
message("Generating per-KO inter-organelle heatmaps...")
for (geno in unique(ko_neuron_combos$genotype)) {
  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
    inter_ko_df <- inter_organelle_ko_all %>% dplyr::filter(.data$genotype == geno, .data$neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(inter_ko_df) < 2) next

    mat_ko      <- build_inter_matrix_ko(inter_ko_df, annots_with_edges)
    mat_ko_plot <- mat_ko; mat_ko_plot[is.na(mat_ko_plot)] <- 0
    if (sum(mat_ko_plot > 0, na.rm = TRUE) < 3) next

    if (nrow(mat_ko_plot) >= 3 && sum(rowSums(mat_ko_plot, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) >= 3) {
      mat_for_dist <- mat_ko_plot; mat_for_dist[mat_for_dist == 0] <- 0.001
      hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - mat_for_dist), method = "ward.D2")
      mat_ko_ordered <- mat_ko_plot[hc$order, hc$order]
    } else {
      mat_ko_ordered <- mat_ko_plot
    }

    pdf(file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges/per_KO", paste0("heatmap_", geno, "_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 6, height = 6)
    corrplot::corrplot(mat_ko_ordered, method = "color", type = "lower",
      col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDAE61", "#D53E4F"))(100),
      is.corr = FALSE, cl.lim = c(0, 1), tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.5, cl.cex = 0.5,
      diag = FALSE, title = paste0("Inter-organelle edge loss: ", geno, " ", nt), mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
    corrplot::corrplot(mat_ko_ordered, method = "number", type = "upper", col = "black",
      is.corr = FALSE, number.cex = 0.35, tl.pos = "n", cl.pos = "n", diag = FALSE, add = TRUE)
    dev.off()

    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(mat_ko) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("annotation"),
      file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges/per_KO", paste0("sourcedata_", geno, "_", nt, ".csv")))
  }
}
message("  Per-KO heatmaps complete.")
```

## Chunk 11: Sphingosine Pathway Disruption Analysis
```{r sphingosine}
# =============================================================================
# Sphingosine Pathway Disruption Analysis
# =============================================================================
#
# Extends ceramide analysis one step downstream to sphingosine.
# ASAH1 converts ceramide -> sphingosine, so:
#   depth_from_sphingosine = depth_from_ceramide + 1
#
# Pathway reference:
#   Sphingosine <- Ceramide <- GlcCer/SM <- higher glycosphingolipids
#   ASAH1 (depth 1) | GBA1, SMPD1 (depth 2) | HEXA, HEXB (depth 4)
# =============================================================================
message("Sphingosine Pathway Disruption Analysis...")

out_dir_sphingosine <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sphingosine_pathway")
dir.create(out_dir_sphingosine, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.1 Define pathway structure (depth from sphingosine)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sphingo_pathway <- data.frame(
  gene                   = c("HEXA", "HEXB", "GBA1", "SMPD1", "ASAH1", "PSAP"),
  branch                 = c("ganglioside", "ganglioside", "glucocerebroside", "sphingomyelin", "downstream", "activator"),
  depth_from_ceramide    = c(3, 3, 1, 1, -1, 0),
  depth_from_sphingosine = c(4, 4, 2, 2, 1, 1),
  substrate              = c("GM2", "GM2", "Glucocerebroside", "Sphingomyelin", "Ceramide", "multiple"),
  product                = c("GM3", "GM3", "Ceramide", "Ceramide", "Sphingosine", "multiple"),
  disease                = c("Tay-Sachs", "Sandhoff", "Gaucher", "Niemann-Pick", "Farber", "Saposin deficiency"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("Sphingolipidosis pathway genes (depth from sphingosine):")
print(sphingo_pathway %>% dplyr::select(gene, branch, depth_from_sphingosine, substrate, product))
readr::write_csv(sphingo_pathway, file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "sphingo_pathway_definition.csv"))


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.2 Extract PPI loss profiles for sphingolipidosis KOs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sphingo_genes      <- sphingo_pathway$gene
sphingo_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingo_genes)
message("Edge states for sphingolipidosis KOs: ", nrow(sphingo_edge_states))

sphingo_loss_wide <- sphingo_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state_q) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lost = as.integer(state_q == "lost"), sample = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, sample, lost) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = lost, values_fill = 0)

message("PPI loss matrix: ", nrow(sphingo_loss_wide), " edges x ", ncol(sphingo_loss_wide) - 1, " samples")
readr::write_csv(sphingo_loss_wide, file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "sphingo_loss_wide_q.csv"))


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.3 Compute pairwise Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_jaccard <- function(x, y) {
  intersection <- sum(x == 1 & y == 1)
  union        <- sum(x == 1 | y == 1)
  if (union == 0) return(NA)
  return(intersection / union)
}

sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sphingo_loss_wide), "key")
loss_mat    <- as.matrix(sphingo_loss_wide[, sample_cols])

n_samples   <- length(sample_cols)
jaccard_mat <- matrix(NA, n_samples, n_samples, dimnames = list(sample_cols, sample_cols))

for (i in 1:n_samples) {
  for (j in 1:n_samples) {
    jaccard_mat[i, j] <- compute_jaccard(loss_mat[, i], loss_mat[, j])
  }
}

message("Jaccard similarity matrix computed")
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(jaccard_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample"),
  file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "jaccard_similarity_matrix.csv"))


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.4 Pathway distance (from sphingosine) vs similarity analysis
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pathway_dist_sphingo <- function(gene_a, gene_b, pathway_df) {
  depth_a <- pathway_df$depth_from_sphingosine[pathway_df$gene == gene_a]
  depth_b <- pathway_df$depth_from_sphingosine[pathway_df$gene == gene_b]
  if (length(depth_a) == 0 || length(depth_b) == 0) return(NA)
  return(abs(depth_a - depth_b))
}

get_pair_similarity <- function(gene_a, gene_b, sim_mat, neuron = "iN") {
  sample_a <- paste(gene_a, neuron, sep = "_")
  sample_b <- paste(gene_b, neuron, sep = "_")
  if (sample_a %in% rownames(sim_mat) && sample_b %in% colnames(sim_mat)) {
    return(sim_mat[sample_a, sample_b])
  }
  return(NA)
}

all_pairs <- expand.grid(gene_a = sphingo_genes, gene_b = sphingo_genes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_a < gene_b) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway_distance_sphingo = pathway_dist_sphingo(gene_a, gene_b, sphingo_pathway),
    same_branch  = sphingo_pathway$branch[sphingo_pathway$gene == gene_a] == sphingo_pathway$branch[sphingo_pathway$gene == gene_b],
    jaccard_iN   = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, jaccard_mat, "iN"),
    jaccard_iDA  = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, jaccard_mat, "iDA")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_csv(all_pairs, file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "pathway_distance_sphingo_vs_similarity.csv"))

p_dist_jaccard <- ggplot2::ggplot(all_pairs, ggplot2::aes(x = pathway_distance_sphingo, y = jaccard_iN)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = same_branch), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = paste(gene_a, gene_b, sep = "-")), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#E41A1C", "TRUE" = "#377EB8"), name = "Same branch") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Pathway distance (steps from sphingosine)", y = "Jaccard similarity (lost PPIs, q-sig)",
    title = "Sphingolipidosis: pathway distance from sphingosine vs PPI disruption similarity") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank())

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "pathway_distance_sphingo_vs_jaccard.pdf"), p_dist_jaccard, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.5 Key comparisons for sphingosine-proximal genes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
comparisons_sphingo <- list(
  "ASAH1_vs_GBA1"  = list(a = "ASAH1", b = "GBA1",  hypothesis = "ASAH1 closest to sphingosine, GBA1 produces ceramide"),
  "ASAH1_vs_SMPD1" = list(a = "ASAH1", b = "SMPD1", hypothesis = "ASAH1 closest to sphingosine, SMPD1 produces ceramide"),
  "ASAH1_vs_PSAP"  = list(a = "ASAH1", b = "PSAP",  hypothesis = "Both proximal to sphingosine (depth 1)"),
  "GBA1_vs_SMPD1"  = list(a = "GBA1",  b = "SMPD1", hypothesis = "Both at ceramide level (depth 2)"),
  "HEXA_vs_HEXB"   = list(a = "HEXA",  b = "HEXB",  hypothesis = "Same substrate (GM2), positive control"),
  "HEXA_vs_ASAH1"  = list(a = "HEXA",  b = "ASAH1", hypothesis = "Distal (depth 4) vs proximal (depth 1)")
)

comparison_results_sphingo <- data.frame(
  comparison  = names(comparisons_sphingo),
  hypothesis  = sapply(comparisons_sphingo, function(x) x$hypothesis),
  jaccard_iN  = sapply(comparisons_sphingo, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, jaccard_mat, "iN")),
  jaccard_iDA = sapply(comparisons_sphingo, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, jaccard_mat, "iDA")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("\nKey pathway comparisons (sphingosine perspective):")
print(comparison_results_sphingo)
readr::write_csv(comparison_results_sphingo, file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "key_comparisons_sphingosine.csv"))


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.6 Jaccard similarity heatmap
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  jaccard_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2166AC"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize = 6, fontsize_number = 5, border_color = NA,
  main = "Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs (q-sig)\n(Sphingolipidosis KOs)",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "jaccard_similarity_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 6, height = 6
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.7 Sphingosine-proximal convergence test
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sphingo_proximal_genes <- c("ASAH1", "PSAP")
ceramide_level_genes   <- c("GBA1", "SMPD1")

within_proximal <- get_pair_similarity("ASAH1", "PSAP", jaccard_mat, "iN")
within_ceramide <- get_pair_similarity("GBA1",  "SMPD1", jaccard_mat, "iN")
between_groups  <- mean(c(
  get_pair_similarity("ASAH1", "GBA1",  jaccard_mat, "iN"),
  get_pair_similarity("ASAH1", "SMPD1", jaccard_mat, "iN"),
  get_pair_similarity("PSAP",  "GBA1",  jaccard_mat, "iN"),
  get_pair_similarity("PSAP",  "SMPD1", jaccard_mat, "iN")
), na.rm = TRUE)

message("\n--- Sphingosine convergence test ---")
message("Within sphingosine-proximal (ASAH1-PSAP): ", round(within_proximal, 3))
message("Within ceramide-level (GBA1-SMPD1): ",       round(within_ceramide, 3))
message("Between groups mean: ",                       round(between_groups, 3))

convergence_summary <- data.frame(
  comparison = c("within_sphingo_proximal", "within_ceramide_level", "between_groups"),
  jaccard_iN = c(within_proximal, within_ceramide, between_groups)
)
readr::write_csv(convergence_summary, file.path(out_dir_sphingosine, "convergence_test_summary.csv"))

message("\n=== Module 11: Sphingosine pathway analysis complete ===")
message("Output: ", out_dir_sphingosine)
```
