## Chunk 12: Ceramide Pathway Disruption Analysis
```{r ceramide}
# =============================================================================
# Ceramide Pathway Disruption Analysis
# Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs + complex disruption correlation
# across sphingolipidosis KOs
#
# Hypothesis: Enzymes proximal to ceramide (ASAH1, GBA1, SMPD1) show 
# convergent PPI/complex disruption despite acting on different substrates,
# because they all affect ceramide homeostasis.
#
# Approach:
# 1. Encode sphingolipid pathway as branch + depth from ceramide
# 2. Compute Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs between all sphingolipidosis KOs
# 3. Compute correlation of complex disruption profiles
# 4. Test if ceramide-proximal enzymes cluster together
# 5. Identify shared disrupted complexes (ceramide-sensitive machinery)
#
# Key comparisons:
# - ASAH1 vs GBA1: Both affect ceramide, opposite directions
# - HEXA vs HEXB: Same substrate (GM2), positive control
# - GBA1 vs SMPD1: Both produce ceramide, different branches

# Jaccard similarity as measure:
# - Jaccard measures overlap of binary sets (lost vs not lost).
# - PPI loss is binary (edge lost or not)
# - Handles sparse data well (most PPIs are not lost in any given KO)
# - Intuitive: intersection / union = what fraction of affected PPIs are shared
# =============================================================================
message("Chunk 12: Ceramide Pathway Disruption Analysis...")

out_dir_ceramide <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "ceramide_pathway")
dir.create(out_dir_ceramide, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- 12.1 Pathway structure ---
sphingo_pathway <- data.frame(
  gene                = c("HEXA", "HEXB", "GBA1", "SMPD1", "ASAH1", "PSAP"),
  branch              = c("ganglioside", "ganglioside", "glucocerebroside", "sphingomyelin", "downstream", "activator"),
  depth_from_ceramide = c(3, 3, 1, 1, -1, 0),
  substrate           = c("GM2", "GM2", "Glucocerebroside", "Sphingomyelin", "Ceramide", "multiple"),
  product             = c("GM3", "GM3", "Ceramide", "Ceramide", "Sphingosine", "multiple"),
  disease             = c("Tay-Sachs", "Sandhoff", "Gaucher", "Niemann-Pick", "Farber", "Saposin deficiency"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

print(sphingo_pathway)
readr::write_csv(sphingo_pathway, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "sphingo_pathway_definition.csv"))


# --- 12.2 Binary PPI loss matrix for sphingolipidosis KOs ---
sphingo_genes      <- sphingo_pathway$gene
sphingo_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingo_genes)
message("Edge states for sphingolipidosis KOs: ", nrow(sphingo_edge_states))

sphingo_loss_wide <- sphingo_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state_q) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lost = as.integer(state_q == "lost"), sample = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, sample, lost) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = lost, values_fill = 0)

message("PPI loss matrix: ", nrow(sphingo_loss_wide), " edges x ", ncol(sphingo_loss_wide) - 1, " samples")
readr::write_csv(sphingo_loss_wide %>% dplyr::select(-key) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("key"),
  file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "sphingo_loss_matrix_sourcedata.csv"))


# --- 12.3 Pairwise Jaccard similarity ---
compute_jaccard <- function(x, y) {
  intersection <- sum(x == 1 & y == 1)
  union        <- sum(x == 1 | y == 1)
  if (union == 0) return(NA)
  intersection / union
}

sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sphingo_loss_wide), "key")
loss_mat    <- as.matrix(sphingo_loss_wide[, sample_cols])
n_samples   <- length(sample_cols)
jaccard_mat <- matrix(NA, n_samples, n_samples, dimnames = list(sample_cols, sample_cols))

for (i in seq_len(n_samples)) for (j in seq_len(n_samples))
  jaccard_mat[i, j] <- compute_jaccard(loss_mat[, i], loss_mat[, j])

message("Jaccard similarity matrix computed")
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(jaccard_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample"),
  file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "jaccard_similarity_matrix.csv"))


# --- 12.4 Complex disruption correlation ---
sphingo_complex_summary <- complex_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingo_genes) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id, sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(frac_disrupted = mean(frac_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

sphingo_complex_wide <- sphingo_complex_summary %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = frac_disrupted, values_fill = 0)

complex_mat     <- as.matrix(sphingo_complex_wide[, -1])
correlation_mat <- cor(complex_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

message("Complex disruption correlation matrix computed")
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(correlation_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample"),
  file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "complex_correlation_matrix.csv"))


# --- 12.5 Key pairwise comparisons ---
comparisons <- list(
  "HEXA_vs_HEXB"   = list(a = "HEXA",  b = "HEXB",  hypothesis = "Same substrate (GM2), expect high similarity"),
  "GBA1_vs_SMPD1"  = list(a = "GBA1",  b = "SMPD1", hypothesis = "Both produce ceramide, different branches"),
  "ASAH1_vs_GBA1"  = list(a = "ASAH1", b = "GBA1",  hypothesis = "Both affect ceramide levels"),
  "ASAH1_vs_SMPD1" = list(a = "ASAH1", b = "SMPD1", hypothesis = "Both affect ceramide levels"),
  "HEXA_vs_ASAH1"  = list(a = "HEXA",  b = "ASAH1", hypothesis = "Distal upstream vs downstream of ceramide"),
  "PSAP_vs_GBA1"   = list(a = "PSAP",  b = "GBA1",  hypothesis = "PSAP activates GBA1, expect similarity"))

get_pair_similarity <- function(gene_a, gene_b, sim_mat, neuron = "iN") {
  sa <- paste(gene_a, neuron, sep = "_"); sb <- paste(gene_b, neuron, sep = "_")
  if (sa %in% rownames(sim_mat) && sb %in% colnames(sim_mat)) return(sim_mat[sa, sb])
  NA
}

comparison_results <- data.frame(
  comparison  = names(comparisons),
  hypothesis  = sapply(comparisons, function(x) x$hypothesis),
  jaccard_iN  = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, jaccard_mat,     "iN")),
  jaccard_iDA = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, jaccard_mat,     "iDA")),
  corr_iN     = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, correlation_mat, "iN")),
  corr_iDA    = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, correlation_mat, "iDA")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

message("\nKey pathway comparisons:")
print(comparison_results)


# --- 12.6 Visualize similarity matrices ---
pheatmap::pheatmap(jaccard_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2166AC"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize = 6, fontsize_number = 5, border_color = NA,
  main = "Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs\n(Sphingolipidosis KOs)",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "jaccard_similarity_heatmap.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)

pheatmap::pheatmap(correlation_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#B2182B", "white", "#2166AC"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize = 6, fontsize_number = 5, border_color = NA,
  main = "Correlation of complex disruption\n(Sphingolipidosis KOs)",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "complex_correlation_heatmap.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)


# --- 12.7 Pathway distance vs similarity ---
pathway_dist <- function(gene_a, gene_b, pathway_df) {
  da <- pathway_df$depth_from_ceramide[pathway_df$gene == gene_a]
  db <- pathway_df$depth_from_ceramide[pathway_df$gene == gene_b]
  if (length(da) == 0 || length(db) == 0) return(NA)
  abs(da - db)
}

all_pairs <- expand.grid(gene_a = sphingo_genes, gene_b = sphingo_genes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_a < gene_b) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway_distance = pathway_dist(gene_a, gene_b, sphingo_pathway),
    same_branch      = sphingo_pathway$branch[sphingo_pathway$gene == gene_a] == sphingo_pathway$branch[sphingo_pathway$gene == gene_b],
    jaccard_iN       = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, jaccard_mat,     "iN"),
    jaccard_iDA      = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, jaccard_mat,     "iDA"),
    corr_iN          = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, correlation_mat, "iN"),
    corr_iDA         = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, correlation_mat, "iDA")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_csv(all_pairs, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "pathway_distance_vs_similarity.csv"))

p_dist_jaccard <- ggplot2::ggplot(all_pairs, ggplot2::aes(x = pathway_distance, y = jaccard_iN)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = same_branch), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = paste(gene_a, gene_b, sep = "-")), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#E41A1C", "TRUE" = "#377EB8"), name = "Same branch") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Pathway distance (steps from ceramide)", y = "Jaccard similarity (lost PPIs)",
    title = "Sphingolipidosis: pathway distance vs PPI disruption similarity") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) + ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank())
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "pathway_distance_vs_jaccard.pdf"), p_dist_jaccard, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- 12.8 Background comparison ---
sphingo_samples_iN <- paste(sphingo_genes, "iN", sep = "_")
sphingo_samples_iN <- sphingo_samples_iN[sphingo_samples_iN %in% sample_cols]

sphingo_pairs <- c()
for (i in 1:(length(sphingo_samples_iN) - 1))
  for (j in (i + 1):length(sphingo_samples_iN))
    sphingo_pairs <- c(sphingo_pairs, jaccard_mat[sphingo_samples_iN[i], sphingo_samples_iN[j]])

asah1_gba1_jaccard <- get_pair_similarity("ASAH1", "GBA1", jaccard_mat, "iN")
message("\n--- Ceramide convergence ---")
message("ASAH1 vs GBA1 Jaccard (iN): ",      round(asah1_gba1_jaccard, 3))
message("Mean sphingolipidosis pair Jaccard: ", round(mean(sphingo_pairs, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
message("Range: ", round(min(sphingo_pairs, na.rm = TRUE), 3), " - ", round(max(sphingo_pairs, na.rm = TRUE), 3))


# --- 12.9 Shared disrupted complexes for high-similarity pairs ---
jaccard_threshold <- 0.25

get_shared_complexes <- function(gene_a, gene_b, complex_states) {
  disrupted_a <- complex_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == gene_a, state_q == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()
  disrupted_b <- complex_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == gene_b, state_q == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()
  intersect(disrupted_a, disrupted_b)
}

high_sim_pairs <- all_pairs %>% dplyr::filter(jaccard_iN > jaccard_threshold) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(jaccard_iN))
message("\nHigh-similarity pairs (Jaccard > ", jaccard_threshold, "):")
print(high_sim_pairs %>% dplyr::select(gene_a, gene_b, jaccard_iN))

shared_complexes_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(high_sim_pairs))) {
  pair   <- high_sim_pairs[i, ]
  shared <- get_shared_complexes(pair$gene_a, pair$gene_b, complex_ko_states)
  if (length(shared) > 0)
    shared_complexes_list[[paste(pair$gene_a, pair$gene_b, sep = "_vs_")]] <- data.frame(
      gene_pair = paste(pair$gene_a, pair$gene_b, sep = "_vs_"), complex_id = shared)
}

if (length(shared_complexes_list) > 0) {
  shared_complexes_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(shared_complexes_list)
  readr::write_csv(shared_complexes_all, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "shared_disrupted_high_similarity_pairs.csv"))
  message("\nShared disrupted complexes by pair:")
  print(shared_complexes_all %>% dplyr::count(gene_pair, name = "n_shared_complexes"))
}


# --- 12.10 Three-way intersection: ASAH1 ∩ GBA1 ∩ SMPD1 ---
ceramide_core <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  complex_ko_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == "ASAH1", state_q == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique(),
  complex_ko_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == "GBA1",  state_q == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique(),
  complex_ko_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == "SMPD1", state_q == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()))

message("\n--- Ceramide core complexes (ASAH1 ∩ GBA1 ∩ SMPD1): ", length(ceramide_core), " ---")

if (length(ceramide_core) > 0) {
  ceramide_core_details <- complex_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id %in% ceramide_core) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle)
  readr::write_csv(ceramide_core_details, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "ceramide_core_complexes.csv"))
  print(ceramide_core_details)
}


# --- 12.11 Summary table ---
summary_table <- comparison_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(interpretation = dplyr::case_when(
    jaccard_iN > 0.5 ~ "High similarity",
    jaccard_iN > 0.3 ~ "Moderate similarity",
    jaccard_iN > 0.1 ~ "Low similarity",
    TRUE             ~ "Minimal similarity"))
readr::write_csv(summary_table, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "key_comparisons_summary.csv"))

message("=== Chunk 12: Ceramide pathway analysis complete ===")
```



## Chunk 13: OXPHOS Vulnerability Analysis
```{r module13}
# =============================================================================
# Module 13: OXPHOS Vulnerability Analysis in Sphingolipidoses
# =============================================================================
message("Module 13: OXPHOS Vulnerability Analysis...")

out_dir_mito <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "mito_oxphos_vulnerability")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

mito_annotations <- c("Mito", "MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI")

sphingolipidosis_genes <- c("ASAH1", "GBA1", "SMPD1", "HEXA", "HEXB", "PSAP")
ceramide_core_genes    <- c("ASAH1", "GBA1", "SMPD1")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.1 Filter PPI summary to mito annotations
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mito_ppi_summary <- ko_summary_by_organelle %>%
  dplyr::filter(shared_organelle %in% mito_annotations)

if (nrow(mito_ppi_summary) == 0) {
  message("  No mito annotation data found. Skipping Module 13.")
} else {

  readr::write_csv(mito_ppi_summary, file.path(out_dir_mito, "tables", "ppi_mito_summary.csv"))
  message("  Mito PPI summary: ", nrow(mito_ppi_summary), " rows")


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13.2 Heatmaps: KO x mito-annotation (n_lost_q)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {

    heatmap_data <- mito_ppi_summary %>%
      dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
      dplyr::select(genotype, shared_organelle, n_lost_q) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = n_lost_q, values_fill = 0, values_fn = max)

    if (nrow(heatmap_data) < 2 || ncol(heatmap_data) < 2) {
      message("  Insufficient data for heatmap (", neuron_type, ")")
      next
    }

    hm_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -1])
    rownames(hm_mat) <- heatmap_data$genotype

    row_totals <- rowSums(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    row_order  <- names(sort(row_totals, decreasing = TRUE))
    hm_mat     <- hm_mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

    row_annot <- disease_class_lookup %>%
      dplyr::filter(genotype %in% rownames(hm_mat)) %>%
      as.data.frame()
    rownames(row_annot) <- row_annot$genotype
    row_annot <- row_annot %>% dplyr::select(DiseaseClass)
    row_annot <- row_annot[rownames(hm_mat), , drop = FALSE]

    ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(row_annot$DiseaseClass)))])

    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(hm_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"),
      file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("ppi_mito_heatmap_", neuron_type, ".csv")))

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("grey95", "#FC9272", "#C51B7D"))(100),
      cluster_rows = FALSE, 
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      display_numbers = FALSE, 
      number_format = "%.0f",
      fontsize = 6, 
      fontsize_number = 5,
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA,
      annotation_row = row_annot, annotation_colors = ann_colors,
      main = paste0("Lost Mito/OXPHOS PPIs (q-sig) - ", neuron_type, "\n(ordered by total lost)"),
      filename = file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("heatmap_mito_lost_ppi_", neuron_type, ".pdf")),
      width = 8, height = 12
    )
    message("  Saved: heatmap_mito_lost_ppi_", neuron_type, ".pdf")
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13.3 Heatmaps: fraction lost (frac_lost_q, normalized)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {

    heatmap_data_frac <- mito_ppi_summary %>%
      dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
      dplyr::select(genotype, shared_organelle, frac_lost_q) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = frac_lost_q, values_fill = 0, values_fn = max)

    if (nrow(heatmap_data_frac) < 2 || ncol(heatmap_data_frac) < 2) next

    hm_mat_frac <- as.matrix(heatmap_data_frac[, -1])
    rownames(hm_mat_frac) <- heatmap_data_frac$genotype

    row_means <- rowMeans(hm_mat_frac, na.rm = TRUE)
    row_order  <- names(sort(row_means, decreasing = TRUE))
    hm_mat_frac <- hm_mat_frac[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

    row_annot_frac <- disease_class_lookup %>%
      dplyr::filter(genotype %in% rownames(hm_mat_frac)) %>%
      as.data.frame()
    rownames(row_annot_frac) <- row_annot_frac$genotype
    row_annot_frac <- row_annot_frac %>% dplyr::select(DiseaseClass)
    row_annot_frac <- row_annot_frac[rownames(hm_mat_frac), , drop = FALSE]

    ann_colors_frac <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(row_annot_frac$DiseaseClass)))])

    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(hm_mat_frac) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"),
      file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("ppi_mito_heatmap_frac_", neuron_type, ".csv")))

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat_frac,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FC9272", "#C51B7D"))(100),
      cluster_rows = FALSE, 
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      display_numbers = FALSE, 
      number_format = "%.2f",
      fontsize = 6, 
      fontsize_number = 5,
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA,
      annotation_row = row_annot_frac, annotation_colors = ann_colors_frac,
      main = paste0("Fraction Mito/OXPHOS PPIs lost (q-sig) - ", neuron_type),
      filename = file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("heatmap_mito_frac_lost_", neuron_type, ".pdf")),
      width = 8, height = 12
    )
    message("  Saved: heatmap_mito_frac_lost_", neuron_type, ".pdf")
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13.4 Barplot: mean frac_lost_q by disease class
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  mito_by_disease <- mito_ppi_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(DiseaseClass), DiseaseClass %in% disease_class_order) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(DiseaseClass = factor(DiseaseClass, levels = disease_class_order)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_lost      = sum(n_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_frac_lost  = mean(frac_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_kos           = dplyr::n_distinct(genotype),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_mito_disease <- ggplot2::ggplot(mito_by_disease, ggplot2::aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = mean_frac_lost, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~neuron) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fraction mito PPIs lost (q-sig)", title = "Mito/OXPHOS vulnerability by disease class") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", "barplot_mito_disease_class.pdf"), p_mito_disease, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  readr::write_csv(mito_by_disease, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", "barplot_mito_disease_class.csv"))


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13.5 Sphingolipidosis focus: ceramide-core vs upstream
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  sphingo_mito <- mito_ppi_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingolipidosis_genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = dplyr::case_when(
      genotype %in% ceramide_core_genes ~ "Ceramide-proximal",
      TRUE ~ "Upstream"
    ))

  if (nrow(sphingo_mito) > 0) {
    sphingo_mito_summary <- sphingo_mito %>%
      dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, group) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        total_lost     = sum(n_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_frac_lost = mean(frac_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    p_sphingo_mito <- ggplot2::ggplot(sphingo_mito_summary, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(genotype, -mean_frac_lost), y = mean_frac_lost, fill = group)) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~neuron) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ceramide-proximal" = "#D53E4F", "Upstream" = "#FEE08B"), name = "Position") +
      ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fraction mito PPIs lost (q-sig)", title = "Sphingolipidosis: Mito/OXPHOS vulnerability") +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", "barplot_sphingo_mito.pdf"), p_sphingo_mito, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
    readr::write_csv(sphingo_mito_summary, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", "barplot_sphingo_mito.csv"))
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13.6 Detailed heatmap: OXPHOS subcompartments
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  oxphos_detail <- mito_ppi_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(shared_organelle %in% c("OXPHOS", "mtComplexI", "MitoMatrix", "MitoIMS"))

  if (nrow(oxphos_detail) > 0) {
    for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {
      heatmap_oxphos <- oxphos_detail %>%
        dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
        dplyr::select(genotype, shared_organelle, frac_lost_q) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = frac_lost_q, values_fill = 0, values_fn = max)

      if (nrow(heatmap_oxphos) < 2 || ncol(heatmap_oxphos) < 2) next

      hm_mat_oxphos <- as.matrix(heatmap_oxphos[, -1])
      rownames(hm_mat_oxphos) <- heatmap_oxphos$genotype

      row_means_oxphos <- rowMeans(hm_mat_oxphos, na.rm = TRUE)
      row_order_oxphos <- names(sort(row_means_oxphos, decreasing = TRUE))
      hm_mat_oxphos    <- hm_mat_oxphos[row_order_oxphos, , drop = FALSE]

      row_annot_oxphos <- disease_class_lookup %>%
        dplyr::filter(genotype %in% rownames(hm_mat_oxphos)) %>%
        as.data.frame()
      rownames(row_annot_oxphos) <- row_annot_oxphos$genotype
      row_annot_oxphos <- row_annot_oxphos %>% dplyr::select(DiseaseClass)
      row_annot_oxphos <- row_annot_oxphos[rownames(hm_mat_oxphos), , drop = FALSE]

      ann_colors_oxphos <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(row_annot_oxphos$DiseaseClass)))])

      readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(hm_mat_oxphos) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"),
        file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_oxphos_detail_", neuron_type, ".csv")))

      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        hm_mat_oxphos,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDAE61", "#D53E4F"))(100),
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        display_numbers = FALSE, 
        number_format = "%.2f",
        fontsize = 6, 
        fontsize_number = 5,
        cellwidth = 10, 
        cellheight = 10, 
        border_color = NA,
        annotation_row = row_annot_oxphos, annotation_colors = ann_colors_oxphos,
        main = paste0("OXPHOS subcompartment vulnerability (q-sig) - ", neuron_type),
        filename = file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("heatmap_oxphos_detail_", neuron_type, ".pdf")),
        width = 6, height = 12
      )
      message("  Saved: heatmap_oxphos_detail_", neuron_type, ".pdf")
    }
  }
}


## Chunk 13 Extended: Mito Subcompartment Vulnerability

# =============================================================================
# Module 13 Extended: Mito Subcompartment Vulnerability (PPI level)
# Fraction denominator: baseline_filtered edges (at least one protein annotated)
# "Mito" excluded -- it is the totality
# =============================================================================
message("Module 13 Extended: Mito subcompartment vulnerability...")

out_dir_mito_sub <- file.path(out_dir_mito, "subcompartments")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "plots"),      recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "sourcedata"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "tables"),     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

mito_sub_tags <- c("MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI", "mtCI_AF")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13E.1 Baseline edge counts per subcompartment (fixed denominator)
# at least one protein annotated to compartment
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_sub_counts <- purrr::map_dfr(mito_sub_tags, function(tag) {
  p1 <- paste0(tag, "_prot1")
  p2 <- paste0(tag, "_prot2")
  n <- baseline_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::coalesce(.data[[p1]], FALSE) | dplyr::coalesce(.data[[p2]], FALSE)) %>%
    nrow()
  tibble::tibble(tag = tag, n_baseline = n)
})

message("  Baseline edges per mito subcompartment:")
print(baseline_sub_counts)
readr::write_csv(baseline_sub_counts, file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "tables", "baseline_sub_counts.csv"))


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13E.2 Per-KO x neuron lost counts per subcompartment
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mito_sub_lost <- purrr::map_dfr(mito_sub_tags, function(tag) {
  p1 <- paste0(tag, "_prot1")
  p2 <- paste0(tag, "_prot2")
  ko_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::coalesce(.data[[p1]], FALSE) | dplyr::coalesce(.data[[p2]], FALSE)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_lost_q = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lost_p = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tag = tag)
}) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(baseline_sub_counts, by = "tag") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    frac_lost_q = n_lost_q / n_baseline,
    frac_lost_p = n_lost_p / n_baseline
  )

readr::write_csv(mito_sub_lost, file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "tables", "mito_sub_lost_per_ko.csv"))
message("  Rows: ", nrow(mito_sub_lost))


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13E.3 Heatmaps per disease class x neuron (KOs x subcompartments)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
disease_classes_present <- intersect(disease_class_order, unique(na.omit(mito_sub_lost$DiseaseClass)))

for (dc in disease_classes_present) {
  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
    hm_data <- mito_sub_lost %>%
      dplyr::filter(DiseaseClass == dc, neuron == nt) %>%
      dplyr::select(genotype, tag, frac_lost_q) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = frac_lost_q, values_fill = 0) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(genotype)

    if (nrow(hm_data) < 1) next

    # Keep only subcompartments present as columns, in fixed order
    present_tags <- intersect(mito_sub_tags, colnames(hm_data))
    hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, present_tags, drop = FALSE])
    rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$genotype
    hm_mat <- hm_mat[order(rowSums(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

    dc_clean <- gsub("\\.", "_", dc)
    fname    <- paste0("heatmap_mito_sub_", dc_clean, "_", nt)

    readr::write_csv(
      as.data.frame(hm_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"),
      file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "sourcedata", paste0(fname, ".csv"))
    )
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("grey97", "#FC9272", "#C51B7D"))(100),
      cluster_rows = FALSE, 
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      display_numbers = FALSE, 
      number_format = "%.2f",
      fontsize = 6, 
      fontsize_number = 5,
      cellwidth = 12, 
      cellheight = 12, 
      border_color = NA,
      main = paste0(dc, " | ", nt, "\nFrac lost (q-sig) / baseline"),
      filename = file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "plots", paste0(fname, ".pdf")),
      width = 5, 
      height = max(3, nrow(hm_mat) * 0.4 + 2)
    )
    message("  Saved: ", fname, ".pdf")
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13E.5 Trimer-level mito subcompartment vulnerability
# "at least one of Gene1/Gene2/Gene3 annotated to compartment" (from subcell_df)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("  13E.5: Trimer mito subcompartment analysis...")

# Gene lookup per compartment from subcell_df
mito_gene_lookup <- purrr::map(mito_sub_tags, function(tag) {
  if (!tag %in% colnames(subcell_df)) return(character(0))
  na.omit(unique(subcell_df[[tag]]))
})
names(mito_gene_lookup) <- mito_sub_tags

# Filter trimers: at least one of Gene1/Gene2/Gene3 in compartment
mito_trimer_filtered <- purrr::map_dfr(mito_sub_tags, function(tag) {
  genes <- mito_gene_lookup[[tag]]
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(NULL)
  trimer_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% genes | Gene2 %in% genes | Gene3 %in% genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tag = tag)
})

message("  Mito trimers (at least one node): ", nrow(mito_trimer_filtered), " rows")

if (nrow(mito_trimer_filtered) == 0) {
  message("  Still no mito trimers found -- check gene name overlap between subcell_df and trimer_ko_states")
} else {

  # Baseline: unique trimers per compartment
  trimer_baseline_counts <- mito_trimer_filtered %>%
    dplyr::distinct(trimer_id, tag) %>%
    dplyr::count(tag, name = "n_baseline_trimers")

  message("  Baseline trimers per mito subcompartment:")
  print(trimer_baseline_counts)
  readr::write_csv(trimer_baseline_counts,
    file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "tables", "trimer_baseline_sub_counts.csv"))

  # Per-KO x neuron lost trimer counts
  mito_trimer_lost <- mito_trimer_filtered %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_trimers_total = dplyr::n(),
      n_disrupted_q   = sum(state_q == "disrupted", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_disrupted_p   = sum(state_p == "disrupted", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(trimer_baseline_counts, by = "tag") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      frac_disrupted_q = n_disrupted_q / n_baseline_trimers,
      frac_disrupted_p = n_disrupted_p / n_baseline_trimers
    )

  readr::write_csv(mito_trimer_lost,
    file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "tables", "mito_trimer_lost_per_ko.csv"))

  # Heatmaps per disease class x neuron
  for (dc in disease_classes_present) {
    for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
      hm_data <- mito_trimer_lost %>%
        dplyr::filter(DiseaseClass == dc, neuron == nt) %>%
        dplyr::select(genotype, tag, frac_disrupted_q) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = frac_disrupted_q, values_fill = 0)

      if (nrow(hm_data) < 1) next

      present_tags <- intersect(mito_sub_tags, colnames(hm_data))
      hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, present_tags, drop = FALSE])
      rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$genotype
      hm_mat <- hm_mat[order(rowSums(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

      dc_clean <- gsub("\\.", "_", dc)
      fname    <- paste0("heatmap_trimer_mito_sub_", dc_clean, "_", nt)

      readr::write_csv(
        as.data.frame(hm_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"),
        file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "sourcedata", paste0(fname, ".csv"))
      )
      # check range of matrix
      if (max(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || diff(range(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE)) == 0) {
        message("  Skipping ", fname, " -- no variation in values")

      }
      pheatmap::pheatmap(

        cluster_rows = FALSE,

        display_numbers = FALSE, 
        number_format = "%.2f",
        fontsize = 6, 
        fontsize_number = 5,
        cellwidth = 12, 
        cellheight = 12, 
        border_color = NA,
        main = paste0(dc, " | ", nt, " | Trimers\nFrac lost (q-sig) / baseline"),
        filename = file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "plots", paste0(fname, ".pdf")),
        width = 5, height = max(3, nrow(hm_mat) * 0.4 + 2)
      )
      message("  Saved: ", fname, ".pdf")
    }
  }

  # Sphingolipidoses x iDA spotlight
  sphingo_trimer_sub <- mito_trimer_lost %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingo_kos) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tag = factor(tag, levels = mito_sub_tags))

  if (nrow(sphingo_trimer_sub) > 0) {
    p_sphingo_trimer_iDA <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      sphingo_trimer_sub %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == "iDA"),

    ) +

      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13E.6 Complex-level mito subcompartment vulnerability
# Denominator: total complexes per compartment in complex_ko_states (baseline)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("  13E.6: Complex mito subcompartment analysis...")

# Build complex_id -> mito subcompartment membership
# at least one member annotated to compartment (via subcell_df)
mito_complex_ids <- purrr::map_dfr(mito_sub_tags, function(tag) {
  genes <- mito_gene_lookup[[tag]] 
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(NULL)
  complex_members_parsed %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::filter(any(members_list %in% genes)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tag = tag)
})

message("  Mito complex-tag pairs: ", nrow(mito_complex_ids))

# Join to complex_ko_states via complex_id + tag
mito_complex_filtered <- complex_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(mito_complex_ids, by = "complex_id", relationship = "many-to-many")

# Split semicolon-separated shared_organelle and explode to one row per tag
# Filter to mito subcompartments only ("Mito" excluded per original design)
mito_complex_states <- complex_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::mutate(organelle_list = stringr::str_split(shared_organelle, ";\\s*")) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(organelle_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(organelle_list %in% mito_sub_tags) %>%
  dplyr::rename(tag = organelle_list)

message("  Mito complex rows after split: ", nrow(mito_complex_states))

if (nrow(mito_complex_states) == 0) {
  message("  No mito complexes found -- skipping complex section")
} else {

  # Baseline complex counts per compartment
  complex_baseline_counts <- complex_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::mutate(organelle_list = stringr::str_split(shared_organelle, ";\\s*")) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(organelle_list) %>%
    dplyr::filter(organelle_list %in% mito_sub_tags) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(complex_id, organelle_list) %>%
    dplyr::count(organelle_list, name = "n_baseline_complexes") %>%
    dplyr::rename(tag = organelle_list)

  message("  Baseline complexes per mito subcompartment:")
  print(complex_baseline_counts)
  readr::write_csv(complex_baseline_counts,
    file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "tables", "complex_baseline_sub_counts.csv"))

  # Per-KO x neuron complex states per subcompartment
  # group_by: shared_organelle -> tag
  mito_complex_lost <- mito_complex_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, tag) %>%    # <-- was shared_organelle
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_complexes_total = dplyr::n(),
      n_disrupted_q     = sum(state_q == "disrupted", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_disrupted_p     = sum(state_p == "disrupted", na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_frac_lost_q  = mean(frac_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(complex_baseline_counts, by = "tag") %>%   # <-- was shared_organelle
    dplyr::mutate(
      frac_disrupted_q = n_disrupted_q / n_baseline_complexes,
      frac_disrupted_p = n_disrupted_p / n_baseline_complexes
    )

  readr::write_csv(mito_complex_lost,
    file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "tables", "mito_complex_lost_per_ko.csv"))
  message("  Complex disruption data: ", nrow(mito_complex_lost), " rows")


  # Heatmaps per disease class x neuron
  for (dc in disease_classes_present) {
    for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
      hm_data <- mito_complex_lost %>%
        dplyr::filter(DiseaseClass == dc, neuron == nt) %>%
        dplyr::select(genotype, tag, frac_disrupted_q) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = frac_disrupted_q, values_fill = 0)

      if (nrow(hm_data) < 1) next

      present_tags <- intersect(mito_sub_tags, colnames(hm_data))
      hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, present_tags, drop = FALSE])
      rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$genotype
      hm_mat <- hm_mat[order(rowSums(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

      dc_clean <- gsub("\\.", "_", dc)
      fname    <- paste0("heatmap_complex_mito_sub_", dc_clean, "_", nt)

      readr::write_csv(
        as.data.frame(hm_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"),
        file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "sourcedata", paste0(fname, ".csv"))
      )
      # check range of matrix
      if (max(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || diff(range(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE)) == 0) {
        message("  Skipping ", fname, " -- no variation in values")
        next
      }
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        hm_mat,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("grey97", "#9ECAE1", "#2171B5"))(100),
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        display_numbers = FALSE, 
        number_format = "%.2f",
        fontsize = 6, 
        fontsize_number = 5,
        cellwidth = 12, 
        cellheight = 12, 
        border_color = NA,
        main = paste0(dc, " | ", nt, " | Complexes\nFrac disrupted (q-sig) / baseline"),
        filename = file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "plots", paste0(fname, ".pdf")),
        width = 5, height = max(3, nrow(hm_mat) * 0.4 + 2)
      )
      message("  Saved: ", fname, ".pdf")
    }
  }


  # Sphingolipidoses x iDA spotlight -- complexes
  sphingo_complex_sub <- mito_complex_lost %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingo_kos) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tag = factor(tag, levels = mito_sub_tags))

  if (nrow(sphingo_complex_sub) > 0) {
    p_sphingo_cx_iDA <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      sphingo_complex_sub %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == "iDA"),
      ggplot2::aes(x = tag, y = frac_disrupted_q, fill = genotype)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "KO") +
      ggplot2::labs(
        x = NULL, y = "Frac disrupted complexes / baseline (q-sig)",
        title = "Sphingolipidoses: mito subcompartment complex vulnerability (iDA)"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                     axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "plots", "sphingo_iDA_complex_mito_sub_barplot.pdf"),
      p_sphingo_cx_iDA, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
    readr::write_csv(
      sphingo_complex_sub %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == "iDA"),
      file.path(out_dir_mito_sub, "sourcedata", "sphingo_iDA_complex_mito_sub_barplot.csv"))
  }

  message("  13E.6 complex section complete")
}

message("Module 13 complete: OXPHOS vulnerability analysis")
```

## Chunk 14: Gain Analysis Metrics
```{r gain_metrics}
# =============================================================================
# Module 14: Gain Analysis Metrics (q-sig primary, p-sig secondary)
# Significant gain: gained_A_q < 0.05 OR gained_B_q < 0.05
# =============================================================================
message("Module 15: Gain analysis metrics...")

out_dir_gain <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "gain_analysis")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_gain, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14.1 PPI-level gain summary (q-sig)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ppi_gain_summary_q <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gain_A    = gained_A_q < 0.05,
    gain_B    = gained_B_q < 0.05,
    any_gain  = gain_A | gain_B
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges      = dplyr::n(),
    n_with_gain      = sum(any_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_with_gain   = n_with_gain / total_edges,
    n_lost           = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost        = n_lost / total_edges,
    loss_gain_ratio  = n_lost / (n_with_gain + 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_with_gain > 0) # exclude KOs with no PPIs gained

readr::write_csv(ppi_gain_summary_q, file.path(out_dir_gain, "tables", "ppi_gain_summary_q.csv"))
message("  Saved: ppi_gain_summary_q.csv")


# p-sig variant
ppi_gain_summary_p <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gain_A    = gained_A_p < 0.05,
    gain_B    = gained_B_p < 0.05,
    any_gain  = gain_A | gain_B
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges      = dplyr::n(),
    n_with_gain      = sum(any_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_with_gain   = n_with_gain / total_edges,
    n_lost           = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost        = n_lost / total_edges,
    loss_gain_ratio  = n_lost / (n_with_gain + 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_with_gain > 0)

readr::write_csv(ppi_gain_summary_p, file.path(out_dir_gain, "tables", "ppi_gain_summary_p.csv"))
message("  Saved: ppi_gain_summary_p.csv")

protein_gain_summary_q <- prot_long %>%
```

## Chunk 15: Multi-Genotype Timecourse (d30 & d50)
```{r module15_timecourse_multi}
# =============================================================================
# Module 15: Multi-Genotype Timecourse PPI Analysis (d30 & d50)
# d50: ko_edge_states (state_q/state_p); d30: computed from wide frame
# =============================================================================
message("Module 15: Multi-Genotype Timecourse (d30 & d50)...")

out_dir_tc_multi <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "timecourse_multi_genotype")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/global"),     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/by_genotype"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "sourcedata"),        recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables"),            recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

genotypes_tc   <- c("ASAH1", "SMPD1", "GBA1", "GRN")
neurons_tc     <- c("iN", "iDA")
drop_thresh_tc <- drop_thresh   # reuse global threshold
sig_thresh_tc  <- 1.301         # -log10(0.05)

genotype_palette_tc <- c(ASAH1 = "#D53E4F", SMPD1 = "#F46D43", GBA1 = "#ABDDA4", GRN = "#66C2A5")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.1 Helper: extract protein-level stats from wide day frame
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
extract_prot_stats <- function(df_wide, genotype, neuron) {
  log2fc_col <- paste0(genotype, "_", neuron, "_log2_fold_change")
  q_col      <- paste0(genotype, "_", neuron, "_neg_log10_q_value")
  p_col      <- paste0(genotype, "_", neuron, "_neg_log10_p_value")
  if (!log2fc_col %in% colnames(df_wide)) return(NULL)
  df_wide %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC = dplyr::all_of(log2fc_col), neg_log10_q = dplyr::all_of(q_col), neg_log10_p = dplyr::all_of(p_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "", !is.na(log2FC)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = genotype, neuron = neuron)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.2 Helper: compute edge states from protein stats + baseline
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_tc_edge_states <- function(prot_stats, baseline_edges, drop_thresh, sig_thresh) {
  detected <- unique(prot_stats$Genes)
  edges <- baseline_edges %>% dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% detected, Gene2 %in% detected)
  edges %>%
    dplyr::left_join(prot_stats %>% dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC, neg_log10_q, neg_log10_p), by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC, qA = neg_log10_q, pA = neg_log10_p) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(prot_stats %>% dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC, neg_log10_q, neg_log10_p), by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC, qB = neg_log10_q, pB = neg_log10_p) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state_q = dplyr::case_when(
        (!is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh & !is.na(qA) & qA > sig_thresh) |
        (!is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh & !is.na(qB) & qB > sig_thresh) ~ "lost",
        (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB)) ~ "retained",
        TRUE ~ "unknown"
      ),
      state_p = dplyr::case_when(
        (!is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh & !is.na(pA) & pA > sig_thresh) |
        (!is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh & !is.na(pB) & pB > sig_thresh) ~ "lost",
        (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB)) ~ "retained",
        TRUE ~ "unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, state_q, state_p)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.3 Build d30 edge states for all 4 genotypes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
d30_edge_list <- list()
for (geno in genotypes_tc) {
  for (nt in neurons_tc) {
    prot <- extract_prot_stats(complete_data_annotated_day30, geno, nt)
    if (is.null(prot) || nrow(prot) == 0) next
    es <- compute_tc_edge_states(prot, baseline_filtered, drop_thresh_tc, sig_thresh_tc) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(genotype = geno, neuron = nt, day = "d30")
    d30_edge_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- es
  }
}
d30_edge_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(d30_edge_list)
message("  d30 edge states: ", nrow(d30_edge_states), " rows")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.4 Pull d50 edge states from ko_edge_states
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
d50_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype %in% genotypes_tc) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, genotype, neuron, state_q, state_p) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(day = "d50")
message("  d50 edge states: ", nrow(d50_edge_states), " rows")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.5 Combine
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
tc_multi_edge_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(d30_edge_states, d50_edge_states) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    day      = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50")),
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = genotypes_tc)
  )

readr::write_csv(tc_multi_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables", "tc_multi_edge_states.csv"))


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.6 Summary: n_lost / frac_lost per genotype x day x neuron
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_tc_summary <- function(edge_states, state_col) {
  edge_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_edges = dplyr::n(),
      n_lost      = sum(.data[[state_col]] == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_retained  = sum(.data[[state_col]] == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost   = n_lost / total_edges,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

tc_multi_summary_q <- make_tc_summary(tc_multi_edge_states, "state_q")
tc_multi_summary_p <- make_tc_summary(tc_multi_edge_states, "state_p")

readr::write_csv(tc_multi_summary_q, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables", "tc_multi_summary_q.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tc_multi_summary_p, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables", "tc_multi_summary_p.csv"))
message("  Summary (q): "); print(tc_multi_summary_q)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.7 Barplot: lost PPIs per genotype x day
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  summ <- if (sig == "q") tc_multi_summary_q else tc_multi_summary_p
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(summ, ggplot2::aes(x = day, y = n_lost, fill = neuron)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = n_lost), position = ggplot2::position_dodge(0.7), vjust = -0.5, size = 2) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~genotype, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Lost PPIs (", sig, "-sig) d30 vs d50"), x = NULL, y = "N lost PPIs") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/global", paste0("bars_lost_ppis_", sig, ".pdf")), p, width = 8, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  readr::write_csv(summ, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "sourcedata", paste0("bars_lost_ppis_", sig, ".csv")))
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.8 Line plot: trajectory comparison across genotypes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  summ <- if (sig == "q") tc_multi_summary_q else tc_multi_summary_p
  summ_num <- summ %>% dplyr::mutate(day_num = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", as.character(day))))
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(summ_num, ggplot2::aes(x = day_num, y = n_lost, color = genotype, linetype = neuron, group = interaction(genotype, neuron))) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = genotype_palette_tc) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = c(iN = "solid", iDA = "dashed")) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 50), labels = c("d30", "d50")) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("PPI loss trajectory (", sig, "-sig)"), x = "Day", y = "N lost PPIs") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank())
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/global", paste0("lines_trajectory_", sig, ".pdf")), p, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  readr::write_csv(summ_num, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "sourcedata", paste0("lines_trajectory_", sig, ".csv")))
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.9 Annotation breakdown via shared_long_full
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig)
  by_annot <- tc_multi_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[state_col]] == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_long_full, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, day, neuron, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  readr::write_csv(by_annot, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables", paste0("tc_multi_lost_by_annotation_", sig, ".csv")))

  # Global heatmap per neuron
  for (nt in neurons_tc) {
    hm_data <- by_annot %>%
      dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
      tidyr::unite("Geno_Day", genotype, day, sep = "_") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Geno_Day, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)
    if (nrow(hm_data) < 2) next
    hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, -c(1:2)])
    rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$tag
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(hm_mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("tag"),
      file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_annotation_", sig, "_", nt, ".csv")))
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/global", paste0("heatmap_annotation_", sig, "_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 8, height = 10)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100), 
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = TRUE, 
      fontsize = 6, 
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA, 
      main = paste0("Lost PPIs by annotation (", sig, "-sig) - ", nt))
    dev.off()
  }

  # Per-genotype heatmaps
  for (geno in genotypes_tc) {
    for (nt in neurons_tc) {
      hm_data <- by_annot %>%
        dplyr::filter(as.character(genotype) == geno, neuron == nt) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = tag, names_from = day, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)
      if (nrow(hm_data) < 2) next
      hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, -1])
      rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$tag
      pdf(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/by_genotype", paste0("heatmap_", geno, "_", nt, "_", sig, ".pdf")), width = 4, height = 8)
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        hm_mat, 
        color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100), 
        cluster_rows = TRUE, 
        cluster_cols = FALSE, 
        fontsize = 6, 
        cellwidth = 10, 
        cellheight = 10, 
        border_color = NA, 
        main = paste0(geno, " ", nt, " (", sig, "-sig)"))
      dev.off()
    }
  }
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.10 Delta analysis (d50 - d30)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  summ <- if (sig == "q") tc_multi_summary_q else tc_multi_summary_p
  delta <- summ %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, day, neuron, n_lost) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = day, values_from = n_lost) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(delta = d50 - d30, abs_delta = abs(delta))
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(delta, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(genotype, -abs_delta), y = delta, fill = neuron)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Delta lost PPIs d50-d30 (", sig, "-sig)"), x = NULL, y = "Delta N lost") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank())
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/global", paste0("bars_delta_", sig, ".pdf")), p, width = 4, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)
  readr::write_csv(delta, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "sourcedata", paste0("bars_delta_", sig, ".csv")))
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15.11 Complex analysis (rebuilt from complex_members_parsed)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build complex -> edge key map once
complex_edge_map <- complex_members_parsed %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle, members_list) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(length(members_list) >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pairs = list(combn(members_list, 2, simplify = FALSE))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::unnest(pairs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene1 = purrr::map_chr(pairs, 1), Gene2 = purrr::map_chr(pairs, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle, Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(baseline_filtered %>% dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2), by = c("Gene1", "Gene2")) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle, key)

message("  Complex edge map: ", nrow(complex_edge_map), " complex-edge pairs")

for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig)
  geno_day_neuron_combos <- tc_multi_edge_states %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype, day, neuron)

  complex_states <- complex_edge_map %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, key) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(geno_day_neuron_combos) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tc_multi_edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key, genotype, day, neuron, dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = c("key", "genotype", "day", "neuron")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(edge_lost = tidyr::replace_na(.data[[state_col]], "retained") == "lost")

  complex_summary <- complex_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, genotype, day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_edges_total = dplyr::n(), n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost), frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total, .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(complex_members_parsed %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle) %>% dplyr::distinct(), by = "complex_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(complex_state = dplyr::case_when(frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact"))

  disruption_summary <- complex_summary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_complexes = dplyr::n(), n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"), n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"), n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"), frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes, .groups = "drop")

  readr::write_csv(disruption_summary, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables", paste0("tc_multi_complex_disruption_", sig, ".csv")))

  p_cx <- ggplot2::ggplot(disruption_summary, ggplot2::aes(x = day, y = n_disrupted, fill = neuron)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~genotype, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Disrupted complexes (", sig, "-sig)"), x = NULL, y = "N disrupted") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "plots/global", paste0("bars_disrupted_complexes_", sig, ".pdf")), p_cx, width = 8, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  readr::write_csv(disruption_summary, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "sourcedata", paste0("bars_disrupted_complexes_", sig, ".csv")))
}

# 15.12  Trimer majority-organelle assignment + d30/d50 states
# =============================================================================
# subcell_df: wide, cols = compartment names, values = gene symbols
tc_comp_cols <- setdiff(colnames(subcell_df), c("Genes", "Gene", "UniprotID", "Protein", "protein", "gene"))
tc_gene_comp_lookup <- lapply(tc_comp_cols, function(comp) na.omit(unique(subcell_df[[comp]])))
names(tc_gene_comp_lookup) <- tc_comp_cols

# Majority organelle: compartment with >=2 of 3 trimer nodes annotated to it
assign_trimer_org_vec <- function(g1_vec, g2_vec, g3_vec, lookup) {
  mapply(function(g1, g2, g3) {
    genes  <- c(g1, g2, g3)
    counts <- sapply(lookup, function(gset) sum(genes %in% gset, na.rm = TRUE))
    max_c  <- max(counts)
    if (max_c >= 2) names(counts)[which(counts == max_c)[1]] else "Mixed"
  }, g1_vec, g2_vec, g3_vec, SIMPLIFY = TRUE, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

trimer_templates <- trimer_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::distinct(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(majority_org = assign_trimer_org_vec(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, tc_gene_comp_lookup))

message("  Trimer majority-org: ", sum(trimer_templates$majority_org != "Mixed"), " / ", nrow(trimer_templates), " non-mixed")

# Compute trimer disruption state from protein-level stats
compute_tc_trimer_states <- function(prot_stats, trimer_tmpl, drop_thresh, sig_thresh) {
  lost_q <- prot_stats %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < drop_thresh, neg_log10_q > sig_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(Genes)
  lost_p <- prot_stats %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < drop_thresh, neg_log10_p > sig_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(Genes)
  trimer_tmpl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state_q = dplyr::if_else(Gene1 %in% lost_q | Gene2 %in% lost_q | Gene3 %in% lost_q, "disrupted", "intact"),
      state_p = dplyr::if_else(Gene1 %in% lost_p | Gene2 %in% lost_p | Gene3 %in% lost_p, "disrupted", "intact")
    )
}

# d30 trimer states
d30_trimer_list_tc <- list()
for (geno in genotypes_tc) {
  for (nt in neurons_tc) {
    prot <- extract_prot_stats(complete_data_annotated_day30, geno, nt)
    if (is.null(prot) || nrow(prot) == 0) next
    ts <- compute_tc_trimer_states(prot, trimer_templates, drop_thresh_tc, sig_thresh_tc) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(genotype = geno, neuron = nt, day = "d30")
    d30_trimer_list_tc[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- ts
  }
}
d30_trimer_states_tc <- dplyr::bind_rows(d30_trimer_list_tc)

  dplyr::mutate(day = "d50")

tc_multi_trimer_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(d30_trimer_states_tc, d50_trimer_states_tc) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50")), genotype = factor(genotype, levels = genotypes_tc))

readr::write_csv(tc_multi_trimer_states %>% dplyr::select(-Gene1, -Gene2, -Gene3),

# Edge-level states per complex -- basis for all downstream summaries
complex_tc_states <- complex_edge_map %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, key) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(tc_multi_edge_states, by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, key, Gene1, Gene2, genotype, day, neuron, state_q, state_p)

readr::write_csv(complex_tc_states, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables", "complex_tc_states.csv"))

# Summarise to complex level: frac lost edges and disruption state per sig
# disrupted >= 0.75, partial >= 0.25, intact otherwise
complex_tc_summary <- complex_tc_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id, genotype, day, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges_total = dplyr::n(),
    n_lost_q      = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p      = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost_q   = n_lost_q / n_edges_total,
    frac_lost_p   = n_lost_p / n_edges_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_members_parsed %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle) %>% dplyr::distinct(), by = "complex_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    complex_state_q = dplyr::case_when(frac_lost_q >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_lost_q >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact"),
    complex_state_p = dplyr::case_when(frac_lost_p >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_lost_p >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact")
  )

readr::write_csv(complex_tc_summary, file.path(out_dir_tc_multi, "tables", "complex_tc_summary.csv"))

message("  Disrupted complexes: q=", sum(complex_tc_summary$complex_state_q == "disrupted"),
        "  p=", sum(complex_tc_summary$complex_state_p == "disrupted"))

# Precompute baseline layouts for union of all disrupted complexes
# Using baseline_filtered so layout is comparable across conditions
tc_cx_layouts <- list()
cx_union <- union(
  complex_tc_summary %>% dplyr::filter(complex_state_q == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique(),
  complex_tc_summary %>% dplyr::filter(complex_state_p == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()
)
for (cx_idx in cx_union) {
  cx_keys  <- complex_edge_map %>% dplyr::filter(complex_id == cx_idx) %>% dplyr::pull(key)
  cx_edges <- baseline_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(key %in% cx_keys) %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2)
  if (nrow(cx_edges) == 0) next
  g_base <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(cx_edges, directed = FALSE)
  tc_cx_layouts[[cx_idx]] <- igraph::layout_with_fr(g_base, niter = 500)
  attr(tc_cx_layouts[[cx_idx]], "node_names") <- igraph::V(g_base)$name
}

)

# Trajectory plot: edges colored by d30/d50 loss category across both timepoints
# Only run for complexes disrupted at d50 to ensure temporal context
plot_tc_cx_trajectory_2d <- function(cx_idx, geno, neur, edge_states, layout_list, out_dir_plots, out_dir_sd, sig = "q") {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig)
  cx_keys   <- complex_edge_map %>% dplyr::filter(complex_id == cx_idx) %>% dplyr::pull(key)
  traj_data <- baseline_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(key %in% cx_keys) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(edge_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, day == "d30", neuron == neur) %>% dplyr::select(key, state_d30 = dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(edge_states %>% dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, day == "d50", neuron == neur) %>% dplyr::select(key, state_d50 = dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state_d30 = tidyr::replace_na(state_d30, "retained"),
      state_d50 = tidyr::replace_na(state_d50, "retained"),
      traj_cat  = dplyr::case_when(
        state_d30 == "lost" & state_d50 == "lost"  ~ "lost_d30_and_d50",
        state_d30 == "lost" & state_d50 != "lost"  ~ "lost_d30_only",
        state_d30 != "lost" & state_d50 == "lost"  ~ "lost_d50_only",
        TRUE                                        ~ "retained"
      ),
      edge_color = tc_traj_palette_2d[traj_cat]
    )
  cx_label <- paste0(substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", cx_idx), 1, 40), "_", abs(sum(utf8ToInt(cx_idx))) %% 9999)
  readr::write_csv(
    traj_data %>% dplyr::mutate(complex_id = cx_idx, genotype = geno, neuron = neur),
    file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0(cx_label, "_", geno, "_", neur, "_trajectory_", sig, "_sourcedata.csv"))
  )
  if (nrow(traj_data) == 0 || !cx_idx %in% names(layout_list)) return(invisible(NULL))
  lay   <- layout_list[[cx_idx]]
  nodes <- attr(lay, "node_names")
  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(traj_data %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2), directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = nodes))
  igraph::E(g)$color <- traj_data$edge_color
  n_any_lost <- sum(traj_data$traj_cat != "retained")
  pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, paste0(cx_label, "_", geno, "_", neur, "_trajectory_", sig, ".pdf")), width = 4, height = 4)
  plot(g, layout = lay, vertex.size = 8, vertex.label.cex = 0.5, vertex.color = "white", vertex.frame.color = "grey40",
       edge.color = igraph::E(g)$color, edge.width = 1.5,
       main = paste0(cx_idx, "\n", geno, " ", neur, " traj (", sig, ")\nlost: ", n_any_lost, " edges"))
  legend("bottomleft", legend = names(tc_traj_palette_2d), col = tc_traj_palette_2d, lwd = 2, cex = 0.5, bty = "n")
  dev.off()
}

# Execute: trajectory only for (complex_id, genotype, neuron) where d50 is disrupted
for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("complex_state_", sig)
  net_dir   <- if (sig == "q") net_dir_q else net_dir_p
  sd_dir    <- if (sig == "q") sd_dir_q  else sd_dir_p

  disrupted_combos <- complex_tc_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[state_col]] == "disrupted") %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, genotype, day, neuron)

  # Trajectory: only for (complex_id, genotype, neuron) where d50 is disrupted
  traj_combos <- disrupted_combos %>%
    dplyr::filter(day == "d50") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(complex_id, genotype, neuron)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(traj_combos))) {
    plot_tc_cx_trajectory_2d(traj_combos$complex_id[i], as.character(traj_combos$genotype[i]),
                              as.character(traj_combos$neuron[i]), tc_multi_edge_states, tc_cx_layouts,
                              net_dir, sd_dir, sig = sig)
  }
}

message("  15.15 complex network plots done")


message("Module 15 complete: Multi-genotype timecourse (PPIs + trimers + complexes + sphingolipidosis)")
```



## Chunk 16: ASAH1 Long Timecourse (d30, d50, d70)

```{r module16_timecourse_asah1}
# =============================================================================

message("Module 16=56: ASAH1 Long Timecourse (d30/d50/d70)...")

for (sig in c("q", "p")) {

  complex_summary <- complex_states %>%

    dplyr::left_join(complex_members_parsed %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle) %>% dplyr::distinct(), by = "complex_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(complex_state = dplyr::case_when(frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact"),

  p_cx <- ggplot2::ggplot(disruption_summary, ggplot2::aes(x = day, y = n_disrupted, fill = neuron)) +

  # Bubble plot: iDA vs iN trajectory coloured by day
  bubble_data <- complex_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, day, neuron, frac_edges_lost, complex_size, shared_organelle) %>%

  p_bub <- ggplot2::ggplot(bubble_data, ggplot2::aes(x = iN, y = iDA, size = complex_size, fill = day)) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.25, alpha = 0.9) +

    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Complex size") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("ASAH1 complex disruption trajectory (", sig, "-sig)"), x = "Frac lost edges (iN)", y = "Frac lost edges (iDA)") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1)
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots", paste0("bubble_trajectory_", sig, ".pdf")), p_bub, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

  # Per-day bubble: iDA vs iN coloured by shared_organelle
  for (d in c("d30", "d50", "d70")) {

    if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) next
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = iN, y = iDA, size = complex_size, fill = shared_organelle)) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.15) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = complex_id), size = 2, max.overlaps = 50, seed = 42) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors, name = "Organelle") +

      ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Complex disruption ASAH1 ", d, " (", sig, "-sig)"), x = "Frac lost edges (iN)", y = "Frac lost edges (iDA)") +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +

    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots", paste0("bubble_", d, "_", sig, ".pdf")), p, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}


# =============================================================================
# 16.10  Trimer annotation heatmaps (d30 / d50 / d70)
# =============================================================================
# Rebuild trimer_templates with majority_org if Chunk 15 didn't run first
if (!exists("trimer_templates") || !"majority_org" %in% colnames(trimer_templates)) {
  if (!exists("tc_comp_cols")) {
    tc_comp_cols <- setdiff(colnames(subcell_df), c("Genes", "Gene", "UniprotID", "Protein", "protein", "gene"))
    tc_gene_comp_lookup <- lapply(tc_comp_cols, function(comp) na.omit(unique(subcell_df[[comp]])))
    names(tc_gene_comp_lookup) <- tc_comp_cols
  }
  assign_trimer_org_vec <- function(g1_vec, g2_vec, g3_vec, lookup) {
    mapply(function(g1, g2, g3) {
      genes  <- c(g1, g2, g3)
      counts <- sapply(lookup, function(gset) sum(genes %in% gset, na.rm = TRUE))
      max_c  <- max(counts)
      if (max_c >= 2) names(counts)[which(counts == max_c)[1]] else "Mixed"
    }, g1_vec, g2_vec, g3_vec, SIMPLIFY = TRUE, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  }
  trimer_templates <- trimer_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::distinct(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(majority_org = assign_trimer_org_vec(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, tc_gene_comp_lookup))
}
if (!exists("compute_tc_trimer_states")) {
  compute_tc_trimer_states <- function(prot_stats, trimer_tmpl, drop_thresh, sig_thresh) {
    lost_q <- prot_stats %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < drop_thresh, neg_log10_q > sig_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(Genes)
    lost_p <- prot_stats %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < drop_thresh, neg_log10_p > sig_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(Genes)
    trimer_tmpl %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        state_q = dplyr::if_else(Gene1 %in% lost_q | Gene2 %in% lost_q | Gene3 %in% lost_q, "disrupted", "intact"),
        state_p = dplyr::if_else(Gene1 %in% lost_p | Gene2 %in% lost_p | Gene3 %in% lost_p, "disrupted", "intact")
      )
  }
}

# d30 ASAH1 trimer states
asah1_d30_trimer_list <- list()
for (nt in neurons_tc) {
  prot <- extract_prot_stats(complete_data_annotated_day30, "ASAH1", nt)
  if (is.null(prot) || nrow(prot) == 0) next
  ts <- compute_tc_trimer_states(prot, trimer_templates, drop_thresh_tc, sig_thresh_tc) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = "ASAH1", neuron = nt, day = "d30")
  asah1_d30_trimer_list[[nt]] <- ts
}
asah1_d30_trimer_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(asah1_d30_trimer_list)

# d50 from trimer_ko_states
asah1_d50_trimer_states <- trimer_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == "ASAH1") %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, genotype, neuron, state_q, state_p) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(trimer_templates %>% dplyr::select(trimer_id, majority_org), by = "trimer_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(day = "d50")

# d70 from diff132_d70_df_annotated
asah1_d70_trimer_list <- list()
for (nt in neurons_tc) {
  log2fc_col <- paste0("d70_", nt, "_log2fc_ASAH1")
  q_col      <- paste0("d70_", nt, "_neg_log10_q_value")
  p_col      <- paste0("d70_", nt, "_neg_log10_p_value")
  prot <- diff132_d70_df_annotated %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC = dplyr::all_of(log2fc_col), neg_log10_q = dplyr::all_of(q_col), neg_log10_p = dplyr::all_of(p_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "", !is.na(log2FC)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = "ASAH1", neuron = nt)
  ts <- compute_tc_trimer_states(prot, trimer_templates, drop_thresh_tc, sig_thresh_tc) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = "ASAH1", neuron = nt, day = "d70")
  asah1_d70_trimer_list[[nt]] <- ts
}
asah1_d70_trimer_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(asah1_d70_trimer_list)

tc_asah1_trimer_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(asah1_d30_trimer_states, asah1_d50_trimer_states, asah1_d70_trimer_states) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70")))

readr::write_csv(tc_asah1_trimer_states %>% dplyr::select(-Gene1, -Gene2, -Gene3),
  file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "tables", "tc_asah1_trimer_states.csv"))
message("  ASAH1 trimer states: ", nrow(tc_asah1_trimer_states))

for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig)
  by_org <- tc_asah1_trimer_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[state_col]] == "disrupted", majority_org != "Mixed") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(day, neuron, majority_org) %>%
```
