```{r module16_timecourse_asah1}
    dplyr::mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70")))
  readr::write_csv(by_org, file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "tables", paste0("tc_asah1_trimer_by_org_", sig, ".csv")))
  for (nt in neurons_tc) {
    hm_data <- by_org %>%
      dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = day, values_from = n_disrupted, values_fill = 0)
    if (nrow(hm_data) < 2) next
    hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, setdiff(colnames(hm_data), c("neuron", "majority_org"))])
    rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$majority_org
    if (diff(range(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE)) == 0) next
    readr::write_csv(tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(hm_mat), "majority_org"),
      file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_trimer_org_", sig, "_", nt, ".csv")))
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots", paste0("heatmap_trimer_org_", sig, "_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 5, height = 8)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat, 
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2166AC"))(100), 
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = FALSE, 
      fontsize = 6, 
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA, 
      main = paste0("ASAH1 disrupted trimers by organelle (", sig, "-sig) - ", nt))
    dev.off()
  }
}


# =============================================================================
# 16.11  Complex annotation heatmaps (d30 / d50 / d70)
# =============================================================================
if (!exists("complex_edge_map")) {
  complex_edge_map <- complex_members_parsed %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle, members_list) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>% dplyr::filter(length(members_list) >= 2) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pairs = list(combn(members_list, 2, simplify = FALSE))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% tidyr::unnest(pairs) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Gene1 = purrr::map_chr(pairs, 1), Gene2 = purrr::map_chr(pairs, 2)) %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle, Gene1, Gene2) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(baseline_filtered %>% dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2), by = c("Gene1", "Gene2")) %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle, key)
}

for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col    <- paste0("state_", sig)
  dn_combos    <- tc_asah1_edge_states %>% dplyr::distinct(day, neuron)

  cx_states_a1 <- complex_edge_map %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, key) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(dn_combos) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tc_asah1_edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key, day, neuron, dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = c("key", "day", "neuron")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(edge_lost = tidyr::replace_na(.data[[state_col]], "retained") == "lost")

  cx_summary_a1 <- cx_states_a1 %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_edges_total = dplyr::n(), n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost), frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total, .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(complex_members_parsed %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, shared_organelle) %>% dplyr::distinct(), by = "complex_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(complex_state = dplyr::case_when(frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact"),
                  day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70")))

  disrupted_by_org_a1 <- cx_summary_a1 %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_state == "disrupted", !is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(org_list = stringr::str_split(shared_organelle, ";\\s*")) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(org_list) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(day, neuron, org_list) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_disrupted = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  readr::write_csv(disrupted_by_org_a1, file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "tables", paste0("tc_asah1_complex_by_org_", sig, ".csv")))

  for (nt in neurons_tc) {
    hm_data <- disrupted_by_org_a1 %>%
      dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = day, values_from = n_disrupted, values_fill = 0)
    if (nrow(hm_data) < 2) next
    hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, setdiff(colnames(hm_data), c("neuron", "org_list"))])
    rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$org_list
    if (diff(range(hm_mat, na.rm = TRUE)) == 0) next
    readr::write_csv(tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(hm_mat), "organelle"),
      file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_complex_org_", sig, "_", nt, ".csv")))
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots", paste0("heatmap_complex_org_", sig, "_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 5, height = 8)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      hm_mat, 
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#762A83"))(100), 
      cluster_rows = TRUE, 
      cluster_cols = FALSE, 
      fontsize = 6, 
      cellwidth = 10, 
      cellheight = 10, 
      border_color = NA, 
      main = paste0("ASAH1 disrupted complexes by organelle (", sig, "-sig) - ", nt))
    dev.off()
  }
}


# =============================================================================
# 16.12  Mito-associated complexes bubble plot
# =============================================================================
mito_sub_tags_asah1 <- c("MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI", "mtCI_AF")

mito_complex_ids <- complex_members_parsed %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(org_list = stringr::str_split(shared_organelle, ";\\s*")) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(org_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(org_list %in% mito_sub_tags_asah1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()

message("  Mito-associated complexes: ", length(mito_complex_ids))

complex_edge_map_mito <- complex_edge_map %>% dplyr::filter(complex_id %in% mito_complex_ids)

# Primary mito sub-tag per complex (first mito tag found)
mito_cx_tag_map <- complex_members_parsed %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_id %in% mito_complex_ids, !is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(org_list = stringr::str_split(shared_organelle, ";\\s*")) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(org_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(org_list %in% mito_sub_tags_asah1) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, mito_tag = org_list)

for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig)
  dn_combos <- tc_asah1_edge_states %>% dplyr::distinct(day, neuron)

  mito_cx_states <- complex_edge_map_mito %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, key) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(dn_combos) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tc_asah1_edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key, day, neuron, dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = c("key", "day", "neuron")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(edge_lost = tidyr::replace_na(.data[[state_col]], "retained") == "lost")

  mito_cx_summary <- mito_cx_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_edges_total = dplyr::n(), n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost), frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total, .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(complex_members_parsed %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle) %>% dplyr::distinct(), by = "complex_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(complex_state = dplyr::case_when(frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact"),
                  day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70")))

  bubble_mito <- mito_cx_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, day, neuron, frac_edges_lost, complex_size, shared_organelle) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = neuron, values_from = frac_edges_lost, values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(mito_cx_tag_map, by = "complex_id")

  readr::write_csv(bubble_mito, file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "sourcedata", paste0("bubble_mito_complexes_", sig, ".csv")))

  # Trajectory plot: all days, fill = day
  p_traj <- ggplot2::ggplot(bubble_mito, ggplot2::aes(x = iN, y = iDA, size = complex_size, fill = day)) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.25, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = complex_id), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = day_palette_long, name = "Day") +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Complex size") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("ASAH1 mito complex disruption trajectory (", sig, "-sig)"), x = "Frac lost edges (iN)", y = "Frac lost edges (iDA)") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1)
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots", paste0("bubble_mito_trajectory_", sig, ".pdf")), p_traj, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

  # Per-day bubbles: fill = mito sub-tag
  for (d in c("d30", "d50", "d70")) {
    plot_data <- bubble_mito %>% dplyr::filter(day == d)
    if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) next
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = iN, y = iDA, size = complex_size, fill = mito_tag)) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.25, alpha = 0.9) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(ggplot2::aes(label = complex_id), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors, name = "Mito subcompartment", na.value = "grey80") +
      ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Complex size") +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("ASAH1 mito complexes ", d, " (", sig, "-sig)"), x = "Frac lost edges (iN)", y = "Frac lost edges (iDA)") +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1)
    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots", paste0("bubble_mito_", d, "_", sig, ".pdf")), p, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}




# =============================================================================
# 16.13  Complex network plots (per-day + trajectory)
# =============================================================================

# Edge-level states per complex -- basis for all downstream summaries
complex_a1_states <- complex_edge_map %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, key) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(tc_asah1_edge_states, by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, key, Gene1, Gene2, day, neuron, state_q, state_p)

readr::write_csv(complex_a1_states, file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "tables", "complex_a1_states.csv"))

# Summarise to complex level: frac lost edges and disruption state per sig
# disrupted >= 0.75, partial >= 0.25, intact otherwise
complex_a1_summary <- complex_a1_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id, day, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges_total = dplyr::n(),
    n_lost_q      = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p      = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost_q   = n_lost_q / n_edges_total,
    frac_lost_p   = n_lost_p / n_edges_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_members_parsed %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_size, shared_organelle) %>% dplyr::distinct(), by = "complex_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    complex_state_q = dplyr::case_when(frac_lost_q >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_lost_q >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact"),
    complex_state_p = dplyr::case_when(frac_lost_p >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted", frac_lost_p >= 0.25 ~ "partial", TRUE ~ "intact")
  )

readr::write_csv(complex_a1_summary, file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "tables", "complex_a1_summary.csv"))

message("  Disrupted complexes: q=", sum(complex_a1_summary$complex_state_q == "disrupted"),
        "  p=", sum(complex_a1_summary$complex_state_p == "disrupted"))

# Precompute baseline layouts for union of all disrupted complexes
# Using baseline_filtered so layout is comparable across conditions
a1_cx_layouts <- if (exists("tc_cx_layouts")) tc_cx_layouts else list()
cx_union <- union(
  complex_a1_summary %>% dplyr::filter(complex_state_q == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique(),
  complex_a1_summary %>% dplyr::filter(complex_state_p == "disrupted") %>% dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()
)
for (cx_idx in cx_union[!cx_union %in% names(a1_cx_layouts)]) {
  cx_keys  <- complex_edge_map %>% dplyr::filter(complex_id == cx_idx) %>% dplyr::pull(key)
  cx_edges <- baseline_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(key %in% cx_keys) %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2)
  if (nrow(cx_edges) == 0) next
  g_base <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(cx_edges, directed = FALSE)
  a1_cx_layouts[[cx_idx]] <- igraph::layout_with_fr(g_base, niter = 500)
  attr(a1_cx_layouts[[cx_idx]], "node_names") <- igraph::V(g_base)$name
}

a1_traj_palette_3d <- c(
  retained      = "grey80",
  lost_d30_only = "#FFFFB2",
  lost_d50_only = "#FEB24C",
  lost_d70_only = "#F03B20",
  lost_d30_d50  = "#FED976",
  lost_d30_d70  = "#FC4E2A",
  lost_d50_d70  = "#E31A1C",
  lost_all      = "#800026"
)

# Output folders: separate by significance threshold
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots/networks/qsig"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
net_dir_q <- file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots/networks/qsig")

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots/networks/psig"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
net_dir_p <- file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "plots/networks/psig")

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "sourcedata/qsig"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sd_dir_q <- file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "sourcedata/qsig")

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "sourcedata/psig"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sd_dir_p <- file.path(out_dir_tc_asah1, "sourcedata/psig")

# Trajectory plot: edges colored by d30/d50/d70 loss category across all timepoints
# Only run for complexes disrupted at d50 to ensure temporal context
plot_a1_cx_trajectory_3d <- function(cx_idx, neur, edge_states, layout_list, out_dir_plots, out_dir_sd, sig = "q") {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig)
  cx_keys   <- complex_edge_map %>% dplyr::filter(complex_id == cx_idx) %>% dplyr::pull(key)
  traj_data <- baseline_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(key %in% cx_keys) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(edge_states %>% dplyr::filter(day == "d30", neuron == neur) %>% dplyr::select(key, state_d30 = dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(edge_states %>% dplyr::filter(day == "d50", neuron == neur) %>% dplyr::select(key, state_d50 = dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(edge_states %>% dplyr::filter(day == "d70", neuron == neur) %>% dplyr::select(key, state_d70 = dplyr::all_of(state_col)), by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state_d30 = tidyr::replace_na(state_d30, "retained"),
      state_d50 = tidyr::replace_na(state_d50, "retained"),
      state_d70 = tidyr::replace_na(state_d70, "retained"),
      lost30 = state_d30 == "lost", lost50 = state_d50 == "lost", lost70 = state_d70 == "lost",
      traj_cat = dplyr::case_when(
        lost30 & lost50 & lost70  ~ "lost_all",
        lost30 & lost50 & !lost70 ~ "lost_d30_d50",
        lost30 & !lost50 & lost70 ~ "lost_d30_d70",
        !lost30 & lost50 & lost70 ~ "lost_d50_d70",
        lost30 & !lost50 & !lost70 ~ "lost_d30_only",
        !lost30 & lost50 & !lost70 ~ "lost_d50_only",
        !lost30 & !lost50 & lost70 ~ "lost_d70_only",
        TRUE                       ~ "retained"
      ),
      edge_color = a1_traj_palette_3d[traj_cat]
    )
  cx_label <- paste0(substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", cx_idx), 1, 40), "_", abs(sum(utf8ToInt(cx_idx))) %% 9999)
  readr::write_csv(
    traj_data %>% dplyr::mutate(complex_id = cx_idx, neuron = neur),
    file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0(cx_label, "_ASAH1_", neur, "_trajectory_", sig, "_sourcedata.csv"))
  )
  if (nrow(traj_data) == 0 || !cx_idx %in% names(layout_list)) return(invisible(NULL))
  lay   <- layout_list[[cx_idx]]
  nodes <- attr(lay, "node_names")
  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(traj_data %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2), directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = nodes))
  igraph::E(g)$color <- traj_data$edge_color
  present_cats <- unique(traj_data$traj_cat)
  n_any_lost   <- sum(traj_data$traj_cat != "retained")
  pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, paste0(cx_label, "_ASAH1_", neur, "_trajectory_", sig, ".pdf")), width = 4, height = 4)
  plot(g, layout = lay, vertex.size = 8, vertex.label.cex = 0.5, vertex.color = "white", vertex.frame.color = "grey40",
       edge.color = igraph::E(g)$color, edge.width = 1.5,
       main = paste0(cx_idx, "\nASAH1 ", neur, " traj (", sig, ")\nlost: ", n_any_lost, " edges"))
  legend("bottomleft", legend = present_cats, col = a1_traj_palette_3d[present_cats], lwd = 2, cex = 0.45, bty = "n")
  dev.off()
}

# Execute: trajectory only for (complex_id, neuron) where d50 is disrupted
for (sig in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("complex_state_", sig)
  net_dir   <- if (sig == "q") net_dir_q else net_dir_p
  sd_dir    <- if (sig == "q") sd_dir_q  else sd_dir_p

  disrupted_combos <- complex_a1_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[state_col]] == "disrupted") %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, day, neuron)

  # Trajectory: only for (complex_id, neuron) where d50 is disrupted
  traj_combos <- disrupted_combos %>%
    dplyr::filter(day == "d50") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(complex_id, neuron)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(traj_combos))) {
    plot_a1_cx_trajectory_3d(traj_combos$complex_id[i], as.character(traj_combos$neuron[i]),
                              tc_asah1_edge_states, a1_cx_layouts,
                              net_dir, sd_dir, sig = sig)
  }
}

message("  16.13 complex network plots done")

message("Module 16 complete: ASAH1 long timecourse (PPIs + trimers + complexes + mito bubbles)")
```

# =================================================
# Module 12: PPI Vulnerability Analysis - HeLa nMOST
# =================================================

PPI vulnerability pipeline in HeLa whole-cell proteomic data
DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.adu5787

Goal: Build a PPI vulnerability landscape for HeLa cells across LSD KOs.
Integrates batch-normalized whole-cell proteomics with predicted and
experimentally validated interaction data to quantify network destabilization
and organelle-specific vulnerabilities.

Data Sources
1. nMOST whole-cell proteomics (HeLa, 39 LSD KOs + Control)
2. PPI databases: Predictome80, Predictomes16k, IntAct
3. Complex databases: CORUM, ComplexPortal
4. MiSeq genotyping: KO validation and allele status




# Module 0: HeLa Data Loading, Preprocessing and QC
Loads raw LFQ quantifications, applies batch-matched log2FC normalization,
and filters KOs to those with confirmed target protein knockdown (log2FC < -2).
Output: hela_log2fc_wide_qc -- proteins x passing KOs, ready for PPI pipeline.

```{r hela_m0_load}
message("Loading phenotype data...")
hela_pheno_raw <- read.csv(path_hela_pheno)
message("  Samples: ", nrow(hela_pheno_raw))

message("Loading MiSeq KO validation...")
hela_miseq <- read.csv(path_hela_miseq, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
message("  MiSeq-validated KOs: ", nrow(hela_miseq))
message("  KO types: ", paste(sort(unique(hela_miseq$Knockout.type)), collapse = ", "))
```

## Chunk 2: Sample Filtering and Column Matching
```{r hela_m0_filter}
# =============================================================================
# Filter Samples: Exclude QC Runs, Restrict to MiSeq-Validated KOs + Controls
# =============================================================================

# --- Clean gene names in quant: first gene before semicolon ---
hela_quant_clean <- hela_quant_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Genes = sapply(strsplit(Gene.names, ";"), `[`, 1)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "")

message("Proteins after gene name cleaning: ", nrow(hela_quant_clean))

# --- MiSeq-validated gene names ---
miseq_genes <- hela_miseq$Gene
message("MiSeq-validated KO genes (n=", length(miseq_genes), "): ", paste(sort(miseq_genes), collapse = ", "))

# --- Filter pheno: remove QC runs, keep controls and MiSeq-validated KOs only ---
# genotype format: "ASAH1 KO", "HeLa Control"
hela_pheno_filtered <- hela_pheno_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(!InstQC, !ExtrQC) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_control = genotype == "HeLa Control",
    ko_gene    = dplyr::if_else(is_control, NA_character_, gsub(" KO$", "", genotype))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is_control | ko_gene %in% miseq_genes)

message("Samples after filtering:")
message("  Control samples : ", sum(hela_pheno_filtered$is_control))
message("  KO samples      : ", sum(!hela_pheno_filtered$is_control))
message("  KO genotypes    : ", length(unique(na.omit(hela_pheno_filtered$ko_gene))))

# --- Match sample IDs to quant columns ---
# Take all WC#### columns from quant; pheno join downstream handles filtering
# ExtrQC / InstQC columns are excluded by the WC prefix filter
quant_sample_cols <- grep("^LFQ\\.intensity\\.\\d+_", colnames(hela_quant_clean), value = TRUE)
quant_sample_ids  <- sub("^LFQ\\.intensity\\.\\d+_", "", quant_sample_cols)

valid_quant_cols <- quant_sample_cols[grepl("^WC", quant_sample_ids)]
valid_sample_ids <- sub("^LFQ\\.intensity\\.\\d+_", "", valid_quant_cols)

missing_in_quant <- hela_pheno_filtered$sample[!hela_pheno_filtered$sample %in% valid_sample_ids]
if (length(missing_in_quant) > 0) message("WARNING: ", length(missing_in_quant), " pheno samples not in quant: ", paste(missing_in_quant, collapse = ", "))

hela_quant_filtered <- hela_quant_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(valid_quant_cols))

message("WC samples in quant  : ", length(valid_quant_cols))
message("Proteins in quant    : ", nrow(hela_quant_filtered))
```

## Chunk 3: Batch-Matched log2FC Computation
```{r hela_m0_log2fc}
# =============================================================================
# log2 Transform and Batch-Matched log2FC Normalization
# =============================================================================

# --- Pivot to long, join pheno ---
hela_long <- hela_quant_filtered %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(valid_quant_cols), names_to = "col_id", values_to = "intensity") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = sub("^LFQ\\.intensity\\.\\d+_", "", col_id)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    hela_pheno_filtered %>% dplyr::select(sample, batch, genotype, is_control, ko_gene),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(log2_intensity = dplyr::if_else(intensity > 0, log2(intensity), NA_real_))

# --- Batch control means per protein ---
hela_ctrl_means <- hela_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(is_control) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes, batch) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ctrl_valid   = sum(!is.na(log2_intensity)),
    ctrl_mean_log2 = dplyr::if_else(
      sum(!is.na(log2_intensity)) >= min_valid_controls,
      mean(log2_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    ctrl_sd_log2   = sd(log2_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- log2FC: KO sample - batch control mean ---
hela_log2fc_long <- hela_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is_control) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    hela_ctrl_means %>% dplyr::select(Genes, batch, ctrl_mean_log2),
    by = c("Genes", "batch")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(log2FC = log2_intensity - ctrl_mean_log2)

# --- Summarise: mean log2FC per protein per KO ---
hela_log2fc_summary <- hela_log2fc_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes, ko_gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_replicates = sum(!is.na(log2FC)),
    mean_log2FC  = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_log2FC    = sd(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Wide format: proteins x KOs ---
hela_log2fc_wide <- hela_log2fc_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, mean_log2FC) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ko_gene, values_from = mean_log2FC)

message("log2FC matrix: ", nrow(hela_log2fc_wide), " proteins x ", ncol(hela_log2fc_wide) - 1, " KOs")

readr::write_csv(hela_log2fc_wide,    file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "tables", "hela_log2fc_wide.csv"))
readr::write_csv(hela_log2fc_summary, file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "tables", "hela_log2fc_long.csv"))
message("Chunk 3 complete: log2FC matrix saved")
```

## Chunk 4: KO Target Protein QC Filter
```{r hela_m0_ko_qc}
# Module 0 - KO QC
# Passes if: (a) mean log2FC < -2, OR (b) protein undetected in KO but present
# in controls (depleted below detection). Fails if log2FC >= -2 or undetected
# in both KO and control. Handles HeLa polyploidy: allele status not used for
# filtering -- quantitative depletion is the sole criterion.

ko_genes_all <- unique(na.omit(hela_pheno_filtered$ko_gene))

# --- Control detection: is the target protein reliably detected in controls? ---
# A protein is ctrl-detected if it has a valid ctrl_mean_log2 in at least one batch
ctrl_detected_genes <- hela_ctrl_means %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ctrl_mean_log2)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Genes) %>%
  unique()

# --- For each KO, assess target protein depletion ---
ko_target_qc <- purrr::map_dfr(ko_genes_all, function(ko) {
  target_rows  <- hela_log2fc_summary %>% dplyr::filter(ko_gene == ko, Genes == ko)
  target_fc    <- target_rows$mean_log2FC
  has_log2fc   <- length(target_fc) > 0 && !is.na(target_fc[1]) && is.finite(target_fc[1])
  in_ctrl      <- ko %in% ctrl_detected_genes

  qc_reason <- dplyr::case_when(
    has_log2fc && target_fc[1] < ko_knockdown_thresh ~ "passed_log2fc",
    !has_log2fc && in_ctrl                           ~ "passed_depleted_below_detection",
    has_log2fc && target_fc[1] >= ko_knockdown_thresh ~ "failed_threshold",
    !has_log2fc && !in_ctrl                          ~ "failed_not_detected",
    TRUE                                             ~ "failed_not_detected"
  )

  dplyr::tibble(
    ko_gene          = ko,
    target_log2FC    = dplyr::if_else(has_log2fc, target_fc[1], NA_real_),
    ctrl_detected    = in_ctrl,
    passes_qc        = qc_reason %in% c("passed_log2fc", "passed_depleted_below_detection"),
    qc_reason        = qc_reason,
    allele_status    = hela_miseq$Knockout.type[match(ko, hela_miseq$Gene)]
  )
})

message("KO target protein QC (threshold: log2FC < ", ko_knockdown_thresh, "):")
message("  KOs tested                       : ", nrow(ko_target_qc))
message("  Passed (log2FC < -2)             : ", sum(ko_target_qc$qc_reason == "passed_log2fc"))
message("  Passed (depleted below detection): ", sum(ko_target_qc$qc_reason == "passed_depleted_below_detection"))
message("  Failed (threshold not met)       : ", sum(ko_target_qc$qc_reason == "failed_threshold"))
message("  Failed (not detected anywhere)   : ", sum(ko_target_qc$qc_reason == "failed_not_detected"))

ko_fail <- ko_target_qc %>% dplyr::filter(!passes_qc)
if (nrow(ko_fail) > 0) { message("Failing KOs:"); print(ko_fail) }

ko_genes_pass <- ko_target_qc %>% dplyr::filter(passes_qc) %>% dplyr::pull(ko_gene)

# --- Check for KOs that passed QC but have no column in wide matrix ---
# Happens when KO samples were absent from quant file (missing_in_quant)
ko_cols_available <- intersect(ko_genes_pass, colnames(hela_log2fc_wide))
ko_cols_missing   <- setdiff(ko_genes_pass, colnames(hela_log2fc_wide))
if (length(ko_cols_missing) > 0) {
  message("WARNING: ", length(ko_cols_missing), " KOs passed QC but have no quant data -- excluded:")
  message("  ", paste(ko_cols_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# --- Filter log2FC matrices to passing KOs with available data ---
hela_log2fc_wide_qc    <- hela_log2fc_wide %>% dplyr::select(Genes, any_of(ko_genes_pass))
hela_log2fc_summary_qc <- hela_log2fc_summary %>% dplyr::filter(ko_gene %in% ko_cols_available)

readr::write_csv(ko_target_qc,        file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "tables", "ko_target_qc.csv"))
readr::write_csv(hela_log2fc_wide_qc, file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "tables", "hela_log2fc_wide_qc.csv"))
message("Chunk 4 complete: ", length(ko_genes_pass), " KOs retained after QC")
```

```{r hela_m0_qc_plots}
# --- Plot 3a: Pairwise replicate correlation distribution per batch ---
# Extract replicate number from genotype_rep (e.g. "NPC2 KO-3" -> 3)
hela_long_rep <- hela_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hela_pheno_filtered %>% dplyr::select(sample, genotype_rep), by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(genotype_rep, "\\d+$")))

rep_corr_wide <- hela_long_rep %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(log2_intensity), !is.na(replicate)) %>%

rep_cols <- grep("^rep\\d+$", colnames(rep_corr_wide), value = TRUE)

# All pairwise correlations per batch x genotype (upper triangle only)
rep_corr_long <- rep_corr_wide %>%
  dplyr::group_by(batch, genotype) %>%

    dplyr::tibble(pair = paste0(colnames(cor_mat)[idx[,1]], "_", colnames(cor_mat)[idx[,2]]), correlation = cor_mat[idx])
  }) %>%
```

## Chunk 6: Per-Protein Significance Testing (limma, KO vs pooled batch-corrected null)
```{r hela_m0_stats}
# =============================================================================
# Statistical significance of KO-induced protein changes
# =============================================================================
#
# DESIGN RATIONALE:
#   Both KO and control replicates are expressed as log2FC relative to their
#   own batch control mean (batch effects removed). Control residual log2FCs
#   (ctrl_rep - batch_ctrl_mean) form the empirical null capturing biological
#   + technical variability expected under no perturbation. Pooling all ~60
#   control residuals across all batches gives a stable null variance estimate.
#
#   Single limma model: ~ 0 + genotype, one contrast per KO (KO - ctrl).
#   eBayes shrinks per-protein variance toward a global prior estimated from
#   all proteins x all samples. BH-FDR applied across all protein x KO tests.
#
# SIGNIFICANCE: q < 0.05 AND |log2FC| >= 1 (both required).
# =============================================================================

# BiocManager::install("limma")
library(limma)
message("Building log2FC matrix (KO replicates + pooled control residuals)...")

# --- Step 1: control residual log2FCs (ctrl_rep - batch_ctrl_mean) ---
hela_ctrl_residuals <- hela_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(is_control, !is.na(log2_intensity)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hela_ctrl_means %>% dplyr::select(Genes, batch, ctrl_mean_log2), by = c("Genes", "batch")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(log2FC = log2_intensity - ctrl_mean_log2) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(log2FC)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, sample, log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = "ctrl")

# --- Step 2: combine KO log2FCs + control residuals ---
ko_fc_long <- hela_log2fc_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(ko_gene %in% ko_genes_pass, !is.na(log2FC)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, sample, group = ko_gene, log2FC)

all_fc_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(ko_fc_long, hela_ctrl_residuals)

# --- Step 3: protein x sample matrix (collapse duplicate gene names by mean) ---
mat_fc <- all_fc_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes, sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = log2FC) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Genes") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Sample metadata aligned to matrix column order
sample_meta  <- dplyr::distinct(all_fc_long, sample, group)
sample_group <- tibble::tibble(sample = colnames(mat_fc)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta, by = "sample")

message("  Matrix dimensions: ", nrow(mat_fc), " proteins x ", ncol(mat_fc), " samples")
message("  Control samples  : ", sum(sample_group$group == "ctrl"))
message("  KO samples       : ", sum(sample_group$group != "ctrl"))

# --- Step 4: filter proteins -- require >= 2 valid ctrl values ---
n_ctrl_valid <- rowSums(!is.na(mat_fc[, sample_group$group == "ctrl", drop = FALSE]))
mat_fc <- mat_fc[n_ctrl_valid >= 2, , drop = FALSE]
message("  Proteins after filter: ", nrow(mat_fc))

# --- Step 5: impute residual NAs with per-row half-minimum ---
row_halfmin <- apply(mat_fc, 1, function(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE) / 2)
for (j in seq_len(nrow(mat_fc))) {
  mat_fc[j, is.na(mat_fc[j, ])] <- row_halfmin[j]
}

# --- Step 6: design matrix (treatment coding, no intercept) ---
# make.names() handles gene names with special characters
safe_levels <- make.names(c("ctrl", ko_genes_pass))
group_safe  <- make.names(sample_group$group)
group_vec   <- factor(group_safe, levels = safe_levels)
design_mat  <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group_vec)
colnames(design_mat) <- safe_levels

# --- Step 7: contrasts -- each KO vs ctrl ---
contrast_strings <- paste0(make.names(ko_genes_pass), " - ctrl")
contrast_mat     <- limma::makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_strings, levels = design_mat)
colnames(contrast_mat) <- ko_genes_pass

# --- Step 8: fit ---
fit  <- limma::lmFit(mat_fc, design_mat)
fit2 <- limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_mat)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2)

# --- Step 9: extract results per KO ---
stat_results_limma <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(ko_genes_pass), function(i) {
  limma::topTable(fit2, coef = i, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Genes") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Genes, ko_gene = ko_genes_pass[i], pval = P.Value)
})

# --- Step 10: BH-FDR across all tests ---
stat_results_limma <- stat_results_limma %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    qval       = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
    neglog10_p = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(pval), -log10(pval), NA_real_),
    neglog10_q = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(qval), -log10(qval), NA_real_)
  )

message("  Tests run             : ", nrow(stat_results_limma))
message("  Significant (q < 0.05): ", sum(!is.na(stat_results_limma$qval) & stat_results_limma$qval < 0.05))

# --- Step 11: merge into summary table + significance flags ---
# Flags defined once here; downstream modules use them directly without recomputing
hela_log2fc_summary_stats <- hela_log2fc_summary_qc %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stat_results_limma %>% dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, pval, qval, neglog10_p, neglog10_q),
    by = c("Genes", "ko_gene")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_sig_p    = !is.na(pval)  & pval  < 0.01,
    is_sig_q    = !is.na(qval)  & qval  < 0.01,
    is_lost_p   = is_sig_p & !is.na(mean_log2FC) & mean_log2FC < -1.3,
    is_lost_q   = is_sig_q & !is.na(mean_log2FC) & mean_log2FC < -1.3,
    is_gained_p = is_sig_p & !is.na(mean_log2FC) & mean_log2FC >  1.3,
    is_gained_q = is_sig_q & !is.na(mean_log2FC) & mean_log2FC >  1.3
  )

readr::write_csv(hela_log2fc_summary_stats,
                 file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "tables", "hela_log2fc_summary_stats.csv"))

# --- Wide matrices for vulnerability module ---
hela_neglog10p_wide <- hela_log2fc_summary_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, neglog10_p) %>%

hela_neglog10q_wide <- hela_log2fc_summary_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, neglog10_q) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ko_gene, values_from = neglog10_q)

readr::write_csv(hela_neglog10p_wide, file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "tables", "hela_neglog10p_wide.csv"))
readr::write_csv(hela_neglog10q_wide, file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "tables", "hela_neglog10q_wide.csv"))

# --- QC: p-value histogram ---
pval_hist_data <- stat_results_limma %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(pval))
readr::write_csv(pval_hist_data, file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "qc", "sourcedata_pval_histogram.csv"))

p_pval_hist <- ggplot(pval_hist_data, aes(x = pval)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "p-value distribution (limma, KO vs pooled ctrl null)",
       x = "p-value", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "qc", "pval_histogram.pdf"), p_pval_hist, width = 3, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)

# --- QC: stacked barplot -- significant up/unchanged/down per KO ---
# Significance: p or q < 0.05 AND |mean_log2FC| >= 1
classify_direction <- function(df, sig_col, thresh = 0.05, lfc_thresh = 1) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(mean_log2FC), !is.na(.data[[sig_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        .data[[sig_col]] < thresh & mean_log2FC <= -lfc_thresh ~ "reduced",
        .data[[sig_col]] < thresh & mean_log2FC >=  lfc_thresh ~ "increased",
        TRUE                                                    ~ "unchanged"
      ),
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("increased", "unchanged", "reduced"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(ko_gene, direction)
}

bar_colors <- c("increased" = "#C0392B", "unchanged" = "grey75", "reduced" = "#2980B9")

make_dir_barplot <- function(count_df, title_str) {
  ko_order_bar <- count_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(direction == "reduced") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(ko_gene)
  count_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ko_gene = factor(ko_gene, levels = ko_order_bar)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = ko_gene, y = n, fill = direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = bar_colors) +
    labs(title = title_str, x = NULL, y = "Proteins", fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(), 
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1), 
      legend.position = "bottom")
}

counts_p <- classify_direction(hela_log2fc_summary_stats, sig_col = "pval", thresh = 0.05, lfc_thresh = 1)
counts_q <- classify_direction(hela_log2fc_summary_stats, sig_col = "qval", thresh = 0.05, lfc_thresh = 1)

p_dir_p <- make_dir_barplot(counts_p, "Protein direction by KO (p < 0.05, |log2FC| >= 1.3)")
p_dir_q <- make_dir_barplot(counts_q, "Protein direction by KO (q < 0.05, |log2FC| >= 1.3)")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "qc", "barplot_protein_direction_p.pdf"), p_dir_p, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "qc", "barplot_protein_direction_q.pdf"), p_dir_q, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

readr::write_csv(counts_p, file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "qc", "sourcedata_protein_direction_p.csv"))
readr::write_csv(counts_q, file.path(out_dir_hela_preproc, "qc", "sourcedata_protein_direction_q.csv"))

# --- Summary table ---
summary_dir <- counts_q %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total       = increased + unchanged + reduced,
                pct_changed = round(100 * (increased + reduced) / total, 1)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(reduced))
print(summary_dir, n = Inf)

message("Chunk 6 complete")
message("  Output: hela_log2fc_summary_stats, hela_neglog10p_wide, hela_neglog10q_wide")
```



# Module 2: Baseline PPI Network
## Chunk 1: Tier1 filtering to HeLa Control proteome
Union of proteins detected in any Control sample across all 15 batches
Requires: master_ppi_v3 (from Module 11), hela_long (from Module 0)

```{r hela_m2_baseline_filter}

# --- HeLa control proteome: union across all batches ---
hela_ctrl_genes <- hela_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == "HeLa Control", !is.na(log2_intensity)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Genes) %>% unique()

message("HeLa control proteome (union, all batches): ", length(hela_ctrl_genes), " proteins")

# --- Tier1 filter on master_ppi_v3 ---
master_ppi_tier_hela <- master_ppi_v3 %>% dplyr::filter(confidence_tier == "Tier1")
message("Tier1 edges total: ", nrow(master_ppi_tier_hela))

# --- Proteome overlap stats ---
n_pre      <- nrow(master_ppi_tier_hela)
n_gene1_in <- sum(master_ppi_tier_hela$Gene1 %in% hela_ctrl_genes)
n_gene2_in <- sum(master_ppi_tier_hela$Gene2 %in% hela_ctrl_genes)
n_both_in  <- sum(master_ppi_tier_hela$Gene1 %in% hela_ctrl_genes & master_ppi_tier_hela$Gene2 %in% hela_ctrl_genes)

message("Proteome overlap (Tier1):")
message("  Gene1 in HeLa ctrl proteome: ", n_gene1_in, " (", round(100 * n_gene1_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")
message("  Gene2 in HeLa ctrl proteome: ", n_gene2_in, " (", round(100 * n_gene2_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")
message("  Both in HeLa ctrl proteome : ", n_both_in,  " (", round(100 * n_both_in  / n_pre, 1), "%)")

# --- Restrict to HeLa control proteome ---
baseline_ppi_hela <- master_ppi_tier_hela %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% hela_ctrl_genes & Gene2 %in% hela_ctrl_genes)

baseline_proteins_hela <- unique(c(baseline_ppi_hela$Gene1, baseline_ppi_hela$Gene2))

message("Baseline edges (Tier1 x HeLa ctrl proteome): ", nrow(baseline_ppi_hela))
message("Unique proteins in baseline                 : ", length(baseline_proteins_hela))
message("Proteome coverage                           : ",
        round(100 * length(baseline_proteins_hela) / length(hela_ctrl_genes), 1), "%")
```

## Chunk 2: Organelle annotations
Adds subcellular localization tags to baseline_ppi_hela (Gene1 and Gene2)
Computes shared-organelle edges
```{r hela_m2_organelle}
# --- Organelle annotations from binary_matrix ---
organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
gene_to_org    <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags))

message("Subcellular annotation tags: ", length(organelle_tags))

# --- Annotate Gene1 and Gene2 ---
baseline_ppi_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot1"), dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot2"), dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags))

n_gene1_annotated <- sum(!is.na(baseline_ppi_hela[[paste0(organelle_tags[1], "_prot1")]]))
n_gene2_annotated <- sum(!is.na(baseline_ppi_hela[[paste0(organelle_tags[1], "_prot2")]]))
message("  Gene1 with annotations: ", n_gene1_annotated, " / ", nrow(baseline_ppi_hela))
message("  Gene2 with annotations: ", n_gene2_annotated, " / ", nrow(baseline_ppi_hela))

# --- Shared organelle edges ---
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")
existing_org1_cols <- intersect(org1_cols, colnames(baseline_ppi_hela))
existing_org2_cols <- intersect(org2_cols, colnames(baseline_ppi_hela))

shared_long_hela <- {
  m1 <- baseline_ppi_hela[, existing_org1_cols, drop = FALSE] %>%
    lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% as.data.frame()
  m2 <- baseline_ppi_hela[, existing_org2_cols, drop = FALSE] %>%
    lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% as.data.frame()
  shared_mat    <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)
  existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1_cols)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
    idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
    if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(key = baseline_ppi_hela$key[i], tag = existing_tags[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

organelle_edge_counts_hela <- shared_long_hela %>%
  dplyr::count(tag, name = "n_edges") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_edges))

message("  Shared organelle edges: ", nrow(shared_long_hela))
print(head(organelle_edge_counts_hela, 15))


```

```{r hela_m2_qc}
# --- Score analysis by organelle ---
score_cols_hela    <- c("RFprob", "AFMprob", "SPOC_score", "ipTM_max")
existing_scores    <- intersect(score_cols_hela, colnames(baseline_ppi_hela))
message("Score columns available: ", paste(existing_scores, collapse = ", "))

organelle_colors_hela <- c(
  "Mito" = "#E41A1C", "MitoIMS" = "#FC8D62", "MitoMatrix" = "#8DA0CB",
  "MitoMIM" = "#E78AC3", "MitoMOM" = "#A6D854", "OXPHOS" = "#FFD92F",
  "mtComplexI" = "#E5C494", "mtCI_AF" = "#B3B3B3",
  "ER" = "#377EB8", "Golgi" = "#4DAF4A", "Lysosome" = "#984EA3",
  "EndoLyso" = "#FF7F00", "EarlyEndosome" = "#FFFF33", "RecyclingEndosome" = "#A65628",
  "Autophagy" = "#F781BF", "Autophagy_det" = "#999999",
  "Nucleus" = "#B3B3B3", "Cytoplasm" = "#1B9E77", "vATPase" = "#66C2A5"
)

if (length(existing_scores) > 0 && nrow(shared_long_hela) > 0) {

  min_edges_for_plot <- 50
  tags_to_keep_hela <- shared_long_hela %>%
    dplyr::count(tag) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n >= min_edges_for_plot) %>%
    dplyr::pull(tag)

  message("Organelles with >= ", min_edges_for_plot, " edges: ", length(tags_to_keep_hela))

  scores_org_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(key, dplyr::all_of(existing_scores)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_long_hela, by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), tag %in% tags_to_keep_hela)

  org_colors_filtered <- organelle_colors_hela[names(organelle_colors_hela) %in% tags_to_keep_hela]

  # --- Organelle score summary ---
  organelle_score_summary_hela <- scores_org_hela %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_edges    = dplyr::n(),
      mean_RFprob  = if ("RFprob"      %in% existing_scores) mean(RFprob,      na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      mean_AFMprob = if ("AFMprob"     %in% existing_scores) mean(AFMprob,     na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      mean_SPOC    = if ("SPOC_score"  %in% existing_scores) mean(SPOC_score,  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      mean_ipTM    = if ("ipTM_max"    %in% existing_scores) mean(ipTM_max,    na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  readr::write_csv(organelle_score_summary_hela, file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "tables", "organelle_score_summary.csv"))

  # --- Bubble plot: RFprob vs AFMprob ---
  if (all(c("RFprob", "AFMprob") %in% existing_scores)) {
    p_bubble_rf_afm_hela <- ggplot(organelle_score_summary_hela, aes(x = mean_AFMprob, y = mean_RFprob, size = n_edges, fill = tag)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.3) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors_filtered, guide = "none") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 12), name = "Edges") +
      labs(title = "HeLa baseline: mean RFprob vs AFMprob by organelle", x = "Mean AFMprob", y = "Mean RFprob") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            legend.position = "right", legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", "bubble_RFprob_vs_AFMprob_by_organelle.pdf"),
           p_bubble_rf_afm_hela, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  # --- Bubble plot: SPOC vs ipTM ---
  if (all(c("SPOC_score", "ipTM_max") %in% existing_scores)) {
    p_bubble_spoc_iptm_hela <- ggplot(organelle_score_summary_hela, aes(x = mean_ipTM, y = mean_SPOC, size = n_edges, fill = tag)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.3) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors_filtered, guide = "none") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 12), name = "Edges") +
      labs(title = "HeLa baseline: mean SPOC vs ipTM by organelle", x = "Mean ipTM_max", y = "Mean SPOC_score") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            legend.position = "right", legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", "bubble_SPOC_vs_ipTM_by_organelle.pdf"),
           p_bubble_spoc_iptm_hela, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  # --- Density and boxplots per score ---
  for (sc in existing_scores) {
    df_sc <- scores_org_hela %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!rlang::sym(sc)))
    if (nrow(df_sc) == 0) next

    readr::write_csv(df_sc %>% dplyr::select(key, tag, !!rlang::sym(sc)),
                     file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", paste0("sourcedata_density_", sc, ".csv")))

    p_dens <- ggplot(df_sc, aes(x = !!rlang::sym(sc), fill = tag)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors_filtered, name = "Organelle") +
      labs(title = paste("HeLa baseline:", sc, "by organelle"), x = sc, y = "Density") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"))
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", paste0("density_", sc, "_by_organelle.pdf")),
           p_dens, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

    bp_summary <- df_sc %>%
      dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), median = median(!!rlang::sym(sc), na.rm = TRUE),
                       q1 = quantile(!!rlang::sym(sc), 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                       q3 = quantile(!!rlang::sym(sc), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    readr::write_csv(bp_summary, file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", paste0("sourcedata_boxplot_", sc, ".csv")))

    tag_order_sc <- bp_summary %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(median)) %>% dplyr::pull(tag)
    df_sc$tag <- factor(df_sc$tag, levels = tag_order_sc)

    p_box <- ggplot(df_sc, aes(x = tag, y = !!rlang::sym(sc), fill = tag)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors_filtered, guide = "none") +
      labs(title = paste("HeLa baseline:", sc, "by organelle"), x = NULL, y = sc) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", paste0("boxplot_", sc, "_by_organelle.pdf")),
           p_box, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
  message("Score analysis by organelle complete")
} else {
  message("Skipping score analysis: no score columns or organelle annotations available")
}

message("Score analysis by organelle complete")


# --- Heatmap: organelle x database validation ---
if (nrow(shared_long_hela) > 0) {
  edge_db_flags_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(key, filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(has_PDB = filter_PDB != "none", has_CORUM = filter_CORUM == "present",
                  has_ComplexPortal = filter_ComplexPortal != "none",
                  has_STRING = filter_STRING == "present", has_BIOGRID = filter_BIOGRID == "present")

  org_db_combined_hela <- shared_long_hela %>% dplyr::left_join(edge_db_flags_hela, by = "key")

  org_db_matrix_hela <- org_db_combined_hela %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_total = dplyr::n(), PDB = sum(has_PDB), CORUM = sum(has_CORUM),
                     ComplexPortal = sum(has_ComplexPortal), STRING = sum(has_STRING),
                     BIOGRID = sum(has_BIOGRID), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_total >= 30)

  readr::write_csv(org_db_matrix_hela, file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "tables", "sourcedata_heatmap_organelle_database.csv"))

  if (nrow(org_db_matrix_hela) > 1) {
    mat_db <- org_db_matrix_hela %>%
      dplyr::select(tag, PDB, CORUM, ComplexPortal, STRING, BIOGRID) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("tag") %>% as.matrix()

    pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_db, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%d",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "steelblue"))(50),
      main = "HeLa baseline: organelle x database validation (counts)", fontsize = 6, fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA, cellheight = 12, cellwidth = 12, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_database_counts.pdf"),
      width = 5, height = max(4, nrow(mat_db) * 0.25))

    mat_db_pct <- sweep(mat_db, 1, org_db_matrix_hela$n_total, "/") * 100
    pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_db_pct, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.0f",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(50),
      main = "HeLa baseline: organelle x database validation (% of edges)", fontsize = 6, fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA, cellheight = 12, cellwidth = 12, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_database_pct.pdf"),
      width = 5, height = max(4, nrow(mat_db_pct) * 0.25))

    message("Heatmaps saved: organelle x database validation")
  }

  # --- Heatmap: support score distribution by organelle ---
  support_org_mat_hela <- shared_long_hela %>%
    dplyr::left_join(baseline_ppi_hela %>% dplyr::select(key, support_score), by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(support_score)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag, support_score) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(tag, support_score, frac) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = support_score, values_from = frac, values_fill = 0) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  hm_mat_supp_hela <- as.matrix(support_org_mat_hela[, -1])
  rownames(hm_mat_supp_hela) <- support_org_mat_hela$tag
  hm_mat_supp_hela <- hm_mat_supp_hela[, order(as.integer(colnames(hm_mat_supp_hela))), drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(hm_mat_supp_hela) >= 2) {
    pheatmap::pheatmap(hm_mat_supp_hela, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2166AC"))(100),
      cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE, clustering_method = "ward.D2",
      display_numbers = FALSE, fontsize = 8, border_color = NA, cellwidth = 12, cellheight = 12,
      main = "HeLa baseline: support score distribution by organelle (fraction of edges)",
      filename = file.path(out_dir_hela_base, "qc", "heatmap_support_score_by_organelle.pdf"),
      width = 5, height = max(4, nrow(hm_mat_supp_hela) * 0.3))
    message("Heatmap saved: support score by organelle")
  }
}

message("Module 2 complete. Output: baseline_ppi_hela ready for Module 3")
```



# Module 3: Trimer Detection and Validation (HeLa)
Detects triangles from gold-tier baseline, validates against CORUM/ComplexPortal

## Chunk 1: Trimer Detection
```{r hela_m3_trimer_detection}

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_trimer_hela <- file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "trimers")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc"),     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

library(igraph)

# --- Build graph from baseline ---
message("Building graph from HeLa baseline (gold-tier)...")

g_hela <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(baseline_ppi_hela %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2), directed = FALSE)
g_hela <- igraph::simplify(g_hela)

message("Graph: ", igraph::vcount(g_hela), " nodes, ", igraph::ecount(g_hela), " edges")

# --- Find all triangles ---
message("Finding triangles...")

triangles_raw_hela <- igraph::triangles(g_hela)
n_triangles_hela   <- length(triangles_raw_hela) / 3

message("Triangles found: ", n_triangles_hela)

if (n_triangles_hela > 0) {
  triangle_matrix_hela        <- matrix(igraph::V(g_hela)$name[triangles_raw_hela], ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  triangle_matrix_sorted_hela <- t(apply(triangle_matrix_hela, 1, sort))

  trimers_hela_df <- data.frame(
    Gene1 = triangle_matrix_sorted_hela[, 1],
    Gene2 = triangle_matrix_sorted_hela[, 2],
    Gene3 = triangle_matrix_sorted_hela[, 3],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(trimer_id = paste(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, sep = "::")) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(trimer_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  message("Unique trimers: ", nrow(trimers_hela_df))
} else {
  stop("No triangles found. Check graph connectivity.")
}

# --- Edge key helper ---
.get_edge_key <- function(a, b) ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))

trimers_hela_df <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge1_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2),
    edge2_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene3),
    edge3_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene3)
  )

# --- Edge lookup ---
edge_lookup_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
  dplyr::mutate(edge_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(edge_key, Protein1, Protein2, RFprob, AFMprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max,
                support_score, filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID,
                corum_complex_ids, corum_complex_names, cp_complex_ids)

# --- Join edge data ---
trimers_hela_df <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup_hela %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e1"), -edge_key), by = c("edge1_key" = "edge_key")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup_hela %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e2"), -edge_key), by = c("edge2_key" = "edge_key")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup_hela %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e3"), -edge_key), by = c("edge3_key" = "edge_key"))
```


## Chunk 2: Trimer Scoring and Validation
```{r hela_m3_trimer_scoring}

safe_mean <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x) & !is.infinite(x)]; if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(x) }
safe_min  <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x) & !is.infinite(x)]; if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else min(x) }

message("Computing trimer scores...")

trimers_hela_df <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_AFMprob = safe_mean(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3)),
    min_AFMprob  = safe_min(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3)),
    mean_RFprob  = safe_mean(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3)),
    min_RFprob   = safe_min(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3)),
    mean_ipTM    = safe_mean(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3)),
    min_ipTM     = safe_min(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3)),
    mean_SPOC    = safe_mean(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3)),
    min_SPOC     = safe_min(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3)),
    support_total = sum(c(support_score_e1, support_score_e2, support_score_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    support_mean  = support_total / 3,
    n_edges_PDB          = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_PDB_exact    = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3) == "exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_CORUM        = sum(c(filter_CORUM_e1, filter_CORUM_e2, filter_CORUM_e3) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_ComplexPortal = sum(c(filter_ComplexPortal_e1, filter_ComplexPortal_e2, filter_ComplexPortal_e3) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_STRING       = sum(c(filter_STRING_e1, filter_STRING_e2, filter_STRING_e3) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_BIOGRID      = sum(c(filter_BIOGRID_e1, filter_BIOGRID_e2, filter_BIOGRID_e3) == "present", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# --- Validation flags ---
trimers_hela_df <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    all_edges_PDB           = n_edges_PDB == 3,
    all_edges_PDB_exact     = n_edges_PDB_exact == 3,
    all_edges_CORUM         = n_edges_CORUM == 3,
    all_edges_ComplexPortal = n_edges_ComplexPortal == 3,
    all_edges_STRING        = n_edges_STRING == 3,
    all_edges_BIOGRID       = n_edges_BIOGRID == 3,
    partial_PDB             = n_edges_PDB >= 2,
    partial_CORUM           = n_edges_CORUM >= 2,
    partial_ComplexPortal   = n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 2,
    validation_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      all_edges_PDB_exact                          ~ "PDB_exact_3",
      all_edges_CORUM | all_edges_ComplexPortal    ~ "known_complex_3",
      n_edges_PDB_exact >= 2                       ~ "PDB_exact_2",
      partial_CORUM | partial_ComplexPortal        ~ "known_complex_2",
      n_edges_PDB >= 2                             ~ "PDB_any_2",
      n_edges_PDB >= 1 | n_edges_CORUM >= 1 | n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 1 ~ "partial_support",
      TRUE                                         ~ "novel"
    )
  )

# --- UniProt lookup ---
uniprot_lookup_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = Gene1, uniprot = Protein1) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(baseline_ppi_hela %>% dplyr::select(Gene2, Protein2) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = Gene2, uniprot = Protein2)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

trimers_hela_df <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_lookup_hela %>% dplyr::rename(Protein1 = uniprot), by = c("Gene1" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_lookup_hela %>% dplyr::rename(Protein2 = uniprot), by = c("Gene2" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_lookup_hela %>% dplyr::rename(Protein3 = uniprot), by = c("Gene3" = "gene"))

# --- ComplexPortal exact match ---
message("Checking ComplexPortal exact matches...")

.check_cp_match <- function(p1, p2, p3, complex_to_proteins) {
  if (is.na(p1) || is.na(p2) || is.na(p3)) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
  proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
    n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]])
    if (n_match == 3) return(list(strict = TRUE,  relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
    if (n_match >= 2) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
  }
  list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_)
}

cp_matches_hela <- purrr::pmap(list(trimers_hela_df$Protein1, trimers_hela_df$Protein2, trimers_hela_df$Protein3),
                               ~ .check_cp_match(..1, ..2, ..3, complex_to_proteins))

trimers_hela_df$cp_strict_match  <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches_hela, "strict")
trimers_hela_df$cp_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches_hela, "relaxed")
trimers_hela_df$cp_matched_id    <- purrr::map_chr(cp_matches_hela, "complex_id")

message("  ComplexPortal strict (3/3): ", sum(trimers_hela_df$cp_strict_match))
message("  ComplexPortal relaxed (2/3): ", sum(trimers_hela_df$cp_relaxed_match))

# --- CORUM exact match ---
message("Checking CORUM exact matches...")

if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0) {
  .check_corum_match <- function(p1, p2, p3, corum_members) {
    proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3); proteins <- proteins[!is.na(proteins)]
    if (length(proteins) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_members))) {
      n_match <- sum(proteins %in% corum_members$proteins[[i]])
      if (n_match == 3) return(list(strict = TRUE,  relaxed = TRUE,  complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
      if (n_match >= 2) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE,  complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
    }
    list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_)
  }

  corum_matches_hela <- purrr::pmap(list(trimers_hela_df$Protein1, trimers_hela_df$Protein2, trimers_hela_df$Protein3),
                                    ~ .check_corum_match(..1, ..2, ..3, corum_complex_members))

  trimers_hela_df$corum_strict_match  <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches_hela, "strict")
  trimers_hela_df$corum_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches_hela, "relaxed")
  trimers_hela_df$corum_matched_id    <- purrr::map_int(corum_matches_hela, "complex_id")
  trimers_hela_df$corum_matched_name  <- purrr::map_chr(corum_matches_hela, "complex_name")

  message("  CORUM strict (3/3): ", sum(trimers_hela_df$corum_strict_match))
  message("  CORUM relaxed (2/3): ", sum(trimers_hela_df$corum_relaxed_match))
} else {
  trimers_hela_df$corum_strict_match  <- FALSE
  trimers_hela_df$corum_relaxed_match <- FALSE
  trimers_hela_df$corum_matched_id    <- NA_integer_
  trimers_hela_df$corum_matched_name  <- NA_character_
}

# --- Known complex flags ---
trimers_hela_df <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_known_complex         = cp_strict_match | corum_strict_match | all_edges_PDB_exact,
    in_known_complex_relaxed = cp_relaxed_match | corum_relaxed_match | all_edges_PDB
  )

message("\nTrimers in known complex (strict): ", sum(trimers_hela_df$in_known_complex))
message("Trimers in known complex (relaxed): ", sum(trimers_hela_df$in_known_complex_relaxed))
```

```{r hela_m3_trimer_qc}
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc", "barplot_known_vs_novel.pdf"), p_known_hela, width = 2, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# --- Plot 5: Support score distribution ---
readr::write_csv(trimers_hela_df %>% dplyr::select(trimer_id, support_mean),
                 file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_support_score.csv"))

p_support_trimer_hela <- ggplot(trimers_hela_df, aes(x = support_mean)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc", "histogram_support_score.pdf"), p_support_trimer_hela, width = 4, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)

# --- Plot 6: Scores by validation status ---
scores_by_known_hela <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(status = ifelse(in_known_complex, "Known", "Novel")) %>%

readr::write_csv(scores_by_known_hela, file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_scores_by_known.csv"))

p_scores_known_hela <- ggplot(scores_by_known_hela %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_AFMprob, mean_ipTM, support_mean), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value"),
                               aes(x = status, y = value, fill = status)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y") +

        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))

# --- Plot 7: Organelle x validation heatmap ---
message("Organelle x validation heatmap...")

if (exists("binary_matrix") && nrow(binary_matrix) > 0) {
  organelle_tags_trim <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
  gene_to_org_trim    <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags_trim))

  .get_majority_organelle <- function(genes, gene_to_org, org_tags) {
    all_orgs <- unlist(lapply(genes, function(g) {
      row <- gene_to_org %>% dplyr::filter(Genes == g)
      if (nrow(row) == 0) return(character(0))
      org_tags[as.logical(row[1, org_tags])]
    }))
    if (length(all_orgs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    names(sort(table(all_orgs), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  }

  trimers_hela_df <- trimers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(majority_organelle = .get_majority_organelle(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3), gene_to_org_trim, organelle_tags_trim)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  trimers_hela_df$shared_organelle <- trimers_hela_df$majority_organelle
  message("  Trimers with organelle annotation: ", sum(!is.na(trimers_hela_df$majority_organelle)), " / ", nrow(trimers_hela_df))

  org_val_mat_hela <- trimers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(majority_organelle)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(majority_organelle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_total = dplyr::n(), PDB_exact = sum(all_edges_PDB_exact), PDB_any = sum(all_edges_PDB),
                     CORUM = sum(all_edges_CORUM), ComplexPortal = sum(all_edges_ComplexPortal),
                     STRING = sum(all_edges_STRING), BIOGRID = sum(all_edges_BIOGRID), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_total >= 5)

  readr::write_csv(org_val_mat_hela, file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_heatmap_organelle_validation.csv"))

  if (nrow(org_val_mat_hela) > 1) {
    mat_h <- org_val_mat_hela %>%
      dplyr::select(majority_organelle, PDB_exact, CORUM, ComplexPortal, STRING, BIOGRID) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("majority_organelle") %>% as.matrix()

    pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_h, display_numbers = FALSE, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "dodgerblue3"))(50),
      main = "HeLa trimers: organelle x validation (counts)", fontsize = 6, border_color = NA,
      cellheight = 12, cellwidth = 12, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation.pdf"),
      width = 5, height = max(4, nrow(mat_h) * 0.25))

    mat_pct_h <- sweep(mat_h, 1, org_val_mat_hela$n_total, "/") * 100
    pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_pct_h, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.0f",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(50),
      main = "HeLa trimers: organelle x validation (% of trimers)", fontsize = 6, fontsize_number = 5,
      border_color = NA, cellheight = 12, cellwidth = 12, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
      filename = file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation_pct.pdf"),
      width = 5, height = max(4, nrow(mat_pct_h) * 0.25))
  }
} else {
  trimers_hela_df$shared_organelle  <- NA_character_
  trimers_hela_df$majority_organelle <- NA_character_
}

# --- Save tables ---
trimer_stats_hela <- data.frame(
  metric = c("total_trimers", "PDB_exact_all3", "CORUM_all3", "ComplexPortal_all3",
             "CORUM_strict", "ComplexPortal_strict", "in_known_complex", "novel",
             "median_support_mean", "median_mean_AFMprob"),
  value  = c(nrow(trimers_hela_df), sum(trimers_hela_df$all_edges_PDB_exact), sum(trimers_hela_df$all_edges_CORUM),
             sum(trimers_hela_df$all_edges_ComplexPortal), sum(trimers_hela_df$corum_strict_match),
             sum(trimers_hela_df$cp_strict_match), sum(trimers_hela_df$in_known_complex),
             sum(!trimers_hela_df$in_known_complex_relaxed),
             round(median(trimers_hela_df$support_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
             round(median(trimers_hela_df$mean_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
)
readr::write_csv(trimer_stats_hela, file.path(out_dir_trimer_hela, "tables", "trimer_stats.csv"))

trimer_evidence_hela <- trimers_hela_df %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Protein1, Protein2, Protein3,
                edge1_key, edge2_key, edge3_key,
                mean_AFMprob, min_AFMprob, mean_RFprob, min_RFprob, mean_ipTM, min_ipTM, mean_SPOC, min_SPOC,
                support_total, support_mean,
                n_edges_PDB, n_edges_PDB_exact, n_edges_CORUM, n_edges_ComplexPortal, n_edges_STRING, n_edges_BIOGRID,
                all_edges_PDB_exact, all_edges_CORUM, all_edges_ComplexPortal,
                validation_tier, shared_organelle,
```
