# Module 4: Tetramer Detection and Validation (HeLa)
Detects 4-cliques from gold-tier baseline, validates against CORUM/ComplexPortal

## Chunk 1: Tetramer Detection
```{r hela_m4_tetramer_detection}

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_tetramer_hela <- file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tetramers")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc"),     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Find 4-cliques ---
message("Finding tetramers (4-cliques)...")

cliques_4_hela <- igraph::cliques(g_hela, min = 4, max = 4)
message("4-cliques found: ", length(cliques_4_hela))

if (length(cliques_4_hela) > 0) {
  tetramers_hela_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cliques_4_hela, function(cl) {
    genes <- sort(igraph::V(g_hela)$name[cl])
    data.frame(tetramer_id = paste(genes, collapse = "::"),
               Gene1 = genes[1], Gene2 = genes[2], Gene3 = genes[3], Gene4 = genes[4],
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })) %>% dplyr::distinct(tetramer_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  message("Unique tetramers: ", nrow(tetramers_hela_df))
} else {
  message("No 4-cliques found. Creating empty tetramer table.")
  tetramers_hela_df <- data.frame(
    tetramer_id = character(), Gene1 = character(), Gene2 = character(),
    Gene3 = character(), Gene4 = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Get edge keys (6 per tetramer) ---
if (nrow(tetramers_hela_df) > 0) {
  tetramers_hela_df <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      edge1_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2), edge2_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene3),
      edge3_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene4), edge4_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene3),
      edge5_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene4), edge6_key = .get_edge_key(Gene3, Gene4)
    )

  for (j in 1:6) {
    edge_col <- paste0("edge", j, "_key")
    suffix   <- paste0("_e", j)
    tetramers_hela_df <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
      dplyr::left_join(edge_lookup_hela %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, suffix), -edge_key),
                       by = setNames("edge_key", edge_col))
  }
}
```


## Chunk 2: Tetramer Scoring and Validation
```{r hela_m4_tetramer_scoring}

if (nrow(tetramers_hela_df) > 0) {
  message("Computing tetramer scores...")

  tetramers_hela_df <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mean_AFMprob = safe_mean(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3, AFMprob_e4, AFMprob_e5, AFMprob_e6)),
      min_AFMprob  = safe_min(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3, AFMprob_e4, AFMprob_e5, AFMprob_e6)),
      mean_RFprob  = safe_mean(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3, RFprob_e4, RFprob_e5, RFprob_e6)),
      min_RFprob   = safe_min(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3, RFprob_e4, RFprob_e5, RFprob_e6)),
      mean_ipTM    = safe_mean(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3, ipTM_max_e4, ipTM_max_e5, ipTM_max_e6)),
      min_ipTM     = safe_min(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3, ipTM_max_e4, ipTM_max_e5, ipTM_max_e6)),
      mean_SPOC    = safe_mean(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3, SPOC_score_e4, SPOC_score_e5, SPOC_score_e6)),
      min_SPOC     = safe_min(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3, SPOC_score_e4, SPOC_score_e5, SPOC_score_e6)),
      support_total = sum(c(support_score_e1, support_score_e2, support_score_e3, support_score_e4, support_score_e5, support_score_e6), na.rm = TRUE),
      support_mean  = support_total / 6,
      n_edges_PDB           = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3, filter_PDB_e4, filter_PDB_e5, filter_PDB_e6) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_PDB_exact     = sum(c(filter_PDB_e1, filter_PDB_e2, filter_PDB_e3, filter_PDB_e4, filter_PDB_e5, filter_PDB_e6) == "exact", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_CORUM         = sum(c(filter_CORUM_e1, filter_CORUM_e2, filter_CORUM_e3, filter_CORUM_e4, filter_CORUM_e5, filter_CORUM_e6) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_ComplexPortal = sum(c(filter_ComplexPortal_e1, filter_ComplexPortal_e2, filter_ComplexPortal_e3, filter_ComplexPortal_e4, filter_ComplexPortal_e5, filter_ComplexPortal_e6) != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_STRING        = sum(c(filter_STRING_e1, filter_STRING_e2, filter_STRING_e3, filter_STRING_e4, filter_STRING_e5, filter_STRING_e6) == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_edges_BIOGRID       = sum(c(filter_BIOGRID_e1, filter_BIOGRID_e2, filter_BIOGRID_e3, filter_BIOGRID_e4, filter_BIOGRID_e5, filter_BIOGRID_e6) == "present", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # --- Validation flags ---
  tetramers_hela_df <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      all_edges_PDB           = n_edges_PDB == 6,
      all_edges_PDB_exact     = n_edges_PDB_exact == 6,
      all_edges_CORUM         = n_edges_CORUM == 6,
      all_edges_ComplexPortal = n_edges_ComplexPortal == 6,
      all_edges_STRING        = n_edges_STRING == 6,
      all_edges_BIOGRID       = n_edges_BIOGRID == 6,
      majority_PDB            = n_edges_PDB >= 4,
      majority_PDB_exact      = n_edges_PDB_exact >= 4,
      majority_CORUM          = n_edges_CORUM >= 4,
      majority_ComplexPortal  = n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 4,
      validation_tier = dplyr::case_when(
        all_edges_PDB_exact                         ~ "PDB_exact_6",
        all_edges_CORUM | all_edges_ComplexPortal   ~ "known_complex_6",
        majority_PDB_exact                          ~ "PDB_exact_4plus",
        majority_CORUM | majority_ComplexPortal     ~ "known_complex_4plus",
        n_edges_PDB >= 3 | n_edges_CORUM >= 3 | n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 3 ~ "partial_support_3plus",
        n_edges_PDB >= 1 | n_edges_CORUM >= 1 | n_edges_ComplexPortal >= 1 ~ "partial_support",
        TRUE ~ "novel"
      )
    )

  # --- UniProt mapping ---
  gene_to_prot_hela <- setNames(uniprot_lookup_hela$uniprot, uniprot_lookup_hela$gene)
  tetramers_hela_df$Protein1 <- gene_to_prot_hela[tetramers_hela_df$Gene1]
  tetramers_hela_df$Protein2 <- gene_to_prot_hela[tetramers_hela_df$Gene2]
  tetramers_hela_df$Protein3 <- gene_to_prot_hela[tetramers_hela_df$Gene3]
  tetramers_hela_df$Protein4 <- gene_to_prot_hela[tetramers_hela_df$Gene4]

  n_with_proteins_tet <- sum(!is.na(tetramers_hela_df$Protein1) & !is.na(tetramers_hela_df$Protein2) &
                              !is.na(tetramers_hela_df$Protein3) & !is.na(tetramers_hela_df$Protein4))
  message("  Tetramers with all 4 proteins mapped: ", n_with_proteins_tet, " / ", nrow(tetramers_hela_df))

  # --- ComplexPortal match ---
  message("Checking ComplexPortal exact matches...")

  .check_cp_match_4 <- function(p1, p2, p3, p4, complex_to_proteins) {
    if (is.na(p1) || is.na(p2) || is.na(p3) || is.na(p4)) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
    proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3, p4)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
      n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]])
      if (n_match == 4) return(list(strict = TRUE,  relaxed = TRUE,  complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
      if (n_match >= 3) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE,  complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
    }
    list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_)
  }

  if (exists("complex_to_proteins") && nrow(complex_to_proteins) > 0 && n_with_proteins_tet > 0) {
    cp_matches_4_hela <- purrr::pmap(list(tetramers_hela_df$Protein1, tetramers_hela_df$Protein2,
                                          tetramers_hela_df$Protein3, tetramers_hela_df$Protein4),
                                     ~ .check_cp_match_4(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4, complex_to_proteins))
    tetramers_hela_df$cp_strict_match  <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches_4_hela, "strict")
    tetramers_hela_df$cp_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_matches_4_hela, "relaxed")
    tetramers_hela_df$cp_matched_id    <- purrr::map_chr(cp_matches_4_hela, "complex_id")
  } else {
    tetramers_hela_df$cp_strict_match  <- FALSE
    tetramers_hela_df$cp_relaxed_match <- FALSE
    tetramers_hela_df$cp_matched_id    <- NA_character_
  }
  message("  ComplexPortal strict (4/4): ", sum(tetramers_hela_df$cp_strict_match))
  message("  ComplexPortal relaxed (3/4): ", sum(tetramers_hela_df$cp_relaxed_match))

  # --- CORUM match ---
  message("Checking CORUM exact matches...")

  if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0 && n_with_proteins_tet > 0) {
    .check_corum_match_4 <- function(p1, p2, p3, p4, corum_members) {
      proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3, p4); proteins <- proteins[!is.na(proteins)]
      if (length(proteins) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_))
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_members))) {
        n_match <- sum(proteins %in% corum_members$proteins[[i]])
        if (n_match == 4) return(list(strict = TRUE,  relaxed = TRUE,  complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
        if (n_match >= 3) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE,  complex_id = corum_members$complex_id[i], complex_name = corum_members$complex_name[i]))
      }
      list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_)
    }
    corum_matches_4_hela <- purrr::pmap(list(tetramers_hela_df$Protein1, tetramers_hela_df$Protein2,
                                             tetramers_hela_df$Protein3, tetramers_hela_df$Protein4),
                                        ~ .check_corum_match_4(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4, corum_complex_members))
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_strict_match  <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches_4_hela, "strict")
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_matches_4_hela, "relaxed")
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_matched_id    <- purrr::map_int(corum_matches_4_hela, "complex_id")
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_matched_name  <- purrr::map_chr(corum_matches_4_hela, "complex_name")
    message("  CORUM strict (4/4): ", sum(tetramers_hela_df$corum_strict_match))
    message("  CORUM relaxed (3/4): ", sum(tetramers_hela_df$corum_relaxed_match))
  } else {
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_strict_match  <- FALSE
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_relaxed_match <- FALSE
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_matched_id    <- NA_integer_
    tetramers_hela_df$corum_matched_name  <- NA_character_
  }

  tetramers_hela_df <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      in_known_complex         = cp_strict_match | corum_strict_match | all_edges_PDB_exact,
      in_known_complex_relaxed = cp_relaxed_match | corum_relaxed_match | majority_PDB
    )
  message("\nTetramers in known complex (strict): ", sum(tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex))
  message("Tetramers in known complex (relaxed): ", sum(tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex_relaxed))
}
```


## Chunk 3: Tetramer QC Plots
```{r hela_m4_tetramer_qc}

if (nrow(tetramers_hela_df) > 0) {

  # --- Plot 1: Database support ---
  db_support_tet_hela <- data.frame(
    database    = c("PDB_any", "PDB_exact", "CORUM", "ComplexPortal", "STRING", "BIOGRID"),
    all_6_edges = c(sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_PDB), sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_PDB_exact),
                    sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_CORUM), sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_ComplexPortal),
                    sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_STRING), sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_BIOGRID)),
    majority_4plus = c(sum(tetramers_hela_df$majority_PDB), sum(tetramers_hela_df$majority_PDB_exact),
                       sum(tetramers_hela_df$majority_CORUM), sum(tetramers_hela_df$majority_ComplexPortal),
                       sum(tetramers_hela_df$n_edges_STRING >= 4), sum(tetramers_hela_df$n_edges_BIOGRID >= 4))
  )
  readr::write_csv(db_support_tet_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_database_support.csv"))

  p_db_tet_hela <- ggplot(db_support_tet_hela %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(-database, names_to = "coverage", values_to = "n_tetramers"),
                           aes(x = database, y = n_tetramers, fill = coverage)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_tetramers), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("all_6_edges" = "#E41A1C", "majority_4plus" = "#377EB8"), name = "Coverage") +
    labs(title = "HeLa tetramer database support", x = NULL, y = "Number of tetramers") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "barplot_database_support.pdf"), p_db_tet_hela, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

  # --- Plot 2: Validation tier ---
  val_counts_tet_hela <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::count(validation_tier) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(validation_tier = factor(validation_tier,
      levels = c("PDB_exact_6", "known_complex_6", "PDB_exact_4plus", "known_complex_4plus",
                 "partial_support_3plus", "partial_support", "novel")))
  readr::write_csv(val_counts_tet_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_validation_tiers.csv"))

  p_val_tet_hela <- ggplot(val_counts_tet_hela, aes(x = validation_tier, y = n, fill = validation_tier)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlGn", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "HeLa tetramer validation tiers", x = NULL, y = "Number of tetramers") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "barplot_validation_tiers.pdf"), p_val_tet_hela, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

  # --- Plot 3: Known complex by source ---
  known_sep_tet_hela <- data.frame(
    source = c("CORUM_strict", "CORUM_relaxed", "ComplexPortal_strict", "ComplexPortal_relaxed", "PDB_exact_6", "Novel"),
    n = c(sum(tetramers_hela_df$corum_strict_match),
          sum(tetramers_hela_df$corum_relaxed_match & !tetramers_hela_df$corum_strict_match),
          sum(tetramers_hela_df$cp_strict_match),
          sum(tetramers_hela_df$cp_relaxed_match & !tetramers_hela_df$cp_strict_match),
          sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_PDB_exact & !tetramers_hela_df$corum_strict_match & !tetramers_hela_df$cp_strict_match),
          sum(!tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex_relaxed))
  )
  readr::write_csv(known_sep_tet_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_known_by_source.csv"))

  p_known_sep_tet_hela <- ggplot(known_sep_tet_hela, aes(x = reorder(source, -n), y = n, fill = source)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("CORUM_strict" = "#f0f0f1", "CORUM_relaxed" = "#f0f0f1",
                                 "ComplexPortal_strict" = "#cfd1d2", "ComplexPortal_relaxed" = "#cfd1d2",
                                 "PDB_exact_6" = "#babcbe", "Novel" = "#E41A1C"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "HeLa tetramers: validation by source", x = NULL, y = "Number of tetramers") +

          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "barplot_known_by_source.pdf"), p_known_sep_tet_hela, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

  # --- Plot 4: Known vs novel combined ---
  known_tet_hela <- data.frame(
    category = c("Known (strict)", "Known (relaxed only)", "Novel"),
    n = c(sum(tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex),
          sum(tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex_relaxed & !tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex),
          sum(!tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex_relaxed))
  ) %>% dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
  readr::write_csv(known_tet_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_known_vs_novel.csv"))

  p_known_tet_hela <- ggplot(known_tet_hela, aes(x = category, y = n, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(scales::comma(n), " (", pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Known (strict)" = "grey40", "Known (relaxed only)" = "grey75", "Novel" = "#E41A1C"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "HeLa tetramers: known vs novel", x = NULL, y = "Number of tetramers") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "barplot_known_vs_novel.pdf"), p_known_tet_hela, width = 2, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

  # --- Plot 5: Support score distribution ---
  readr::write_csv(tetramers_hela_df %>% dplyr::select(tetramer_id, support_mean),
                   file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_support_score.csv"))

  p_support_tet_hela <- ggplot(tetramers_hela_df, aes(x = support_mean)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +

  # --- Plot 6: Scores by validation status ---
  scores_tet_hela <- tetramers_hela_df %>%

  readr::write_csv(scores_tet_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_scores_by_known.csv"))

  p_scores_tet_hela <- ggplot(scores_tet_hela %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_AFMprob, mean_ipTM, support_mean), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value"),

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "boxplot_scores_by_known.pdf"), p_scores_tet_hela, width = 4, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)

  # --- Plot 7: Organelle x validation heatmap ---
  if (exists("binary_matrix") && nrow(binary_matrix) > 0) {
    organelle_tags_tet <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
    gene_to_org_tet    <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags_tet))

    .get_majority_organelle_4 <- function(genes, gene_to_org, org_tags) {
      all_orgs <- unlist(lapply(genes, function(g) {
        row <- gene_to_org %>% dplyr::filter(Genes == g)
        if (nrow(row) == 0) return(character(0))
        org_tags[as.logical(row[1, org_tags])]
      }))
      if (length(all_orgs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      names(sort(table(all_orgs), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    }

    tetramers_hela_df <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
      dplyr::rowwise() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(majority_organelle = .get_majority_organelle_4(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4), gene_to_org_tet, organelle_tags_tet)) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()

    org_val_tet_hela <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(majority_organelle)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(majority_organelle) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n_total = dplyr::n(), PDB_exact = sum(all_edges_PDB_exact), PDB_any = sum(all_edges_PDB),
                       CORUM = sum(all_edges_CORUM), ComplexPortal = sum(all_edges_ComplexPortal), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_total >= 3)

    readr::write_csv(org_val_tet_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "sourcedata_heatmap_organelle_validation.csv"))

    if (nrow(org_val_tet_hela) > 1) {
      mat_t <- org_val_tet_hela %>%
        dplyr::select(majority_organelle, PDB_exact, CORUM, ComplexPortal) %>%
        tibble::column_to_rownames("majority_organelle") %>% as.matrix()
      pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_t, display_numbers = FALSE, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "dodgerblue3"))(50),
        main = "HeLa tetramers: organelle x validation (counts)", fontsize = 6, border_color = NA,
        cellheight = 12, cellwidth = 12, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
        filename = file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "qc", "heatmap_organelle_validation.pdf"),
        width = 4, height = max(4, nrow(mat_t) * 0.25))
    }
  }

  # --- Save tables ---
  tetramer_stats_hela <- data.frame(
    metric = c("total_tetramers", "PDB_exact_all6", "CORUM_all6", "ComplexPortal_all6",
               "CORUM_strict", "ComplexPortal_strict", "in_known_complex", "novel",
               "median_support_mean", "median_mean_AFMprob"),
    value  = c(nrow(tetramers_hela_df), sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_PDB_exact), sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_CORUM),
               sum(tetramers_hela_df$all_edges_ComplexPortal), sum(tetramers_hela_df$corum_strict_match),
               sum(tetramers_hela_df$cp_strict_match), sum(tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex),
               sum(!tetramers_hela_df$in_known_complex_relaxed),
               round(median(tetramers_hela_df$support_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
               round(median(tetramers_hela_df$mean_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
  )
  readr::write_csv(tetramer_stats_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "tables", "tetramer_stats.csv"))

  tetramer_evidence_hela <- tetramers_hela_df %>%
    dplyr::select(tetramer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4, Protein1, Protein2, Protein3, Protein4,
                  mean_AFMprob, min_AFMprob, mean_RFprob, min_RFprob, mean_ipTM, min_ipTM, mean_SPOC, min_SPOC,
                  support_total, support_mean,
                  n_edges_PDB, n_edges_PDB_exact, n_edges_CORUM, n_edges_ComplexPortal, n_edges_STRING, n_edges_BIOGRID,
                  all_edges_PDB_exact, all_edges_CORUM, all_edges_ComplexPortal,
                  validation_tier,
                  cp_strict_match, cp_relaxed_match, cp_matched_id,
                  corum_strict_match, corum_relaxed_match, corum_matched_id, corum_matched_name,
                  in_known_complex, in_known_complex_relaxed)
  readr::write_csv(tetramer_evidence_hela, file.path(out_dir_tetramer_hela, "tables", "tetramer_evidence.csv"))

  message("\nModule 4 complete. ", nrow(tetramer_evidence_hela), " tetramers saved")
  message("  Known complex (strict): ", sum(tetramer_evidence_hela$in_known_complex))
  message("  Novel: ", sum(!tetramer_evidence_hela$in_known_complex_relaxed))
} else {
  tetramer_evidence_hela <- data.frame()
  message("No tetramers detected. tetramer_evidence_hela is empty.")
}
```


# Module 5: Complex Growing from Trimers and Tetramers (HeLa)
Grows complexes iteratively: seed -> add neighbors connected to >=2 members
Merges overlapping complexes at 80% threshold, validates against CORUM/ComplexPortal


## Chunk 1: Build Adjacency and Growth Functions
```{r hela_m5_complex_setup}

out_dir_complex_hela <- file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "complexes")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_complex_hela, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_complex_hela, "qc"),     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("=== Complex Growing from HeLa Trimers/Tetramers ===")

# --- Adjacency list from baseline ---
adj_list_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  {
    edges <- rbind(data.frame(from = .$Gene1, to = .$Gene2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                   data.frame(from = .$Gene2, to = .$Gene1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    split(edges$to, edges$from)
  }

message("Adjacency list: ", length(adj_list_hela), " nodes")

# --- Compartment groups (HeLa -- no SynapticGeneral) ---
compartment_groups_hela <- list(
  Nucleus   = c("Nucleus"),
  ER        = c("ER"),
  Golgi     = c("Golgi", "ER", "EarlyEndosome"),
  Mito      = c("Mito", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "MitoIMS", "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI"),
  Endosome  = c("Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome", "Lysosome", "vATPase"),
  Autophagy = c("Autophagy", "Lysosome", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "vATPase")
)

compatible_multi_groups_hela <- c("ER", "Golgi", "Lysosome", "Endosome", "Autophagy")

tag_to_groups_hela <- list()
for (.grp in names(compartment_groups_hela))
  for (.tg in compartment_groups_hela[[.grp]])
    tag_to_groups_hela[[.tg]] <- unique(c(tag_to_groups_hela[[.tg]], .grp))

# --- Build gene_to_org from binary_matrix ---
organelle_tags_cx <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
gene_to_org_cx    <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags_cx))

.present_cx_tags <- intersect(unique(unlist(compartment_groups_hela)), colnames(gene_to_org_cx))

protein_allowed_hela_df <- gene_to_org_cx %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(.present_cx_tags)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "tag", values_to = "present") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(present) & as.logical(present)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(groups = list(unique(unlist(purrr::map(tag, ~tag_to_groups_hela[[.x]])))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(length(groups) == 1 | all(groups %in% compatible_multi_groups_hela)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(allowed = list(if (all(groups %in% compatible_multi_groups_hela)) unlist(groups) else groups[[1]])) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

protein_allowed_hela <- setNames(protein_allowed_hela_df$allowed, protein_allowed_hela_df$Genes)
message("Compartment-constrained proteins: ", length(protein_allowed_hela))

# --- Growth functions ---
.get_seed_allowed_hela <- function(seed_members) {
  all_grps <- unlist(purrr::map(seed_members, ~protein_allowed_hela[[.x]]))
  if (length(all_grps) == 0) return(NULL)
  unique_grps <- unique(all_grps)
  if (all(unique_grps %in% compatible_multi_groups_hela)) return(unique_grps)
  names(sort(table(all_grps), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

.grow_complex_hela <- function(members, adj_list, min_edges = 2, allowed_groups = NULL) {
  all_neighbors <- unlist(adj_list[members])
  if (is.null(all_neighbors) || length(all_neighbors) == 0) return(character(0))
  neighbor_counts <- table(all_neighbors)
  candidates <- names(neighbor_counts)[neighbor_counts >= min_edges]
  candidates <- setdiff(candidates, members)
  if (!is.null(allowed_groups) && length(candidates) > 0) {
    candidates <- candidates[vapply(candidates, function(cand) {
      cg <- protein_allowed_hela[[cand]]
      !is.null(cg) && any(cg %in% allowed_groups)
    }, logical(1))]
  }
  return(candidates)
}

.grow_complex_iterative_hela <- function(seed_members, adj_list, min_edges = 2, max_size = 100, allowed_groups = NULL) {
  current <- seed_members
  repeat {
    if (length(current) >= max_size) break
    candidates <- .grow_complex_hela(current, adj_list, min_edges, allowed_groups)
    if (length(candidates) == 0) break
    current <- c(current, candidates)
  }
  return(sort(current))
}

.overlap_fraction <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / min(length(a), length(b))
```


## Chunk 2: Grow Complexes from Seeds
```{r hela_m5_complex_growing}

# --- Grow from trimers ---
message("Growing complexes from trimers...")

trimer_seeds_hela <- trimer_evidence_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(seed_members = list(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

grown_from_trimers_hela <- trimer_seeds_hela %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    seed_allowed  = list(.get_seed_allowed_hela(seed_members)),
    grown_members = list(.grow_complex_iterative_hela(seed_members, adj_list_hela, min_edges = 2, allowed_groups = seed_allowed)),
    grown_size    = length(grown_members),
    complex_id    = paste(sort(grown_members), collapse = "::")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("  Trimers grown: ", nrow(grown_from_trimers_hela))
message("  Unique complexes from trimers: ", length(unique(grown_from_trimers_hela$complex_id)))

# --- Grow from tetramers ---
message("Growing complexes from tetramers...")

if (nrow(tetramer_evidence_hela) > 0) {
  tetramer_seeds_hela <- tetramer_evidence_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(tetramer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(seed_members = list(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  grown_from_tetramers_hela <- tetramer_seeds_hela %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      seed_allowed  = list(.get_seed_allowed_hela(seed_members)),
      grown_members = list(.grow_complex_iterative_hela(seed_members, adj_list_hela, min_edges = 2, allowed_groups = seed_allowed)),
      grown_size    = length(grown_members),
      complex_id    = paste(sort(grown_members), collapse = "::")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  message("  Tetramers grown: ", nrow(grown_from_tetramers_hela))
  message("  Unique complexes from tetramers: ", length(unique(grown_from_tetramers_hela$complex_id)))
} else {
  grown_from_tetramers_hela <- data.frame(
    tetramer_id = character(), grown_members = I(list()), grown_size = integer(),
    complex_id = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Internal QC: trimer+1 vs tetramer ---
trimer_plus_one_hela <- grown_from_trimers_hela %>% dplyr::filter(grown_size == 4)
message("Trimers that grew to size 4: ", nrow(trimer_plus_one_hela))

if (nrow(tetramer_evidence_hela) > 0 && nrow(trimer_plus_one_hela) > 0) {
  tet_ids_hela <- tetramer_evidence_hela %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(complex_id = paste(sort(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4)), collapse = "::")) %>%
    dplyr::pull(complex_id)
  overlap_hela <- sum(trimer_plus_one_hela$complex_id %in% tet_ids_hela)
  message("  Trimer+1 matching de novo tetramers: ", overlap_hela, " / ", nrow(trimer_plus_one_hela))
  message("  Match rate: ", round(100 * overlap_hela / nrow(trimer_plus_one_hela), 1), "%")
}

# --- Combine ---
all_grown_hela <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  grown_from_trimers_hela %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, grown_members, grown_size) %>% dplyr::mutate(seed_type = "trimer"),
  grown_from_tetramers_hela %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, grown_members, grown_size) %>% dplyr::mutate(seed_type = "tetramer")
)

complex_seed_counts_hela <- all_grown_hela %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_trimer_seeds = sum(seed_type == "trimer"), n_tetramer_seeds = sum(seed_type == "tetramer"),
                   n_total_seeds = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

unique_complexes_hela <- all_grown_hela %>%
  dplyr::distinct(complex_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_seed_counts_hela, by = "complex_id")

message("Unique complexes (before merging): ", nrow(unique_complexes_hela))
```


## Chunk 3: Merge Overlapping Complexes
```{r hela_m5_complex_merging}

message("Merging overlapping complexes (80% threshold)...")

unique_complexes_hela <- unique_complexes_hela %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(grown_size))

merged_complexes_hela <- list()
used <- rep(FALSE, nrow(unique_complexes_hela))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(unique_complexes_hela))) {
  if (used[i]) next
  current      <- unique_complexes_hela$grown_members[[i]]
  current_seeds <- c(unique_complexes_hela$n_trimer_seeds[i], unique_complexes_hela$n_tetramer_seeds[i])

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(unique_complexes_hela))) {
    if (i == j || used[j]) next
    other   <- unique_complexes_hela$grown_members[[j]]
    overlap <- .overlap_fraction(current, other)
    if (overlap >= 0.8) {
      current       <- union(current, other)
      current_seeds <- current_seeds + c(unique_complexes_hela$n_trimer_seeds[j], unique_complexes_hela$n_tetramer_seeds[j])
      used[j] <- TRUE
    }
  }

  merged_complexes_hela[[length(merged_complexes_hela) + 1]] <- list(
    members = sort(current), size = length(current),
    n_trimer_seeds = current_seeds[1], n_tetramer_seeds = current_seeds[2]
  )
  used[i] <- TRUE
}

message("Complexes after merging: ", length(merged_complexes_hela))

complex_evidence_hela <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(merged_complexes_hela), function(i) {
  data.frame(complex_id = paste(merged_complexes_hela[[i]]$members, collapse = "::"),
             complex_size = merged_complexes_hela[[i]]$size,
             n_trimer_seeds = merged_complexes_hela[[i]]$n_trimer_seeds,
             n_tetramer_seeds = merged_complexes_hela[[i]]$n_tetramer_seeds,
             members = I(list(merged_complexes_hela[[i]]$members)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(complex_idx = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_idx, complex_id, complex_size, n_trimer_seeds, n_tetramer_seeds, members)

message("Final complex count: ", nrow(complex_evidence_hela))
print(complex_evidence_hela %>% dplyr::count(complex_size, name = "n_complexes") %>% dplyr::arrange(complex_size))
```


## Chunk 4: Support Scores and Validation
```{r hela_m5_complex_scoring}

message("Computing support scores for complexes...")

.make_undirected_key <- function(a, b) ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))

support_lookup_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
  dplyr::mutate(edge_key = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(edge_key, support_score, filter_BIOGRID, filter_STRING, filter_PDB,
                filter_ComplexPortal, filter_CORUM, corum_complex_ids, corum_complex_names)

.compute_complex_support_hela <- function(members, support_lookup) {
  if (length(members) < 2) return(list(n_edges = 0, support_total = 0, support_mean = NA_real_,
                                        n_with_PDB_exact = 0, n_with_PDB_homolog = 0))
  pairs     <- t(combn(sort(unique(members)), 2))
  edge_keys <- apply(pairs, 1, function(p) .make_undirected_key(p[1], p[2]))
  matched   <- support_lookup %>% dplyr::filter(edge_key %in% edge_keys)
  list(
    n_edges            = nrow(matched),
    n_edges_possible   = length(edge_keys),
    support_total      = sum(matched$support_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    support_mean       = if (nrow(matched) > 0) round(mean(matched$support_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA_real_,
    n_in_CORUM         = sum(matched$filter_CORUM == "present", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_with_PDB         = sum(matched$filter_PDB != "none", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_with_PDB_exact   = sum(matched$filter_PDB == "exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_with_PDB_homolog = sum(matched$filter_PDB == "homolog", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_in_ComplexPortal = sum(matched$filter_ComplexPortal != "none", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

complex_evidence_hela <- complex_evidence_hela %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    support_info             = list(.compute_complex_support_hela(members, support_lookup_hela)),
    n_edges_in_baseline      = support_info$n_edges,
    n_edges_possible         = support_info$n_edges_possible,
    edge_coverage            = round(n_edges_in_baseline / n_edges_possible, 2),
    complex_support_total    = support_info$support_total,
    complex_support_mean     = support_info$support_mean,
    n_edges_in_CORUM         = support_info$n_in_CORUM,
    n_edges_with_PDB         = support_info$n_with_PDB,
    n_edges_with_PDB_exact   = support_info$n_with_PDB_exact,
    n_edges_with_PDB_homolog = support_info$n_with_PDB_homolog,
    n_edges_in_ComplexPortal = support_info$n_in_ComplexPortal,
    pct_edges_CORUM          = round(100 * n_edges_in_CORUM / n_edges_in_baseline, 1),
    pct_edges_PDB            = round(100 * n_edges_with_PDB / n_edges_in_baseline, 1),
    pct_edges_PDB_exact      = round(100 * n_edges_with_PDB_exact / n_edges_in_baseline, 1),
    has_PDB_exact_majority   = (n_edges_with_PDB_exact / n_edges_in_baseline) >= 0.5,
    has_PDB_any_majority     = (n_edges_with_PDB / n_edges_in_baseline) >= 0.5
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-support_info) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# --- ComplexPortal validation ---
message("Validating complexes against ComplexPortal...")

if (exists("complex_to_proteins") && exists("uniprot_lookup_hela")) {
  .check_complex_match_hela <- function(members, complex_to_proteins, uniprot_lookup) {
    uniprots <- uniprot_lookup$uniprot[match(members, uniprot_lookup$gene)]
    uniprots <- uniprots[!is.na(uniprots)]
    if (length(uniprots) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_, pct_overlap = 0))
    best_strict <- FALSE; best_relaxed <- FALSE; best_id <- NA_character_; best_pct <- 0
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
      cp_prots  <- complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]]
      n_overlap <- sum(uniprots %in% cp_prots)
      pct       <- n_overlap / length(uniprots)
      if (n_overlap == length(uniprots) && !best_strict) { best_strict <- TRUE; best_id <- complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]; best_pct <- pct }
      if (pct >= 0.5 && !best_relaxed) { best_relaxed <- TRUE; if (is.na(best_id)) best_id <- complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]; best_pct <- max(best_pct, pct) }
    }
    list(strict = best_strict, relaxed = best_relaxed, complex_id = best_id, pct_overlap = round(best_pct, 2))
  }

  cp_complex_matches_hela <- purrr::map(complex_evidence_hela$members,
                                         ~.check_complex_match_hela(.x, complex_to_proteins, uniprot_lookup_hela))
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_strict_match  <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_complex_matches_hela, "strict")
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(cp_complex_matches_hela, "relaxed")
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_matched_id    <- purrr::map_chr(cp_complex_matches_hela, "complex_id")
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_pct_overlap   <- purrr::map_dbl(cp_complex_matches_hela, "pct_overlap")
  message("  CP strict: ", sum(complex_evidence_hela$cp_strict_match))
  message("  CP relaxed (>=50%): ", sum(complex_evidence_hela$cp_relaxed_match))
} else {
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_strict_match  <- FALSE
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_relaxed_match <- FALSE
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_matched_id    <- NA_character_
  complex_evidence_hela$cp_pct_overlap   <- NA_real_
}

# --- CORUM validation ---
message("Validating complexes against CORUM...")

if (!is.null(corum_complex_members) && nrow(corum_complex_members) > 0) {
  .check_corum_complex_match_hela <- function(members, corum_members) {
    members_clean <- members[!is.na(members)]
    if (length(members_clean) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_integer_, complex_name = NA_character_, pct_overlap = 0))
    best_strict <- FALSE; best_relaxed <- FALSE; best_id <- NA_integer_; best_name <- NA_character_; best_pct <- 0
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_members))) {
      n_overlap <- sum(members_clean %in% corum_members$proteins[[i]])
      pct       <- n_overlap / length(members_clean)
      if (n_overlap == length(members_clean) && !best_strict) { best_strict <- TRUE; best_id <- corum_members$complex_id[i]; best_name <- corum_members$complex_name[i]; best_pct <- pct }
      if (pct >= 0.5 && !best_relaxed) { best_relaxed <- TRUE; if (is.na(best_id)) { best_id <- corum_members$complex_id[i]; best_name <- corum_members$complex_name[i] }; best_pct <- max(best_pct, pct) }
    }
    list(strict = best_strict, relaxed = best_relaxed, complex_id = best_id, complex_name = best_name, pct_overlap = round(best_pct, 2))
  }

  corum_complex_matches_hela <- purrr::map(complex_evidence_hela$members,
                                            ~.check_corum_complex_match_hela(.x, corum_complex_members))
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_strict_match  <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_complex_matches_hela, "strict")
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_relaxed_match <- purrr::map_lgl(corum_complex_matches_hela, "relaxed")
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_matched_id    <- purrr::map_int(corum_complex_matches_hela, "complex_id")
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_matched_name  <- purrr::map_chr(corum_complex_matches_hela, "complex_name")
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_pct_overlap   <- purrr::map_dbl(corum_complex_matches_hela, "pct_overlap")
  message("  CORUM strict: ", sum(complex_evidence_hela$corum_strict_match))
  message("  CORUM relaxed (>=50%): ", sum(complex_evidence_hela$corum_relaxed_match))
} else {
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_strict_match  <- FALSE
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_relaxed_match <- FALSE
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_matched_id    <- NA_integer_
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_matched_name  <- NA_character_
  complex_evidence_hela$corum_pct_overlap   <- NA_real_
}

complex_evidence_hela <- complex_evidence_hela %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_known_complex         = cp_strict_match | corum_strict_match | has_PDB_exact_majority,
    in_known_complex_relaxed = cp_relaxed_match | corum_relaxed_match | has_PDB_any_majority
  )

message("\nComplexes in known complex (strict): ", sum(complex_evidence_hela$in_known_complex))
message("Complexes in known complex (relaxed): ", sum(complex_evidence_hela$in_known_complex_relaxed))
```

.get_majority_org_cx <- function(members, gene_to_org, org_tags) {
  all_orgs <- unlist(lapply(members, function(g) {
    row <- gene_to_org %>% dplyr::filter(Genes == g)
    if (nrow(row) == 0) return(character(0))
    org_tags[as.logical(row[1, org_tags])]
  }))
  if (length(all_orgs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  names(sort(table(all_orgs), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

# Module 6: Complex Network Visualization (HeLa)
Generates network plots for each HeLa baseline complex
Edge coloring by evidence tier, edge width by support score
Exports source CSV per complex (summary + proteins + edges)

## Chunk 1: Setup and Edge Palette
```{r m12_m6_c1_network_setup}
# =============================================================================
# HeLa Complex Networks: Setup
# =============================================================================

library(igraph)

out_dir_cx_nets_hela     <- file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "complexes", "network_plots")
out_dir_cx_nets_csv_hela <- file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "complexes", "network_csv")
dir.create(out_dir_cx_nets_hela,     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_cx_nets_csv_hela, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("=== HeLa Complex Network Visualization ===")

# --- Evidence tier color palette ---
evidence_palette_hela <- c(
  "PDB_exact"     = "#8B0000",
  "PDB_homolog"   = "#FF6B6B",
  "CORUM"         = "#228B22",
  "ComplexPortal" = "#4169E1",
  "STRING"        = "#FFD700",
  "BIOGRID"       = "#FF8C00",
  "multi_db"      = "#800080",
  "baseline"      = "#A9A9A9"
)

# --- Derive validation_status if not present ---
complex_evidence_hela <- complex_evidence_hela %>%
  dplyr::mutate(validation_status = dplyr::case_when(
    in_known_complex          ~ "strict_match",
    in_known_complex_relaxed  ~ "relaxed_match",
    TRUE                      ~ "novel"
  ))

# --- Filter to plottable complexes (size <= 50) ---
complexes_to_plot_hela <- complex_evidence_hela %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_size <= 50) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(complex_idx)

message("Complexes to plot (size <= 50): ", nrow(complexes_to_plot_hela), " / ", nrow(complex_evidence_hela))

# --- Edge lookup from baseline ---
edge_data_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
  dplyr::mutate(edge_key = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(edge_key, Gene1, Gene2, Protein1, Protein2,
                AFMprob, RFprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max, support_score,
                filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID,
                in_both_predictions)

# --- Classify edge evidence tier ---
edge_data_hela <- edge_data_hela %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_databases = (filter_PDB != "none") + (filter_CORUM == "present") +
                  (filter_ComplexPortal != "none") + (filter_STRING == "present") +
                  (filter_BIOGRID == "present"),
    evidence_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      filter_PDB == "exact"         ~ "PDB_exact",
      n_databases >= 3              ~ "multi_db",
      filter_PDB == "homolog"       ~ "PDB_homolog",
      filter_CORUM == "present"     ~ "CORUM",
      filter_ComplexPortal != "none" ~ "ComplexPortal",
      filter_STRING == "present"    ~ "STRING",
      filter_BIOGRID == "present"   ~ "BIOGRID",
      TRUE                          ~ "baseline"
    ),
    edge_color = evidence_palette_hela[evidence_tier]
  )
```


## Chunk 2: Generate Network Plots
```{r m12_m6_c2_network_plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# =============================================================================
# HeLa Complex Networks: Generate Plots
# =============================================================================

message("Generating HeLa complex network plots...")

plot_count_hela <- 0
skipped_hela    <- 0

for (i in seq_len(nrow(complexes_to_plot_hela))) {
  cx      <- complexes_to_plot_hela[i, ]
  members <- cx$members[[1]]

  edges <- edge_data_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% members & Gene2 %in% members)

  if (nrow(edges) < 2) { skipped_hela <- skipped_hela + 1; next }

  # --- Source CSV ---
  protein_info_hela <- data.frame(gene = members, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_data_hela %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>% dplyr::distinct() %>%
        dplyr::rename(gene = Gene1, uniprot = Protein1),
      by = "gene"
    )

  edge_info_hela <- edges %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, Protein1, Protein2,
                  AFMprob, RFprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max, support_score,
                  filter_PDB, filter_CORUM, filter_ComplexPortal, filter_STRING, filter_BIOGRID,
                  evidence_tier, n_databases)

  complex_summary_hela <- data.frame(
    complex_idx        = cx$complex_idx,
    complex_size       = cx$complex_size,
    n_edges            = nrow(edges),
    mean_support       = round(mean(edges$support_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_AFMprob       = round(mean(edges$AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    pct_PDB            = round(100 * sum(edges$filter_PDB != "none") / nrow(edges), 1),
    pct_CORUM          = round(100 * sum(edges$filter_CORUM == "present") / nrow(edges), 1),
    pct_ComplexPortal  = round(100 * sum(edges$filter_ComplexPortal != "none") / nrow(edges), 1),
    validation_status  = cx$validation_status,
    corum_matched_name = ifelse(is.na(cx$corum_matched_name), "", cx$corum_matched_name),
    cp_matched_id      = ifelse(is.na(cx$cp_matched_id), "", cx$cp_matched_id)
  )

  csv_path_hela <- file.path(out_dir_cx_nets_csv_hela,
                              paste0(sprintf("%03d", cx$complex_idx), "_complex_data.csv"))

  con <- file(csv_path_hela, "w"); writeLines("## COMPLEX_SUMMARY", con); close(con)
  readr::write_csv(complex_summary_hela, csv_path_hela, append = TRUE)
  con <- file(csv_path_hela, "a"); writeLines("\n## PROTEINS", con); close(con)
  readr::write_csv(protein_info_hela, csv_path_hela, append = TRUE)
  con <- file(csv_path_hela, "a"); writeLines("\n## EDGES", con); close(con)
  readr::write_csv(edge_info_hela, csv_path_hela, append = TRUE)

  # --- Build igraph ---
  g_cx <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    edges %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = data.frame(name = members)
  )

  layout_cx <- if (cx$complex_size <= 10) igraph::layout_in_circle(g_cx) else
               if (cx$complex_size <= 20) igraph::layout_with_kk(g_cx) else
               igraph::layout_with_fr(g_cx)

  # --- Edge attributes ---
  edge_list_cx  <- igraph::as_edgelist(g_cx)
  edge_keys_cx  <- apply(edge_list_cx, 1, function(e) .make_undirected_key(e[1], e[2]))
  edge_match_cx <- match(edge_keys_cx, edges$edge_key)

  igraph::E(g_cx)$color    <- edges$edge_color[edge_match_cx]
  igraph::E(g_cx)$width    <- scales::rescale(edges$support_score[edge_match_cx], to = c(0.8, 4), from = c(0, 9))
  igraph::E(g_cx)$evidence <- edges$evidence_tier[edge_match_cx]

  # --- Title ---
  validation_label_cx <- dplyr::case_when(
    cx$validation_status == "strict_match"  ~ "KNOWN (strict)",
    cx$validation_status == "relaxed_match" ~ "KNOWN (relaxed)",
    TRUE ~ "NOVEL"
  )

  matched_name_cx <- ""
  if (!is.na(cx$corum_matched_name) && cx$corum_matched_name != "") {
    matched_name_cx <- paste0("\n", substr(cx$corum_matched_name, 1, 50))
  } else if (!is.na(cx$cp_matched_id) && cx$cp_matched_id != "") {
    matched_name_cx <- paste0("\nCP: ", cx$cp_matched_id)
  }

  mean_support_cx <- round(mean(edges$support_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  mean_afm_cx     <- round(mean(edges$AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3)

  plot_title_cx <- paste0(
    "Complex ", cx$complex_idx, " | Size: ", cx$complex_size, " | Edges: ", nrow(edges),
    "\n", validation_label_cx, " | Mean Support: ", mean_support_cx, " | Mean AFMprob: ", mean_afm_cx,
    matched_name_cx
  )

  # --- PDF ---
  pdf_path_cx <- file.path(out_dir_cx_nets_hela,
                            paste0(sprintf("%03d", cx$complex_idx), "_network.pdf"))
  pdf(pdf_path_cx, width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 4, 1))

  plot(g_cx,
       layout             = layout_cx,
       vertex.size        = ifelse(cx$complex_size > 30, 6, ifelse(cx$complex_size > 15, 8, 10)),
       vertex.label.cex   = ifelse(cx$complex_size > 30, 0.4, ifelse(cx$complex_size > 15, 0.5, 0.6)),
       vertex.color       = "grey90",
       vertex.frame.color = "grey50",
       edge.color         = igraph::E(g_cx)$color,
       edge.width         = igraph::E(g_cx)$width,
       main               = plot_title_cx)

  evidence_present_cx <- unique(edges$evidence_tier)
  legend("bottomleft",
         legend = evidence_present_cx,
         col    = evidence_palette_hela[evidence_present_cx],
         lwd = 3, bty = "n", cex = 0.6, title = "Edge evidence")

  legend("bottomright",
         legend = c("Low support", "High support"),
         lwd = c(1, 4), col = "gray50", bty = "n", cex = 0.6, title = "Edge width")

  dev.off()

  plot_count_hela <- plot_count_hela + 1
  if (plot_count_hela %% 50 == 0) message("  Generated ", plot_count_hela, " plots...")
}

message("\nHeLa network plots complete:")
message("  Generated : ", plot_count_hela)
message("  Skipped   : ", skipped_hela, " (< 2 edges)")
message("  Output    : ", out_dir_cx_nets_hela)
message("  CSV data  : ", out_dir_cx_nets_csv_hela)
```
