# Module 7: KO Vulnerability Analysis (HeLa)
Significance-filtered PPI/trimer/tetramer/complex vulnerability across 39 HeLa KOs
both p and q thresholds evaluated throughout

## Chunk 0: Setup and Configuration
```{r m12_m7_c0_setup}
# =============================================================================
# Setup: libraries, thresholds, disease classes, output dirs, helpers
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(igraph)
library(fmsb)

# --- Disease class definitions ---
# Priority order: Sphingolipidoses and NCL first; duplicate KOs (e.g. GLB1,
# ATP13A2) are assigned to the highest-priority matching class.
disease_classes_hela <- list(
  Sphingolipidoses                    = c("ARSA", "ASAH1", "GALC", "GBA1", "GLA", "GLB1", "GM2A", "HEXA", "HEXB", "PSAP", "SMPD1"),
  Neuronal.ceroid.lipofuscinoses      = c("PPT1", "CTSD", "GRN", "ATP13A2", "CTSF", "KCTD7", "TPP1", "CLN3", "DNAJC5", "CLN5", "CLN6", "MFSD8", "CLN8"),
  Mucopolysaccharidoses               = c("GLB1", "ARSB", "GALNS", "GNS", "GUSB", "HGSNAT", "HYAL1", "IDS", "IDUA", "NAGLU", "SGSH"),
  Glycoproteinoses                    = c("AGA", "CTSA", "FUCA", "MAN2B1", "MANBA", "NAGA", "NEU1"),
  Integral.membrane.protein.disorders = c("ATP13A2", "CLN3", "CTNS", "LAMP2", "MCOLN1", "NPC1", "NPC2", "SCARB2", "SLC17A5"),
  PTM.defects                         = c("GNPTAB", "GNPTG", "SUMF1"),
  Lipid.storage.diseases              = c("GAA", "LIPA")
)

disease_colors_hela <- c(
  Sphingolipidoses                    = "#D53E4F",
  Neuronal.ceroid.lipofuscinoses      = "#FEE08B",
  Mucopolysaccharidoses               = "#F46D43",
  Glycoproteinoses                    = "#FDAE61",
  Integral.membrane.protein.disorders = "#E6F598",
  PTM.defects                         = "#ABDDA4",
  Lipid.storage.diseases              = "#66C2A5"
)

disease_priority_hela <- names(disease_classes_hela)  # priority = list order

# KO -> primary disease class (priority-resolved, one class per KO)
ko_to_class_hela <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_classes_hela, ~data.frame(KO = .x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), .id = "class") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(class = factor(class, levels = disease_priority_hela)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(KO, class) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(KO, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(class = as.character(class))

message("Disease class mapping: ", nrow(ko_to_class_hela), " KOs assigned")

# --- HeLa radar annotations: exclude neuronal/synaptic compartments ---
radar_annotations_hela <- intersect(
  c("Mito", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "MitoIMS",
    "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI", "Golgi", "Lysosome", "ER",
    "Cytoplasm", "Nucleus", "Autophagy", "EndoLyso",
    "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome", "vATPase"),
  organelle_tags   # defined in M12 M2 from binary_matrix
)
message("Radar annotations (HeLa): ", paste(radar_annotations_hela, collapse = ", "))

# --- Output dirs ---
out_dir_vuln_hela <- file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "KO_eval")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/global"),    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/complexes"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/radar"),     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/radar/by_disease_class"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables"),          recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "sourcedata"),      recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "sourcedata/radar"),recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Helper: save plot + sourcedata CSV ---
save_plot_sd_hela <- function(plot, filename, data, width = 6, height = 5) {
  pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, paste0(filename, ".pdf"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(pdf_path, plot, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
  csv_path <- file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "sourcedata", paste0(basename(filename), "_sourcedata.csv"))
  readr::write_csv(data, csv_path)
  message("Saved: ", basename(pdf_path))
  invisible(list(pdf = pdf_path, csv = csv_path))
}

message("Module 7 setup complete")
message("  Significance: p < 0.05 and q < 0.05 evaluated in parallel")
```


## Chunk 1: Build Significance-Filtered Proteome Data
```{r m12_m7_c1_proteome}
# =============================================================================
# Build proteome significance table from hela_log2fc_summary_stats (M0 C6)
# No neuron dimension -- single cell type
# =============================================================================

message("Building HeLa significance-filtered proteome data...")

# Flags (is_sig_p/q, is_lost_p/q, is_gained_p/q) pre-computed in M0 C6 -- use directly
prot_long_hela <- hela_log2fc_summary_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(ko_gene %in% colnames(hela_log2fc_wide_qc)[-1])

ko_list_hela <- unique(prot_long_hela$ko_gene)
message("  KOs in analysis: ", length(ko_list_hela))

# Significance summary per KO
sig_summary_hela <- prot_long_hela %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ko_gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_proteins  = dplyr::n(),
    n_sig_p     = sum(is_sig_p,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_q     = sum(is_sig_q,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p    = sum(is_lost_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_q    = sum(is_lost_q, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_gained_p  = sum(is_gained_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_gained_q  = sum(is_gained_q, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ko_to_class_hela, by = c("ko_gene" = "KO")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DiseaseClass = class)

readr::write_csv(sig_summary_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "significance_summary.csv"))
message("  Saved: significance_summary.csv")
message("Chunk 1 complete")
```


## Chunk 2: Build KO Edge States Table
```{r m12_m7_c2_edge_states}
# =============================================================================
# KO edge states: for each baseline PPI x KO, classify as lost/retained/unknown
# Uses significance flags from prot_long_hela; both p and q state columns
# Also builds shared_long_hela_full for radar plots (all shared org tags per edge)
# =============================================================================

message("Building HeLa KO edge states table...")

# Minimal baseline columns for cross-join
# baseline_ppi_hela is the annotated version -- baseline_ppi_hela_ann is saved back as baseline_ppi_hela at end of M2 C2
baseline_edge_hela <- baseline_ppi_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, support_score, in_both_predictions,
                dplyr::any_of(paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")),
                dplyr::any_of(paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")))

message("  Baseline PPIs: ", nrow(baseline_edge_hela))

# Cross-join baseline x KO list
ko_dummy_hela <- data.frame(ko_gene = ko_list_hela, dummy = 1L)
edge_dummy_hela <- baseline_edge_hela %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1L)

baseline_expanded_hela <- edge_dummy_hela %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ko_dummy_hela, by = "dummy", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dummy)

message("  Expanded table rows: ", nrow(baseline_expanded_hela))

# Sig lookup per protein x KO
prot_sig_hela <- prot_long_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, mean_log2FC, is_lost_p, is_lost_q, is_gained_p, is_gained_q)

ko_edge_states_hela <- baseline_expanded_hela %>%
  dplyr::left_join(prot_sig_hela, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "ko_gene")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(fc_A = mean_log2FC, lost_A_p = is_lost_p, lost_A_q = is_lost_q,
                gained_A_p = is_gained_p, gained_A_q = is_gained_q) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(prot_sig_hela, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "ko_gene")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(fc_B = mean_log2FC, lost_B_p = is_lost_p, lost_B_q = is_lost_q,
                gained_B_p = is_gained_p, gained_B_q = is_gained_q) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    state_q = dplyr::case_when(
      lost_A_q | lost_B_q       ~ "lost",
      !is.na(fc_A) | !is.na(fc_B) ~ "retained",
      TRUE                       ~ "unknown"
    ),
    state_p = dplyr::case_when(
      lost_A_p | lost_B_p       ~ "lost",
      !is.na(fc_A) | !is.na(fc_B) ~ "retained",
      TRUE                       ~ "unknown"
    ),
    loss_driver_q = dplyr::case_when(
      lost_A_q & lost_B_q ~ "both", lost_A_q ~ "Gene1", lost_B_q ~ "Gene2", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    loss_driver_p = dplyr::case_when(
      lost_A_p & lost_B_p ~ "both", lost_A_p ~ "Gene1", lost_B_p ~ "Gene2", TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ko_to_class_hela, by = c("ko_gene" = "KO")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DiseaseClass = class)

# Shared organelle per edge (first match, for summary tables)
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")
exist_p1  <- intersect(org1_cols, colnames(ko_edge_states_hela))
exist_p2  <- intersect(org2_cols, colnames(ko_edge_states_hela))
exist_tags_ko <- sub("_prot1$", "", exist_p1)

if (length(exist_p1) > 0) {
  m1 <- as.matrix(ko_edge_states_hela[, exist_p1]); m1[is.na(m1)] <- FALSE
  m2 <- as.matrix(ko_edge_states_hela[, exist_p2]); m2[is.na(m2)] <- FALSE
  shared_mat_ko <- m1 & m2
  ko_edge_states_hela$OrgPair <- ifelse(rowSums(shared_mat_ko) > 0, "same", "cross")
  ko_edge_states_hela$shared_organelle <- apply(shared_mat_ko, 1, function(r) {
    idx <- which(r); if (length(idx) > 0) exist_tags_ko[idx[1]] else NA_character_
  })
} else {
  ko_edge_states_hela$OrgPair        <- NA_character_
  ko_edge_states_hela$shared_organelle <- NA_character_
}

# Save (drop heavy annotation columns)
ko_edge_export_hela <- ko_edge_states_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, key, ko_gene, DiseaseClass,
                support_score, in_both_predictions,
                fc_A, fc_B, lost_A_p, lost_A_q, lost_B_p, lost_B_q,
                state_q, state_p, loss_driver_q, loss_driver_p,
                OrgPair, shared_organelle)
readr::write_csv(ko_edge_export_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "ko_edge_states.csv"))

# KO-level summary
ko_summary_hela <- ko_edge_export_hela %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges  = dplyr::n(),
    n_lost_q     = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p     = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained_q = sum(state_q == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost_q  = n_lost_q / total_edges,
    frac_lost_p  = n_lost_p / total_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(ko_summary_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "ko_summary_global.csv"))

# KO x organelle summary
ko_org_summary_hela <- ko_edge_export_hela %>%
  dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same", !is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, shared_organelle) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges     = dplyr::n(),
    n_lost_q    = sum(state_q == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost_p    = sum(state_p == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost_q = n_lost_q / n_edges,
    frac_lost_p = n_lost_p / n_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(ko_org_summary_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "ko_summary_by_organelle.csv"))

# --- shared_long_hela_full: all shared org tags per edge (for radar) ---
# Use distinct edges from baseline (not the expanded KO table)
edge_annot_base_hela <- baseline_edge_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(key, dplyr::all_of(exist_p1), dplyr::all_of(exist_p2)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)

m_p1 <- as.matrix(edge_annot_base_hela[, exist_p1]); m_p1[is.na(m_p1)] <- FALSE
m_p2 <- as.matrix(edge_annot_base_hela[, exist_p2]); m_p2[is.na(m_p2)] <- FALSE
shared_mat_base_hela <- m_p1 & m_p2
colnames(shared_mat_base_hela) <- exist_tags_ko

shared_long_hela_full <- as.data.frame(shared_mat_base_hela) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(key = edge_annot_base_hela$key) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-key, names_to = "tag", values_to = "shared") %>%
  dplyr::filter(shared) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, tag)

message("  shared_long_hela_full: ", nrow(shared_long_hela_full), " edge-tag pairs")
message("Chunk 2 complete: ", nrow(ko_edge_export_hela), " edge x KO rows")
```

## Chunk 3: Trimer Vulnerability
```{r m12_m7_c3_trimers}
# =============================================================================
# Trimer vulnerability: for each trimer x KO, count lost members (p and q)
# =============================================================================

message("Analyzing HeLa trimer vulnerability...")

trimer_genes_hela <- trimer_evidence_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3)

prot_sig_trim_hela <- prot_long_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, mean_log2FC, is_lost_p, is_lost_q)

trimer_vuln_list_hela <- lapply(ko_list_hela, function(ko) {
  loss_data <- prot_sig_trim_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(ko_gene == ko) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, mean_log2FC, is_lost_p, is_lost_q)

  trimer_genes_hela %>%
    dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc1 = mean_log2FC, lost1_p = is_lost_p, lost1_q = is_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc2 = mean_log2FC, lost2_p = is_lost_p, lost2_q = is_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene3" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc3 = mean_log2FC, lost3_p = is_lost_p, lost3_q = is_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ko_gene  = ko,
      n_lost_q = rowSums(cbind(lost1_q, lost2_q, lost3_q), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lost_p = rowSums(cbind(lost1_p, lost2_p, lost3_p), na.rm = TRUE),
      state_q  = dplyr::if_else(n_lost_q >= 1, "disrupted", "intact"),
      state_p  = dplyr::if_else(n_lost_p >= 1, "disrupted", "intact")
    )
})

trimer_ko_states_hela <- dplyr::bind_rows(trimer_vuln_list_hela) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ko_to_class_hela, by = c("ko_gene" = "KO")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DiseaseClass = class)

readr::write_csv(trimer_ko_states_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "trimer_ko_states.csv"))

trimer_summary_ko_hela <- trimer_ko_states_hela %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_trimers    = dplyr::n(),
    n_disrupted_q    = sum(state_q == "disrupted"),
    n_disrupted_p    = sum(state_p == "disrupted"),
    frac_disrupted_q = n_disrupted_q / total_trimers,
    frac_disrupted_p = n_disrupted_p / total_trimers,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(trimer_summary_ko_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "trimer_summary_ko.csv"))

message("Chunk 3 complete: trimer vulnerability done")
```


## Chunk 4: Tetramer Vulnerability
```{r m12_m7_c4_tetramers}
# =============================================================================
# Tetramer vulnerability: same logic as trimers, 4 members
# =============================================================================

message("Analyzing HeLa tetramer vulnerability...")

if (nrow(tetramer_evidence_hela) == 0) {
  message("  No tetramers detected -- skipping")
  tetramer_summary_ko_hela <- data.frame(ko_gene = ko_list_hela, DiseaseClass = NA,
    total_tetramers = 0, n_disrupted_q = 0, n_disrupted_p = 0,
    frac_disrupted_q = NA_real_, frac_disrupted_p = NA_real_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  tetramer_genes_hela <- tetramer_evidence_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(tetramer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4)

  prot_sig_tet_hela <- prot_long_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, mean_log2FC, is_lost_p, is_lost_q)

  tetramer_vuln_list_hela <- lapply(ko_list_hela, function(ko) {
    loss_data <- prot_sig_tet_hela %>%
      dplyr::filter(ko_gene == ko) %>%
      dplyr::select(Genes, mean_log2FC, is_lost_p, is_lost_q)

    tetramer_genes_hela %>%
      dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(fc1 = mean_log2FC, lost1_p = is_lost_p, lost1_q = is_lost_q) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(fc2 = mean_log2FC, lost2_p = is_lost_p, lost2_q = is_lost_q) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene3" = "Genes")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(fc3 = mean_log2FC, lost3_p = is_lost_p, lost3_q = is_lost_q) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(loss_data, by = c("Gene4" = "Genes")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(fc4 = mean_log2FC, lost4_p = is_lost_p, lost4_q = is_lost_q) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        ko_gene  = ko,
        n_lost_q = rowSums(cbind(lost1_q, lost2_q, lost3_q, lost4_q), na.rm = TRUE),
        n_lost_p = rowSums(cbind(lost1_p, lost2_p, lost3_p, lost4_p), na.rm = TRUE),
        state_q  = dplyr::if_else(n_lost_q >= 1, "disrupted", "intact"),
        state_p  = dplyr::if_else(n_lost_p >= 1, "disrupted", "intact")
      )
  })

  tetramer_ko_states_hela <- dplyr::bind_rows(tetramer_vuln_list_hela) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(ko_to_class_hela, by = c("ko_gene" = "KO")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(DiseaseClass = class)

  readr::write_csv(tetramer_ko_states_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "tetramer_ko_states.csv"))

  tetramer_summary_ko_hela <- tetramer_ko_states_hela %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_tetramers  = dplyr::n(),
      n_disrupted_q    = sum(state_q == "disrupted"),
      n_disrupted_p    = sum(state_p == "disrupted"),
      frac_disrupted_q = n_disrupted_q / total_tetramers,
      frac_disrupted_p = n_disrupted_p / total_tetramers,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  readr::write_csv(tetramer_summary_ko_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "tetramer_summary_ko.csv"))
}

message("Chunk 4 complete: tetramer vulnerability done")
```


## Chunk 5: Complex Vulnerability + Heatmaps
```{r m12_m7_c5_complexes}
# =============================================================================
# Complex vulnerability: disruption threshold scales with complex size
#   size <= 4: any 1 lost member = disrupted
#   size >  4: >= 25% members lost = disrupted
# Two heatmaps: rows annotated by majority_organelle and by validation_status
# =============================================================================

message("Analyzing HeLa complex vulnerability...")

# Derive validation_status if not already present (added in M6 but may not persist)
if (!"validation_status" %in% colnames(complex_evidence_hela)) {
  complex_evidence_hela <- complex_evidence_hela %>%
    dplyr::mutate(validation_status = dplyr::case_when(
      in_known_complex         ~ "strict_match",
      in_known_complex_relaxed ~ "relaxed_match",
      TRUE                     ~ "novel"
    ))
}

complex_members_hela <- complex_evidence_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_idx, complex_size, majority_organelle, validation_status,
                corum_matched_name, cp_matched_id, members)

prot_loss_q_hela <- prot_long_hela %>% dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, is_lost_q) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ko_gene, values_from = is_lost_q)
prot_loss_p_hela <- prot_long_hela %>% dplyr::select(Genes, ko_gene, is_lost_p) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ko_gene, values_from = is_lost_p)

# Build named vectors per KO for fast lookup
complex_vuln_list_hela <- lapply(ko_list_hela, function(ko) {
  loss_q <- prot_long_hela %>% dplyr::filter(ko_gene == ko) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, is_lost_q) %>% tibble::deframe()
  loss_p <- prot_long_hela %>% dplyr::filter(ko_gene == ko) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, is_lost_p) %>% tibble::deframe()

  complex_members_hela %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_members   = length(members),
      n_lost_q    = sum(loss_q[members], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lost_p    = sum(loss_p[members], na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost_q = n_lost_q / n_members,
      frac_lost_p = n_lost_p / n_members,
      state_q = dplyr::case_when(
        n_members <= 4 & n_lost_q >= 1        ~ "disrupted",
        n_members >  4 & frac_lost_q >= 0.25  ~ "disrupted",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      ),
      state_p = dplyr::case_when(
        n_members <= 4 & n_lost_p >= 1        ~ "disrupted",
        n_members >  4 & frac_lost_p >= 0.25  ~ "disrupted",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ko_gene = ko)
})

complex_ko_states_hela <- dplyr::bind_rows(complex_vuln_list_hela) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ko_to_class_hela, by = c("ko_gene" = "KO")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DiseaseClass = class)

complex_ko_export_hela <- complex_ko_states_hela %>% dplyr::select(-members)
readr::write_csv(complex_ko_export_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "complex_ko_states.csv"))

complex_summary_ko_hela <- complex_ko_states_hela %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_complexes  = dplyr::n(),
    n_disrupted_q    = sum(state_q == "disrupted"),
    n_disrupted_p    = sum(state_p == "disrupted"),
    frac_disrupted_q = n_disrupted_q / total_complexes,
    frac_disrupted_p = n_disrupted_p / total_complexes,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(complex_summary_ko_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "complex_summary_ko.csv"))

# =============================================================================
# Heatmap 1: complexes x KOs, row annotation = majority_organelle
# Heatmap 2: complexes x KOs, row annotation = validation_status
# Both: q-value disruption binary; KO columns colored by DiseaseClass
# =============================================================================
message("Generating complex vulnerability heatmaps...")

# Build binary disruption matrix (complexes x KOs, q-value)
hm_data_hela <- complex_ko_states_hela %>%
  dplyr::mutate(disrupted_bin = as.integer(state_q == "disrupted")) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_idx, ko_gene, disrupted_bin) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ko_gene, values_from = disrupted_bin, values_fill = 0L)

if (nrow(hm_data_hela) >= 2 && ncol(hm_data_hela) >= 3) {
  hm_mat_hela <- as.matrix(hm_data_hela[, -1])
  rownames(hm_mat_hela) <- hm_data_hela$complex_idx

  # Row annotations
  cx_annot_hela <- complex_evidence_hela %>%
    dplyr::distinct(complex_idx, majority_organelle, validation_status) %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_idx %in% rownames(hm_mat_hela)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(cx_annot_hela) <- cx_annot_hela$complex_idx
  cx_annot_hela <- cx_annot_hela[rownames(hm_mat_hela), , drop = FALSE]

  # Column annotation (disease class per KO)
  ko_in_mat <- colnames(hm_mat_hela)
  col_annot_hela <- ko_to_class_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(KO %in% ko_in_mat) %>%
    dplyr::select(KO, class) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(col_annot_hela) <- col_annot_hela$KO
  col_annot_hela <- col_annot_hela[ko_in_mat, "class", drop = FALSE]
  colnames(col_annot_hela) <- "DiseaseClass"

  dc_present  <- intersect(names(disease_colors_hela), unique(na.omit(col_annot_hela$DiseaseClass)))
  org_present <- unique(na.omit(cx_annot_hela$majority_organelle))
  vs_present  <- unique(na.omit(cx_annot_hela$validation_status))
  n_org <- length(org_present); n_vs <- length(vs_present)
  org_pal <- setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, min(n_org, 12)), "Set3"))(n_org), org_present)
  vs_pal  <- c(strict_match = "steelblue", relaxed_match = "lightblue", novel = "grey80")[vs_present]

  # Sort rows by n disrupted KOs
  row_sums_hela <- rowSums(hm_mat_hela)
  row_ord_hela  <- order(row_sums_hela, decreasing = TRUE)
  hm_ord_hela   <- hm_mat_hela[row_ord_hela, , drop = FALSE]

  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(hm_ord_hela) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("complex_idx"),
    file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "sourcedata", "complex_heatmap_qval_sourcedata.csv"))

  # Heatmap 1: row annotation = majority_organelle
  row_annot_org <- cx_annot_hela[rownames(hm_ord_hela), "majority_organelle", drop = FALSE]
  ann_colors_org <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_colors_hela[dc_present],
                         majority_organelle = org_pal)

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/complexes", "heatmap_complex_vuln_by_organelle.pdf"), width = 12, height = 18)
  pheatmap::pheatmap(hm_ord_hela,
    color = c("grey95", "#C51B7D"), breaks = c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5),
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = TRUE, clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_row = row_annot_org, annotation_col = col_annot_hela,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors_org,
    show_rownames = FALSE, fontsize = 6, fontsize_col = 7, cellwidth = 8, border_color = NA,
    main = paste0("Complex Vulnerability (q < 0.05)\n", nrow(hm_ord_hela), " complexes x ", ncol(hm_ord_hela), " KOs | annotated by organelle"))
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: heatmap_complex_vuln_by_organelle.pdf")

  # Heatmap 2: row annotation = validation_status
  row_annot_vs <- cx_annot_hela[rownames(hm_ord_hela), "validation_status", drop = FALSE]
  ann_colors_vs <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_colors_hela[dc_present],
                        validation_status = vs_pal)

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/complexes", "heatmap_complex_vuln_by_validation.pdf"), width = 12, height = 18)
  pheatmap::pheatmap(hm_ord_hela,
    color = c("grey95", "#C51B7D"), breaks = c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5),
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = TRUE, clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_row = row_annot_vs, annotation_col = col_annot_hela,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors_vs,
    show_rownames = FALSE, fontsize = 6, fontsize_col = 7, cellwidth = 8, border_color = NA,
    main = paste0("Complex Vulnerability (q < 0.05)\n", nrow(hm_ord_hela), " complexes x ", ncol(hm_ord_hela), " KOs | annotated by validation status"))
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: heatmap_complex_vuln_by_validation.pdf")
} else {
  message("  Insufficient data for complex heatmaps")
}

message("Chunk 5 complete")
```


## Chunk 6: PPI Vulnerability Visualizations
```{r m12_m7_c6_ppi_viz}
# =============================================================================
# PPI vulnerability plots: barplots (q and p), organelle x KO heatmaps,
# structure comparison barplots (Proteins / PPIs / Trimers / Tetramers / Complexes)
# =============================================================================

message("Generating HeLa PPI vulnerability visualizations...")

ko_order_hela <- ko_summary_hela %>%
  dplyr::arrange(DiseaseClass, dplyr::desc(frac_lost_q)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(ko_gene)

# --- Barplot: edge states per KO (q and p) ---
for (sig_type in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig_type)
  plot_data_bar <- ko_edge_export_hela %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, .data[[state_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state = factor(.data[[state_col]], levels = c("retained", "lost", "unknown")),
                  ko_gene = factor(ko_gene, levels = ko_order_hela))

  p_bar <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data_bar, ggplot2::aes(x = ko_gene, y = n, fill = state)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey80", lost = "#C51B7D", unknown = "grey50")) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "PPI edges", title = paste0("PPI edge states per KO (", sig_type, " < 0.05)")) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

  save_plot_sd_hela(p_bar, paste0("plots/global/barplot_ppi_states_", sig_type, "val"), plot_data_bar, width = 8, height = 5)
}

# --- Organelle x KO heatmap (fraction lost, q and p) ---
for (sig_type in c("q", "p")) {
  frac_col <- paste0("frac_lost_", sig_type)
  hm_org_data <- ko_org_summary_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(ko_gene, shared_organelle, dplyr::all_of(frac_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = dplyr::all_of(frac_col), values_fill = NA)

  if (nrow(hm_org_data) < 2) next

  hm_org_mat <- as.matrix(hm_org_data[, -1])
  rownames(hm_org_mat) <- hm_org_data$ko_gene

  ko_in_org <- rownames(hm_org_mat)
  col_annot_org <- ko_to_class_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(KO %in% ko_in_org) %>% as.data.frame()
  rownames(col_annot_org) <- col_annot_org$KO
  col_annot_org <- col_annot_org[ko_in_org, "class", drop = FALSE]
  colnames(col_annot_org) <- "DiseaseClass"
  dc_org <- intersect(names(disease_colors_hela), unique(na.omit(col_annot_org$DiseaseClass)))

  readr::write_csv(hm_org_data,
    file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_organelle_ko_", sig_type, "val_sourcedata.csv")))

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/global", paste0("heatmap_organelle_ko_", sig_type, "val.pdf")), width = 12, height = 10)
  pheatmap::pheatmap(hm_org_mat,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    border_color = NA, fontsize = 6, cellwidth = 10, cellheight = 10,
    cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_row = col_annot_org,
    annotation_colors = list(DiseaseClass = disease_colors_hela[dc_org]),
    main = paste0("Fraction PPIs lost by organelle (", sig_type, " < 0.05)"))
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: heatmap_organelle_ko_", sig_type, "val.pdf")
}

# --- Structure comparison: Proteins / PPIs / Trimers / Tetramers / Complexes ---
comparison_data_hela <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  sig_summary_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, n_lost_p, n_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(structure = "Proteins"),
  ko_summary_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, n_lost_p, n_lost_q) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(structure = "PPIs"),
  trimer_summary_ko_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, n_disrupted_p, n_disrupted_q) %>%
    dplyr::rename(n_lost_p = n_disrupted_p, n_lost_q = n_disrupted_q) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(structure = "Trimers"),
  tetramer_summary_ko_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, n_disrupted_p, n_disrupted_q) %>%
    dplyr::rename(n_lost_p = n_disrupted_p, n_lost_q = n_disrupted_q) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(structure = "Tetramers"),
  complex_summary_ko_hela %>%
    dplyr::select(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, n_disrupted_p, n_disrupted_q) %>%
    dplyr::rename(n_lost_p = n_disrupted_p, n_lost_q = n_disrupted_q) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(structure = "Complexes")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(structure = factor(structure, levels = c("Proteins", "PPIs", "Trimers", "Tetramers", "Complexes")),
                ko_gene = factor(ko_gene, levels = ko_order_hela))

readr::write_csv(comparison_data_hela, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", "structure_loss_comparison.csv"))

for (sig_type in c("q", "p")) {
  y_col <- paste0("n_lost_", sig_type)
  p_facet <- ggplot2::ggplot(comparison_data_hela,
      ggplot2::aes(x = ko_gene, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = DiseaseClass)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~structure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = disease_colors_hela, na.value = "grey70") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = paste0("N lost/disrupted (", sig_type, " < 0.05)"),
                  title = paste0("Structure vulnerability by KO (", sig_type, " < 0.05)")) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                   strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"))

  save_plot_sd_hela(p_facet, paste0("plots/global/barplot_structure_loss_faceted_", sig_type, "val"), comparison_data_hela, width = 10, height = 14)
}
```

## Chunk 8: Radar / Spider Plots
```{r m12_m7_c8_radar}
# =============================================================================
# Radar plots: PPI vulnerability profile by organelle
# Global: one line per disease class (mean lost PPIs / KO in class)
# Per disease class: one line per KO within the class
# Both q and p thresholds; HeLa organelles only (no synaptic/neuronal)
# =============================================================================

message("Generating HeLa radar plots...")

out_dir_radar_hela    <- file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "plots/radar")
out_dir_radar_dc_hela <- file.path(out_dir_radar_hela, "by_disease_class")
out_dir_radar_sd_hela <- file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "sourcedata/radar")

# --- Prepare global radar data (disease class average, one sig type) ---
prepare_radar_global_hela <- function(df_states, shared_long, sig_state_col, radar_anns) {
  shared_tags <- shared_long %>% dplyr::distinct(key, tag)
  df_tagged <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass), tag %in% radar_anns)

  n_per_class <- df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::distinct(ko_gene, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::count(DiseaseClass, name = "n_KOs")

  df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[sig_state_col]] == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(n_per_class, by = "DiseaseClass") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(loss_per_KO = n_lost / n_KOs) %>%
    dplyr::select(DiseaseClass, tag, loss_per_KO) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = loss_per_KO, values_fill = 0) %>%
    { for (a in radar_anns) if (!a %in% colnames(.)) .[[a]] <- 0; . } %>%
    dplyr::select(DiseaseClass, dplyr::all_of(radar_anns))
}

# --- Prepare per-genotype radar data ---
prepare_radar_byko_hela <- function(df_states, shared_long, sig_state_col, radar_anns) {
  shared_tags <- shared_long %>% dplyr::distinct(key, tag)
  df_tagged <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass), tag %in% radar_anns)

  df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[sig_state_col]] == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0) %>%
    { for (a in radar_anns) if (!a %in% colnames(.)) .[[a]] <- 0; . }
}

# --- Plot global radar (one line per disease class) ---
plot_radar_global_hela <- function(radar_data, sig_label, out_dir, radar_anns, out_dir_sd) {
  ann_cols <- intersect(radar_anns, colnames(radar_data))
  if (length(ann_cols) < 3 || nrow(radar_data) < 1) return(invisible(NULL))

  data_mat <- as.data.frame(radar_data[, ann_cols])
  rownames(data_mat) <- radar_data$DiseaseClass
  max_val <- max(data_mat, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  if (max_val == 0) max_val <- 1

  radar_df <- rbind(rep(max_val, ncol(data_mat)), rep(0, ncol(data_mat)), data_mat)
  colnames(radar_df) <- ann_cols

  dc_in_data  <- radar_data$DiseaseClass
  line_colors <- disease_colors_hela[dc_in_data]
  fill_colors <- adjustcolor(line_colors, alpha.f = 0.15)

  fname <- paste0("radar_ppi_global_", sig_label, ".pdf")
  pdf(file.path(out_dir, fname), width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
  fmsb::radarchart(radar_df,
    axistype = 1, pcol = line_colors, pfcol = fill_colors,
    plwd = 2, plty = 1, cglcol = "grey70", cglty = 1, cglwd = 0.8,
    axislabcol = "grey30", vlcex = 0.7, calcex = 0.6,
    title = paste0("PPI Vulnerability by Disease Class (HeLa, ", sig_label, " < 0.05)\nNormalized lost PPIs per KO"))
  legend("topright", legend = dc_in_data, col = line_colors, lwd = 2, lty = 1, bty = "n", cex = 0.7)
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: ", fname)
  readr::write_csv(radar_data, file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0("radar_global_", sig_label, "_sourcedata.csv")))
}

# --- Plot per-disease-class radar (one line per KO) ---
plot_radar_dc_hela <- function(radar_byko, dc, sig_label, out_dir, radar_anns, out_dir_sd) {
  dc_data <- radar_byko %>% dplyr::filter(DiseaseClass == dc)
  if (nrow(dc_data) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  ann_cols <- intersect(radar_anns, colnames(dc_data))
  if (length(ann_cols) < 3) return(invisible(NULL))

  data_mat <- as.data.frame(dc_data[, ann_cols])
  rownames(data_mat) <- dc_data$ko_gene
  max_val <- max(data_mat, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  if (max_val == 0) max_val <- 1

  radar_df <- rbind(rep(max_val, ncol(data_mat)), rep(0, ncol(data_mat)), data_mat)
  colnames(radar_df) <- ann_cols

  base_col   <- disease_colors_hela[dc]
  n_ko       <- nrow(dc_data)
  line_colors <- colorRampPalette(c(base_col, adjustcolor(base_col, red.f = 1.3, green.f = 1.3, blue.f = 1.3)))(n_ko)
  fill_colors <- adjustcolor(line_colors, alpha.f = 0.1)

  dc_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dc)
  fname    <- paste0("radar_", dc_label, "_", sig_label, ".pdf")
  pdf(file.path(out_dir, fname), width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
  fmsb::radarchart(radar_df,
    axistype = 1, pcol = line_colors, pfcol = fill_colors,
    plwd = 2, plty = 1, cglcol = "grey70", cglty = 1, cglwd = 0.8,
    axislabcol = "grey30", vlcex = 0.7, calcex = 0.6,
    title = paste0(dc, " | PPI Vulnerability (", sig_label, " < 0.05)\nLost PPIs per organelle"))
  legend("topright", legend = dc_data$ko_gene, col = line_colors, lwd = 2, lty = 1, bty = "n", cex = 0.65)
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: ", fname)

  src <- dc_data %>% dplyr::select(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, dplyr::all_of(ann_cols))
  readr::write_csv(src, file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0("radar_", dc_label, "_", sig_label, "_sourcedata.csv")))
}

# --- Run all radars for both p and q ---
for (sig_type in c("q", "p")) {
  state_col <- paste0("state_", sig_type)

  # Global
  rd_global <- prepare_radar_global_hela(ko_edge_export_hela, shared_long_hela_full,
                                          state_col, radar_annotations_hela)
  plot_radar_global_hela(rd_global, sig_type, out_dir_radar_hela,
                          radar_annotations_hela, out_dir_radar_sd_hela)
  readr::write_csv(rd_global, file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, "tables", paste0("radar_global_", sig_type, ".csv")))

  # Per disease class
  rd_byko <- prepare_radar_byko_hela(ko_edge_export_hela, shared_long_hela_full,
                                      state_col, radar_annotations_hela)
  dc_present_hela <- unique(na.omit(ko_edge_export_hela$DiseaseClass))
  for (dc in dc_present_hela) {
    plot_radar_dc_hela(rd_byko, dc, sig_type, out_dir_radar_dc_hela,
                       radar_annotations_hela, out_dir_radar_sd_hela)
  }
}

message("Chunk 8 complete: radar plots done")
```

```{r m12_m7_c9_extended_viz}
# --- Helper: build KO x organelle fraction-disrupted summary ---
make_ko_org_hm <- function(ko_states, organelle_col, state_col, n_col, frac_col_name) {
  ko_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[organelle_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ko_gene, DiseaseClass, organelle = .data[[organelle_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total      = dplyr::n(),
      n_disrupted  = sum(.data[[state_col]] == "disrupted", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(frac = n_disrupted / n_total) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!frac_col_name := frac)
}

# --- Helper: draw KO x organelle heatmap ---
draw_ko_org_hm <- function(summary_df, frac_col, title_str, out_path, out_sd_path) {
  hm_wide <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::select(ko_gene, organelle, dplyr::all_of(frac_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = organelle, values_from = dplyr::all_of(frac_col), values_fill = NA)

  if (nrow(hm_wide) < 2 || ncol(hm_wide) < 3) { message("  Insufficient data: ", title_str); return(invisible(NULL)) }

  hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_wide[, -1])
  rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_wide$ko_gene

  # Row annotation: disease class
  row_ann <- ko_to_class_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(KO %in% rownames(hm_mat)) %>% as.data.frame()
  rownames(row_ann) <- row_ann$KO
  row_ann <- row_ann[rownames(hm_mat), "class", drop = FALSE]
  colnames(row_ann) <- "DiseaseClass"
  dc_p <- intersect(names(disease_colors_hela), unique(na.omit(row_ann$DiseaseClass)))

  readr::write_csv(hm_wide, out_sd_path)

  pdf(out_path, width = max(6, ncol(hm_mat) * 0.5 + 2), height = max(5, nrow(hm_mat) * 0.3 + 2))
  pheatmap::pheatmap(hm_mat,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    border_color = NA, fontsize = 6, cellwidth = 12, cellheight = 10,
    cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_row = row_ann,
    annotation_colors = list(DiseaseClass = disease_colors_hela[dc_p]),
    main = title_str)
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: ", basename(out_path))
}

# Precompute baseline layouts for disrupted complexes
cx_to_plot_vuln <- complex_ko_states_hela %>%
  dplyr::filter(state_q == "disrupted" | state_p == "disrupted") %>%
  dplyr::pull(complex_idx) %>%
  unique()

message("  Unique complexes to plot: ", length(cx_to_plot_vuln))

# Edge lookup from baseline (need Gene1, Gene2, key per edge)
baseline_edges_distinct_hela <- baseline_edge_hela %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

baseline_layouts_vuln <- list()
for (cidx in cx_to_plot_vuln) {
  cx_row <- complex_evidence_hela %>% dplyr::filter(complex_idx == cidx)
  if (nrow(cx_row) == 0) next
  members <- cx_row$members[[1]]
  if (length(members) < 2) next

  edges_base <- baseline_edges_distinct_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% members, Gene2 %in% members)
  if (nrow(edges_base) < 1) next

  g_base <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edges_base %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
    directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = members))

  cx_size    <- length(members)
  layout_mat <- if (cx_size <= 10) igraph::layout_in_circle(g_base) else
                if (cx_size <= 20) igraph::layout_with_kk(g_base) else
                igraph::layout_with_fr(g_base)
  rownames(layout_mat) <- igraph::V(g_base)$name
  baseline_layouts_vuln[[as.character(cidx)]] <- list(layout = layout_mat, members = members)
}
message("  Layouts precomputed: ", length(baseline_layouts_vuln))

# --- Plot function: one complex x one KO ---
plot_cx_ko_network_hela <- function(cx_idx, ko, ko_edge_export, complex_evidence_hela,
                                     complex_ko_states_hela, baseline_layouts_vuln,
                                     out_dir, out_dir_sd, sig_col) {
  bl <- baseline_layouts_vuln[[as.character(cx_idx)]]
  if (is.null(bl)) return(invisible(NULL))
  members    <- bl$members
  layout_mat <- bl$layout

  edges_ko <- ko_edge_export %>%
    dplyr::filter(ko_gene == ko, Gene1 %in% members, Gene2 %in% members)
  if (nrow(edges_ko) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  cx_sum <- complex_ko_states_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_idx == cx_idx, ko_gene == ko)
  if (nrow(cx_sum) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  cx_meta   <- complex_evidence_hela %>% dplyr::filter(complex_idx == cx_idx)
  cx_size   <- cx_meta$complex_size[1]

  # Validation label
  val_status  <- dplyr::coalesce(cx_meta$validation_status[1], "novel")
  val_label   <- dplyr::case_when(
    val_status == "strict_match"  ~ "KNOWN (strict)",
    val_status == "relaxed_match" ~ "KNOWN (relaxed)",
    TRUE                          ~ "NOVEL"
  )

  # Matched complex name: CORUM first, then ComplexPortal
  cx_name <- ""
  corum_name <- cx_meta$corum_matched_name[1]
  cp_id      <- cx_meta$cp_matched_id[1]
  if (!is.na(corum_name) && nchar(corum_name) > 0) {
    cx_name <- paste0("\n", substr(corum_name, 1, 50))
  } else if (!is.na(cp_id) && nchar(cp_id) > 0) {
    cx_name <- paste0("\nCP: ", cp_id)
  }

  edge_state_vec <- edges_ko[[sig_col]]

  # Node states from edge states
  node_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    edges_ko %>% dplyr::select(node = Gene1, edge_state = dplyr::all_of(sig_col)),
    edges_ko %>% dplyr::select(node = Gene2, edge_state = dplyr::all_of(sig_col))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(node) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_cx  = dplyr::n(),
                     n_lost = sum(edge_state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(node_state = dplyr::case_when(
      n_lost == n_cx ~ "lost", n_lost > 0 ~ "disrupted", TRUE ~ "retained"))

  g_ko <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edges_ko %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
    directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = members))

  igraph::E(g_ko)$color <- ifelse(edge_state_vec == "lost", "#CC0000", "grey40")
  igraph::E(g_ko)$lty   <- ifelse(edge_state_vec == "lost", 2L, 1L)
  igraph::E(g_ko)$width <- 1.8

  vnames      <- igraph::V(g_ko)$name
  layout_plot <- layout_mat[match(vnames, rownames(layout_mat)), , drop = FALSE]

  node_palette   <- c(lost = "#CC0000", disrupted = "#FD8D3C", retained = "white")
  node_state_vec <- node_states$node_state[match(vnames, node_states$node)]
  node_state_vec[is.na(node_state_vec)] <- "retained"
  vertex_colors  <- node_palette[node_state_vec]

  n_lost_nodes <- sum(node_states$node_state == "lost")
  n_dis_nodes  <- sum(node_states$node_state == "disrupted")
  vsize <- ifelse(cx_size > 30, 6, ifelse(cx_size > 15, 8, 10))
  vlcex <- ifelse(cx_size > 30, 0.4, ifelse(cx_size > 15, 0.5, 0.6))
  sig_label <- toupper(sub("state_", "", sig_col))

  plot_title <- paste0("Complex ", cx_idx, " | ", ko, " [", sig_label, "] | ", val_label,
    "\nSize: ", cx_size, " | Edges: ", nrow(edges_ko),
    " | Lost nodes: ", n_lost_nodes, " | Disrupted nodes: ", n_dis_nodes, cx_name)

  cx_label <- sprintf("%03d", cx_idx)
  pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(cx_label, "_", ko, "_network.pdf"))
  pdf(pdf_path, width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 4, 1))
  plot(g_ko, layout = layout_plot,
    vertex.size = vsize, vertex.label.cex = vlcex,
    vertex.color = vertex_colors, vertex.frame.color = "grey50",
    edge.color = igraph::E(g_ko)$color,
    edge.width = igraph::E(g_ko)$width,
    edge.lty   = igraph::E(g_ko)$lty,
    main = plot_title)
  legend("bottomleft",
    legend = c("Retained edge", "Lost edge", "Node: retained", "Node: disrupted", "Node: lost"),
    col    = c("grey40", "#CC0000", "grey50", "grey50", "grey50"),
    pt.bg  = c(NA, NA, "white", "#FD8D3C", "#CC0000"),
    lwd = c(2, 2, NA, NA, NA), pch = c(NA, NA, 21, 21, 21),
    lty = c(1, 2, NA, NA, NA), pt.cex = c(NA, NA, 1.2, 1.2, 1.2),
    bty = "n", cex = 0.7, title = paste0("PPI state (", sig_label, ")"))
  dev.off()

  readr::write_csv(
    edges_ko %>% dplyr::mutate(complex_idx = cx_idx, sig = sig_label, n_lost_nodes = n_lost_nodes),
    file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0(cx_label, "_", ko, "_sourcedata.csv")))
  readr::write_csv(
    node_states %>% dplyr::mutate(complex_idx = cx_idx, ko_gene = ko, sig = sig_label),
    file.path(out_dir_sd, paste0(cx_label, "_", ko, "_nodestates.csv")))

  invisible(NULL)
}

# --- Run for all disrupted complex x KO, both q and p ---
for (sig_type in c("q", "p")) {
  sig_col      <- paste0("state_", sig_type)
  out_cx_net   <- file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, paste0("plots/complex_networks_", sig_type))
  out_cx_net_sd <- file.path(out_dir_vuln_hela, paste0("sourcedata/complex_networks_", sig_type))

  disrupted_sig_hela <- complex_ko_states_hela %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[sig_col]] == "disrupted",
                  complex_idx %in% as.integer(names(baseline_layouts_vuln)))

  message("  Running ", toupper(sig_type), ": ", nrow(disrupted_sig_hela), " complex x KO combinations")

  plot_n <- 0; skip_n <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(disrupted_sig_hela))) {
    row <- disrupted_sig_hela[i, ]
    result <- tryCatch(
      plot_cx_ko_network_hela(
        cx_idx = row$complex_idx, ko = row$ko_gene,
        ko_edge_export = ko_edge_export_hela,
        complex_evidence_hela = complex_evidence_hela,
        complex_ko_states_hela = complex_ko_states_hela,
        baseline_layouts_vuln = baseline_layouts_vuln,
        out_dir = out_cx_net, out_dir_sd = out_cx_net_sd,
        sig_col = sig_col),
      error = function(e) {
        message("  SKIP cx ", row$complex_idx, " / ", row$ko_gene, ": ", e$message); "error"
      })
    if (identical(result, "error")) skip_n <- skip_n + 1 else plot_n <- plot_n + 1
    if ((plot_n + skip_n) %% 100 == 0) message("  ", plot_n, " done / ", skip_n, " skipped")
  }
  message(toupper(sig_type), " complete: ", plot_n, " plots, ", skip_n, " skipped")
}

message("Chunk 9 complete")
message("\nModule 7 complete")
message("  KOs analyzed  : ", length(ko_list_hela))
message("  Output        : ", out_dir_vuln_hela)
```
